When your [leaf] was being carried away by the Gāyatrī,

sanskrit_iast: parṇamapatattṛtīyasyai divo'dhi | so'yaṃ parṇaḥ somaparṇāddhi jātaḥ | tato harāmi somapīthasyāvaruddhyai | devānāṃ brahmavādaṃ vadatāṃ yat | upāśṛṇoḥ suśravā vai śruto'si | tato māmāviśatu brahmavarcasam | tathsaṃbharaṃstadavarundhīya sākṣāt | yayā te sṛṣṭasyāgneḥ | hetimaśamayatprajāpatiḥ | tāmimāmapradāhāya
meaning: पर्णमपतत्तृतीयस्यै दिवोऽधि । सोऽयं पर्णः सोमपर्णाद्धि जातः । ततो हरामि सोमपीथस्यावरुद्ध्यै । देवानां ब्रह्मवादं वदतां यत् । उपाशृणोः सुश्रवा वै श्रुतोऽसि । ततो मामाविशतु ब्रह्मवर्चसम् । तथ्संभरंस्तदवरुन्धीय साक्षात् । यया ते सृष्टस्याग्नेः । हेतिमशमयत्प्रजापतिः । तामिमामप्रदाहाय

sanskrit_iast: śamīṃ śāntyai harāmyaham | yatte sṛṣṭasya yataḥ | vikaṅkataṃ bhā ārchajjātavedaḥ | tayā bhāsā saṃmitaḥ | uruṃ no lokamanu prabhāhi | yatte tāntasya hṛdayamācchindañjātavedaḥ | maruto'dbhistamayitvā | etatte tadaśaneḥ saṃbharāmi | sātmā agne sahṛdayo bhaveha | citriyādaśvatthāthsaṃbhṛtā bṛhatyaḥ
meaning: शमीं शान्त्यै हराम्यहम् । यत्ते सृष्टस्य यतः । विकङ्कतं भा आर्छज्जातवेदः । तया भासा संमितः । उरुं नो लोकमनु प्रभाहि । यत्ते तान्तस्य हृदयमाच्छिन्दञ्जातवेदः । मरुतोऽद्भिस्तमयित्वा । एतत्ते तदशनेः संभरामि । सात्मा अग्ने सहृदयो भवेह । चित्रियादश्वत्थाथ्संभृता बृहत्यः
text_mt:
I bring for appeasement.
When your light, O Jātavedas, as you were created,
surpassed the viṅkaṅkata tree,
measured by that light,
shine forth along our broad world!
When the Maruts, having choked it with waters, torn away the heart
of you, exhausted, O Jātavedas,
that [heart] of yours I collect from the thunderbolt;
here, O Agni, be endowed with self and endowed with heart!
Gathered from the sacred aśvattha tree, the great [verses]...

sanskrit_iast: śarīramabhi saṃskṛtāḥ stha | prajāpatinā yajñamukhena saṃmitāḥ | tisrastrivṛdbhirmithunāḥ prajātyai | aśvatthāddhavyavāhāddhi jātām | agnestanūṃ yajñiyāṃ saṃbharāmi | śāntayoniṃ śamīgarbham | agnaye prajanayitave | yo aśvatthaḥ śamīgarbhaḥ | āruroha tve sacā | taṃ te harāmi brahmaṇā
meaning: शरीरमभि संस्कृताः स्थ । प्रजापतिना यज्ञमुखेन संमिताः । तिस्रस्त्रिवृद्भिर्मिथुनाः प्रजात्यै । अश्वत्थाद्धव्यवाहाद्धि जाताम् । अग्नेस्तनूं यज्ञियां संभरामि । शान्तयोनिं शमीगर्भम् । अग्नये प्रजनयितवे । यो अश्वत्थः शमीगर्भः । आरुरोह त्वे सचा । तं ते हरामि ब्रह्मणा
text_mt: Formed for the body are you, / matched by Prajāpati the face of the sacrifice, / three united pairs with the threefold ones for procreation. / Born from the Aśvattha, carrying the oblation, / I gather Agni's sacrificial body, / whose womb is pacified, born within the Śamī, / for Agni to be engendered. / The Aśvattha that, pregnant with the Śamī, / mounted upon you in unison, / that I bring to you with the brahman,

sanskrit_iast: yajñiyaiḥ ketubhiḥ saha | yaṃ tvā samabharañjātavedaḥ | yathā śarīraṃ bhūteṣu nyaktam | sa saṃbhṛtaḥ sīda śivaḥ prajābhyaḥ | uruṃ no lokamanuneṣi vidvān | pravedhase kavaye medhyāya | vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe | yato bhayamabhayaṃ tanno astu | ava devān yaje heḍyān | samidhā'gniṃ duvasyata
meaning: यज्ञियैः केतुभिः सह । यं त्वा समभरञ्जातवेदः । यथा शरीरं भूतेषु न्यक्तम् । स संभृतः सीद शिवः प्रजाभ्यः । उरुं नो लोकमनुनेषि विद्वान् । प्रवेधसे कवये मेध्याय । वचो वन्दारु वृषभाय वृष्णे । यतो भयमभयं तन्नो अस्तु । अव देवान् यजे हेड्यान् । समिधाऽग्निं दुवस्यत
text_mt: together with sacrificial banners. / As you were gathered, Jātavedas, / according to each body inherent in creatures, / so gathered, sit down propitious to offspring; / wise one, lead us to a wide realm. / To the wise, the poet, the one worthy of sacrifice, / words of praise to the bull, the virile, / whence there is fear, let there be freedom from fear for us from that; / I sacrifice away the deities' anger. / Attend to Agni with fuel,

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtairbodhayatātithim | ā'smin havyā juhotana | upa tvā'gne haviṣmatīḥ | ghṛtācīryantu haryata | juṣasva samidho mama | taṃ tvā samidbhiraṅgiraḥ | ghṛtena vardhayāmasi | bṛhacchocā yaviṣṭhya | samidhyamānaḥ prathamo nu dharmaḥ | samaktubhirajyate viśvavāraḥ
meaning: घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम् । आऽस्मिन् हव्या जुहोतन । उप त्वाऽग्ने हविष्मतीः । घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत । जुषस्व समिधो मम । तं त्वा समिद्भिरङ्गिरः । घृतेन वर्धयामसि । बृहच्छोचा यविष्ठ्य । समिध्यमानः प्रथमो नु धर्मः । समक्तुभिरज्यते विश्ववारः
text_mt: awaken the guest with clarified butter, / pour oblations into him. / Towards you, Agni, let the oblation-bearing / ladles dripping with clarified butter approach, o desired one; / enjoy my fuel-sticks. / Thee, Agni, with fuel, o Aṅgiras, / with clarified butter we magnify, / shine brightly, youngest one. / Being kindled, the first ordinance now, / anointed with unguents, possessing all boons,

sanskrit_iast: śociṣkeśo ghṛtanirṇikpāvakaḥ | suyajño agniryajathāya devān | ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayoniragniḥ | ghṛtaiḥ samiddho ghṛtamasyānnam | ghṛtapruṣastvā sarito vahanti | ghṛtaṃ pibanthsuyajā yakṣi devān | āyurdā agne haviṣo juṣāṇaḥ | ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayoniredhi | ghṛtaṃ pītvā madhu cāru gavyam | piteva putramabhi rakṣatādimam
meaning: शोचिष्केशो घृतनिर्णिक्पावकः । सुयज्ञो अग्निर्यजथाय देवान् । घृतप्रतीको घृतयोनिरग्निः । घृतैः समिद्धो घृतमस्यान्नम् । घृतप्रुषस्त्वा सरितो वहन्ति । घृतं पिबन्थ्सुयजा यक्षि देवान् । आयुर्दा अग्ने हविषो जुषाणः । घृतप्रतीको घृतयोनिरेधि । घृतं पीत्वा मधु चारु गव्यम् । पितेव पुत्रमभि रक्षतादिमम्
text_mt: hair of flames, robed in clarified butter, purifying, / sacrificial Agni, for sacrificing to the gods. / Having clarified butter as womb is Agni; / kindled with clarified butter, clarified butter is his food; / streams dripping with clarified butter bear you; / drinking clarified butter, sacrificer of good sacrifices, sacrifice to the gods. / Bestower of lifespan, Agni, taking pleasure in the oblation, / having clarified butter for face, having clarified butter for womb be; / having drunk clarified butter, honey, pleasant, of the cow, / as a father his son, do you protect this man.

sanskrit_iast: tvāmagne samidhānaṃ yaviṣṭha | devā dūtaṃ cakrire havyavāham | urujrayasaṃ ghṛtayonimāhutam | tveṣaṃ cakṣurdadhire codayanvati | tvāmagne pradiva āhutaṃ ghṛtena | sumnāyavaḥ suṣamidhā samīdhire | sa vāvṛdhāna oṣadhībhirukṣitaḥ | urujrayāṃsi pārthivā vitiṣṭhase | ghṛtapratīkaṃ va ṛtasya dhūrṣadam | agniṃ mitraṃ na samidhāna ṛñjate
meaning: त्वामग्ने समिधानं यविष्ठ । देवा दूतं चक्रिरे हव्यवाहम् । उरुज्रयसं घृतयोनिमाहुतम् । त्वेषं चक्षुर्दधिरे चोदयन्वति । त्वामग्ने प्रदिव आहुतं घृतेन । सुम्नायवः सुषमिधा समीधिरे । स वावृधान ओषधीभिरुक्षितः । उरुज्रयांसि पार्थिवा वितिष्ठसे । घृतप्रतीकं व ऋतस्य धूर्षदम् । अग्निं मित्रं न समिधान ऋञ्जते
text_mt: Thee, Agni, being kindled, youngest one, / the gods made the messenger, the oblation-bearer; / of wide course, having clarified butter as womb, offered unto, / a dazzling sight they placed in the urging [offering]. / Thee, Agni, offered unto with clarified butter from of old, / desiring favor, with good fuel they kindled; / he, grown great, sprinkled by the plants, / spreadest over the wide terrestrial realms. / Having clarified butter for face and seated at the helm of cosmic order, / men adorn Agni as a friend when kindled.

sanskrit_iast: indhāno akro vidatheṣu dīdyat | śukravarṇāmudu no yaṃsate dhiyam | prajā agne saṃvāsaya | āśāśca paśubhiḥ saha | rāṣṭrāṇyasmā ādhehi | yānyāsanthsavituḥ save | mahī viśpatnī sadane ṛtasya | arvācī etaṃ dharuṇe rayīṇām | antarvatnī janyaṃ jātavedasam | adhvarāṇāṃ janayathaḥ purogām
meaning: इन्धानो अक्रो विदथेषु दीद्यत् । शुक्रवर्णामुदु नो यंसते धियम् । प्रजा अग्ने संवासय । आशाश्च पशुभिः सह । राष्ट्राण्यस्मा आधेहि । यान्यासन्थ्सवितुः सवे । मही विश्पत्नी सदने ऋतस्य । अर्वाची एतं धरुणे रयीणाम् । अन्तर्वत्नी जन्यं जातवेदसम् । अध्वराणां जनयथः पुरोगाम्
text_mt: Kindled, the swift horse shining at assemblies, / will lift up our bright-hued prayer. / Make the offspring dwell together, Agni, / and the quarters together with domestic animals; / bestow dominions on him / which were in the impulsion of Savitṛ. / Mighty, mistress of the clan, in the seat of the cosmic order, / come turning hither, in the support of riches; / pregnant with the related Jātavedas, / bring forth the leader of the sacrificial rites.

sanskrit_iast: ārohataṃ daśataṃ śakvarīrmama | ṛtenāgna āyuṣā varcasā saha | jyogjīvanta uttarāmuttarāṃ samām | darśamahaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajñaṃ yathā yajai | ṛtviyavatī stho agniretasau | garbhaṃ dadhāthāṃ te vāmahaṃ dade | tathsatyaṃ yadvīraṃ bibhṛthaḥ | vīraṃ janayiṣyathaḥ | te matprātaḥ prajaniṣyethe | te mā prajāte prajanayiṣyathaḥ
meaning: आरोहतं दशतं शक्वरीर्मम । ऋतेनाग्न आयुषा वर्चसा सह । ज्योग्जीवन्त उत्तरामुत्तरां समाम् । दर्शमहं पूर्णमासं यज्ञं यथा यजै । ऋत्वियवती स्थो अग्निरेतसौ । गर्भं दधाथां ते वामहं ददे । तथ्सत्यं यद्वीरं बिभृथः । वीरं जनयिष्यथः । ते मत्प्रातः प्रजनिष्येथे । ते मा प्रजाते प्रजनयिष्यथः
text_mt: Mount, you two, my ten Śakvarīs, / with cosmic order, Agni, with lifespan, with luster; / living long through each succeeding year, / so that I may perform the New-moon and Full-moon sacrifice. / You two are possessed of the season, bearing the seed of Agni; / you two bear the embryo, these two of you I take; / that is true: that you bear a hero, / you will bring forth a hero; / you two shall be born from me in the morning, / you, having brought forth, will cause me to bring forth,

sanskrit_iast: prajayā paśubhirbrahmavarcasena suvarge loke | anṛtāthsatyamupaimi | mānuṣāddaivyamupaimi | daivīṃ vācaṃ yacchāmi | śalkairagnimindhānaḥ | ubhau lokau sanemaham | ubhayorlokayorṛddhvā | ati mṛtyuṃ tarāmyaham | jātavedo bhuvanasya retaḥ | iha siñca tapaso yajjaniṣyate
meaning: प्रजया पशुभिर्ब्रह्मवर्चसेन सुवर्गे लोके । अनृताथ्सत्यमुपैमि । मानुषाद्दैव्यमुपैमि । दैवीं वाचं यच्छामि । शल्कैरग्निमिन्धानः । उभौ लोकौ सनेमहम् । उभयोर्लोकयोरृद्ध्वा । अति मृत्युं तराम्यहम् । जातवेदो भुवनस्य रेतः । इह सिञ्च तपसो यज्जनिष्यते
text_mt: with offspring, with domestic animals, with spiritual preeminence in the heavenly realm. / From untruth I approach the truth, / from the human I approach the divine, / I restrain speech for the divine. / Kindling Agni with wood-chips, / may I win both worlds; / having prospered in both worlds, / I cross beyond death. / Jātavedas, seed of the world, / pour here what will be born from ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast: agnimaśvatthādadhi havyavāham | śamīgarbhājjanayan yo mayobhūḥ | ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyaḥ | yato jāto arocathāḥ | taṃ jānannagna āroha | athā no vardhayā rayim | apeta vīta vi ca sarpatātaḥ | ye'tra stha purāṇā ye ca nūtanāḥ | adādidaṃ yamo'vasānaṃ pṛthivyāḥ | akrannimaṃ pitaro lokamasmai
meaning: अग्निमश्वत्थादधि हव्यवाहम् । शमीगर्भाज्जनयन् यो मयोभूः । अयं ते योनिरृत्वियः । यतो जातो अरोचथाः । तं जानन्नग्न आरोह । अथा नो वर्धया रयिम् । अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातः । येऽत्र स्थ पुराणा ये च नूतनाः । अदादिदं यमोऽवसानं पृथिव्याः । अक्रन्निमं पितरो लोकमस्मै
text_mt: Agni, the oblation-bearer from the Aśvattha, / bringing forth from the Śamī-womb, he who brings delight, / this is your seasonal womb, / born from which you shone; / knowing that, mount it, Agni, / and then increase our wealth. / Go away, depart, and creep apart from here, / you who are here, ancient and who are new; / Yama has granted this resting-place of the earth; / the fathers have made this world for him.

sanskrit_iast: agnerbhasmāsyagneḥ purīṣamasi | saṃjñānamasi kāmadharaṇam | mayi te kāmadharaṇaṃ bhūyāt | saṃ vaḥ sṛjāmi hṛdayāni | saṃsṛṣṭaṃ mano astu vaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭaḥ prāṇo astu vaḥ | saṃ yā vaḥ priyāstanuvaḥ | saṃpriyā hṛdayāni vaḥ | ātmā vo astu saṃpriyaḥ | saṃpriyāstanuvo mama
meaning: अग्नेर्भस्मास्यग्नेः पुरीषमसि । संज्ञानमसि कामधरणम् । मयि ते कामधरणं भूयात् । सं वः सृजामि हृदयानि । संसृष्टं मनो अस्तु वः । संसृष्टः प्राणो अस्तु वः । सं या वः प्रियास्तनुवः । संप्रिया हृदयानि वः । आत्मा वो अस्तु संप्रियः । संप्रियास्तनुवो मम
text_mt: You are Agni's ashes, you are Agni's debris; / you are mutual accord, the fulfiller of desires; / may the fulfillment of desires be in me. / I unite your hearts, / let your mind be united, / let your exhalation be united, / united whatever are your dear bodies, / united your dear hearts, / let your self be mutually dear, / mutually dear my bodies.

sanskrit_iast: kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī | kalpantāmāpa oṣadhīḥ | kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthak | mama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ | ye'gnayaḥ samanasaḥ | antarā dyāvāpṛthivī | vāsantikāvṛtū abhi kalpamānāḥ | indramiva devā abhi saṃviśantu | divastvā vīryeṇa | pṛthivyai mahimnā
meaning: कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी । कल्पन्तामाप ओषधीः । कल्पन्तामग्नयः पृथक् । मम ज्यैष्ठ्याय सव्रताः । येऽग्नयः समनसः । अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी । वासन्तिकावृतू अभि कल्पमानाः । इन्द्रमिव देवा अभि संविशन्तु । दिवस्त्वा वीर्येण । पृथिव्यै महिम्ना
text_mt: May heaven and earth be fit; / may waters, plants be fit; / may the fires separately be fit, / obedient to my seniority. / The fires that are like-minded / between heaven and earth, / becoming fit toward the two spring seasons, / let them enter together as the gods around Indra. / By the heroic power of heaven, / by the greatness of the earth,

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣasya poṣeṇa | sarvapaśumādadhe | ajījanannamṛtaṃ martyāsaḥ | asremāṇaṃ taraṇiṃ vīḍujambham | daśa svasāro agruvaḥ samīcīḥ | pumāṃsaṃ jātamabhi saṃrabhantām | prajāpatestvā prāṇenābhi prāṇimi | pūṣṇaḥ poṣeṇa mahyam | dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya | śataṃ śaradbhya āyuṣe varcase
meaning: अन्तरिक्षस्य पोषेण । सर्वपशुमादधे । अजीजनन्नमृतं मर्त्यासः । अस्रेमाणं तरणिं वीडुजम्भम् । दश स्वसारो अग्रुवः समीचीः । पुमांसं जातमभि संरभन्ताम् । प्रजापतेस्त्वा प्राणेनाभि प्राणिमि । पूष्णः पोषेण मह्यम् । दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय । शतं शरद्भ्य आयुषे वर्चसे
text_mt: by the nourishment of the atmosphere, / I establish you, possessing all domestic animals. / Mortals have engendered the immortal, / tireless, swift, strong-jawed; / let the ten unwed united sisters / seize around the male that is born. / With the exhalation of Prajāpati I breathe upon you, / with the nourishment of Pūṣan, for myself, / for long life of a hundred autumns, / for a hundred autumns, for lifespan, for luster,

sanskrit_iast: jīvātvai puṇyāya | ahaṃ tvadasmi madasi tvametat | mamāsi yonistava yonirasmi | mamaiva sanvaha havyānyagne | putraḥ pitre lokakṛjjātavedaḥ | prāṇe tvā'mṛtamādadhāmi | annādamannādyāya | goptāraṃ guptyai | sugārhapatyo vidahannarātīḥ | uṣasaḥ śreyasīḥ śreyasīrdadhat
meaning: जीवात्वै पुण्याय । अहं त्वदस्मि मदसि त्वमेतत् । ममासि योनिस्तव योनिरस्मि । ममैव सन्वह हव्यान्यग्ने । पुत्रः पित्रे लोककृज्जातवेदः । प्राणे त्वाऽमृतमादधामि । अन्नादमन्नाद्याय । गोप्तारं गुप्त्यै । सुगार्हपत्यो विदहन्नरातीः । उषसः श्रेयसीः श्रेयसीर्दधत्
text_mt: for long life, for merit. / I am from you, you are this from me; / you are my womb, I am your womb; / being mine, carry the oblations, Agni, / a son making a realm for the father, Jātavedas. / In the breath I establish you, the immortal, / the eater of food for the eating of food, / the protector for protection; / possessing a good householder's fire, burning away hostilities, / bringing ever better dawns,

sanskrit_iast: agne sapatnāṃ apa bādhamānaḥ | rāyaspoṣamiṣamūrjamasmāsu dhehi | imā u māmupa tiṣṭhantu rāyaḥ | ābhiḥ prajābhiriha saṃvaseya | iho iḍā tiṣṭhatu viśvarūpī | madhye vasordīdihi jātavedaḥ | ojase balāya tvodyacche | vṛṣaṇe śuṣmāyāyuṣe varcase | sapatnatūrasi vṛtratūḥ | yaste deveṣu mahimā suvargaḥ
meaning: अग्ने सपत्नां अप बाधमानः । रायस्पोषमिषमूर्जमस्मासु धेहि । इमा उ मामुप तिष्ठन्तु रायः । आभिः प्रजाभिरिह संवसेय । इहो इडा तिष्ठतु विश्वरूपी । मध्ये वसोर्दीदिहि जातवेदः । ओजसे बलाय त्वोद्यच्छे । वृषणे शुष्मायायुषे वर्चसे । सपत्नतूरसि वृत्रतूः । यस्ते देवेषु महिमा सुवर्गः
text_mt: repelling rivals, Agni, / bestow nourishment of wealth, refreshment, vigor upon us. / May these riches wait upon me, / with these offspring may I dwell together here; / here let Iḍā abide, all-formed; / shine in the midst of wealth, Jātavedas. / For splendorous might, for strength I raise you up, / for the bull, for vigor, for lifespan, for luster. / You are the slayer of rivals, the slayer of Vṛtra; / whatever is your heavenly greatness among the gods,

sanskrit_iast: yasta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭaḥ | puṣṭiryā te manuṣyeṣu paprathe | tayā no agne juṣamāṇa ehi | divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāt | vātātpaśubhyo adhyoṣadhībhyaḥ | yatra yatra jātavedaḥ saṃbabhūtha | tato no agne juṣamāṇa ehi | prācīmanu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvān | agneragne puro agnirbhaveha | viśvā āśā dīdyāno vibhāhi
meaning: यस्त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टः । पुष्टिर्या ते मनुष्येषु पप्रथे । तया नो अग्ने जुषमाण एहि । दिवः पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षात् । वातात्पशुभ्यो अध्योषधीभ्यः । यत्र यत्र जातवेदः संबभूथ । ततो नो अग्ने जुषमाण एहि । प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वान् । अग्नेरग्ने पुरो अग्निर्भवेह । विश्वा आशा दीद्यानो विभाहि
text_mt: That self of yours which has entered into domestic animals, / that nourishment of yours which spread out among humans — / taking pleasure in that, O Agni, come to us / from the sky, from the earth, from the intermediate space, / from the wind, from domestic animals, from the plants. / Wherever you have come into being, O Jātavedas, / from there, O Agni, taking pleasure, come to us. / Advance, knowing, toward the eastern direction; / O Agni, become the fire in front of the fire here. / Shining, illuminate all quarters.

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade | anvagniruṣasāmagramakhyat | anvahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ | anu sūryasya purutrā ca raśmīn | anu dyāvāpṛthivī ātatāna | vikramasva mahāṃ asi | vediṣanmānuṣebhyaḥ | triṣu lokeṣu jāgṛhi | yadidaṃ divo yadadaḥ pṛthivyāḥ | saṃvidāne rodasī saṃbabhūvatuḥ
meaning: ऊर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पदे । अन्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यत् । अन्वहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः । अनु सूर्यस्य पुरुत्रा च रश्मीन् । अनु द्यावापृथिवी आततान । विक्रमस्व महां असि । वेदिषन्मानुषेभ्यः । त्रिषु लोकेषु जागृहि । यदिदं दिवो यददः पृथिव्याः । संविदाने रोदसी संबभूवतुः
text_mt: Bestow vigor upon our two-footed and four-footed [creatures]. / Agni has looked along the forefront of the dawns; / Jātavedas, the first, along the days; / and along the many rays of the sun, / along heaven and earth he has stretched out. / Stride forth, you are great, / sitting on the altar for humans; / watch in the three worlds. / What [is] here of the sky, what yonder of the earth, / the two harmonious worlds came into being.

sanskrit_iast: tayoḥ pṛṣṭhe sīdatu jātavedāḥ | śaṃbhūḥ prajābhyastanuve syonaḥ | prāṇaṃ tvā'mṛta ādadhāmi | annādamannādyāya | goptāraṃ guptyai | yatte śukra śukraṃ varcaḥ śukrā tanūḥ | śukraṃ jyotirajasram | tena me dīdihi tena tvā''dadhe | agninā'gne brahmaṇā | ānaśe vyānaśe sarvamāyurvyānaśe
meaning: तयोः पृष्ठे सीदतु जातवेदाः । शंभूः प्रजाभ्यस्तनुवे स्योनः । प्राणं त्वाऽमृत आदधामि । अन्नादमन्नाद्याय । गोप्तारं गुप्त्यै । यत्ते शुक्र शुक्रं वर्चः शुक्रा तनूः । शुक्रं ज्योतिरजस्रम् । तेन मे दीदिहि तेन त्वा'ऽदधे । अग्निनाऽग्ने ब्रह्मणा । आनशे व्यानशे सर्वमायुर्व्यानशे
text_mt: On their back let Jātavedas sit, / bringing welfare to offspring, gentle to the body. / I place breath in you, the immortal, / the eater of food for food-eating, / the protector for protection. / What clear splendor, clear body is yours, O clear one, / what clear, unfailing light, / with that shine for me, with that I establish you / with Agni, O Agni, with brahman. / I have reached, I have pervaded, I have pervaded the full lifespan.

sanskrit_iast: narya prajāṃ me gopāya | amṛtatvāya jīvase | jātāṃ janiṣyamāṇāṃ ca | amṛte satye pratiṣṭhitām | atharva pituṃ me gopāya | rasamannamihāyuṣe | adabdhāyo'śītatano | aviṣaṃ naḥ pituṃ kṛṇu | śaṃsya paśūnme gopāya | dvipādo ye catuṣpadaḥ
meaning: नर्य प्रजां मे गोपाय । अमृतत्वाय जीवसे । जातां जनिष्यमाणां च । अमृते सत्ये प्रतिष्ठिताम् । अथर्व पितुं मे गोपाय । रसमन्नमिहायुषे । अदब्धायोऽशीततनो । अविषं नः पितुं कृणु । शंस्य पशून्मे गोपाय । द्विपादो ये चतुष्पदः
text_mt: O friendly one, protect my offspring, / for immortality, for life, / both born and to be born, / established in the immortal, in the real. / O Atharvan, protect my food, / the sap, the nourishment here for lifespan. / O you of unassailable lifespan, of unchilled body, / make our food poison-free. / O praiseworthy one, protect my domestic animals, / those two-footed and those four-footed,

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāśaphāśca ya ihāgne | ye caikaśaphā āśugāḥ | sapratha sabhāṃ me gopāya | ye ca sabhyāḥ sabhāsadaḥ | tānindriyāvataḥ kuru | sarvamāyurupāsatām | ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya | yamṛṣayastraividā viduḥ | ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajūṃṣi | sā hi śrīramṛtā satām
meaning: अष्टाशफाश्च य इहाग्ने । ये चैकशफा आशुगाः । सप्रथ सभां मे गोपाय । ये च सभ्याः सभासदः । तानिन्द्रियावतः कुरु । सर्वमायुरुपासताम् । अहे बुध्निय मन्त्रं मे गोपाय । यमृषयस्त्रैविदा विदुः । ऋचः सामानि यजूंषि । सा हि श्रीरमृता सताम्
text_mt: and those of eight hooves here, O Agni, / and those of one hoof, swift-running. / O far-reaching one, protect my assembly / and the assembly-men who sit in the assembly; / make them endowed with faculties; / may they attend during their full lifespan. / O serpent of the deep, protect my mantra / which the three-knowledge seers know: / the verses, the chants, the sacrificial formulas; / for that is the immortal prosperity of the good.

sanskrit_iast: catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ | ghṛtapratīkā bhuvanasya madhye | marmṛjyamānā mahate saubhagāya | mahyaṃ dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān | ihaiva santatra sato vo agnayaḥ | prāṇena vācā manasā bibharmi | tiro mā santamāyurmā prahāsīt | jyotiṣā vo vaiśvānareṇopatiṣṭhe | pañcadhā'gnīnvyakrāmat | virāṭthsṛṣṭā prajāpateḥ | ūrdhvā''rohadrohiṇī | yoniragneḥ pratiṣṭhitiḥ
meaning: चतुःशिखण्डा युवतिः सुपेशाः । घृतप्रतीका भुवनस्य मध्ये । मर्मृज्यमाना महते सौभगाय । मह्यं धुक्ष्व यजमानाय कामान् । इहैव सन्तत्र सतो वो अग्नयः । प्राणेन वाचा मनसा बिभर्मि । तिरो मा सन्तमायुर्मा प्रहासीत् । ज्योतिषा वो वैश्वानरेणोपतिष्ठे । पञ्चधाऽग्नीन्व्यक्रामत् । विराट्थ्सृष्टा प्रजापतेः । ऊर्ध्वा'ऽरोहद्रोहिणी । योनिरग्नेः प्रतिष्ठितिः
text_mt: Having four braids, youthful, fair-formed, / butter-faced in the middle of the world, / adorning herself for great good fortune, / yield desires to me, the sacrificer. / Being here indeed, you fires who are there, / I sustain you with exhalation, speech, mind. / May lifespan not abandon me who am hidden. / With the light of Vaiśvānara I attend upon you. / Fivefold she stepped across the fires, / the Virāj created by Prajāpati, / mounting upward, ascending, / the womb of Agni, the foundation.

sanskrit_iast: navaitānyahāni bhavanti | nava vai suvargā lokāḥ | yadetānyahānyupayanti | navasveva tathsuvargeṣu lokeṣu satriṇaḥ pratitiṣṭhanto yanti | agniṣṭomāḥ paraḥ sāmānaḥ kāryā ityāhuḥ | agniṣṭomasaṃmitaḥ suvargo loka iti | dvādaśāgniṣṭomasya stotrāṇi | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | tattanna sūrkṣyam | ukthyā eva saptadaśāḥ paraḥ sāmānaḥ kāryāḥ
meaning: नवैतान्यहानि भवन्ति । नव वै सुवर्गा लोकाः । यदेतान्यहान्युपयन्ति । नवस्वेव तथ्सुवर्गेषु लोकेषु सत्रिणः प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति । अग्निष्टोमाः परः सामानः कार्या इत्याहुः । अग्निष्टोमसंमितः सुवर्गो लोक इति । द्वादशाग्निष्टोमस्य स्तोत्राणि । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । तत्तन्न सूर्क्ष्यम् । उक्थ्या एव सप्तदशाः परः सामानः कार्याः
text_mt: These days become nine. / Nine indeed are the heavenly realms. / When they undertake these days, / the session-performers proceed establishing themselves in the nine heavenly realms. / They say: 'The paraḥsāman [days] should be made as agniṣṭomas, / for the heavenly realm is commensurate with the agniṣṭoma. / Twelve are the laudatory chants of the agniṣṭoma; / twelve are the months of the year.' / That is not to be heeded. / The seventeenfold ukthyas alone should be made as paraḥsāman [days].

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vā ukthāni | paśūnāmavarudhyai | viśvajidabhijitāvagniṣṭomau | ukthyāḥ saptadaśāḥ paraḥ sāmānaḥ | te saṃstutā virājamabhi saṃpadyante | dve carcāvati ricyete | ekayā gauratiriktaḥ | ekayā''yurūnaḥ | suvargo vai loko jyotiḥ | ūrgvirāṭ
meaning: पशवो वा उक्थानि । पशूनामवरुध्यै । विश्वजिदभिजितावग्निष्टोमौ । उक्थ्याः सप्तदशाः परः सामानः । ते संस्तुता विराजमभि संपद्यन्ते । द्वे चर्चावति रिच्येते । एकया गौरतिरिक्तः । एकया'ऽयुरूनः । सुवर्गो वै लोको ज्योतिः । ऊर्ग्विराट्
text_mt: Ukthas are indeed domestic animals, / for the securing of domestic animals. / The Viśvajit and Abhijit are two agniṣṭomas; / the paraḥsāmans are seventeenfold ukthyas. / Being fully praised, they correspond to the Virāj. / And two verses exceed: / by one the Gau is excessive, / by one the Āyus is deficient. / The heavenly realm is indeed light; / the Virāj is vigor.

sanskrit_iast: suvargameva tena lokamabhi jayanti | yatparaṃ rāthantaram | tatprathame'hankāryam | bṛhaddvitīye | vairūpaṃ tṛtīye | vairājaṃ caturthe | śākvaraṃ pañcame | raivataṃ ṣaṣṭhe | tadu pṛṣṭhebhyo nayanti | saṃtanaya ete grahā gṛhyante
meaning: सुवर्गमेव तेन लोकमभि जयन्ति । यत्परं राथन्तरम् । तत्प्रथमेऽहन्कार्यम् । बृहद्द्वितीये । वैरूपं तृतीये । वैराजं चतुर्थे । शाक्वरं पञ्चमे । रैवतं षष्ठे । तदु पृष्ठेभ्यो नयन्ति । संतनय एते ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते
text_mt: By that they conquer the heavenly realm itself. / The higher Rāthantara / is to be performed on the first day, / the Bṛhat on the second, / the Vairūpa on the third, / the Vairāja on the fourth, / the Śākvara on the fifth, / the Raivata on the sixth. / And they lead them from the pṛṣṭhas; / these cups are drawn continuous.

sanskrit_iast: atigrāhyāḥ paraḥ sāmasu | imānevaitairlokānthsaṃ tanvanti | mithunā ete grahā gṛhyante | atigrāhyāḥ paraḥ sāmasu | mithunameva tairyajamānā avarundhate | bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati | bṛhadvai suvargo lokaḥ | bṛhataiva suvargaṃ lokaṃ yanti | trayastriṃśi nāma sāma | mādhyandine pavamāne bhavati
meaning: अतिग्राह्याः परः सामसु । इमानेवैतैर्लोकान्थ्सं तन्वन्ति । मिथुना एते ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते । अतिग्राह्याः परः सामसु । मिथुनमेव तैर्यजमाना अवरुन्धते । बृहत्पृष्ठं भवति । बृहद्वै सुवर्गो लोकः । बृहतैव सुवर्गं लोकं यन्ति । त्रयस्त्रिंशि नाम साम । माध्यन्दिने पवमाने भवति
text_mt: The atigrāhyas on the paraḥsāman [days] — / by them they connect these worlds. / These cups are drawn as a pair, / the atigrāhyas on the paraḥsāman [days]; / by them the sacrificers secure a pair. / The Bṛhat becomes the pṛṣṭha; / the heavenly realm is indeed the Bṛhat; / by the Bṛhat alone they go to the heavenly realm. / The chant called the Trayastriṃśa / is on the midday purifying [chant].

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśadvai devatāḥ | devatā evāvarundhate | ye vā itaḥ parāñcaṃ saṃvathsaramupa yanti | na hainaṃ te svasti samaśnuvate | atha ye'muto'rvāñcamupa yanti | te hainaṃ svasti samaśñuvate | etadvā amuto'rvāñcamupa yanti | yadevam | yo ha khalu vāva prajāpatiḥ | sa u vevendraḥ | tadu devebhyo nayanti
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वै देवताः । देवता एवावरुन्धते । ये वा इतः पराञ्चं संवथ्सरमुप यन्ति । न हैनं ते स्वस्ति समश्नुवते । अथ येऽमुतोऽर्वाञ्चमुप यन्ति । ते हैनं स्वस्ति समश्ञुवते । एतद्वा अमुतोऽर्वाञ्चमुप यन्ति । यदेवम् । यो ह खलु वाव प्रजापतिः । स उ वेवेन्द्रः । तदु देवेभ्यो नयन्ति
text_mt: Thirty-three indeed are the deities; / they secure the deities alone. / Those who go through the year facing away from here / do not attain it with well-being; / but those who go through it facing toward this side from yonder / attain it with well-being. / That they thus go toward this side from yonder, / that is so. / Prajāpati indeed is he / who is Indra himself; / and that they lead to the gods.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtatirvā ete grahāḥ | yatparaḥ sāmānaḥ | viṣūvāndivākīrtyam | yathā śālāyai pakṣasī | evaṃ saṃvathsarasya pakṣasī | yadetena gṛhyeran | viṣūcī saṃvathsarasya pakṣasī vyavasraṃseyātām | ārtimārcheyuḥ | yadete gṛhyante | yathā śālāyai pakṣasī madhyamaṃ vaṃśamabhi samāyacchati
meaning: संततिर्वा एते ग्रहाः । यत्परः सामानः । विषूवान्दिवाकीर्त्यम् । यथा शालायै पक्षसी । एवं संवथ्सरस्य पक्षसी । यदेतेन गृह्येरन् । विषूची संवथ्सरस्य पक्षसी व्यवस्रंसेयाताम् । आर्तिमार्छेयुः । यदेते गृह्यन्ते । यथा शालायै पक्षसी मध्यमं वंशमभि समायच्छति
text_mt: Continuity indeed are these cups / which are the paraḥsāmans, / the solstice day, the central day. / Just as the two wings of a shed, / even so are the two wings of the year. / If these were not drawn, / the two divergent wings of the year would fall apart; / they would incur ruin. / When these are drawn, / just as one joins the two wings of a shed to the central beam,

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ saṃvathsarasya pakṣasī divākīrtyamabhi saṃtanvanti | nā''rtimārchanti | ekaviṃśamaharbhavati | śukrāgrā grahā gṛhyante | pratyuttabdhyai sayatvāya | saurya etadahaḥ paśurālabhyate | sauryo'tigrāhyo gṛhyate | ahareva rūpeṇa samardhayanti | atho ahna evaiṣa balirhriyate | saptaitadaharatigrāhyā gṛhyante
meaning: एवं संवथ्सरस्य पक्षसी दिवाकीर्त्यमभि संतन्वन्ति । ना'ऽर्तिमार्छन्ति । एकविंशमहर्भवति । शुक्राग्रा ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते । प्रत्युत्तब्ध्यै सयत्वाय । सौर्य एतदहः पशुरालभ्यते । सौर्योऽतिग्राह्यो गृह्यते । अहरेव रूपेण समर्धयन्ति । अथो अह्न एवैष बलिर्ह्रियते । सप्तैतदहरतिग्राह्या गृह्यन्ते
text_mt: even so they connect the two wings of the year to the central day; / they do not incur ruin. / The day becomes twenty-one-fold. / The cups are drawn with the clear soma cup at the beginning / for support, for union. / On this day a animal for Sūrya is offered; / an atigrāhya cup for Sūrya is drawn; / they enrich the day itself with its form. / Moreover, this tribute is brought for the day. / Seven atigrāhya cups are drawn on this day.

sanskrit_iast: sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ | asāvādityaḥ śiraḥ prajānām | śīrṣanneva prajānāṃ prāṇāndadhāti | tasmāthsapta śīrṣanprāṇāḥ | indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | asurānparābhāvya | sa imān lokānabhyajayat | tasyāsau loko'nabhijita āsīt | taṃ viśvakarmā bhūtvā'bhyajayat | yadvaiśvakarmaṇo gṛhyate
meaning: सप्त वै शीर्षण्याः प्राणाः । असावादित्यः शिरः प्रजानाम् । शीर्षन्नेव प्रजानां प्राणान्दधाति । तस्माथ्सप्त शीर्षन्प्राणाः । इन्द्रो वृत्रं हत्वा । असुरान्पराभाव्य । स इमान् लोकानभ्यजयत् । तस्यासौ लोकोऽनभिजित आसीत् । तं विश्वकर्मा भूत्वाऽभ्यजयत् । यद्वैश्वकर्मणो गृह्यते
text_mt: Seven indeed are the breaths in the head; / yonder sun is the head of offspring; / in the head of offspring he places the breaths; / therefore there are seven breaths in the head. / Indra, having slain Vṛtra, / having overthrown the asuras, / conquered these worlds. / That world yonder was unconquered by him; / having become Viśvakarman, he conquered it, / when the Vaiśvakarmaṇa [cup] is drawn.

sanskrit_iast: suvargasya lokasyābhijityai | pra vā ete'smāllokāccyavante | ye vaiśvakarmaṇaṃ gṛhṇate | ādityaḥ śvo gṛhyate | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhanti | anyonyo gṛhyete | viśvānyevānyena karmāṇi kurvāṇā yanti | asyāmanyena pratitiṣṭhanti | tāvāparārdhāthsaṃvathsarasyānyonyo gṛhyete | tāvubhau saha mahāvrate gṛhyete | yajñasyaivāntaṃ gatvā | ubhayorlokayoḥ pratitiṣṭhanti | arkyamukthaṃ bhavati | annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिजित्यै । प्र वा एतेऽस्माल्लोकाच्च्यवन्ते । ये वैश्वकर्मणं गृह्णते । आदित्यः श्वो गृह्यते । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । अन्योन्यो गृह्येते । विश्वान्येवान्येन कर्माणि कुर्वाणा यन्ति । अस्यामन्येन प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । तावापरार्धाथ्संवथ्सरस्यान्योन्यो गृह्येते । तावुभौ सह महाव्रते गृह्येते । यज्ञस्यैवान्तं गत्वा । उभयोर्लोकयोः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । अर्क्यमुक्थं भवति । अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt:
For the winning of the heavenly realm.
They indeed fall away from this world,
who draw the Vaiśvakarmana cup.
The Āditya cup is drawn on the morrow.
This [earth] is Aditi.
In her indeed they establish themselves.
The two are drawn alternately.
Performing all rites through the one, they proceed;
in this [earth] through the other, they establish themselves.
The two are drawn alternately until the second half of the year.
The two are drawn together at the Mahāvrata.
Having gone to the very end of the sacrifice,
they establish themselves in both worlds.
The recitation is the Arkya,
for the obtainment of food.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśa eṣa bhavati | etena vai devā ekaviṃśena | ādityamita uttamaṃ suvargaṃ lokamārohayann | sa vā eṣa ita ekaviṃśaḥ | tasya daśāvastādahāni | daśa parastāt | sa vā eṣa virājyubhayataḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | virāji hi vā eṣa ubhayataḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tasmādantaremau lokau yan | sarveṣu suvargeṣu lokeṣvabhitapanneti
meaning: एकविंश एष भवति । एतेन वै देवा एकविंशेन । आदित्यमित उत्तमं सुवर्गं लोकमारोहयन्न् । स वा एष इत एकविंशः । तस्य दशावस्तादहानि । दश परस्तात् । स वा एष विराज्युभयतः प्रतिष्ठितः । विराजि हि वा एष उभयतः प्रतिष्ठितः । तस्मादन्तरेमौ लोकौ यन् । सर्वेषु सुवर्गेषु लोकेष्वभितपन्नेति
text_mt: This becomes the twenty-first [day]. / By means of this twenty-first, the gods indeed / made the sun mount from here to the highest heavenly realm. / It is indeed this twenty-first from here; / ten days are below it, / ten days beyond. / It is established on both sides upon the Virāj; / for indeed it is established on both sides upon the Virāj. / Therefore, going between these two worlds, / it proceeds burning upon all the heavenly realms.

sanskrit_iast: devā vā ādityasya suvargasya lokasya | parāco'tipādādabibhayuḥ | taṃ chandobhiradṛṃhandhṛtyai | devā vā ādityasya suvargasya lokasya | avāco'vapādādabibhayuḥ | taṃ pañcabhī raśmibhirudavayann | tasmādekaviṃśe'hanpañca divākīrtyāni kriyante | raśmayo vai divākīrtyāni | ye gāyatre | te gāyatrīṣūttarayoḥ pavamānayoḥ
meaning: देवा वा आदित्यस्य सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य । पराचोऽतिपादादबिभयुः । तं छन्दोभिरदृंहन्धृत्यै । देवा वा आदित्यस्य सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य । अवाचोऽवपादादबिभयुः । तं पञ्चभी रश्मिभिरुदवयन्न् । तस्मादेकविंशेऽहन्पञ्च दिवाकीर्त्यानि क्रियन्ते । रश्मयो वै दिवाकीर्त्यानि । ये गायत्रे । ते गायत्रीषूत्तरयोः पवमानयोः
text_mt: The gods feared the falling away of the sun, / of the heavenly realm, into the beyond. / They made it firm with the meters for support. / The gods feared the falling downward of the sun, / of the heavenly realm. / They wove it upward with five rays. / Therefore, on the twenty-first day, five Divākīrtya [chants] are performed. / The Divākīrtyas are indeed rays. / Those that are in the Gāyatra / are on Gāyatrī [verses] in the latter two Pavamānas.

sanskrit_iast: mahādivākīrtyaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭham | vikarṇaṃ brahmasāmam | bhāso'gniṣṭomaḥ | athaitāni parāṇi | parairvai devā ādityaṃ suvargaṃ lokamapārayann | yadapārayann | tatparāṇāṃ paratvam | pārayantyenaṃ parāṇi | ya evaṃ veda | athaitāni sparāṇi | sparairvai devā ādityaṃ suvargaṃ lokamaspārayann | yadaspārayann | tathsparāṇāg sparatvam | spārayantyenagg sparāṇi | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: महादिवाकीर्त्यं होतुः पृष्ठम् । विकर्णं ब्रह्मसामम् । भासोऽग्निष्टोमः । अथैतानि पराणि । परैर्वै देवा आदित्यं सुवर्गं लोकमपारयन्न् । यदपारयन्न् । तत्पराणां परत्वम् । पारयन्त्येनं पराणि । य एवं वेद । अथैतानि स्पराणि । स्परैर्वै देवा आदित्यं सुवर्गं लोकमस्पारयन्न् । यदस्पारयन्न् । तथ्स्पराणाग् स्परत्वम् । स्पारयन्त्येनग्ग् स्पराणि । य एवं वेद
text_mt: The Mahādivākīrtya is the Pṛṣṭha [sāman] of the Hotṛ; / the Vikarṇa is the Brahma-sāman; / the Bhāsa is the Agniṣṭoma [sāman]. / Now these are the Pāras; / by the Pāras the gods brought the sun across to the heavenly realm. / Because they brought [it] across (apārayan), / that is the crossing nature (paratva) of the Pāras. / The Pāras bring him across / who knows thus. / Now these are the Spāras; / by the Spāras the gods rescued the sun to the heavenly realm. / Because they rescued [it] (aspārayan), / that is the saving nature (sparatva) of the Spāras. / The Spāras rescue him / who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: apratiṣṭhāṃ vā ete gacchanti | yeṣāṃ saṃvathsare'nāpte'tha | ekādaśinyāpyate | vaiṣṇavaṃ vāmanamālabhante | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajñamevālabhante pratiṣṭhityai | aindrāgnamālabhante | indrāgnī vai devānāmayātayāmānau | ye eva devate ayātayāmnī | te evālabhante
meaning: अप्रतिष्ठां वा एते गच्छन्ति । येषां संवथ्सरेऽनाप्तेऽथ । एकादशिन्याप्यते । वैष्णवं वामनमालभन्ते । यज्ञो वै विष्णुः । यज्ञमेवालभन्ते प्रतिष्ठित्यै । ऐन्द्राग्नमालभन्ते । इन्द्राग्नी वै देवानामयातयामानौ । ये एव देवते अयातयाम्नी । ते एवालभन्ते
text_mt: They indeed go to lack of support / for whom, when the year is not completed, then / the group of eleven [victims] is completed. / They immolate a dwarf [victim] sacred to Viṣṇu; / Viṣṇu is indeed the sacrifice; / they immolate the sacrifice itself for support. / They immolate [a victim] sacred to Indra and Agni; / Indra and Agni are the unexhausted among the gods; / whichever two deities are unexhausted, / those two they immolate.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevamālabhante | devatā evāvarundhate | dyāvāpṛthivyāṃ dhenumālabhante | dyāvāpṛthivyoreva pratitiṣṭhanti | vāyavyaṃ vathsamālabhante | vāyurevaibhyo yathā''yatanāddevatā avarundhe | ādityāmaviṃ vaśāmālabhante | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhanti | maitrāvaruṇīmālabhante
meaning: वैश्वदेवमालभन्ते । देवता एवावरुन्धते । द्यावापृथिव्यां धेनुमालभन्ते । द्यावापृथिव्योरेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । वायव्यं वथ्समालभन्ते । वायुरेवैभ्यो यथा'ऽयतनाद्देवता अवरुन्धे । आदित्यामविं वशामालभन्ते । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । मैत्रावरुणीमालभन्ते
text_mt: They immolate [a victim] sacred to the All-gods; / they secure the deities. / They immolate a cow sacred to heaven and earth; / they find support in heaven and earth. / They immolate a calf sacred to Vāyu; / Vāyu secures for them the deities from their proper abode. / They immolate a barren ewe sacred to Aditi; / Aditi is this [earth]; / they find support on this [earth]. / They immolate [a victim] sacred to Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: mitreṇaiva yajñasya sviṣṭaṃ śamayanti | varuṇena duriṣṭam | prājāpatyaṃ tūparaṃ mahāvrata ālabhante | prājāpatyo'tigrāhyo gṛhyate | ahareva rūpeṇa samardhayanti | atho ahna evaiṣa balirhriyate | āgneyamālabhante prati prajñātyai | ajapetvān vā ete pūrvairmāsairavarundhate | yadete gavyāḥ paśava ālabhyante | ubhayeṣāṃ paśūnāmavarudhyai
meaning: मित्रेणैव यज्ञस्य स्विष्टं शमयन्ति । वरुणेन दुरिष्टम् । प्राजापत्यं तूपरं महाव्रत आलभन्ते । प्राजापत्योऽतिग्राह्यो गृह्यते । अहरेव रूपेण समर्धयन्ति । अथो अह्न एवैष बलिर्ह्रियते । आग्नेयमालभन्ते प्रति प्रज्ञात्यै । अजपेत्वान् वा एते पूर्वैर्मासैरवरुन्धते । यदेते गव्याः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । उभयेषां पशूनामवरुध्यै
text_mt: By Mitra they appease what is well-offered in the sacrifice, / by Varuṇa what is ill-offered. / At the Mahāvrata they immolate a hornless [he-goat] sacred to Prajāpati; / an Atigrāhya [cup] sacred to Prajāpati is drawn; / they furnish the day with its proper form; / moreover, this tribute is brought for the day. / They immolate [a victim] sacred to Agni for recognition. / By the previous months they secure non-bovine animals; / when these bovine animals are immolated, / it is to secure both kinds of animals. / If they were to immolate a superfluous group of eleven, / it would exceed over the disliked rival. / If they were to combine the animals two by two, / they would make their lifespan shorter. / When these animals accompanied by Brāhmaṇa [exegesis] are immolated, / it does not exceed over the disliked rival, / [and] they do not make their lifespan shorter.

sanskrit_iast: yadatiriktāmekādaśinīmālabheran | apriyaṃ bhrātṛvyamabhyatiricyeta | yaddvau dvau paśū samasyeyuḥ | kanīya āyuḥ kurvīran | yadete brāhmaṇavantaḥ paśava ālabhyante | nāpriyaṃ bhrātṛvyamabhyatiricyate | na kanīya āyuḥ kurvate
meaning: यदतिरिक्तामेकादशिनीमालभेरन् । अप्रियं भ्रातृव्यमभ्यतिरिच्येत । यद्द्वौ द्वौ पशू समस्येयुः । कनीय आयुः कुर्वीरन् । यदेते ब्राह्मणवन्तः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । नाप्रियं भ्रातृव्यमभ्यतिरिच्यते । न कनीय आयुः कुर्वते

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā vṛtto'śayat | taṃ devā bhūtānāṃ rasaṃ tejaḥ saṃbhṛtya | tenainamabhiṣajyan | mahānavavartīti | tanmahāvratasya mahāvratatvam | mahadvratamiti | tanmahāvratasya mahāvratatvam | mahato vratamiti | tanmahāvratasya mahāvratatvam | pañcaviṃśaḥ stomo bhavati
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा वृत्तोऽशयत् । तं देवा भूतानां रसं तेजः संभृत्य । तेनैनमभिषज्यन् । महानववर्तीति । तन्महाव्रतस्य महाव्रतत्वम् । महद्व्रतमिति । तन्महाव्रतस्य महाव्रतत्वम् । महतो व्रतमिति । तन्महाव्रतस्य महाव्रतत्वम् । पञ्चविंशः स्तोमो भवति
text_mt: Prajāpati, having emitted creatures, lay curled up. / The gods, having collected the sap, the fiery energy of beings, / treated him with it. / 'He rolled around greatly' (mahān avavarti): / that is the great-vow-ness (mahāvratatva) of the Mahāvrata. / 'A great vow' (mahad vratam): / that is the great-vow-ness of the Mahāvrata. / 'The vow of the great one' (mahato vratam): / that is the great-vow-ness of the Mahāvrata. / The stoma is twenty-five-fold.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśatyardhamāsaḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | yadvā etasminthsaṃvathsare'dhi prājāyata | tadannaṃ pañcaviṃśamabhavat | madhyataḥ kriyate | madhyato hyannamaśitaṃ dhinoti | atho madhyata eva prajānāmūrgdhīyate | atha yadvā idamantataḥ kriyate | tasmādudante prajāḥ samedhante | antataḥ kriyate prajananāyaiva | trivṛcchiro bhavati
meaning: चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासः संवथ्सरः । यद्वा एतस्मिन्थ्संवथ्सरेऽधि प्राजायत । तदन्नं पञ्चविंशमभवत् । मध्यतः क्रियते । मध्यतो ह्यन्नमशितं धिनोति । अथो मध्यत एव प्रजानामूर्ग्धीयते । अथ यद्वा इदमन्ततः क्रियते । तस्मादुदन्ते प्रजाः समेधन्ते । अन्ततः क्रियते प्रजननायैव । त्रिवृच्छिरो भवति
text_mt: The year has twenty-four half-months. / What was born upon this year, / that food became the twenty-fifth. / It is performed in the middle; / for food, when eaten, gratifies from the middle; / moreover, vigor is placed in the middle of offspring. / And because this is performed at the end, / therefore offspring thrive at the end. / It is performed at the end just for procreation. / The head is the Trivṛt [stoma].

sanskrit_iast: tredhā vihitaṃ hi śiraḥ | loma chavīrasthi | parācā stuvanti | tasmāttathsadṛgeva | na medyato'numedyati | na kṛśyato'nu kṛśyati | pañcadaśo'nyaḥ pakṣo bhavati | saptadaśo'nyaḥ | tasmādvayāṃsyanyataramardhamabhi paryāvartante | anyatarato hi tadgarīyaḥ kriyate
meaning: त्रेधा विहितं हि शिरः । लोम छवीरस्थि । पराचा स्तुवन्ति । तस्मात्तथ्सदृगेव । न मेद्यतोऽनुमेद्यति । न कृश्यतोऽनु कृश्यति । पञ्चदशोऽन्यः पक्षो भवति । सप्तदशोऽन्यः । तस्माद्वयांस्यन्यतरमर्धमभि पर्यावर्तन्ते । अन्यतरतो हि तद्गरीयः क्रियते
text_mt: For the head is threefold: / hair, skin, bone. / They praise facing away; / therefore that [head] is uniform; / it does not fatten along with the fattening [body], / nor does it become emaciated along with the emaciating [body]. / The other wing is fifteen-fold; / the other is seventeen-fold; / therefore birds turn toward one side, / for it is made heavier on one side.

sanskrit_iast: pañcaviṃśa ātmā bhavati | tasmānmadhyataḥ paśavo variṣṭhāḥ | ekaviṃśaṃ puccham | dvipadāsu stuvanti pratiṣṭhityai | sarveṇa saha stuvanti | sarveṇa hyātmanā''tmanvī | sahotpatanti | ekaikāmucchiṃṣanti | ātmann hyaṅgāni baddhāni | na vā etena sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ
meaning: पञ्चविंश आत्मा भवति । तस्मान्मध्यतः पशवो वरिष्ठाः । एकविंशं पुच्छम् । द्विपदासु स्तुवन्ति प्रतिष्ठित्यै । सर्वेण सह स्तुवन्ति । सर्वेण ह्यात्मना'ऽत्मन्वी । सहोत्पतन्ति । एकैकामुच्छिंषन्ति । आत्मन्न् ह्यङ्गानि बद्धानि । न वा एतेन सर्वः पुरुषः
text_mt: The body is twenty-five-fold; / therefore animals are thickest in the middle. / The tail is twenty-one-fold. / They praise on two-footed [verses] for support. / They praise together with all; / for through the whole body one is embodied. / They fly up together; / they leave one remaining; / for the limbs are bound in the body. / Not everyone indeed [is whole] by this man.

sanskrit_iast: yadita ito lomāni dato nakhān | parimādaḥ kriyante | tānyeva tena pratyupyante | audumbarastalpo bhavati | ūrgvā annamudumbaraḥ | ūrja evānnādyasyāvarudhyai | yasya talpasadyamanabhijitaṃ syāt | sa devānāṃ sāmyakṣe | talpasadyamabhijayānīti talpamāruhyodgāyet | talpasadyamevābhijayati
meaning: यदित इतो लोमानि दतो नखान् । परिमादः क्रियन्ते । तान्येव तेन प्रत्युप्यन्ते । औदुम्बरस्तल्पो भवति । ऊर्ग्वा अन्नमुदुम्बरः । ऊर्ज एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै । यस्य तल्पसद्यमनभिजितं स्यात् । स देवानां साम्यक्षे । तल्पसद्यमभिजयानीति तल्पमारुह्योद्गायेत् । तल्पसद्यमेवाभिजयति
text_mt:
Because hair, teeth, nails from here and there / [are fallen], songs of mourning (parimādaḥ) are performed; / by that, these very [parts] are replanted. / The couch is made of udumbara wood; / the udumbara is vigor, food; / [it is] for securing vigor, food. / He who has not won couch-sitting, / he, in the presence of the gods, / should ascend the couch and chant, thinking: 'May I win couch-sitting!' / He wins couch-sitting.

He who has won couch-sitting, / he, in the presence of the gods, / should ascend the couch and chant, thinking: 'May I not lose couch-sitting!' / He does not lose couch-sitting. / He recites on a swing; / the swing is majesty; / [it is] for securing majesty, food. / The gods and the asuras were in conflict; / they contended for the sun; / the gods won it.

sanskrit_iast: yasya talpasadyamabhijitaṃ syāt | sa devānāṃ sāmyakṣe | talpasadyaṃ mā parājeṣīti talpamāruhyodgāyet | na talpasadyaṃ parājayate | pleṅkhe śaṃsati | maho vai pleṅkhaḥ | mahasa evānnādyasyāvaruddhyai | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | ta āditye vyāyacchanta | taṃ devāḥ samajayan
meaning: यस्य तल्पसद्यमभिजितं स्यात् । स देवानां साम्यक्षे । तल्पसद्यं मा पराजेषीति तल्पमारुह्योद्गायेत् । न तल्पसद्यं पराजयते । प्लेङ्खे शंसति । महो वै प्लेङ्खः । महस एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै । देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । त आदित्ये व्यायच्छन्त । तं देवाः समजयन्

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaśca śūdraśca carmakarte vyāyacchete | daivyo vai varṇo brāhmaṇaḥ | asuryaḥ śūdraḥ | ime'rāthsurime subhūtamakrannityanyataro brūyāt | ima udvāsīkāriṇa ime durbhūtamakrannityanyataraḥ | yadevaiṣāṃ sukṛtaṃ yā rāddhiḥ | tadanyataro'bhiśrīṇāti | yadevaiṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ yā'rāddhiḥ | tadanyataro'pahanti | brāhmaṇaḥ saṃjayati | amumevādityaṃ bhrātṛvyasya saṃ vindante
meaning: ब्राह्मणश्च शूद्रश्च चर्मकर्ते व्यायच्छेते । दैव्यो वै वर्णो ब्राह्मणः । असुर्यः शूद्रः । इमेऽराथ्सुरिमे सुभूतमक्रन्नित्यन्यतरो ब्रूयात् । इम उद्वासीकारिण इमे दुर्भूतमक्रन्नित्यन्यतरः । यदेवैषां सुकृतं या राद्धिः । तदन्यतरोऽभिश्रीणाति । यदेवैषां दुष्कृतं याऽराद्धिः । तदन्यतरोऽपहन्ति । ब्राह्मणः संजयति । अमुमेवादित्यं भ्रातृव्यस्य सं विन्दन्ते
text_mt: A Brahmin and a Śūdra contend over a round hide. / The Brahmin is divine in caste; / the Śūdra is of asuric nature. / 'These have succeeded, these have produced good fortune,' one should say; / 'These have abandoned, these have produced ill fortune,' the other. / Whatever good deed they have, whatever success, / that one joins with; / whatever bad deed they have, whatever success, / that the other strikes away. / The Brahmin wins; / they win that very sun from the rival.

sanskrit_iast: devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te devā vijayamupayantaḥ | agnīṣomayostejasvinīstanūḥ saṃnyadadhata | idamu no bhaviṣyati | yadi no jeṣyantīti | tenāgnīṣomāvapākrāmatām | te devā vijitya | agnīṣomāvanvaicchan | te'gnimanvavindannṛtuṣūthsannam | tasya vibhaktībhistejasvinīstanūravārundhata
meaning: देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । ते देवा विजयमुपयन्तः । अग्नीषोमयोस्तेजस्विनीस्तनूः संन्यदधत । इदमु नो भविष्यति । यदि नो जेष्यन्तीति । तेनाग्नीषोमावपाक्रामताम् । ते देवा विजित्य । अग्नीषोमावन्वैच्छन् । तेऽग्निमन्वविन्दन्नृतुषूथ्सन्नम् । तस्य विभक्तीभिस्तेजस्विनीस्तनूरवारुन्धत
text_mt:
The gods and the asuras were in conflict.
Those gods, setting out for victory,
deposited the fiery energetic forms of Agni and Soma [saying]:
"This shall be ours
if they defeat us."
Therefore Agni and Soma departed.
The gods, having conquered,
sought after Agni and Soma.
They found Agni disappeared into the seasons.
Through the grammatical case-forms, they obtained his fiery energetic forms.

sanskrit_iast: te somamanvavindan | tamaghnan | tasya yathā'bhijñāyaṃ tanūrvyagṛhṇata | te grahā abhavan | tadgrahāṇāṃ grahatvam | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo grahā gṛhyante | tasya tveva gṛhītāḥ | nānāgneyaṃ punarādheye kuryāt | yadanāgneyaṃ punarādheye kuryāt | vyṛddhameva tat
meaning: ते सोममन्वविन्दन् । तमघ्नन् । तस्य यथाऽभिज्ञायं तनूर्व्यगृह्णत । ते ग्रहा अभवन् । तद्ग्रहाणां ग्रहत्वम् । यस्यैवं विदुषो ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते । तस्य त्वेव गृहीताः । नानाग्नेयं पुनराधेये कुर्यात् । यदनाग्नेयं पुनराधेये कुर्यात् । व्यृद्धमेव तत्
text_mt:
They found Soma.
They struck him.
They drew out his forms according to recognition.
These became the soma draughts.
That is the drawn nature of the soma draughts.
He who knows thus, for him the soma draughts are drawn;
for him indeed they are drawn.
One should not make [anything] non-Agni-related at the re-establishment [of the fires].
If one were to make [something] non-Agni-related at the re-establishment,
that indeed would be disordered.

sanskrit_iast: anāgneyaṃ vā etatkriyate | yathsamidhastanūnapātamiḍo barhiryajati | ubhāvāgneyāvājyabhāgau syātām | anājyabhāgau bhavata ityāhuḥ | yadubhāvāgneyāvanvañcāviti | agnaye pavamānāyottaraḥ syāt | yatpavamānāya | tenājyabhāgaḥ | tena saumyaḥ | budhanvatyāgneyasyājyabhāgasya puro'nuvākyā bhavati
meaning: अनाग्नेयं वा एतत्क्रियते । यथ्समिधस्तनूनपातमिडो बर्हिर्यजति । उभावाग्नेयावाज्यभागौ स्याताम् । अनाज्यभागौ भवत इत्याहुः । यदुभावाग्नेयावन्वञ्चाविति । अग्नये पवमानायोत्तरः स्यात् । यत्पवमानाय । तेनाज्यभागः । तेन सौम्यः । बुधन्वत्याग्नेयस्याज्यभागस्य पुरोऽनुवाक्या भवति
text_mt:
Indeed, this is made non-Agni-related
when one offers the kindling sticks, Tanūnapāt, the ritual refreshments, the sacred grass.
Both portions of clarified butter should belong to Agni.
"They become not [true] portions of clarified butter,"
they say, "if both, one after the other, belong to Agni."
The latter should be for Agni Pavamāna.
Because it is for Pavamāna,
thereby it is a portion of clarified butter,
thereby it belongs to Soma.
The invitatory verse for Agni's portion of clarified butter contains [the word] "awakening".

sanskrit_iast: yathā suptaṃ bodhayati | tādṛgeva tat | agninyaktāḥ patnīsaṃyājānāmṛcaḥ syuḥ | tenāgneyaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati | ekadhā tejasvinīṃ devatāmupaitītyāhuḥ | sainamīśvarā pradaha iti | neti brūyāt | prajananaṃ vā agniḥ | prajananamevopaitīti | kṛtayajuḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāra ityāhuḥ
meaning: यथा सुप्तं बोधयति । तादृगेव तत् । अग्निन्यक्ताः पत्नीसंयाजानामृचः स्युः । तेनाग्नेयं सर्वं भवति । एकधा तेजस्विनीं देवतामुपैतीत्याहुः । सैनमीश्वरा प्रदह इति । नेति ब्रूयात् । प्रजननं वा अग्निः । प्रजननमेवोपैतीति । कृतयजुः संभृतसंभार इत्याहुः
text_mt:
Just as one awakens a sleeping person,
just so is that.
The verses for the wife-offerings should be marked with Agni.
Thereby everything becomes Agni-related.
"He approaches the deity of fiery energy as single,"
they say, "it is liable to burn him up."
He should say: "No.
Agni is indeed generation;
he approaches generation indeed."
"With sacrificial formula uttered, with materials gathered,"
they say,

sanskrit_iast: na saṃbhṛtyāḥ saṃbhārāḥ | na yajuḥ kāryamiti | atho khalu | saṃbhṛtyā eva saṃbhārāḥ | kāryaṃ yajuḥ | punarādheyasya samṛddhyai | tenopāṃśu pracarati | eṣya iva vā eṣaḥ | yatpunarādheyaḥ | yathopāṃśu naṣṭamicchati
meaning: न संभृत्याः संभाराः । न यजुः कार्यमिति । अथो खलु । संभृत्या एव संभाराः । कार्यं यजुः । पुनराधेयस्य समृद्ध्यै । तेनोपांशु प्रचरति । एष्य इव वा एषः । यत्पुनराधेयः । यथोपांशु नष्टमिच्छति
text_mt:
"no materials are to be gathered,
no sacrificial formula is to be performed."
And then moreover [they say]:
"The materials are indeed to be gathered;
the sacrificial formula is to be performed
for the success of the re-establishment."
Therefore he proceeds in a whisper.
As if seeking, indeed, is he,
namely [the one performing] the re-establishment;
just as one seeks what is lost in a whisper,

sanskrit_iast: tādṛgeva tat | uccaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtamuthsṛjati | yathā naṣṭaṃ vittvā prāhāyamiti | tādṛgeva tat | ekadhā tejasvinīṃ devatāmupaitītyāhuḥ | sainamīśvarā pradaha iti | tattathā nopaiti | prayājānūyājeṣveva vibhaktīḥ kuryāt | yathāpūrvamājyabhāgau syātām | evaṃ patnīsaṃyājāḥ
meaning: तादृगेव तत् । उच्चैः स्विष्टकृतमुथ्सृजति । यथा नष्टं वित्त्वा प्राहायमिति । तादृगेव तत् । एकधा तेजस्विनीं देवतामुपैतीत्याहुः । सैनमीश्वरा प्रदह इति । तत्तथा नोपैति । प्रयाजानूयाजेष्वेव विभक्तीः कुर्यात् । यथापूर्वमाज्यभागौ स्याताम् । एवं पत्नीसंयाजाः
text_mt:
just so is that.
He releases the offering to [Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt aloud,
just as one, having found what is lost, says: "Here it is!"
Just so is that.
"He approaches the deity of fiery energy as single,"
they say, "it is liable to burn him up."
He does not approach it thus.
He should make the grammatical case-forms in the fore-offerings and after-offerings.
The two portions of clarified butter should be as formerly [prescribed];
so too the wife-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: tadvaiśvānaravatprajananavattaramupaitīti | tadāhuḥ | vyṛddhaṃ vā etat | anāgneyaṃ vā etatkriyata iti | neti brūyāt | agniṃ prathamaṃ vibhaktīnāṃ yajati | agnimuttamaṃ patnīsaṃyājānām | tenāgneyam | tena samṛddhaṃ kriyata iti
meaning: तद्वैश्वानरवत्प्रजननवत्तरमुपैतीति । तदाहुः । व्यृद्धं वा एतत् । अनाग्नेयं वा एतत्क्रियत इति । नेति ब्रूयात् । अग्निं प्रथमं विभक्तीनां यजति । अग्निमुत्तमं पत्नीसंयाजानाम् । तेनाग्नेयम् । तेन समृद्धं क्रियत इति
text_mt:
"Thus he approaches it characterized by Vaiśvānara, more characterized by generation."
Regarding that, they say:
"Indeed, this is disordered;
indeed, this is made non-Agni-related."
He should say: "No.
He offers to Agni first among the case-forms,
to Agni last among the wife-offerings.
Thereby it is made Agni-related,
thereby it is made successful."

sanskrit_iast: devā vai yathādarśaṃ yajñānāharanta | yo'gniṣṭomam | ya ukthyam | yo'tirātram | te sahaiva sarve vājapeyamapaśyan | te | anyonyasmai nātiṣṭhanta | ahamanena yajā iti | te'bruvan | ājimasya dhāvāmeti
meaning: देवा वै यथादर्शं यज्ञानाहरन्त । योऽग्निष्टोमम् । य उक्थ्यम् । योऽतिरात्रम् । ते सहैव सर्वे वाजपेयमपश्यन् । ते । अन्योन्यस्मै नातिष्ठन्त । अहमनेन यजा इति । तेऽब्रुवन् । आजिमस्य धावामेति
text_mt:
The gods brought forward the sacrifices according to what they envisioned:
one the Agniṣṭoma,
one the Ukthya,
one the Atirātra.
Together all of them saw the Vājapeya.
They
did not give way to one another [saying]:
"I shall sacrifice with this!"
They said:
"Let us run a race for it."

sanskrit_iast: tasminnājimadhāvan | taṃ bṛhaspatirudajayat | tenāyajata | sa svārājyamagacchat | tamindro'bravīt | māmanena yājayeti | tenendramayājayat | so'graṃ devatānāṃ paryait | agacchathsvārājyam | atiṣṭhantāsmai jyaiṣṭhyāya
meaning: तस्मिन्नाजिमधावन् । तं बृहस्पतिरुदजयत् । तेनायजत । स स्वाराज्यमगच्छत् । तमिन्द्रोऽब्रवीत् । मामनेन याजयेति । तेनेन्द्रमयाजयत् । सोऽग्रं देवतानां पर्यैत् । अगच्छथ्स्वाराज्यम् । अतिष्ठन्तास्मै ज्यैष्ठ्याय
text_mt:
In it they ran a race.
Bṛhaspati won it.
With it he sacrificed.
He went to independent sovereignty.
Indra said to him:
"Make me sacrifice with this."
With it he made Indra sacrifice.
He attained the foremost place among the deities;
he went to independent sovereignty;
they gave way to him for preeminence.

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ vidvān vājapeyena yajate | gacchati svārājyam | agraṃ samānānāṃ paryeti | tiṣṭhante'smai jyaiṣṭhyāya | sa vā eṣa brāhmaṇasya caiva rājanyasya ca yajñaḥ | taṃ vā etaṃ vājapeya ityāhuḥ | vājāpyo vā eṣaḥ | vājagg hyetena devā aipsann | somo vai vājapeyaḥ | yo vai somaṃ vājapeyaṃ veda
meaning: य एवं विद्वान् वाजपेयेन यजते । गच्छति स्वाराज्यम् । अग्रं समानानां पर्येति । तिष्ठन्तेऽस्मै ज्यैष्ठ्याय । स वा एष ब्राह्मणस्य चैव राजन्यस्य च यज्ञः । तं वा एतं वाजपेय इत्याहुः । वाजाप्यो वा एषः । वाजग्ग् ह्येतेन देवा ऐप्सन्न् । सोमो वै वाजपेयः । यो वै सोमं वाजपेयं वेद

sanskrit_iast: vājyevainaṃ pītvā bhavati | ā'sya vājī jāyate | annaṃ vai vājapeyaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | attyannam | ā'syānnādo jāyate | brahma vai vājapeyaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | atti brahmaṇā'nnam | ā'sya brahmā jāyate
meaning: वाज्येवैनं पीत्वा भवति । आऽस्य वाजी जायते । अन्नं वै वाजपेयः । य एवं वेद । अत्त्यन्नम् । आऽस्यान्नादो जायते । ब्रह्म वै वाजपेयः । य एवं वेद । अत्ति ब्रह्मणाऽन्नम् । आऽस्य ब्रह्मा जायते

sanskrit_iast: vāgvai vājasya prasavaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | karoti vācā vīryam | ainaṃ vācā gacchati | apivatīṃ vācaṃ vadati | prajāpatirdevebhyo yajñānvyādiśat | sa ātmanvājapeyamadhatta | taṃ devā abruvan | eṣa vāva yajñaḥ | yadvājapeyaḥ
meaning: वाग्वै वाजस्य प्रसवः । य एवं वेद । करोति वाचा वीर्यम् । ऐनं वाचा गच्छति । अपिवतीं वाचं वदति । प्रजापतिर्देवेभ्यो यज्ञान्व्यादिशत् । स आत्मन्वाजपेयमधत्त । तं देवा अब्रुवन् । एष वाव यज्ञः । यद्वाजपेयः
text_mt:
Speech is indeed the impulse of vigor.
He who knows thus
makes heroic power by means of speech;
[everything] comes to him by means of speech;
he speaks speech rich in drink.
Prajāpati assigned the sacrifices to the gods.
He placed the Vājapeya in himself.
The gods said to him:
"This indeed is the sacrifice,
namely the Vājapeya.

sanskrit_iast: apyeva no'trāstviti | tebhya etā ujjitīḥ prāyacchat | tā vā etā ujjitayo vyākhyāyante | yajñasya sarvatvāya | devatānāmanirbhāgāya | devā vai brahmaṇaścānnasya ca śamalamapāghnan | yadbrahmaṇaḥ śamalamāsīt | sā gāthā nārāśaṃsyabhavat | yadannasya | sā surā
meaning: अप्येव नोऽत्रास्त्विति । तेभ्य एता उज्जितीः प्रायच्छत् । ता वा एता उज्जितयो व्याख्यायन्ते । यज्ञस्य सर्वत्वाय । देवतानामनिर्भागाय । देवा वै ब्रह्मणश्चान्नस्य च शमलमपाघ्नन् । यद्ब्रह्मणः शमलमासीत् । सा गाथा नाराशंस्यभवत् । यदन्नस्य । सा सुरा
text_mt:
Let there be a share for us in this as well."
To them he gave these victorious wins.
Indeed, these victorious wins are explained
for the completeness of the sacrifice,
for the non-exclusion of the deities.
The gods struck away the impurity of the brahman and of food.
What was the impurity of the brahman,
that became the verses praising men;
what was [the impurity] of food,
that became surā.

sanskrit_iast: tasmādgāyataśca mattasya ca na pratigṛhyam | yatpratigṛhṇīyāt | śamalaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt | sarvā vā etasya vāco'varuddhāḥ | yo vājapeyayājī | yā pṛthivyāṃ yā'gnau yā rathantare | yā'ntarikṣe yā vāyau yā vāmadevye | yā divi yā''ditye yā bṛhati | yā'psu yauṣadhīṣu yā vanaspatiṣu | tasmādvājapeyayājyārtvijīnaḥ | sarvā hyasya vāco'varuddhāḥ
meaning: तस्माद्गायतश्च मत्तस्य च न प्रतिगृह्यम् । यत्प्रतिगृह्णीयात् । शमलं प्रतिगृह्णीयात् । सर्वा वा एतस्य वाचोऽवरुद्धाः । यो वाजपेययाजी । या पृथिव्यां याऽग्नौ या रथन्तरे । याऽन्तरिक्षे या वायौ या वामदेव्ये । या दिवि या'ऽदित्ये या बृहति । याऽप्सु यौषधीषु या वनस्पतिषु । तस्माद्वाजपेययाज्यार्त्विजीनः । सर्वा ह्यस्य वाचोऽवरुद्धाः

sanskrit_iast: devā vai yadanyairgrahairyajñasya nāvārundhata | tadatigrāhyairatigṛhyāvārundhata | tadatigrāhyāṇāmatigrāhyatvam | yadatigrāhyā gṛhyante | yadevānyairgrahairyajñasya nāvarundhe | tadeva tairatigṛhyāvarundhe | pañca gṛhyante | pāṅkto yajñaḥ | yāvāneva yajñaḥ | tamāptvā'varundhe
meaning: देवा वै यदन्यैर्ग्रहैर्यज्ञस्य नावारुन्धत । तदतिग्राह्यैरतिगृह्यावारुन्धत । तदतिग्राह्याणामतिग्राह्यत्वम् । यदतिग्राह्या गृह्यन्ते । यदेवान्यैर्ग्रहैर्यज्ञस्य नावरुन्धे । तदेव तैरतिगृह्यावरुन्धे । पञ्च गृह्यन्ते । पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः । यावानेव यज्ञः । तमाप्त्वाऽवरुन्धे
text_mt:
What the gods did not obtain of the sacrifice by other draughts,
that they obtained by drawing with the additional draughts.
That is the nature of the additional draughts as additional draughts.
When the additional draughts are drawn,
whatever he does not obtain of the sacrifice by other draughts,
just that he obtains by drawing with them.
Five are drawn.
The sacrifice is fivefold.
As great as the sacrifice is,
having reached it, he obtains it.

sanskrit_iast: sarva aindrā bhavanti | ekadhaiva yajamāna indriyaṃ dadhati | saptadaśa prājāpatyā grahā gṛhyante | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | ekayarcā gṛhṇāti | ekadhaiva yajamāne vīryaṃ dadhāti | somagrahāṃśca surāgrahāṃśca gṛhṇāti | etadvai devānāṃ paramamannam | yathsomaḥ
meaning: सर्व ऐन्द्रा भवन्ति । एकधैव यजमान इन्द्रियं दधति । सप्तदश प्राजापत्या ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते । सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । एकयर्चा गृह्णाति । एकधैव यजमाने वीर्यं दधाति । सोमग्रहांश्च सुराग्रहांश्च गृह्णाति । एतद्वै देवानां परममन्नम् । यथ्सोमः
text_mt:
All are dedicated to Indra.
At once they place physical power in the sacrificer.
Seventeen draughts dedicated to Prajāpati are drawn.
Prajāpati is seventeenfold,
for the attainment of Prajāpati.
With a single verse he draws [each];
at once he places heroic power in the sacrificer.
He draws both soma draughts and surā draughts.
This indeed is the highest food of the gods,
namely Soma.

sanskrit_iast: etanmanuṣyāṇām | yathsurā | parameṇaivāsmā annādyenāvaramannādyamavarundhe | somagrahāngṛhṇāti | brahmaṇo vā etattejaḥ | yathsomaḥ | brahmaṇa eva tejasā tejo yajamāne dadhāti | surāgrahāngṛhṇāti | annasya vā etacchamalam | yathsurā
meaning: एतन्मनुष्याणाम् । यथ्सुरा । परमेणैवास्मा अन्नाद्येनावरमन्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । सोमग्रहान्गृह्णाति । ब्रह्मणो वा एतत्तेजः । यथ्सोमः । ब्रह्मण एव तेजसा तेजो यजमाने दधाति । सुराग्रहान्गृह्णाति । अन्नस्य वा एतच्छमलम् । यथ्सुरा
text_mt: This is [the highest food] of men, / namely surā. / By the highest food itself he obtains for him the lower food. / He draws the soma cups; / this indeed is the fiery energy of the brahman, / namely soma. / By the fiery energy of the brahman itself he places fiery energy in the sacrificer. / He draws the surā cups; / this indeed is the impurity of food, / namely surā.

sanskrit_iast: annasyaiva śamalena śamalaṃ yajamānādapahanti | somagrahāṃśca surāgrahāṃśca gṛhṇāti | pumān vai somaḥ | strī surā | tanmithunam | mithunamevāsya tadyajñe karoti prajananāya | ātmānameva somagrahaiḥ spṛṇoti | jāyāṃ surāgrahaiḥ | tasmādvājapeyayājyamuṣmiṃ lloke striyaṃ saṃbhavati | vājapeyābhijitagg hyasya
meaning: अन्नस्यैव शमलेन शमलं यजमानादपहन्ति । सोमग्रहांश्च सुराग्रहांश्च गृह्णाति । पुमान् वै सोमः । स्त्री सुरा । तन्मिथुनम् । मिथुनमेवास्य तद्यज्ञे करोति प्रजननाय । आत्मानमेव सोमग्रहैः स्पृणोति । जायां सुराग्रहैः । तस्माद्वाजपेययाज्यमुष्मिं ल्लोके स्त्रियं संभवति । वाजपेयाभिजितग्ग् ह्यस्य
text_mt: By the impurity of food itself he strikes away the impurity from the sacrificer. / He draws both the soma cups and the surā cups. / Soma is male; / surā is female; / that is a pair. / A pair indeed he thereby makes in his sacrifice for procreation. / He preserves himself by means of the soma cups, / [and his] wife by means of the surā cups. / Therefore one who has performed the Vājapeya unites with a woman in that world, / for [she] is won by him through the Vājapeya.

sanskrit_iast: pūrve somagrahā gṛhyante | apare surāgrahāḥ | purokṣaṃ somagrahānthsādayati | paścādakṣaṃ surāgrahān | pāpavasyasasya vidhṛtyai | eṣa vai yajamānaḥ | yathsomaḥ | annaṃ surā | somagrahāṃśca surāgrahāṃśca vyatiṣajati | annādyenaivainaṃ vyatiṣajati
meaning: पूर्वे सोमग्रहा गृह्यन्ते । अपरे सुराग्रहाः । पुरोक्षं सोमग्रहान्थ्सादयति । पश्चादक्षं सुराग्रहान् । पापवस्यसस्य विधृत्यै । एष वै यजमानः । यथ्सोमः । अन्नं सुरा । सोमग्रहांश्च सुराग्रहांश्च व्यतिषजति । अन्नाद्येनैवैनं व्यतिषजति
text_mt: The soma cups are drawn in front; / behind, the surā cups. / In front of the axle he deposits the soma cups; / behind the axle, the surā cups, / for the separation of the worse and the better. / This indeed is the sacrificer, / namely soma; / food is surā. / He alternates the soma cups and the surā cups; / with food itself he alternates him.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpṛcaḥ stha saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅktetyāha | annaṃ vai bhadram | annādyenaivainaṃ saṃsṛjati | annasya vā etacchamalam | yathsurā | pāpmeva khalu vai śamalam | pāpmanā vā enametacchamalena vyatiṣajati | yathsomagrahāṃśca surāgrahāṃśca vyatiṣajati | vipṛcaḥ stha vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅktetyāha | pāpmanaivainaṃ śamalena vyāvartayati
meaning: संपृचः स्थ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्तेत्याह । अन्नं वै भद्रम् । अन्नाद्येनैवैनं संसृजति । अन्नस्य वा एतच्छमलम् । यथ्सुरा । पाप्मेव खलु वै शमलम् । पाप्मना वा एनमेतच्छमलेन व्यतिषजति । यथ्सोमग्रहांश्च सुराग्रहांश्च व्यतिषजति । विपृचः स्थ वि मा पाप्मना पृङ्क्तेत्याह । पाप्मनैवैनं शमलेन व्यावर्तयति
text_mt: ‘You are unifiers; unite me with good fortune,’ he says. / Food indeed is good fortune; / with food itself he mixes him. / This indeed is the impurity of food, / namely surā. / Evil indeed is impurity; / with evil indeed, with impurity, he alternates him, / when he alternates the soma cups and the surā cups. / ‘You are separators; separate me from evil,’ he says; / from evil itself, from impurity, he sets him apart.

sanskrit_iast: tasmādvājapeyayājī pūto medhyo dakṣiṇyaḥ | prāṅudravati somagrahaiḥ | amumeva tairlokamabhijayati | pratyaṅkhsurāgrahaiḥ | imameva tairlokamabhijayati | pratiṣṭhanti somagrahaiḥ | yāvadeva satyam | tena sūyate | vājasṛdbhyaḥ surāgrahān haranti | anṛtenaiva viśaṃ saṃsṛjati | hiraṇyapātraṃ madhoḥ pūrṇaṃ dadāti | madhavyo'sānīti | ekadhā brahmaṇa upaharati | ekadhaiva yajamāna āyustejo dadhāti
meaning: तस्माद्वाजपेययाजी पूतो मेध्यो दक्षिण्यः । प्राङुद्रवति सोमग्रहैः । अमुमेव तैर्लोकमभिजयति । प्रत्यङ्ख्सुराग्रहैः । इममेव तैर्लोकमभिजयति । प्रतिष्ठन्ति सोमग्रहैः । यावदेव सत्यम् । तेन सूयते । वाजसृद्भ्यः सुराग्रहान् हरन्ति । अनृतेनैव विशं संसृजति । हिरण्यपात्रं मधोः पूर्णं ददाति । मधव्योऽसानीति । एकधा ब्रह्मण उपहरति । एकधैव यजमान आयुस्तेजो दधाति
text_mt: Therefore one who has performed the Vājapeya is purified, fit for sacrifice, worthy of the sacrificial fee. / He runs eastward with the soma cups; / that world indeed he conquers by means of them. / Westward with the surā cups; / this world indeed he conquers by means of them. / They stand firm with the soma cups; / as far as truth extends, / by that he is consecrated. / To the race-runners they take the surā cups; / with untruth indeed he mixes the people. / He gives a golden vessel filled with honey, / [thinking,] ‘May I be sweet.’ / All at once he brings [it] to the brahman; / all at once he places lifespan and fiery energy in the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti | nāgniṣṭomo nokthyaḥ | na ṣoḍaśī nātirātraḥ | atha kasmādvājapeye sarve yajñakratavo'varudhyanta iti | paśubhiriti brūyāt | āgneyaṃ paśumālabhate | agniṣṭomameva tenāvarundhe | aindrāgnenokthyam | aindreṇa ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotram | sārasvatyā'tirātram
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । नाग्निष्टोमो नोक्थ्यः । न षोडशी नातिरात्रः । अथ कस्माद्वाजपेये सर्वे यज्ञक्रतवोऽवरुध्यन्त इति । पशुभिरिति ब्रूयात् । आग्नेयं पशुमालभते । अग्निष्टोममेव तेनावरुन्धे । ऐन्द्राग्नेनोक्थ्यम् । ऐन्द्रेण षोडशिनः स्तोत्रम् । सारस्वत्याऽतिरात्रम्
text_mt: The discussers of sacred lore say: / ‘[There is] no Agniṣṭoma, no Ukthya, / no Ṣoḍaśin, no Atirātra; / why then in the Vājapeya are all the sacrificial rites obtained?’ / He should say: ‘By the sacrificial animals.’ / He immolates an animal sacred to Agni; / by that he obtains the Agniṣṭoma itself; / by one sacred to Indra and Agni, the Ukthya; / by one sacred to Indra, the laud of the Ṣoḍaśin; / by one sacred to Sarasvatī, the Atirātra;

sanskrit_iast: mārutyā bṛhataḥ stotram | etāvanto vai yajñakratavaḥ | tānpaśubhirevāvarundhe | ātmānameva spṛṇotyagniṣṭomena | prāṇāpānāvukthyena | vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotreṇa | vācamatirātreṇa | prajāṃ bṛhataḥ stotreṇa | imameva lokamabhi jayatyagniṣṭomena | antarikṣamukthyena
meaning: मारुत्या बृहतः स्तोत्रम् । एतावन्तो वै यज्ञक्रतवः । तान्पशुभिरेवावरुन्धे । आत्मानमेव स्पृणोत्यग्निष्टोमेन । प्राणापानावुक्थ्येन । वीर्यं षोडशिनः स्तोत्रेण । वाचमतिरात्रेण । प्रजां बृहतः स्तोत्रेण । इममेव लोकमभि जयत्यग्निष्टोमेन । अन्तरिक्षमुक्थ्येन
text_mt: by one sacred to the Maruts, the laud of the Bṛhat. / So many indeed are the sacrificial rites; / them he obtains through the sacrificial animals themselves. / He preserves himself by the Agniṣṭoma; / exhalation and inhalation by the Ukthya; / heroic power by the laud of the Ṣoḍaśin; / speech by the Atirātra; / offspring by the laud of the Bṛhat. / This world he conquers by the Agniṣṭoma; / the intermediate space by the Ukthya;

sanskrit_iast: suvargaṃ lokaṃ ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotreṇa | devayānāneva patha ārohatyatirātreṇa | nākaṃ rohati bṛhataḥ stotreṇa | teja evā''tmandhatta āgneyena paśunā | ojo balamaindrāgnena | indriyamaindreṇa | vācaṃ sārasvatyā | ubhāveva devalokaṃ ca manuṣyalokaṃ cābhijayati mārutyā vaśayā | saptadaśa prājāpatyānpaśūnālabhate | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ
meaning: सुवर्गं लोकं षोडशिनः स्तोत्रेण । देवयानानेव पथ आरोहत्यतिरात्रेण । नाकं रोहति बृहतः स्तोत्रेण । तेज एवा'ऽत्मन्धत्त आग्नेयेन पशुना । ओजो बलमैन्द्राग्नेन । इन्द्रियमैन्द्रेण । वाचं सारस्वत्या । उभावेव देवलोकं च मनुष्यलोकं चाभिजयति मारुत्या वशया । सप्तदश प्राजापत्यान्पशूनालभते । सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः
text_mt: the heavenly realm by the laud of the Ṣoḍaśin; / the paths trodden by the gods he mounts by the Atirātra; / the firmament he mounts by the laud of the Bṛhat. / Fiery energy he places in himself by the animal sacred to Agni; / splendorous might and strength by the one sacred to Indra and Agni; / faculties of sense by the one sacred to Indra; / speech by the one sacred to Sarasvatī; / both the realm of the gods and the realm of men he conquers by the barren cow sacred to the Maruts. / He immolates seventeen animals sacred to Prajāpati; / Prajāpati is seventeenfold;

sanskrit_iast: prajāpaterāptyai | śyāmā ekarūpā bhavanti | evamiva hi prajāpatiḥ samṛddhyai | tānparyagnikṛtānuthsṛjati | maruto yajñamajighāṃsanprajāpateḥ | tebhya etāṃ mārutīṃ vaśāmālabhata | tayaivainānaśamayat | mārutyā pracarya | etānthsaṃjñapayet | maruta eva śamayitvā
meaning: प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । श्यामा एकरूपा भवन्ति । एवमिव हि प्रजापतिः समृद्ध्यै । तान्पर्यग्निकृतानुथ्सृजति । मरुतो यज्ञमजिघांसन्प्रजापतेः । तेभ्य एतां मारुतीं वशामालभत । तयैवैनानशमयत् । मारुत्या प्रचर्य । एतान्थ्संज्ञपयेत् । मरुत एव शमयित्वा
text_mt: for obtaining Prajāpati. / They are dark-grey, of uniform appearance; / for Prajāpati is like this, for success. / Having carried fire around them, he releases them. / The Maruts wished to strike down the sacrifice of Prajāpati; / for them he immolated this barren cow sacred to the Maruts; / with it he appeased them. / Having proceeded with the one sacred to the Maruts, / he should slaughter these; / having appeased the Maruts themselves,

sanskrit_iast: etaiḥ pracarati | yajñasyāghātāya | ekadhā vapā juhoti | ekadevatyā hi | ete | atho ekadhaiva yajamāne vīryaṃ dadhāti | naivāreṇa saptadaśaśarāveṇaitarhi pracarati | etatpuroḍāśā hyete | atho paśūnāmeva chidramapidadhāti | sārasvatyottamayā pracarati | vāgvai sarasvatī | tasmātprāṇānāṃ vāguttamā | atho prajāpatāveva yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | prajāpatirhi vāk | apannadatī bhavati | tasmānmanuṣyāḥ sarvāṃ vācaṃ vadanti
meaning: एतैः प्रचरति । यज्ञस्याघाताय । एकधा वपा जुहोति । एकदेवत्या हि । एते । अथो एकधैव यजमाने वीर्यं दधाति । नैवारेण सप्तदशशरावेणैतर्हि प्रचरति । एतत्पुरोडाशा ह्येते । अथो पशूनामेव छिद्रमपिदधाति । सारस्वत्योत्तमया प्रचरति । वाग्वै सरस्वती । तस्मात्प्राणानां वागुत्तमा । अथो प्रजापतावेव यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठापयति । प्रजापतिर्हि वाक् । अपन्नदती भवति । तस्मान्मनुष्याः सर्वां वाचं वदन्ति
text_mt: he proceeds with these, / so as not to injure the sacrifice. / All at once he offers the omentum; / for having a single deity / are these; / also all at once he places heroic power in the sacrificer. / With a dish of wild rice containing seventeen platters he proceeds at this time; / for these are the sacrificial cakes of these; / also he stops up the deficiency of the animals. / With the one sacred to Sarasvatī as the last he proceeds; / speech indeed is Sarasvatī; / therefore among the vital breaths speech is the last; / also in Prajāpati he establishes the sacrifice; / for Prajāpati is speech. / It has not shed its teeth; / therefore men speak all speech.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitraṃ juhoti karmaṇaḥkarmaṇaḥ purastāt | kastadvedetyāhuḥ | yadvājapeyasya pūrvaṃ yadaparamiti | savitṛprasūta eva yathāpūrvaṃ karmāṇi karoti | savane savane juhoti | ākramaṇameva tathsetuṃ yajamānaḥ kurute | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | vācaspatirvācamadya svadāti na ityāha | vāgvai devānāṃ purā'nnamāsīt | vācamevāsmā annaṃ svadayati
meaning: सावित्रं जुहोति कर्मणःकर्मणः पुरस्तात् । कस्तद्वेदेत्याहुः । यद्वाजपेयस्य पूर्वं यदपरमिति । सवितृप्रसूत एव यथापूर्वं कर्माणि करोति । सवने सवने जुहोति । आक्रमणमेव तथ्सेतुं यजमानः कुरुते । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । वाचस्पतिर्वाचमद्य स्वदाति न इत्याह । वाग्वै देवानां पुराऽन्नमासीत् । वाचमेवास्मा अन्नं स्वदयति
text_mt: He offers [an oblation] to Savitṛ before each rite. / ‘Who knows that?’ they say, / ‘what is earlier in the Vājapeya, what is later?’ / Impelled by Savitṛ, he performs the rites in proper sequence. / At each pressing he offers; / an ascent, a bridge, the sacrificer makes that, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / ‘May the lord of speech sweeten our speech today,’ he says. / Speech indeed was the food of the gods anciently; / he sweetens speech itself as food for him.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya vajro'si vārtraghna iti rathamupāvaharati vijityai | vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīmityāha | yaccaiveyam | yaccāsyāmadhi | tadevāvarundhe | atho tasminnevobhaye'bhiṣicyate | apsvantaramṛtamapsu bheṣajamityaśvānpalpūlayati | apsu vā aśvasya tṛtīyaṃ praviṣṭam | tadanuvenanvavaplavate | yadapsu palpūlayati
meaning: इन्द्रस्य वज्रोऽसि वार्त्रघ्न इति रथमुपावहरति विजित्यै । वाजस्य नु प्रसवे मातरं महीमित्याह । यच्चैवेयम् । यच्चास्यामधि । तदेवावरुन्धे । अथो तस्मिन्नेवोभयेऽभिषिच्यते । अप्स्वन्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजमित्यश्वान्पल्पूलयति । अप्सु वा अश्वस्य तृतीयं प्रविष्टम् । तदनुवेनन्ववप्लवते । यदप्सु पल्पूलयति
text_mt: ‘You are Indra's thunderbolt, slayer of Vṛtra,’ [saying this,] he brings down the chariot for victory. / ‘Now in the impulse of the prize, mother the great [earth],’ he says; / both what this [earth] is, / and what is upon it, / that itself he obtains; / and also upon that both he is consecrated. / ‘Within the waters is immortality, within the waters is healing,’ [saying this,] he washes the horses. / In the waters indeed a third of the horse entered; / longing after that, he leaps down, / when he washes them in the waters.

sanskrit_iast: yadevāsyāpsu praviṣṭam | tadevāvarundhe | bahu vā aśvo'medhyamupagacchati | yadapsu palpūlayati | medhyānevainānkaroti | vāyurvā tvā manurvā tvetyāha | etā vā etaṃ devatā agre aśvamayuñjan | tābhirevainān yunakti | savasyojjityai | yajuṣā yunakti vyāvṛttyai
meaning: यदेवास्याप्सु प्रविष्टम् । तदेवावरुन्धे । बहु वा अश्वोऽमेध्यमुपगच्छति । यदप्सु पल्पूलयति । मेध्यानेवैनान्करोति । वायुर्वा त्वा मनुर्वा त्वेत्याह । एता वा एतं देवता अग्रे अश्वमयुञ्जन् । ताभिरेवैनान् युनक्ति । सवस्योज्जित्यै । यजुषा युनक्ति व्यावृत्त्यै
text_mt: What of him entered into the waters, / that indeed he obtains. / The horse comes into contact with much that is unfit for sacrifice; / when he washes them in the waters, / he makes them fit for sacrifice. / ‘Either Vāyu [yokes] you, or Manu [yokes] you,’ he says. / These deities yoked the horse in the beginning; / by them he yokes them, / for the winning of the sacrificial impulse. / He yokes with a yajus, for separation.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ na pādāśuhemanniti saṃmārṣṭi | medhyānevainānkaroti | atho stautyevainānājiṃ sariṣyataḥ | viṣṇukramānkramate | viṣṇureva bhūtvemān lokānabhijayati | vaiśvadevo vai rathaḥ | aṅkau nyaṅkāvabhito rathaṃ yāvityāha | yā eva devatā rathe praviṣṭāḥ | tābhya eva namaskaroti | ātmano'nārtyai | aśamarathaṃ bhāvuko'sya ratho bhavati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अपां न पादाशुहेमन्निति संमार्ष्टि । मेध्यानेवैनान्करोति । अथो स्तौत्येवैनानाजिं सरिष्यतः । विष्णुक्रमान्क्रमते । विष्णुरेव भूत्वेमान् लोकानभिजयति । वैश्वदेवो वै रथः । अङ्कौ न्यङ्कावभितो रथं यावित्याह । या एव देवता रथे प्रविष्टाः । ताभ्य एव नमस्करोति । आत्मनोऽनार्त्यै । अशमरथं भावुकोऽस्य रथो भवति । य एवं वेद
text_mt: With 'O child of the waters, swift of impulse', he wipes [the horses] down; / he thereby makes them fit for sacrifice. / Moreover, he praises them as they are about to run the race. / He steps the strides of Viṣṇu; / having become Viṣṇu indeed, he conquers these worlds. / The chariot belongs to all the gods; / with 'The two curved ends, the two lower curves around the chariot', he says [a verse]; / whichever deities have entered the chariot, / to them he renders homage, / to prevent injury to himself. / His chariot becomes one that does not meet with destruction, / who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: devasyāhaṃ savituḥ prasave bṛhaspatinā vājajitā vājaṃ jeṣamityāha | savitṛprasūta eva brahmaṇā vājamujjayati | devasyāhaṃ savituḥ prasave bṛhaspatinā vājajitā varṣiṣṭhaṃ nākaṃ ruheyamityāha | savitṛprasūta eva brahmaṇā varṣiṣṭhaṃ nākaṃ rohati | cātvāle rathacakraṃ nimitaṃ rohati | ato vā aṃgirasa uttamāḥ suvargaṃ lokamāyan | sākṣādeva yajamānaḥ suvargaṃ lokameti | āveṣṭayati | vajro vai rathaḥ | vajreṇaiva diśo'bhi jayati
meaning: देवस्याहं सवितुः प्रसवे बृहस्पतिना वाजजिता वाजं जेषमित्याह । सवितृप्रसूत एव ब्रह्मणा वाजमुज्जयति । देवस्याहं सवितुः प्रसवे बृहस्पतिना वाजजिता वर्षिष्ठं नाकं रुहेयमित्याह । सवितृप्रसूत एव ब्रह्मणा वर्षिष्ठं नाकं रोहति । चात्वाले रथचक्रं निमितं रोहति । अतो वा अंगिरस उत्तमाः सुवर्गं लोकमायन् । साक्षादेव यजमानः सुवर्गं लोकमेति । आवेष्टयति । वज्रो वै रथः । वज्रेणैव दिशोऽभि जयति
text_mt: 'At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with Bṛhaspati who wins the prize, may I win the prize,' he says; / impelled by Savitṛ, through brahman indeed he wins the prize. / 'At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with Bṛhaspati who wins the prize, may I mount the highest vault of heaven,' he says; / impelled by Savitṛ, through brahman indeed he mounts the highest vault of heaven. / He mounts a chariot wheel set up upon the cātvāla; / from this, indeed, the highest Aṅgirases went to the heavenly realm. / Directly the sacrificer goes to the heavenly realm. / He causes [it] to spin around. / The chariot is indeed a vajra; / with the vajra indeed he conquers the directions.

sanskrit_iast: vājināṃ sāma gāyate | annaṃ vai vājaḥ | annamevāvarundhe | vāco varṣma devebhyo'pākrāmat | tadvanaspatīnprāviśat | saiṣā vāgvanaspatiṣu vadati | yā dundubhau | tasmāddundubhiḥ sarvā vāco'tivadati | dundubhīnthsamāghnanti | paramā vā eṣā vāk
meaning: वाजिनां साम गायते । अन्नं वै वाजः । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । वाचो वर्ष्म देवेभ्योऽपाक्रामत् । तद्वनस्पतीन्प्राविशत् । सैषा वाग्वनस्पतिषु वदति । या दुन्दुभौ । तस्माद्दुन्दुभिः सर्वा वाचोऽतिवदति । दुन्दुभीन्थ्समाघ्नन्ति । परमा वा एषा वाक्
text_mt: The sāman of the swift ones is sung; / food indeed is the prize; / food he thereby secures. / The summit of speech departed from the gods; / it entered into the trees. / That is the speech which speaks in the trees, / which is in the war-drum. / Therefore the war-drum surpasses all speech. / They beat the war-drums together; / supreme indeed is this speech.

sanskrit_iast: yā dundubhau | paramayaiva vācā'varāṃ vācamavarundhe | atho vāca eva varṣma yajamāno'varundhe | indrāya vācaṃ vadatendraṃ vājaṃ jāpayatendro vājamajayidityāha | eṣa vā etarhīndraḥ | yo yajate | yajamāna eva vājamujjayati | saptadaśa pravyādhānājiṃ dhāvanti | saptadaśaṃ stotraṃ bhavati | saptadaśa saptadaśa dīyante
meaning: या दुन्दुभौ । परमयैव वाचाऽवरां वाचमवरुन्धे । अथो वाच एव वर्ष्म यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । इन्द्राय वाचं वदतेन्द्रं वाजं जापयतेन्द्रो वाजमजयिदित्याह । एष वा एतर्हीन्द्रः । यो यजते । यजमान एव वाजमुज्जयति । सप्तदश प्रव्याधानाजिं धावन्ति । सप्तदशं स्तोत्रं भवति । सप्तदश सप्तदश दीयन्ते
text_mt: Which is in the war-drum; / by the supreme speech indeed he secures the lower speech. / And also the sacrificer secures the summit of speech. / 'Speak speech for Indra, make Indra win the prize, Indra has won the prize,' he says. / This one is Indra at this time, / he who sacrifices. / The sacrificer himself wins the prize. / Seventeen arrow-shots they run the race; / the stotra is seventeen-fold; / seventeen by seventeen [gifts] are given.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | arvā'si saptirasi vājyasītyāha | agnirvā arvā | vāyuḥ saptiḥ | ādityo vājī | etābhirevāsmai devatābhirdevarathaṃ yunakti | praṣṭivāhinaṃ yunakti | praṣṭivāhī vai devarathaḥ | devarathamevāsmai yunakti
meaning: सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । अर्वाऽसि सप्तिरसि वाज्यसीत्याह । अग्निर्वा अर्वा । वायुः सप्तिः । आदित्यो वाजी । एताभिरेवास्मै देवताभिर्देवरथं युनक्ति । प्रष्टिवाहिनं युनक्ति । प्रष्टिवाही वै देवरथः । देवरथमेवास्मै युनक्ति
text_mt: Seventeen-fold is Prajāpati; / [this is] for obtaining Prajāpati. / 'You are a courser, you are a steed, you are a runner,' he says. / Agni is the courser, / Vāyu is the steed, / the Āditya is the runner. / With these deities indeed he yokes the chariot of the gods for him. / He yokes a chariot with an outrunner; / the chariot of the gods indeed has an outrunner; / he yokes the chariot of the gods for him.

sanskrit_iast: vājino vājaṃ dhāvata kāṣṭhāṃ gacchatetyāha | suvargo vai lokaḥ kāṣṭhā | suvargameva lokaṃ yanti | suvargaṃ vā ete lokaṃ yanti | ya ājiṃ dhāvanti | prāñco dhāvanti | prāṅiva hi suvargo lokaḥ | catasṛbhiranu mantrayate | catvāri chandāṃsi | chandobhirevainānthsuvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati
meaning: वाजिनो वाजं धावत काष्ठां गच्छतेत्याह । सुवर्गो वै लोकः काष्ठा । सुवर्गमेव लोकं यन्ति । सुवर्गं वा एते लोकं यन्ति । य आजिं धावन्ति । प्राञ्चो धावन्ति । प्राङिव हि सुवर्गो लोकः । चतसृभिरनु मन्त्रयते । चत्वारि छन्दांसि । छन्दोभिरेवैनान्थ्सुवर्गं लोकं गमयति
