text_mt: Agni is indeed the year; / Āditya is the full year (parivatsara); / the Moon is the recurring year (idāvatsara); / Vāyu is the following year (anuvatsara). / When he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva, / he thereby attains Agni, the year. / Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Vaiśvadeva, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the year." / When he sacrifices with the Varuṇapraghāsas, / he thereby attains Āditya, the full year.

sanskrit_iast: tasmādvaruṇapraghāsairyajamānaḥ | parivathsarīṇāg svastimāśāsta ityāśāsīta | yathsākamedhairyajate | candramasameva tadidāvathsaramāpnoti | tasmāthsākamedhairyajamānaḥ | idāvathsarīṇāg svastimāśāsta ityāśāsīta | yatpitṛyajñena yajate | devāneva tadanvavasyati | atha vā asya vāyuścānuvathsaraścāprītāvucchiṣyete | yacchunāsīrīyeṇa yajate
meaning: तस्माद्वरुणप्रघासैर्यजमानः । परिवथ्सरीणाग् स्वस्तिमाशास्त इत्याशासीत । यथ्साकमेधैर्यजते । चन्द्रमसमेव तदिदावथ्सरमाप्नोति । तस्माथ्साकमेधैर्यजमानः । इदावथ्सरीणाग् स्वस्तिमाशास्त इत्याशासीत । यत्पितृयज्ञेन यजते । देवानेव तदन्ववस्यति । अथ वा अस्य वायुश्चानुवथ्सरश्चाप्रीतावुच्छिष्येते । यच्छुनासीरीयेण यजते
text_mt: Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Varuṇapraghāsas, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the full year." / When he sacrifices with the Sākamedhas, / he thereby attains the Moon, the recurring year. / Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Sākamedhas, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the recurring year." / When he sacrifices with the Pitṛyajña, / he thereby settles along with the gods. / But Vāyu and the following year would be left unpropitiated for him. / When he sacrifices with the Śunāsīrīya,

sanskrit_iast: vāyumeva tadanuvathsaramāpnoti | tasmācchunāsīrīyeṇa yajamānaḥ | anuvathsarīṇāg svastimāśāsta ityāśāsīta | saṃvathsaraṃ vā eṣa īpsatītyāhuḥ | yaścāturmāsyairyajata iti | eṣa ha tvai saṃvathsaramāpnoti | ya evaṃ vidvāṃścāturmāsyairyajate | viśve devāḥ samayajanta | te'gnimevāyajanta | ta etaṃ lokamajayan
meaning: वायुमेव तदनुवथ्सरमाप्नोति । तस्माच्छुनासीरीयेण यजमानः । अनुवथ्सरीणाग् स्वस्तिमाशास्त इत्याशासीत । संवथ्सरं वा एष ईप्सतीत्याहुः । यश्चातुर्मास्यैर्यजत इति । एष ह त्वै संवथ्सरमाप्नोति । य एवं विद्वांश्चातुर्मास्यैर्यजते । विश्वे देवाः समयजन्त । तेऽग्निमेवायजन्त । त एतं लोकमजयन्
text_mt: he thereby attains Vāyu, the following year. / Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Śunāsīrīya, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the following year." / "He seeks to win the year," they say, / "who sacrifices with the four-month sacrifices." / He indeed attains the year / who knows thus and sacrifices with the four-month sacrifices. / All the gods sacrificed together; / they sacrificed to Agni alone. / They won this world

sanskrit_iast: yasminnagniḥ | yadvaiśvadevena yajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminnagniḥ | agnereva sāyujyamupaiti | yadā vaiśvadevena yajate | atha saṃvathsarasya gṛhapatimāpnoti | yadā saṃvathsarasya gṛhapatimāpnoti | atha sahasrayājinamāpnoti | yadā sahasrayājinamāpnoti
meaning: यस्मिन्नग्निः । यद्वैश्वदेवेन यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्नग्निः । अग्नेरेव सायुज्यमुपैति । यदा वैश्वदेवेन यजते । अथ संवथ्सरस्य गृहपतिमाप्नोति । यदा संवथ्सरस्य गृहपतिमाप्नोति । अथ सहस्रयाजिनमाप्नोति । यदा सहस्रयाजिनमाप्नोति
text_mt: in which Agni is. / When he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva, / he wins this very world / in which Agni is. / He attains unison with Agni. / When he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva, / then he attains the master of the house of the year; / when he attains the master of the house of the year, / then he attains the sacrificer of a thousand; / when he attains the sacrificer of a thousand,

sanskrit_iast: atha gṛhamedhinamāpnoti | yadā gṛhamedhinamāpnoti | athāgnirbhavati | yadā'gnirbhavati | atha gaurbhavati | eṣā vai vaiśvadevasya mātrā | etadvā eteṣāmavamam | ato'to vā uttarāṇi śreyāṃsi bhavanti | yadviśve devāḥ samayajanta | tadvaiśvadevasya vaiśvadevatvam
meaning: अथ गृहमेधिनमाप्नोति । यदा गृहमेधिनमाप्नोति । अथाग्निर्भवति । यदाऽग्निर्भवति । अथ गौर्भवति । एषा वै वैश्वदेवस्य मात्रा । एतद्वा एतेषामवमम् । अतोऽतो वा उत्तराणि श्रेयांसि भवन्ति । यद्विश्वे देवाः समयजन्त । तद्वैश्वदेवस्य वैश्वदेवत्वम्
text_mt: then he attains the sacrificer of domestic rites (gṛhamedhin); / when he attains the sacrificer of domestic rites, / then he becomes Agni; / when he becomes Agni, / then he becomes a cow. / This indeed is the measure of the Vaiśvadeva. / This is indeed the lowest of these; / higher and higher than this become the superior [states]. / Because all the gods (viśve devāḥ) sacrificed together, / that is the all-god-nature of the Vaiśvadeva.

sanskrit_iast: athādityo varuṇaṃ rājānaṃ varuṇapraghāsairayajata | sa etaṃ lokamajayat | yasminnādityaḥ | yadvaruṇapraghāsairyajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminnādityaḥ | ādityasyaiva sāyujyamupaiti | yadādityo varuṇaṃ rājānaṃ varuṇapraghāsairayajata | tadvaruṇapraghāsānāṃ varuṇapraghāsatvam | atha somo rājā chandāṃsi sākamedhairayajata
meaning: अथादित्यो वरुणं राजानं वरुणप्रघासैरयजत । स एतं लोकमजयत् । यस्मिन्नादित्यः । यद्वरुणप्रघासैर्यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्नादित्यः । आदित्यस्यैव सायुज्यमुपैति । यदादित्यो वरुणं राजानं वरुणप्रघासैरयजत । तद्वरुणप्रघासानां वरुणप्रघासत्वम् । अथ सोमो राजा छन्दांसि साकमेधैरयजत
text_mt: Then Āditya sacrificed to king Varuṇa with the Varuṇapraghāsas. / He conquered that world / where Āditya is. / When one sacrifices with the Varuṇapraghāsas, / he conquers that very world / where Āditya is. / He attains unison with Āditya. / Because Āditya sacrificed to king Varuṇa with the Varuṇapraghāsas, / that is the essence of the Varuṇapraghāsas. / Then King Soma sacrificed to the metres with the Sākamedhas.

sanskrit_iast: sa etaṃ lokamajayat | yasmiṃścandramā vibhāti | yathsākamedhairyajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasmiṃścandramā vibhāti | candramasa eva sāyujyamupaiti | somo vai candramāḥ | eṣa ha tvai sākṣāthsomaṃ bhakṣayati | ya evaṃ vidvānthsākamedhairyajate | yathsomaśca rājā chandāṃsi ca samaidhanta
meaning: स एतं लोकमजयत् । यस्मिंश्चन्द्रमा विभाति । यथ्साकमेधैर्यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिंश्चन्द्रमा विभाति । चन्द्रमस एव सायुज्यमुपैति । सोमो वै चन्द्रमाः । एष ह त्वै साक्षाथ्सोमं भक्षयति । य एवं विद्वान्थ्साकमेधैर्यजते । यथ्सोमश्च राजा छन्दांसि च समैधन्त
text_mt: He conquered that world / where the moon shines forth. / When one sacrifices with the Sākamedhas, / he conquers that very world / where the moon shines forth. / He attains unison with the moon. / Soma indeed is the moon. / He directly partakes of Soma, / who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the Sākamedhas. / Because King Soma and the metres prospered together (samaidhanta),

sanskrit_iast: tathsākamedhānāṃ sākamedhatvam | athartavaḥ pitaraḥ prajāpatiṃ pitaraṃ pitṛyajñenāyajanta | ta etaṃ lokamajayan | yasminnṛtavaḥ | yatpitṛyajñena yajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminnṛtavaḥ | ṛtūnāmeva sāyujyamupaiti | yadṛtavaḥ pitaraḥ prajāpatiṃ pitaraṃ pitṛyajñenāyajanta | tatpitṛyajñasya pitṛyajñatvam
meaning: तथ्साकमेधानां साकमेधत्वम् । अथर्तवः पितरः प्रजापतिं पितरं पितृयज्ञेनायजन्त । त एतं लोकमजयन् । यस्मिन्नृतवः । यत्पितृयज्ञेन यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्नृतवः । ऋतूनामेव सायुज्यमुपैति । यदृतवः पितरः प्रजापतिं पितरं पितृयज्ञेनायजन्त । तत्पितृयज्ञस्य पितृयज्ञत्वम्
text_mt: that is the essence of the Sākamedhas. / Then the seasons, the ancestors, sacrificed to Prajāpati the father with the Pitṛyajña. / They conquered that world / where the seasons are. / When one sacrifices with the Pitṛyajña, / he conquers that very world / where the seasons are. / He attains unison with the seasons. / Because the seasons, the ancestors, sacrificed to Prajāpati the father with the Pitṛyajña, / that is the essence of the Pitṛyajña.

sanskrit_iast: athauṣadhaya imaṃ devaṃ tryambakairayajanta prathemahīti | tato vai tā aprathanta | ya evaṃ vidvāṃstryambakairyajate | prathate prajayā paśubhiḥ | atha vāyuḥ parameṣṭhinaṃ śunāsīrīyeṇāyajata | sa etaṃ lokamajayat | yasminvāyuḥ | yacchunāsīrīyeṇa yajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminvāyuḥ
meaning: अथौषधय इमं देवं त्र्यम्बकैरयजन्त प्रथेमहीति । ततो वै ता अप्रथन्त । य एवं विद्वांस्त्र्यम्बकैर्यजते । प्रथते प्रजया पशुभिः । अथ वायुः परमेष्ठिनं शुनासीरीयेणायजत । स एतं लोकमजयत् । यस्मिन्वायुः । यच्छुनासीरीयेण यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्वायुः
text_mt: Then the plants sacrificed to this deity with the Tryambakas, [saying,] “May we spread forth!” / Then indeed they spread forth. / He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the Tryambakas, / spreads forth with offspring and domestic animals. / Then Vāyu sacrificed to Parameṣṭhin with the Śunāsīrīya. / He conquered that world / where Vāyu is. / When one sacrifices with the Śunāsīrīya, / he conquers that very world / where Vāyu is.

sanskrit_iast: vāyoreva sāyujyamupaiti | brahmavādino vadanti | pra cāturmāsyayājī mīyatāna pramīyatāiti | jīvanvā eṣa ṛtūnapyeti | yadi vasantā pramīyate | vasanto bhavati | yadi grīṣme grīṣmaḥ | yadi varṣāsu varṣāḥ | yadi śaradi śarat | yadi heman hemantaḥ | ṛturbhūtvā saṃvathsaramapyeti | saṃvathsaraḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpatirvāvaiṣaḥ
meaning: वायोरेव सायुज्यमुपैति । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । प्र चातुर्मास्ययाजी मीयतान प्रमीयताइति । जीवन्वा एष ऋतूनप्येति । यदि वसन्ता प्रमीयते । वसन्तो भवति । यदि ग्रीष्मे ग्रीष्मः । यदि वर्षासु वर्षाः । यदि शरदि शरत् । यदि हेमन् हेमन्तः । ऋतुर्भूत्वा संवथ्सरमप्येति । संवथ्सरः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतिर्वावैषः
text_mt: He attains unison with Vāyu. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / “Does the performer of the four-month sacrifices die or does he not die?” / Living indeed, he enters into the seasons. / If he dies in the spring, / he becomes the spring. / If in the summer, the summer. / If in the rains, the rains. / If in the autumn, the autumn. / If in the winter, the winter. / Having become a season, he enters into the year. / The year is Prajāpati. / He indeed is Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: agneḥ kṛttikāḥ | śukraṃ parastājjyotiravastāt | prajāpate rohiṇī | āpaḥ parastādoṣadhayo'vastāt | somasyenvakā vitatāni | parastādvayanto'vastāt | rudrasya bāhū | mṛgayavaḥ parastādvikṣāro'vastāt | adityai punarvasū | vātaḥ parastādārdramavastāt
meaning: अग्नेः कृत्तिकाः । शुक्रं परस्ताज्ज्योतिरवस्तात् । प्रजापते रोहिणी । आपः परस्तादोषधयोऽवस्तात् । सोमस्येन्वका विततानि । परस्ताद्वयन्तोऽवस्तात् । रुद्रस्य बाहू । मृगयवः परस्ताद्विक्षारोऽवस्तात् । अदित्यै पुनर्वसू । वातः परस्तादार्द्रमवस्तात्
text_mt: Agni's are the Kṛttikās: / bright above, light below. / Prajāpati's is Rohiṇī: / waters above, plants below. / Soma's is Invakā: / [threads] stretched above, weavers below. / Rudra's are the Bāhū: / hunters above, the dripping [prey] below. / Aditi's are the Punarvasus: / wind above, moisture below.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatestiṣyaḥ | juhvataḥ parastādyajamānā avastāt | sarpāṇāmāśreṣāḥ | abhyāgacchantaḥ parastādabhyānṛtyanto'vastāt | pitṛṇāṃ maghāḥ | rudantaḥ parastādapabhraṃśo'vastāt | aryamṇaḥ pūrve phalgunī | jāyā parastādṛṣabho'vastāt | bhagasyottare | vahatavaḥ parastādvahamānā avastāt
meaning: बृहस्पतेस्तिष्यः । जुह्वतः परस्ताद्यजमाना अवस्तात् । सर्पाणामाश्रेषाः । अभ्यागच्छन्तः परस्तादभ्यानृत्यन्तोऽवस्तात् । पितृणां मघाः । रुदन्तः परस्तादपभ्रंशोऽवस्तात् । अर्यम्णः पूर्वे फल्गुनी । जाया परस्तादृषभोऽवस्तात् । भगस्योत्तरे । वहतवः परस्ताद्वहमाना अवस्तात्
text_mt: Bṛhaspati's is Tiṣya: / those who sacrifice above, the sacrificers below. / The serpents' are the Āśreṣās: / approaching above, dancing toward below. / The ancestors' are the Maghās: / weepers above, falling away below. / Aryaman's are the Pūrve Phalgunī: / the wife above, the bull below. / Bhaga's are the Uttare [Phalgunī]: / the bridal carts above, those who are borne along below.

sanskrit_iast: devasya saviturhastaḥ | prasavaḥ parastāthsaniravastāt | indrasya citrā | ṛtaṃ parastāthsatyamavastāt | vāyorniṣṭyā vratatiḥ | parastādasiddhiravastāt | indrāgniyorviśākhe | yugāni parastātkṛṣamāṇā avastāt | mitrasyānūrādhāḥ | abhyārohatparastādabhyārūḍhamavastāt
meaning: देवस्य सवितुर्हस्तः । प्रसवः परस्ताथ्सनिरवस्तात् । इन्द्रस्य चित्रा । ऋतं परस्ताथ्सत्यमवस्तात् । वायोर्निष्ट्या व्रततिः । परस्तादसिद्धिरवस्तात् । इन्द्राग्नियोर्विशाखे । युगानि परस्तात्कृषमाणा अवस्तात् । मित्रस्यानूराधाः । अभ्यारोहत्परस्तादभ्यारूढमवस्तात्
text_mt: The god Savitṛ's is Hasta: / impulsion above, acquisition below. / Indra's is Citrā: / truth above, reality below. / Vāyu's is Niṣṭyā: / creepers above, unfulfillment below. / Indrāgni's are the Viśākhes: / yokes above, plowing below. / Mitra's are the Anūrādhās: / mounting above, the mounted below.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya rohiṇī | śṛṇatparastātpratiśṛṇadavastāt | nirṛtyai mūlavarhaṇī | pratibhañjantaḥ parastātpratiśṛṇanto'vastāt | apāṃ pūrvā aṣāḍhāḥ | varcaḥ parastāthsamitiravastāt | viśveṣāṃ devānāmuttarāḥ | abhijayatparastādabhijitamavastāt | viṣṇoḥ śroṇā pṛcchamānāḥ | parastātpanthā avastāt
meaning: इन्द्रस्य रोहिणी । शृणत्परस्तात्प्रतिशृणदवस्तात् । निरृत्यै मूलवर्हणी । प्रतिभञ्जन्तः परस्तात्प्रतिशृणन्तोऽवस्तात् । अपां पूर्वा अषाढाः । वर्चः परस्ताथ्समितिरवस्तात् । विश्वेषां देवानामुत्तराः । अभिजयत्परस्तादभिजितमवस्तात् । विष्णोः श्रोणा पृच्छमानाः । परस्तात्पन्था अवस्तात्
text_mt: Indra's is Rohiṇī: / crushing above, crushing in return below. / Nirṛti's are the Mūlavarhaṇīs: / breaking in pieces above, breaking in pieces in return below. / The Waters' are the Pūrvā Aṣāḍhās: / luster above, assembly below. / The All-gods' are the Uttarās: / conquering completely above, conquered completely below. / Viṣṇu's is Śroṇā: / questioning above, the path below.

sanskrit_iast: vasūnāg śraviṣṭhāḥ | bhūtaṃ parastādbhūtiravastāt | indrasya śatabhiṣak | viśvavyacāḥ parastādviśvakṣitiravastāt | ajasyaikapadaḥ pūrve proṣṭhapadāḥ | vaiśvānaraṃ parastādvaiśvāvasavamavastāt | aherbudhniyasyottare | abhiṣiñcantaḥ parastādabhiṣuṇvanto'vastāt | pūṣṇo revatī | gāvaḥ parastādvathsā avastāt | aśvinoraśvayujau | grāmaḥ parastāthsenā'vastāt | yamasyāpabharaṇīḥ | apakarṣantaḥ parastādapavahanto'vastāt | pūrṇā paścādyatte devā adadhuḥ
meaning: वसूनाग् श्रविष्ठाः । भूतं परस्ताद्भूतिरवस्तात् । इन्द्रस्य शतभिषक् । विश्वव्यचाः परस्ताद्विश्वक्षितिरवस्तात् । अजस्यैकपदः पूर्वे प्रोष्ठपदाः । वैश्वानरं परस्ताद्वैश्वावसवमवस्तात् । अहेर्बुध्नियस्योत्तरे । अभिषिञ्चन्तः परस्तादभिषुण्वन्तोऽवस्तात् । पूष्णो रेवती । गावः परस्ताद्वथ्सा अवस्तात् । अश्विनोरश्वयुजौ । ग्रामः परस्ताथ्सेनाऽवस्तात् । यमस्यापभरणीः । अपकर्षन्तः परस्तादपवहन्तोऽवस्तात् । पूर्णा पश्चाद्यत्ते देवा अदधुः
text_mt: The Vasus' are the Śraviṣṭhās: / what has become above, prosperity below. / Indra's is Śatabhiṣak: / all-encompassing above, all-abiding below. / Aja Ekapād's are the Pūrve Proṣṭhapadās: / Vaiśvānara above, belonging to all Vasus below. / Ahi Budhnya's are the Uttare [Proṣṭhapadās]: / consecrating above, pressing soma below. / Pūṣan's is Revatī: / cows above, calves below. / The Aśvins' are the Aśvayujas: / the village above, the army below. / Yama's are the Apabharaṇīs: / hauling away above, conveying away below. / The full [moon] from behind, which the gods established for you.

sanskrit_iast: yatpuṇyaṃ nakṣatram | tadbaṭ kurvītopavyuṣam | yadā vai sūrya udeti | atha nakṣattraṃ naiti | yāvati tatra sūryo gacchet | yatra jaghanyaṃ paśyet | tāvati kurvīta yatkārī syāt | puṇyāha eva kurute | evaṃ ha vai yajñeṣuṃ ca śatadyumnaṃ ca māthsyo niravasāyayāñcakāra
meaning: यत्पुण्यं नक्षत्रम् । तद्बट् कुर्वीतोपव्युषम् । यदा वै सूर्य उदेति । अथ नक्षत्त्रं नैति । यावति तत्र सूर्यो गच्छेत् । यत्र जघन्यं पश्येत् । तावति कुर्वीत यत्कारी स्यात् । पुण्याह एव कुरुते । एवं ह वै यज्ञेषुं च शतद्युम्नं च माथ्स्यो निरवसाययाञ्चकार
text_mt: Whatever lunar mansion is auspicious, / at that [time] indeed he should act, at the break of dawn. / For when the sun rises, / then the lunar mansion does not come [into view]. / As far as the sun would advance there, / where he might see the lowest [degree of it], / in so much [time] he should act, whatever he would do. / He acts on an auspicious day itself. / Thus indeed the Matsya [king] settled Yajñeṣu and Śatadyumna.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai nakṣattriyaṃ prajāpatiṃ veda | ubhayorenaṃ lokayorviduḥ | hasta evāsya hastaḥ | citrā śiraḥ | niṣṭyā hṛdayam | ūrū viśākhe | pratiṣṭhā'nūrādhāḥ | eṣa vai nakṣattriyaḥ prajāpatiḥ | ya evaṃ veda | ubhayorenaṃ lokayorviduḥ
meaning: यो वै नक्षत्त्रियं प्रजापतिं वेद । उभयोरेनं लोकयोर्विदुः । हस्त एवास्य हस्तः । चित्रा शिरः । निष्ट्या हृदयम् । ऊरू विशाखे । प्रतिष्ठाऽनूराधाः । एष वै नक्षत्त्रियः प्रजापतिः । य एवं वेद । उभयोरेनं लोकयोर्विदुः
text_mt: He who knows the astral Prajāpati, / they know him in both worlds. / Hasta indeed is his hand; / Citrā is the head; / Niṣṭyā is the heart; / the two Viśākhes are the thighs; / the Anūrādhās are the firm foundation. / This indeed is the astral Prajāpati. / He who knows thus, / they know him in both worlds,

sanskrit_iast: asmiṃścāmuṣmiṃśca | yāṃ kāmayeta duhitaraṃ priyā syāditi | tāṃ niṣṭyāyāṃ dadyāt | priyaiva bhavati | naiva tu punarāgacchati | abhijinnāma nakṣattram | upariṣṭādaṣāḍhānām | avastācchroṇāyai | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te devāstasminnakṣattre'bhyajayan
meaning: अस्मिंश्चामुष्मिंश्च । यां कामयेत दुहितरं प्रिया स्यादिति । तां निष्ट्यायां दद्यात् । प्रियैव भवति । नैव तु पुनरागच्छति । अभिजिन्नाम नक्षत्त्रम् । उपरिष्टादषाढानाम् । अवस्ताच्छ्रोणायै । देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । ते देवास्तस्मिन्नक्षत्त्रेऽभ्यजयन्
text_mt: both in this and in that. / Whichever daughter he would wish to be dear, / he should give her away under Niṣṭyā. / She becomes dear indeed; / yet she returns again. / Abhijit is a lunar mansion by name, / above the Aṣāḍhās, / below Śroṇā. / The gods and the asuras were in conflict; / those gods triumphed under that lunar mansion.

sanskrit_iast: yadabhyajayan | tadabhijito'bhijittvam | yaṃ kāmayetānapajayyaṃ jayediti | tametasminnakṣattre yātayet | anapajayyameva jayati | pāpaparājitamiva tu | prajāpatiḥ paśūnasṛjata | te nakṣattraṃ nakṣattramupātiṣṭhanta | te samāvanta evābhavan | te revatīmupātiṣṭhanta
meaning: यदभ्यजयन् । तदभिजितोऽभिजित्त्वम् । यं कामयेतानपजय्यं जयेदिति । तमेतस्मिन्नक्षत्त्रे यातयेत् । अनपजय्यमेव जयति । पापपराजितमिव तु । प्रजापतिः पशूनसृजत । ते नक्षत्त्रं नक्षत्त्रमुपातिष्ठन्त । ते समावन्त एवाभवन् । ते रेवतीमुपातिष्ठन्त
text_mt: Because they conquered (abhyajayan), that is the conquering nature (abhijittva) of Abhijit. If he should desire of someone, 'May he conquer unconquerably,' he should cause him to march under this lunar mansion. He conquers unconquerably, though as if [defeating] one already poorly defeated. Prajāpati created domestic animals. They waited upon lunar mansion after lunar mansion. They remained just equal [in number]. They waited upon Revatī.

sanskrit_iast: te revatyāṃ prābhavan | tasmādrevatyāṃ paśūnāṃ kurvīta | yatkiṃ cārvācīnaṃ somāt | praiva bhavanti | salilaṃ vā idamantarāsīt | yadataran | tattārakāṇāṃ tārakatvam | yo vā iha yajate | amuṃ salokaṃ nakṣate | tannakṣattrāṇāṃ nakṣattratvam
meaning: ते रेवत्यां प्राभवन् । तस्माद्रेवत्यां पशूनां कुर्वीत । यत्किं चार्वाचीनं सोमात् । प्रैव भवन्ति । सलिलं वा इदमन्तरासीत् । यदतरन् । तत्तारकाणां तारकत्वम् । यो वा इह यजते । अमुं सलोकं नक्षते । तन्नक्षत्त्राणां नक्षत्त्रत्वम्
text_mt: They prospered at Revatī. Therefore, regarding domestic animals, one should act under Revatī. Whatever [rites there are] short of soma, they indeed prosper. Water, verily, was this between. Because they crossed over (ataran), that is the star-nature (tārakatva) of the stars (tārakā). He who sacrifices here reaches (nakṣate) that realm; that is the lunar-mansion-nature (nakṣatratva) of the lunar mansions (nakṣatra).

sanskrit_iast: devagṛhā vai nakṣattrāṇi | ya evaṃ veda | gṛhyeva bhavati | yāni vā imāni pṛthivyāścitrāṇi | tāni nakṣattrāṇi | tasmādaślīlanāmaṃścitre | nāvasyenna yajeta | yathā pāpāhe kurute | tādṛgeva tat | devanakṣattrāṇi vā anyāni
meaning: देवगृहा वै नक्षत्त्राणि । य एवं वेद । गृह्येव भवति । यानि वा इमानि पृथिव्याश्चित्राणि । तानि नक्षत्त्राणि । तस्मादश्लीलनामंश्चित्रे । नावस्येन्न यजेत । यथा पापाहे कुरुते । तादृगेव तत् । देवनक्षत्त्राणि वा अन्यानि
text_mt: The lunar mansions, verily, are the dwellings of the gods. He who knows thus becomes possessed of a dwelling. Verily, whatever bright ornaments (citrāṇi) there are of the earth, those are the lunar mansions. Therefore, under an inauspiciously named [lunar mansion] and under Citrā, one should neither settle nor sacrifice. Just as one fares on an evil day, such indeed is that. Some are the divine lunar mansions,

sanskrit_iast: yamanakṣattrāṇyanyāni | kṛttikāḥ prathamam | viśākhe uttamam | tāni devanakṣattrāṇi | anūrādhāḥ prathamam | apabharaṇīruttamam | tāni yamanakṣattrāṇi | yāni devanakṣattrāṇi | tāni dakṣiṇena pariyanti | yāni yamanakṣattrāṇi
meaning: यमनक्षत्त्राण्यन्यानि । कृत्तिकाः प्रथमम् । विशाखे उत्तमम् । तानि देवनक्षत्त्राणि । अनूराधाः प्रथमम् । अपभरणीरुत्तमम् । तानि यमनक्षत्त्राणि । यानि देवनक्षत्त्राणि । तानि दक्षिणेन परियन्ति । यानि यमनक्षत्त्राणि
text_mt: others are Yama's lunar mansions. The Kṛttikās are the first, the Viśākhās the last: these are the divine lunar mansions. Anūrādhās are the first, the Apabharaṇīs the last: these are Yama's lunar mansions. The ones that are the divine lunar mansions go around by the south. The ones that are Yama's lunar mansions

sanskrit_iast: tānyuttareṇa | anveṣāmarāthsmeti | tadanūrādhāḥ | jyeṣṭhameṣāmavadhiṣmeti | tajjyeṣṭhaghnī | mūlameṣāmavṛkṣāmeti | tanmūlavarhaṇī | yannāsahanta | tadaṣāḍhāḥ | yadaśloṇat
meaning: तान्युत्तरेण । अन्वेषामराथ्स्मेति । तदनूराधाः । ज्येष्ठमेषामवधिष्मेति । तज्ज्येष्ठघ्नी । मूलमेषामवृक्षामेति । तन्मूलवर्हणी । यन्नासहन्त । तदषाढाः । यदश्लोणत्
text_mt: [go around] by the north. 'We have prospered after them (ánv eṣām arātsma),' [they thought]; therefore [the name is] Anūrādhās. 'We have slain their eldest (jyeṣṭham eṣām avadhiṣma),' [they thought]; therefore [the name is] Jyeṣṭhaghnī. 'We have uprooted their root (mūlam eṣām avṛkṣāma),' [they thought]; therefore [the name is] Mūlabarhaṇī. Because they could not endure (yán nā́sadhanta), therefore [the name is] Aṣāḍhās. Because it limped (áśloṇat),

sanskrit_iast: tacchroṇā | yadaśṛṇot | tacchraviṣṭhāḥ | yacchatamabhiṣajyan | tacchatabhiṣak | proṣṭhapadeṣūdayacchanta | revatyāmaravanta | aśvayujorayuñjata | apabharaṇīṣvapāvahan | tāni vā etāni yamanakṣattrāṇi | yānyeva devanakṣattrāṇi | teṣu kurvīta yatkārī syāt | puṇyāha eva kurute
meaning: तच्छ्रोणा । यदशृणोत् । तच्छ्रविष्ठाः । यच्छतमभिषज्यन् । तच्छतभिषक् । प्रोष्ठपदेषूदयच्छन्त । रेवत्यामरवन्त । अश्वयुजोरयुञ्जत । अपभरणीष्वपावहन् । तानि वा एतानि यमनक्षत्त्राणि । यान्येव देवनक्षत्त्राणि । तेषु कुर्वीत यत्कारी स्यात् । पुण्याह एव कुरुते
text_mt: therefore [the name is] Śroṇā. Because it heard (áśṛṇot), therefore [the name is] Śraviṣṭhās. Because a hundred healed (śatam ábhiṣajyan), therefore [the name is] Śatabhiṣaj. At the Proṣṭhapadās they held up. At Revatī they roared. At the Aśvayujau they harnessed. At the Apabharaṇīs they carried off. These indeed are Yama's lunar mansions. Whatever are the divine lunar mansions, under them should one act, whatever one may do. He acts verily on an auspicious day.

sanskrit_iast: devasya savituḥ prātaḥ prasavaḥ prāṇaḥ | varuṇasya sāyamāsavo'pānaḥ | yatpratīcīnaṃ prātastanāt | prācīnaṃ saṃgavāt | tato devā agniṣṭomaṃ niramimata | tattadāttavīryaṃ nirmārgaḥ | mitrasya saṃgavaḥ | tatpuṇyaṃ tejasvyahaḥ | tasmāttarhi paśavaḥ samāyanti | yatpratīcīnaṃ saṃgavāt
meaning: देवस्य सवितुः प्रातः प्रसवः प्राणः । वरुणस्य सायमासवोऽपानः । यत्प्रतीचीनं प्रातस्तनात् । प्राचीनं संगवात् । ततो देवा अग्निष्टोमं निरमिमत । तत्तदात्तवीर्यं निर्मार्गः । मित्रस्य संगवः । तत्पुण्यं तेजस्व्यहः । तस्मात्तर्हि पशवः समायन्ति । यत्प्रतीचीनं संगवात्
text_mt: In the morning, the impelling of the god Savitṛ is exhalation; in the evening, the extraction of Varuṇa is inhalation. What is westward from the morning [period] and eastward from the cow-gathering [period], from that the gods fashioned the Agniṣṭoma. That is that whose vigor has been drawn out, [a mere] sweepings-out. The cow-gathering belongs to Mitra; that is an auspicious, fiery-energetic part of the day. Therefore domestic animals gather together then. What is westward from the cow-gathering

sanskrit_iast: prācīnaṃ madhyandināt | tato devā ukthyaṃ niramimata | tattadāttavīryaṃ nirmārgaḥ | bṛhaspatermadhyandinaḥ | tatpuṇyaṃ tejasvyahaḥ | tasmāttarhi tekṣṇiṣṭhaṃ tapati | yatpratīcīnaṃ madhyandināt | prācīnamaparāhṇāt | tato devāḥ ṣoḍaśinaṃ niramimata | tattadāttavīryaṃ nirmārgaḥ
meaning: प्राचीनं मध्यन्दिनात् । ततो देवा उक्थ्यं निरमिमत । तत्तदात्तवीर्यं निर्मार्गः । बृहस्पतेर्मध्यन्दिनः । तत्पुण्यं तेजस्व्यहः । तस्मात्तर्हि तेक्ष्णिष्ठं तपति । यत्प्रतीचीनं मध्यन्दिनात् । प्राचीनमपराह्णात् । ततो देवाः षोडशिनं निरमिमत । तत्तदात्तवीर्यं निर्मार्गः
text_mt: and eastward from midday, from that the gods fashioned the Ukthya. That is that whose vigor has been drawn out, [a mere] sweepings-out. Midday belongs to Bṛhaspati; that is an auspicious, fiery-energetic part of the day. Therefore it burns hottest then. What is westward from midday and eastward from the afternoon, from that the gods fashioned the Ṣoḍaśin. That is that whose vigor has been drawn out, [a mere] sweepings-out.

sanskrit_iast: bhagasyāparāhṇaḥ | tatpuṇyaṃ tejasvyahaḥ | tasmādaparāhṇe kumāryo bhagamicchamānāścaranti | yatpratīcīnamaparāhṇāt | prācīnaṃ sāyāt | tato devā atirātraṃ niramimata | tattadāttavīryaṃ nirmārgaḥ | varuṇasya sāyam | tatpuṇyaṃ tejasvyahaḥ | tasmāttarhi nānṛtaṃ vadet
meaning: भगस्यापराह्णः । तत्पुण्यं तेजस्व्यहः । तस्मादपराह्णे कुमार्यो भगमिच्छमानाश्चरन्ति । यत्प्रतीचीनमपराह्णात् । प्राचीनं सायात् । ततो देवा अतिरात्रं निरमिमत । तत्तदात्तवीर्यं निर्मार्गः । वरुणस्य सायम् । तत्पुण्यं तेजस्व्यहः । तस्मात्तर्हि नानृतं वदेत्
text_mt: The afternoon belongs to Bhaga; that is an auspicious, fiery-energetic part of the day. Therefore in the afternoon maidens go about seeking Bhaga (good fortune). What is westward from the afternoon and eastward from evening, from that the gods fashioned the Atirātra. That is that whose vigor has been drawn out, [a mere] sweepings-out. Evening belongs to Varuṇa; that is an auspicious, fiery-energetic part of the day. Therefore at that time one should not speak untruth.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo vā aṣṭāviṃśo nakṣatrāṇām | samānasyāhnaḥ pañca puṇyāni nakṣatrāṇi | catvāryaślīlāni | tāni nava | yacca parastānnakṣatrāṇāṃ yaccāvastāt | tānyekādaśa | brāhmaṇo dvādaśaḥ | ya evaṃ vidvānthsaṃvathsaraṃ vrataṃ carati | saṃvathsareṇaivāsya vrataṃ guptaṃ bhavati | samānasyāhnaḥ pañca puṇyāni nakṣatrāṇi | catvāryaślīlāni | tāni nava | āgneyī rātriḥ | aindramahaḥ | tānyekādaśa | ādityo dvādaśaḥ | ya evaṃ vidvānthsaṃvathsaraṃ vrataṃ carati | saṃvathsareṇaivāsya vrataṃ guptaṃ bhavati
meaning: ब्राह्मणो वा अष्टाविंशो नक्षत्राणाम् । समानस्याह्नः पञ्च पुण्यानि नक्षत्राणि । चत्वार्यश्लीलानि । तानि नव । यच्च परस्तान्नक्षत्राणां यच्चावस्तात् । तान्येकादश । ब्राह्मणो द्वादशः । य एवं विद्वान्थ्संवथ्सरं व्रतं चरति । संवथ्सरेणैवास्य व्रतं गुप्तं भवति । समानस्याह्नः पञ्च पुण्यानि नक्षत्राणि । चत्वार्यश्लीलानि । तानि नव । आग्नेयी रात्रिः । ऐन्द्रमहः । तान्येकादश । आदित्यो द्वादशः । य एवं विद्वान्थ्संवथ्सरं व्रतं चरति । संवथ्सरेणैवास्य व्रतं गुप्तं भवति
text_mt: The Brahmin, verily, is the twenty-eighth of the lunar mansions. Of the same day, five lunar mansions are auspicious, four are inauspicious: those are nine. What is beyond the lunar mansions and what is below: those are eleven. The Brahmin is the twelfth. He who, knowing thus, observes the vow for a year, his vow is guarded by the year. Of the same day, five lunar mansions are auspicious, four are inauspicious: those are nine. Night belongs to Agni, day belongs to Indra: those are eleven. The Āditya is the twelfth. He who, knowing thus, observes the vow for a year, his vow is guarded by the year.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti | kati pātrāṇi yajñaṃ vahantīti | trayodaśeti brūyāt | sa yadbrūyāt | kastāni niramimīteti | prajāpatiriti brūyāt | sa yadbrūyāt | kutastāni niramimīteti | ātmana iti | prāṇāpānābhyāmevopāṃśvantaryāmau niramimīta
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । कति पात्राणि यज्ञं वहन्तीति । त्रयोदशेति ब्रूयात् । स यद्ब्रूयात् । कस्तानि निरमिमीतेति । प्रजापतिरिति ब्रूयात् । स यद्ब्रूयात् । कुतस्तानि निरमिमीतेति । आत्मन इति । प्राणापानाभ्यामेवोपांश्वन्तर्यामौ निरमिमीत
text_mt: The discussers of sacred lore say: 'How many vessels carry the sacrifice?' 'Thirteen,' he should say. If he should ask, 'Who fashioned them?' 'Prajāpati,' he should say. If he should ask, 'From what did he fashion them?' 'From himself,' [he should say]. From exhalation and inhalation he fashioned the Upāṃśu and Antaryāma [cups].

sanskrit_iast: vyānādupāṃśusavanam | vāca aindravāyavam | dakṣakratubhyāṃ maitrāvaruṇam | śrotrādāśvinam | cakṣuṣaḥ śukrāmanthinau | ātmana āgrayaṇam | aṅgebhya ukthyam | āyuṣo dhruvam | pratiṣṭhāyā ṛtupātre | yajñaṃ vāva taṃ prajāpatirniramimīta | sa nirmito nāddhriyata samavlīyata | sa etānprajāpatirapivāpānapaśyat | tānniravapat | tairvai sa yajñamapyavapat | yadapivāpā bhavanti | yajñasya dhṛtyā asaṃvlayāya
meaning: व्यानादुपांशुसवनम् । वाच ऐन्द्रवायवम् । दक्षक्रतुभ्यां मैत्रावरुणम् । श्रोत्रादाश्विनम् । चक्षुषः शुक्रामन्थिनौ । आत्मन आग्रयणम् । अङ्गेभ्य उक्थ्यम् । आयुषो ध्रुवम् । प्रतिष्ठाया ऋतुपात्रे । यज्ञं वाव तं प्रजापतिर्निरमिमीत । स निर्मितो नाद्ध्रियत समव्लीयत । स एतान्प्रजापतिरपिवापानपश्यत् । तान्निरवपत् । तैर्वै स यज्ञमप्यवपत् । यदपिवापा भवन्ति । यज्ञस्य धृत्या असंव्लयाय
text_mt: From diffused breath [he fashioned] the Upāṃśusavana [stone]. From speech [he fashioned] the Aindravāyava [cup]. From insight and will [he fashioned] the Maitrāvaruṇa [cup]. From hearing [he fashioned] the Āśvina [cup]. From sight [he fashioned] the Śukra and Manthin [cups]. From himself [he fashioned] the Āgrayaṇa [cup]. From the limbs [he fashioned] the Ukthya [cup]. From lifespan [he fashioned] the Dhruva [cup]. From foundation [he fashioned] the two Ṛtupātra cups. Prajāpati verily fashioned that sacrifice. When fashioned, it could not support itself; it collapsed. Prajāpati saw these grain additions (apivāpa); he poured them out. With them he built up the sacrifice. In that there are grain additions, it is for the support of the sacrifice, that it may not collapse.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtameva parameṣṭhi | ṛtaṃ nātyeti kiṃ cana | ṛte samudra āhitaḥ | ṛte bhūmiriyaṃ śritā | agnistigmena śociṣā | tapa ākrāntamuṣṇihā | śirastapasyāhitam | vaiśvānarasya tejasā | ṛtenāsya nivartaye | satyena parivartaye
meaning: ऋतमेव परमेष्ठि । ऋतं नात्येति किं चन । ऋते समुद्र आहितः । ऋते भूमिरियं श्रिता । अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा । तप आक्रान्तमुष्णिहा । शिरस्तपस्याहितम् । वैश्वानरस्य तेजसा । ऋतेनास्य निवर्तये । सत्येन परिवर्तये
text_mt: Truth is the highest, / nothing surpasses truth. / On truth the ocean is established, / on truth this earth is supported. / Agni with sharp flame, / heat reached by the Uṣṇih meter, / the head placed in heat, / with the fiery energy of Vaiśvānara / through truth I turn it back, / through reality I turn it around.

sanskrit_iast: tapasā'syānuvartaye | śivenāsyopavartaye | śagmenāsyābhivartaye | tadṛtaṃ tathsatyam | tadvrataṃ tacchakeyam | tena śakeyaṃ tena rādhyāsam | yadgharmaḥ paryavartayat | antānpṛthivyā divaḥ | agnirīśāna ojasā | varuṇo dhītibhiḥ saha
meaning: तपसाऽस्यानुवर्तये । शिवेनास्योपवर्तये । शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तये । तदृतं तथ्सत्यम् । तद्व्रतं तच्छकेयम् । तेन शकेयं तेन राध्यासम् । यद्घर्मः पर्यवर्तयत् । अन्तान्पृथिव्या दिवः । अग्निरीशान ओजसा । वरुणो धीतिभिः सह
text_mt: Through heat I turn it along, / through the auspicious I turn it toward, / through the powerful I turn it against. / That is truth, that is reality, / that vow, may I be capable of it; / through it may I be capable, through it may I succeed. / When the Gharma cauldron turned around / the ends of earth and heaven, / Agni, ruler through splendorous might, / Varuṇa together with the visions,

sanskrit_iast: indro marudbhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha | agnistigmena śociṣā | tapa ākrāntamuṣṇihā | śirastapasyāhitam | vaiśvānarasya tejasā | ṛtenāsya nivartaye | satyena parivartaye | tapasā'syānuvartaye | śivenāsyopavartaye | śagmenāsyābhivartaye
meaning: इन्द्रो मरुद्भिः सखिभिः सह । अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा । तप आक्रान्तमुष्णिहा । शिरस्तपस्याहितम् । वैश्वानरस्य तेजसा । ऋतेनास्य निवर्तये । सत्येन परिवर्तये । तपसाऽस्यानुवर्तये । शिवेनास्योपवर्तये । शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तये
text_mt: Indra together with the Maruts as companions, / Agni with sharp flame, / heat reached by the Uṣṇih meter, / the head placed in heat, / with the fiery energy of Vaiśvānara / through truth I turn it back, / through reality I turn it around, / through heat I turn it along, / through the auspicious I turn it toward, / through the powerful I turn it against.

sanskrit_iast: tadṛtaṃ tathsatyam | tadvrataṃ tacchakeyam | tena śakeyaṃ tena rādhyāsam | yo asyāḥ pṛthivyāstvaci | nivartayatyoṣadhīḥ | agnirīśāna ojasā | varuṇo dhītibhiḥ saha | indro marudbhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha | agnistigmena śociṣā | tapa ākrāntamuṣṇihā
meaning: तदृतं तथ्सत्यम् । तद्व्रतं तच्छकेयम् । तेन शकेयं तेन राध्यासम् । यो अस्याः पृथिव्यास्त्वचि । निवर्तयत्योषधीः । अग्निरीशान ओजसा । वरुणो धीतिभिः सह । इन्द्रो मरुद्भिः सखिभिः सह । अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा । तप आक्रान्तमुष्णिहा
text_mt: That is cosmic order, that is truth; / that is the vow; may I be able to keep that; / by that may I be able, by that may I succeed! / He who on the surface of this earth / brings back the plants, / Agni the ruler through splendorous might, / Varuṇa together with his insights, / Indra together with the Maruts, his companions, / Agni with his sharp blaze— / the heat has been stepped upon by the uṣṇih.

sanskrit_iast: śirastapasyāhitam | vaiśvānarasya tejasā | ṛtenāsya nivartaye | satyena parivartaye | tapasā'syānuvartaye | śivenāsyopavartaye | śagmenāsyābhivartaye | tadṛtaṃ tathsatyam | tadvrataṃ tacchakeyam | tena śakeyaṃ tena rādhyāsam
meaning: शिरस्तपस्याहितम् । वैश्वानरस्य तेजसा । ऋतेनास्य निवर्तये । सत्येन परिवर्तये । तपसाऽस्यानुवर्तये । शिवेनास्योपवर्तये । शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तये । तदृतं तथ्सत्यम् । तद्व्रतं तच्छकेयम् । तेन शकेयं तेन राध्यासम्
text_mt: The head is placed upon heat, / with the fiery energy of Vaiśvānara. / By truth I turn it downwards; / by truthfulness I turn it around; / by ascetic heat I turn it along; / by what is auspicious I turn it towards; / by what is beneficial I turn it over. / That is the cosmic order, that is truth; / may I be equal to that vow; / through it may I be capable, through it may I succeed.

sanskrit_iast: ekaṃ māsamudasṛjat | parameṣṭhī prajābhyaḥ | tenābhyo maha āvahat | amṛtaṃ martyābhyaḥ | prajāmanu prajāyase | tadu te martyāmṛtam | yena māsā ardhamāsāḥ | ṛtavaḥ parivathsarāḥ | yena te te prajāpate | ījānasya nyavartayan
meaning: एकं मासमुदसृजत् । परमेष्ठी प्रजाभ्यः । तेनाभ्यो मह आवहत् । अमृतं मर्त्याभ्यः । प्रजामनु प्रजायसे । तदु ते मर्त्यामृतम् । येन मासा अर्धमासाः । ऋतवः परिवथ्सराः । येन ते ते प्रजापते । ईजानस्य न्यवर्तयन्
text_mt: Parameṣṭhin released one month / for offspring. / Through it he brought splendor to them, / immortality to mortals: / 'Thou dost reproduce following offspring; / that indeed is thine immortality, O mortal!' / By which months, half-months, / seasons, [and] years [revolve], / by which those [rites] of thine, O Prajāpati, / for the one who has sacrificed, they turned downward—

sanskrit_iast: tenāhamasya brahmaṇā | nivartayāmi jīvase | agnistigmena śociṣā | tapa ākrāntamuṣṇihā | śirastapasyāhitam | vaiśvānarasya tejasā | ṛtenāsya nivartaye | satyena parivartaye | tapasā'syānuvartaye | śivenāsyopavartaye | śagmenāsyābhivartaye | tadṛtaṃ tathsatyam | tadvrataṃ tacchakeyam | tena śakeyaṃ tena rādhyāsam
meaning: तेनाहमस्य ब्रह्मणा । निवर्तयामि जीवसे । अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा । तप आक्रान्तमुष्णिहा । शिरस्तपस्याहितम् । वैश्वानरस्य तेजसा । ऋतेनास्य निवर्तये । सत्येन परिवर्तये । तपसाऽस्यानुवर्तये । शिवेनास्योपवर्तये । शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तये । तदृतं तथ्सत्यम् । तद्व्रतं तच्छकेयम् । तेन शकेयं तेन राध्यासम्
text_mt: By that brahman of his / do I turn [the razor] for life. / Agni with sharp flaming glow, / heat pervaded by the Uṣṇih, / the head placed upon heat / with the fiery energy of Vaiśvānara: / by truth I turn it downwards; / by truthfulness I turn it around; / by ascetic heat I turn it along; / by what is auspicious I turn it towards; / by what is beneficial I turn it over. / That is the cosmic order, that is truth; / may I be equal to that vow; / through it may I be capable, through it may I succeed.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai yadyajñe'kurvata | tadasurā akurvata | te'surā ūrdhvaṃ pṛṣṭhebhyo nāpaśyan | te keśānagre'vapanta | atha śmaśrūṇi | athopapakṣau | tataste'vāñca āyan | parā'bhavan | yasyaivaṃ vapanti | avāṅeti
meaning: देवा वै यद्यज्ञेऽकुर्वत । तदसुरा अकुर्वत । तेऽसुरा ऊर्ध्वं पृष्ठेभ्यो नापश्यन् । ते केशानग्रेऽवपन्त । अथ श्मश्रूणि । अथोपपक्षौ । ततस्तेऽवाञ्च आयन् । पराऽभवन् । यस्यैवं वपन्ति । अवाङेति
text_mt: Indeed, whatever the gods did in the sacrifice, / the asuras did that. / Those asuras did not see upwards from the back [of their heads]; / they shaved their head-hair first, / then the beard, / then the armpits. / Thereupon they went downwards; / they were defeated. / For whomever they shave thus, / he goes downwards,

sanskrit_iast: atho paraiva bhavati | atha devā ūrdhvaṃ pṛṣṭhebhyo'paśyan | ta upapakṣāvagre'vapanta | atha śmaśrūṇi | atha keśān | tataste'bhavan | suvargaṃ lokamāyan | yasyaivaṃ vapanti | bhavatyātmanā | atho suvargaṃ lokameti
meaning: अथो परैव भवति । अथ देवा ऊर्ध्वं पृष्ठेभ्योऽपश्यन् । त उपपक्षावग्रेऽवपन्त । अथ श्मश्रूणि । अथ केशान् । ततस्तेऽभवन् । सुवर्गं लोकमायन् । यस्यैवं वपन्ति । भवत्यात्मना । अथो सुवर्गं लोकमेति
text_mt: and he becomes as if ruined. / Then the gods saw upwards from the back [of their heads]; / they shaved the armpits first, / then the beard, / then the head-hair. / Thereupon they prospered; / they went to the heavenly realm. / For whomever they shave thus, / he prospers in his own self, / and he goes to the heavenly realm.

sanskrit_iast: athaitanmanurvaptre mithunamapaśyat | sa śmaśrūṇyagre'vapata | athopapakṣau | atha keśān | tato vai sa prājāyata prajayā paśubhiḥ | yasyaivaṃ vapanti | pra prajayā paśubhirmithunairjāyate | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te saṃvathsare vyāyacchanta | tāndevāścāturmāsyairevābhi prāyuñjata
meaning: अथैतन्मनुर्वप्त्रे मिथुनमपश्यत् । स श्मश्रूण्यग्रेऽवपत । अथोपपक्षौ । अथ केशान् । ततो वै स प्राजायत प्रजया पशुभिः । यस्यैवं वपन्ति । प्र प्रजया पशुभिर्मिथुनैर्जायते । देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । ते संवथ्सरे व्यायच्छन्त । तान्देवाश्चातुर्मास्यैरेवाभि प्रायुञ्जत
text_mt: Then Manu saw this pair for the shaver: / he shaved the beard first, / then the armpits, / then the head-hair. / Thereupon indeed he reproduced with offspring and domestic animals. / For whomever they shave thus, / he propagates in pairs with offspring and domestic animals. / The gods and the asuras were in conflict; / they contended over the year. / The gods engaged them with the Four-Month rites alone.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevena caturo māso'vṛñjatendra rājānaḥ | tān chīrṣanni cāvartayanta pari ca | varuṇapraghāsaiścaturo māso'vṛñjata varuṇarājānaḥ | tān chīrṣanni cāvartayanta pari ca | sākamedhaiścaturo māso'vṛñjata somarājānaḥ | tān chīrṣanni cāvartayanta pari ca | yā saṃvathsara upajīvā''sīt | tāmeṣāmavṛñjata | tato devā abhavan | parā'surāḥ
meaning: वैश्वदेवेन चतुरो मासोऽवृञ्जतेन्द्र राजानः । तान् छीर्षन्नि चावर्तयन्त परि च । वरुणप्रघासैश्चतुरो मासोऽवृञ्जत वरुणराजानः । तान् छीर्षन्नि चावर्तयन्त परि च । साकमेधैश्चतुरो मासोऽवृञ्जत सोमराजानः । तान् छीर्षन्नि चावर्तयन्त परि च । या संवथ्सर उपजीवा'ऽसीत् । तामेषामवृञ्जत । ततो देवा अभवन् । पराऽसुराः
text_mt: With the Vaiśvadeva, having Indra as king, they wrested four months; / they turned those down and around upon the head. / With the Varuṇapraghāsa rites, having Varuṇa as king, they wrested four months; / they turned those down and around upon the head. / With the Sākamedha rites, having Soma as king, they wrested four months; / they turned those down and around upon the head. / Whatever livelihood there was in the year, / they wrested that from them. / Thereupon the gods prospered; / the asuras were defeated.

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ vidvāṃścāturmāsyairyajate | bhrātṛvyasyaiva māso vṛktvā | śīrṣanni ca vartayate pari ca | yaiṣā saṃvathsara upajīvā | vṛṅkte tāṃ bhrātṛvyasya | kṣudhā'sya bhrātṛvyaḥ parābhavati | lohitāyasena nivartayate | yadvā imāmagnirṛtāvāgate nivartayati | etadevaināṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā nivartayati | sā tataḥ śvaḥ śvo bhūyasī bhavantyeti
meaning: य एवं विद्वांश्चातुर्मास्यैर्यजते । भ्रातृव्यस्यैव मासो वृक्त्वा । शीर्षन्नि च वर्तयते परि च । यैषा संवथ्सर उपजीवा । वृङ्क्ते तां भ्रातृव्यस्य । क्षुधाऽस्य भ्रातृव्यः पराभवति । लोहितायसेन निवर्तयते । यद्वा इमामग्निरृतावागते निवर्तयति । एतदेवैनां रूपं कृत्वा निवर्तयति । सा ततः श्वः श्वो भूयसी भवन्त्येति
text_mt: He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the Four-Month rites, / having wrested the months of his rival, / turns them down and around upon his head. / Whatever livelihood there is in the year, / he wrests that from his rival. / His rival perishes through hunger. / He shaves with a bronze [blade]. / When Agni shaves this [earth] when the season has come, / having made it into this very form he shaves it; / she then goes on, becoming greater day by day;

sanskrit_iast: prajāyate | ya evaṃ vidvāṃ llohitāyasena nivartayate | etadeva rūpaṃ kṛtvā nivartayate | sa tataḥ śvaḥ śvo bhūyānbhavanneti | praiva jāyate | treṇyā śalalyā nivartayeta | trīṇitrīṇi vai devānāmṛddhāni | trīṇi chandāṃsi | trīṇi savanāni | traya ime lokāḥ
meaning: प्रजायते । य एवं विद्वां ल्लोहितायसेन निवर्तयते । एतदेव रूपं कृत्वा निवर्तयते । स ततः श्वः श्वो भूयान्भवन्नेति । प्रैव जायते । त्रेण्या शलल्या निवर्तयेत । त्रीणित्रीणि वै देवानामृद्धानि । त्रीणि छन्दांसि । त्रीणि सवनानि । त्रय इमे लोकाः
text_mt: she reproduces. / He who, knowing thus, shaves with a bronze [blade], / having made this very form, he shaves; / he then goes on, becoming greater day by day; / he reproduces. / He should shave with a three-spotted porcupine quill; / threefold indeed are the prosperous [things] of the gods: / three meters, / three pressings, / these three worlds.

sanskrit_iast: ṛddhyāmeva tadvīrya eṣu lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati | yaccāturmāsyayājyātmano nāvadyet | devebhya āvṛścyeta | catṛṣu catṛṣu māseṣu nivartayeta | parokṣameva taddevebhya ātmano'vadyatyanāvraskāya | devānāṃ vā eṣa ānītaḥ | yaścāturmāsyayājī | ya evaṃ vidvānni ca vartayate pari ca | devatā evāpyeti | nāsya rudraḥ prajāṃ paśūnabhi manyate
meaning: ऋद्ध्यामेव तद्वीर्य एषु लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति । यच्चातुर्मास्ययाज्यात्मनो नावद्येत् । देवेभ्य आवृश्च्येत । चतृषु चतृषु मासेषु निवर्तयेत । परोक्षमेव तद्देवेभ्य आत्मनोऽवद्यत्यनाव्रस्काय । देवानां वा एष आनीतः । यश्चातुर्मास्ययाजी । य एवं विद्वान्नि च वर्तयते परि च । देवता एवाप्येति । नास्य रुद्रः प्रजां पशूनभि मन्यते
text_mt: He thus firmly establishes himself in prosperity, in heroic power, in these worlds. / If the sacrificer of the Four-Month rites were not to offer [a portion] of himself, / he would be cut off from the gods. / He should shave every four months; / thereby he secretly offers [a portion] of himself to the gods, in order not to be cut off. / Indeed, he is brought to the gods, / the sacrificer of the Four-Month rites who, knowing thus, turns [the razor] down and around; / he joins the deities; / Rudra does not harm his offspring or domestic animals.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣaḥ prāṇaṃ saṃtanu | prāṇādapānaṃ saṃtanu | apānādvyānaṃ saṃtanu | vyānāccakṣuḥ saṃtanu | cakṣuṣaḥ śrotraṃ saṃtanu | śrotrānmanaḥ saṃtanu | manaso vācaṃ saṃtanu | vāca ātmānaṃ saṃtanu | ātmanaḥ pṛthivīṃ saṃtanu | pṛthivyā antarikṣaṃ saṃtanu | antarikṣāddivaṃ saṃtanu | divaḥ suvaḥ saṃtanu
meaning: आयुषः प्राणं संतनु । प्राणादपानं संतनु । अपानाद्व्यानं संतनु । व्यानाच्चक्षुः संतनु । चक्षुषः श्रोत्रं संतनु । श्रोत्रान्मनः संतनु । मनसो वाचं संतनु । वाच आत्मानं संतनु । आत्मनः पृथिवीं संतनु । पृथिव्या अन्तरिक्षं संतनु । अन्तरिक्षाद्दिवं संतनु । दिवः सुवः संतनु
text_mt: Continue exhalation from lifespan; / continue inhalation from exhalation; / continue diffused breath from inhalation; / continue sight from diffused breath; / continue hearing from sight; / continue mind from hearing; / continue speech from mind; / continue the self from speech; / continue the earth from the self; / continue the intermediate region from the earth; / continue heaven from the intermediate region; / continue the light of heaven from heaven.

sanskrit_iast: indro dadhīco asthabhiḥ | vṛtrāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ | jaghāna navatīrnava | icchannaśvasya yacchiraḥ | parvateṣvapaśritam | tadvidaccharyaṇāvati | atrāha goramanvata | nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam | itthā candramaso gṛhe | indramidgāthino bṛhat
meaning: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिः । वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव । इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः । पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम् । तद्विदच्छर्यणावति । अत्राह गोरमन्वत । नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् । इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे । इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहत्
text_mt: Indra, unopposed, / slew ninety-nine Vṛtras / with the bones of Dadhyañc. / Seeking the head of the horse / that was hidden in the mountains, / he found it in Śaryaṇāvant. / Here indeed they recognized the secret name / of the cow of Tvaṣṭṛ, / thus in the house of the moon. / The singers [praise] Indra loudly,

sanskrit_iast: indramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ | indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata | indra iddharyoḥ sacā | saṃmiśla āvaco yujā | indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ | indro dīrghāya cakṣase | ā sūryaṃ rohayaddivi | vi gobhiradrimairayat | indra vājeṣu no ava | sahasrapradhaneṣu ca
meaning: इन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत । इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा । संमिश्ल आवचो युजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः । इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षसे । आ सूर्यं रोहयद्दिवि । वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत् । इन्द्र वाजेषु नो अव । सहस्रप्रधनेषु च
text_mt: the chanters with chants [praise] Indra; / the voices resounded to Indra. / Indra alone, united with his two bay horses, / joined with those harnessed by speech; / Indra, wielder of the vajra, golden. / Indra made the sun rise in the sky / for long vision; / he split the rock with the cows. / O Indra, help us in contests / and in battles for thousands!

sanskrit_iast: ugra ugrābhirūtibhiḥ | tamindraṃ vājayāmasi | mahe vṛtrāya hantave | sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat | indraḥ sa dāmane kṛtaḥ | ojiṣṭhaḥ sa bale hitaḥ | dyumnī ślokī sa saumyaḥ | girā vajro na saṃbhṛtaḥ | sabalo anapacyutaḥ | vavakṣurugro astṛtaḥ
meaning: उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः । तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि । महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् । इन्द्रः स दामने कृतः । ओजिष्ठः स बले हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सौम्यः । गिरा वज्रो न संभृतः । सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्षुरुग्रो अस्तृतः
text_mt: Mighty with mighty aids, / that Indra do we invigorate / to slay the great Vṛtra. / May he, the bull, the stallion, / Indra, be made to give; / he is most splendorous in might, established in strength, / resplendent, renowned, related to Soma; / like a vajra gathered by song, / strong, unyielding, / eager to grow, fierce, unsubdued.

sanskrit_iast: devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | sa prajāpatirindraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ putramapa nyadhatta | nedenamasurā balīyāṃ so'hananniti | prahrādo ha vai kāyādhavaḥ | virocanaṃ svaṃ putramapa nyadhatta | nedenaṃ devā ahananniti | te devāḥ prajāpatimupasametyocuḥ | nārājakasya yuddhamasti | indramanvicchāmeti | taṃ yajñakratubhiranvaicchan
meaning: देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । स प्रजापतिरिन्द्रं ज्येष्ठं पुत्रमप न्यधत्त । नेदेनमसुरा बलीयां सोऽहनन्निति । प्रह्रादो ह वै कायाधवः । विरोचनं स्वं पुत्रमप न्यधत्त । नेदेनं देवा अहनन्निति । ते देवाः प्रजापतिमुपसमेत्योचुः । नाराजकस्य युद्धमस्ति । इन्द्रमन्विच्छामेति । तं यज्ञक्रतुभिरन्वैच्छन्
text_mt:
The gods and the asuras were in conflict. / Prajāpati concealed Indra, his eldest son, / [thinking,] 'Lest the stronger asuras slay him.' / Prahrāda Kāyādhava / concealed Virocana, his own son, / [thinking,] 'Lest the gods slay him.' / Those gods, approaching Prajāpati, said, / 'There is no fighting for one without a king; / let us seek Indra!' / They sought him through the sacrificial rites.

They did not find him by means of sacrificial rites.
They sought him by means of offerings (iṣṭi).
They found him by means of offerings.
That is the offering-nature (iṣṭitva) of the offerings.
Indeed, their name is 'seekings' (eṣṭi).
They call them 'offerings' (iṣṭi) cryptically,
for the gods are fond of the cryptic, as it were.
For him, they poured out this initiation offering (dīkṣaṇīyā) on eleven potsherds for Agni and Viṣṇu.
Having hastened away, they performed it.
They brought it as far as the patnīsaṃyājas.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ yajñakratubhirnānvavindan | tamiṣṭibhiranvaicchan | tamiṣṭibhiranvavindan | tadiṣṭīnāmiṣṭitvam | eṣṭayo ha vai nāma | tā iṣṭaya ityācakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣapriyā iva hi devāḥ | tasmā etamāgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ dīkṣaṇīyaṃ niravapan | tadapadrutyātanvata | tānpatnīsaṃyājānta upānayan
meaning: तं यज्ञक्रतुभिर्नान्वविन्दन् । तमिष्टिभिरन्वैच्छन् । तमिष्टिभिरन्वविन्दन् । तदिष्टीनामिष्टित्वम् । एष्टयो ह वै नाम । ता इष्टय इत्याचक्षते परोक्षेण । परोक्षप्रिया इव हि देवाः । तस्मा एतमाग्नावैष्णवमेकादशकपालं दीक्षणीयं निरवपन् । तदपद्रुत्यातन्वत । तान्पत्नीसंयाजान्त उपानयन्

sanskrit_iast: te tadantameva kṛtvodadravan | te prāyaṇīyamabhi samārohan | tadapadrutyātanvata | tāñchaṃyvanta upānayan | te tadantameva kṛtvodadravan | ta ātitthyamabhi samārohan | tadapadrutyātanvata | tāniḍānta upānayan | te tadantameva kṛtvodadravan | tasmādetā etadantā iṣṭayaḥ saṃtiṣṭhante
meaning: ते तदन्तमेव कृत्वोदद्रवन् । ते प्रायणीयमभि समारोहन् । तदपद्रुत्यातन्वत । ताञ्छंय्वन्त उपानयन् । ते तदन्तमेव कृत्वोदद्रवन् । त आतित्थ्यमभि समारोहन् । तदपद्रुत्यातन्वत । तानिडान्त उपानयन् । ते तदन्तमेव कृत्वोदद्रवन् । तस्मादेता एतदन्ता इष्टयः संतिष्ठन्ते
text_mt:
Having made that its end, they hurried away.
They undertook the introductory offering (prāyaṇīyā).
Having hastened away, they performed it.
They brought it as far as the Śaṃyu-formula.
Having made that its end, they hurried away.
They undertook the hospitality offering (ātithyā).
Having hastened away, they performed it.
They brought it as far as the iḍā.
Having made that its end, they hurried away.
Therefore, these offerings conclude with these [respective] ends.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ hi devā akurvata | iti devā akurvata | ityu vai manuṣyāḥ kurvate | te devā ūcuḥ | yadvā idamuccairyajñena carāma | tanno'surāḥ pāpmā'nuvindanti | upāṃśūpasadā carāma | tathā no'surāḥ pāpmā nānuvethsyantīti | ta upāṃśūpasadamatanvata | tisra eva sāmidhenīranūcya
meaning: एवं हि देवा अकुर्वत । इति देवा अकुर्वत । इत्यु वै मनुष्याः कुर्वते । ते देवा ऊचुः । यद्वा इदमुच्चैर्यज्ञेन चराम । तन्नोऽसुराः पाप्माऽनुविन्दन्ति । उपांशूपसदा चराम । तथा नोऽसुराः पाप्मा नानुवेथ्स्यन्तीति । त उपांशूपसदमतन्वत । तिस्र एव सामिधेनीरनूच्य

sanskrit_iast: sruveṇāghāramāghārya | tisraḥ parācīrāhutīrhutvā | sruveṇopasadaṃ juhavāñcakruḥ | ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīṃ tveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhīg svāheti | aśanayāpipāse ha vā ugraṃ vacaḥ | enaśca vairahatyaṃ ca tveṣaṃ vacaḥ | etaṃ ha vāva taccaturdhā vihitaṃ pāpmānaṃ devā apajaghnire | tatho evaitadevaṃ vidyajamānaḥ | tisra eva sāmidhenīranūcya | sruveṇāghāramāghārya
meaning: स्रुवेणाघारमाघार्य । तिस्रः पराचीराहुतीर्हुत्वा । स्रुवेणोपसदं जुहवाञ्चक्रुः । उग्रं वचो अपावधीं त्वेषं वचो अपावधीग् स्वाहेति । अशनयापिपासे ह वा उग्रं वचः । एनश्च वैरहत्यं च त्वेषं वचः । एतं ह वाव तच्चतुर्धा विहितं पाप्मानं देवा अपजघ्निरे । तथो एवैतदेवं विद्यजमानः । तिस्र एव सामिधेनीरनूच्य । स्रुवेणाघारमाघार्य
text_mt:
Having made the libation (āghāra) with the dipping spoon (sruva),
having offered three successive oblations,
they made an offering of the upasad with the dipping spoon:
'Fierce speech I have struck down, violent speech I have struck down, svāhā.'
Hunger and thirst are indeed fierce speech;
sin and the slaying of an enemy are violent speech.
Verily, that fourfold evil the gods struck away.
Likewise, the sacrificer who knows thus,
having recited only three kindling verses,
having made the libation with the dipping spoon,

sanskrit_iast: tisraḥ parācīrāhutīrhutvā | sruveṇopasadaṃ juhoti | ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīṃ tveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhīg svāheti | aśanayāpipāse ha vā ugraṃ vacaḥ | enaśca vairahatyaṃ ca tveṣaṃ vacaḥ | etameva taccaturdhā vihitaṃ pāpmānaṃ yajamāno'pahate | te'bhinīyaivāhaḥ paśumā'labhanta | ahna eva taddevā avartiṃ pāpmānaṃ mṛtyumapajaghnire | tenābhinīyeva rātreḥ prācaran | rātriyā eva taddevā avartiṃ pāpmānaṃ mṛtyumapajaghnire
meaning: तिस्रः पराचीराहुतीर्हुत्वा । स्रुवेणोपसदं जुहोति । उग्रं वचो अपावधीं त्वेषं वचो अपावधीग् स्वाहेति । अशनयापिपासे ह वा उग्रं वचः । एनश्च वैरहत्यं च त्वेषं वचः । एतमेव तच्चतुर्धा विहितं पाप्मानं यजमानोऽपहते । तेऽभिनीयैवाहः पशुमाऽलभन्त । अह्न एव तद्देवा अवर्तिं पाप्मानं मृत्युमपजघ्निरे । तेनाभिनीयेव रात्रेः प्राचरन् । रात्रिया एव तद्देवा अवर्तिं पाप्मानं मृत्युमपजघ्निरे

sanskrit_iast: tasmādabhinīyaivāhaḥ paśumālabheta | ahna eva tadyajamāno'vartiṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyānapanudate | tenābhinīyeva rātreḥ pracaret | rātriyā eva tadyajamāno'vartiṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyānapanudate | sa eṣa upavasathīye'handvidevatyaḥ paśurālabhyate | dvayaṃ vā asmiṃ lloke yajamānaḥ | asthi ca māṃsaṃ ca | asthi caiva tena māṃsaṃ ca yajamānaḥ saṃskurute | tā vā etāḥ pañca devatāḥ | agnīṣomāvagnirmitrāvaruṇau
meaning: तस्मादभिनीयैवाहः पशुमालभेत । अह्न एव तद्यजमानोऽवर्तिं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यानपनुदते । तेनाभिनीयेव रात्रेः प्रचरेत् । रात्रिया एव तद्यजमानोऽवर्तिं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यानपनुदते । स एष उपवसथीयेऽहन्द्विदेवत्यः पशुरालभ्यते । द्वयं वा अस्मिं ल्लोके यजमानः । अस्थि च मांसं च । अस्थि चैव तेन मांसं च यजमानः संस्कुरुते । ता वा एताः पञ्च देवताः । अग्नीषोमावग्निर्मित्रावरुणौ
text_mt:
Therefore, having brought [the day] to a close, he should seize the victim;
thereby the sacrificer thrusts away destitution, evil, [and his] rivals from the day.
As if having brought [it] to a close, he should proceed from the night;
thereby the sacrificer thrusts away destitution, evil, [and his] rivals from the night.
This animal victim dedicated to two deities is seized on the day of preparation (upavasathīya).
The sacrificer in this world is twofold indeed:
bone and flesh.
Thereby the sacrificer refines both bone and flesh.
These indeed are five deities:
Agni-and-Soma, Agni, and Mitra-and-Varuṇa.
Fivefold indeed is the sacrificer:
skin, flesh, sinew, bone, marrow.
He thus frees this self, constituted fivefold, from the fetters of Varuṇa,
for healing, for freedom from Varuṇa.
They called him in the morning with seven metres;
therefore seven metres, each increasing by four [syllables], are recited in the morning recitation (prātaranuvāka).
Having approached him with this [verse], they sat by:
'Sing to him, o men!'
Therefore, with this [verse] the out-of-doors chant (bahiṣpavamāna) is to be approached.

sanskrit_iast: pañcapañcī vai yajamānaḥ | tvaṅmāṃ saṃ snāvā'sthi majjā | etameva tatpañcadhā vihitamātmānaṃ varuṇapāśānmuñcati | bheṣajatāyai nirvaruṇatvāya | taṃ saptabhiśchandobhiḥ prātarahvayan | tasmāthsapta caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsi prātaranuvāke'nūcyante | tametayopasametyopāsīdan | upāsmai gāyatā nara iti | tasmādetayā bahiṣpavamāna upasadyaḥ
meaning: पञ्चपञ्ची वै यजमानः । त्वङ्मां सं स्नावाऽस्थि मज्जा । एतमेव तत्पञ्चधा विहितमात्मानं वरुणपाशान्मुञ्चति । भेषजतायै निर्वरुणत्वाय । तं सप्तभिश्छन्दोभिः प्रातरह्वयन् । तस्माथ्सप्त चतुरुत्तराणि छन्दांसि प्रातरनुवाकेऽनूच्यन्ते । तमेतयोपसमेत्योपासीदन् । उपास्मै गायता नर इति । तस्मादेतया बहिष्पवमान उपसद्यः

sanskrit_iast: sa samudra uttarataḥ prājvaladbhūmyantena | eṣa vāva sa samudraḥ | yaccātvālaḥ | eṣa u veva sa bhūmyantaḥ | yadvedyantaḥ | tadetattriśalaṃ tripūruṣam | tasmāttaṃ trivitastaṃ khananti | sa suvarṇarajatābhyāṃ kuśībhyāṃ parigṛhīta āsīt | taṃ yadasyā adhyajanayan | tasmādādityaḥ
meaning: स समुद्र उत्तरतः प्राज्वलद्भूम्यन्तेन । एष वाव स समुद्रः । यच्चात्वालः । एष उ वेव स भूम्यन्तः । यद्वेद्यन्तः । तदेतत्त्रिशलं त्रिपूरुषम् । तस्मात्तं त्रिवितस्तं खनन्ति । स सुवर्णरजताभ्यां कुशीभ्यां परिगृहीत आसीत् । तं यदस्या अध्यजनयन् । तस्मादादित्यः
text_mt:
That ocean flared forth from the north along the border of the earth.
That ocean is indeed
what the pit (cātvāla) is.
And that border of the earth is indeed
what the border of the altar is.
That is three spans, three puruṣas [in measure].
Therefore they dig it three vitastis deep.
It was held around by two points (kuśī), of gold and silver.
Because they generated him from this [earth],
therefore [he is] Āditya.

Now, because it was held around by two points of gold and silver,
that is his nature as Kauśika.
They praised towards him with the ninefold [stoma];
they took him with the ninefold;
they bore him with the ninefold,
as great as is the measure of the ninefold.
They praised towards him with the fifteenfold [stoma];
they took him with the fifteenfold;
they bore him with the fifteenfold,
as great as is the measure of the fifteenfold.

sanskrit_iast: atha yathsuvarṇarajatābhyāṃ kuśībhyāṃ parigṛhīta āsīt | sā'sya kauśikatā | taṃ trivṛtā'bhi prāstuvata | taṃ trivṛtā''dadata | taṃ trivṛtā''haran | yāvatī trivṛto mātrā | taṃ pañcadaśenābhi prāstuvata | taṃ pañcadaśenādadata | taṃ pañcadaśenāharan | yāvatī pañcadaśasya mātrā
meaning: अथ यथ्सुवर्णरजताभ्यां कुशीभ्यां परिगृहीत आसीत् । साऽस्य कौशिकता । तं त्रिवृताऽभि प्रास्तुवत । तं त्रिवृता'ऽददत । तं त्रिवृता'ऽहरन् । यावती त्रिवृतो मात्रा । तं पञ्चदशेनाभि प्रास्तुवत । तं पञ्चदशेनाददत । तं पञ्चदशेनाहरन् । यावती पञ्चदशस्य मात्रा

sanskrit_iast: taṃ saptadaśenābhi prāstuvata | taṃ saptadaśenādadata | taṃ saptadaśenāharan | yāvatī saptadaśasya mātrā | tasya saptadaśena hriyamāṇasya tejo haro'patat | tamekaviṃśenābhi prāstuvata | tamekaviṃśenādadata | tamekaviṃśenāharan | yāvatyekaviṃśasya mātrā | te yattrivṛtā stuvate
meaning: तं सप्तदशेनाभि प्रास्तुवत । तं सप्तदशेनाददत । तं सप्तदशेनाहरन् । यावती सप्तदशस्य मात्रा । तस्य सप्तदशेन ह्रियमाणस्य तेजो हरोऽपतत् । तमेकविंशेनाभि प्रास्तुवत । तमेकविंशेनाददत । तमेकविंशेनाहरन् । यावत्येकविंशस्य मात्रा । ते यत्त्रिवृता स्तुवते

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtaiva tadyajamānamādadate | taṃ trivṛtaiva haranti | yāvatī trivṛto mātrā | agnirvai trivṛt | yāvadvā agnerdahato dhūma udetyānu vyeti | tāvatī trivṛto mātrā | agnerevainaṃ tat | mātrāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ gamayanti | atha yatpañcadaśena stuvate | pañcadaśenaiva tadyajamānamādadate
meaning: त्रिवृतैव तद्यजमानमाददते । तं त्रिवृतैव हरन्ति । यावती त्रिवृतो मात्रा । अग्निर्वै त्रिवृत् । यावद्वा अग्नेर्दहतो धूम उदेत्यानु व्येति । तावती त्रिवृतो मात्रा । अग्नेरेवैनं तत् । मात्रां सायुज्यं सलोकतां गमयन्ति । अथ यत्पञ्चदशेन स्तुवते । पञ्चदशेनैव तद्यजमानमाददते
text_mt:
they thereby take the sacrificer with the ninefold;
they bear him with the ninefold,
as great as is the measure of the ninefold.
Agni is indeed the ninefold.
As far as the smoke of burning Agni goes up and disperses,
so great is the measure of the ninefold.
They thereby cause him to attain
measure, unison, [and] co-residence with Agni.
And when they chant praise with the fifteenfold,
they thereby take the sacrificer with the fifteenfold;

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pañcadaśenaiva haranti | yāvatī pañcadaśasya mātrā | candramā vai pañcadaśaḥ | eṣa hi pañcadaśyāmapakṣīyate | pañcadaśyāmāpūryate | candramasa evainaṃ tat | mātrāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ gamayanti | atha yathsaptadaśena stuvate | saptadaśenaiva tadyajamānamādadate | taṃ saptadaśenaiva haranti
meaning: तं पञ्चदशेनैव हरन्ति । यावती पञ्चदशस्य मात्रा । चन्द्रमा वै पञ्चदशः । एष हि पञ्चदश्यामपक्षीयते । पञ्चदश्यामापूर्यते । चन्द्रमस एवैनं तत् । मात्रां सायुज्यं सलोकतां गमयन्ति । अथ यथ्सप्तदशेन स्तुवते । सप्तदशेनैव तद्यजमानमाददते । तं सप्तदशेनैव हरन्ति
text_mt:
they bear him with the fifteenfold,
as great as is the measure of the fifteenfold.
The moon is indeed the fifteenfold,
for it wanes on the fifteenth day,
[and] it waxes on the fifteenth day.
They thereby cause him to attain
measure, unison, [and] co-residence with the moon.
Now, when they chant praise with the seventeenfold,
they thereby take the sacrificer with the seventeenfold;
they bear him with the seventeenfold,

sanskrit_iast: yāvatī saptadaśasya mātrā | prajāpatirvai saptadaśaḥ | prajāpaterevainaṃ tat | mātrāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ gamayanti | atha yadekaviṃśena stuvate | ekaviṃśenaiva tadyajamānamādadate | tamekaviṃśenaiva haranti | yāvatyekaviṃśasya mātrā | asau vā āditya ekaviṃśaḥ | ādityasyaivainaṃ tat
meaning: यावती सप्तदशस्य मात्रा । प्रजापतिर्वै सप्तदशः । प्रजापतेरेवैनं तत् । मात्रां सायुज्यं सलोकतां गमयन्ति । अथ यदेकविंशेन स्तुवते । एकविंशेनैव तद्यजमानमाददते । तमेकविंशेनैव हरन्ति । यावत्येकविंशस्य मात्रा । असौ वा आदित्य एकविंशः । आदित्यस्यैवैनं तत्
text_mt: As great as is the measure of the seventeenfold [stoma]— / Prajāpati indeed is seventeenfold— / to Prajāpati's measure, unison, [and] co-residence they thereby cause him to go. / Then when they chant with the twenty-onefold [stoma], / by the twenty-onefold they then grasp the sacrificer; / him they convey by the twenty-onefold. / As great as is the measure of the twenty-onefold— / yonder sun indeed is twenty-onefold— / to the sun's [measure] they then

sanskrit_iast: mātrāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ gamayanti | te kuśyau | vyaghnan | te ahorātre abhavatām | ahareva suvarṇā'bhavat | rajatā rātriḥ | sa yadāditya udeti | etāmeva tathsuvarṇāṃ kuśīmanu sameti | atha yadastameti | etāmeva tadrajatāṃ kuśīmanu saṃviśati | prahrādo ha vai kāyādhavaḥ | virocanaṃ svaṃ putramudāsyat | sa pradaro'bhavat | tasmātpradarādudakaṃ nācāmet
meaning: मात्रां सायुज्यं सलोकतां गमयन्ति । ते कुश्यौ । व्यघ्नन् । ते अहोरात्रे अभवताम् । अहरेव सुवर्णाऽभवत् । रजता रात्रिः । स यदादित्य उदेति । एतामेव तथ्सुवर्णां कुशीमनु समेति । अथ यदस्तमेति । एतामेव तद्रजतां कुशीमनु संविशति । प्रह्रादो ह वै कायाधवः । विरोचनं स्वं पुत्रमुदास्यत् । स प्रदरोऽभवत् । तस्मात्प्रदरादुदकं नाचामेत्
text_mt: measure, unison, [and] co-residence cause him to go. / They [Indra and the gods] struck the two points. / They became day and night. / The golden one became day; / the silver one, night. / When yonder sun rises, / along this golden point he then goes. / And when he sets, / into this silver point he then enters. / Prahrāda Kāyādhava indeed / cast out Virocana, his own son. / He became a chasm. / Therefore one should not sip water from a chasm.

sanskrit_iast: ye vai catvāraḥ stomāḥ | kṛtaṃ tat | atha ye pañca | kaliḥ saḥ | tasmāccatuṣṭomaḥ | taccatuṣṭomasya catuṣṭomatvam | tadāhuḥ | katamāni tāni jyotīṃṣi | ya etasya stomā iti | trivṛtpañcadaśaḥ saptadaśa ekaviṃśaḥ
meaning: ये वै चत्वारः स्तोमाः । कृतं तत् । अथ ये पञ्च । कलिः सः । तस्माच्चतुष्टोमः । तच्चतुष्टोमस्य चतुष्टोमत्वम् । तदाहुः । कतमानि तानि ज्योतींषि । य एतस्य स्तोमा इति । त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशः सप्तदश एकविंशः
text_mt: Those which are the four stomas, / that is the Kṛta [throw]. / And that which is five, / that is Kali. / Therefore it is the Catuṣṭoma. / That is the catuṣṭoma nature of the Catuṣṭoma. / As to this they say: / 'Which are those lights / that are the stomas of this [rite]?' / The nine-versed, the fifteen-versed, the seventeen-versed, [and] the twenty-one-versed.

sanskrit_iast: etāni vāva tāni jyotīṃṣi | ya etasya stomāḥ | so'bravīt | saptadaśena hriyamāṇo vyaleśiṣi | bhiṣajyatameti | tamaśvinau dhānābhirabhiṣajyatām | pūṣā karambheṇa | bhāratī parivāpeṇa | mitrāvaruṇau payasyayā | tadāhuḥ
meaning: एतानि वाव तानि ज्योतींषि । य एतस्य स्तोमाः । सोऽब्रवीत् । सप्तदशेन ह्रियमाणो व्यलेशिषि । भिषज्यतमेति । तमश्विनौ धानाभिरभिषज्यताम् । पूषा करम्भेण । भारती परिवापेण । मित्रावरुणौ पयस्यया । तदाहुः
text_mt: These indeed are those lights / that are the stomas of this [rite]. / He said: / 'Being conveyed by the seventeenfold, I have become unstrung; / heal me!' / Him the two Aśvins healed with parched grains, / Pūṣan with groats, / Bhāratī with puffed grain, / Mitra and Varuṇa with curdled milk. / As to this they say:

sanskrit_iast: yadaśvibhyāṃ dhānāḥ | pūṣṇaḥ karambhaḥ | bhāratyai parivāpaḥ | mitrāvaruṇayoḥ payasyā'tha | kasmādeteṣāṃ haviṣāmindrameva yajantīti | etā hyenaṃ devatā iti brūyāt | etairhavirbhirabhiṣajyaṃstasmāditi | taṃ vasavo'ṣṭākapālena prātaḥsavane'bhiṣajyan | rudrā ekādaśakapālena mādhyandine savane | viśve devā dvādaśakapālena tṛtīyasavane
meaning: यदश्विभ्यां धानाः । पूष्णः करम्भः । भारत्यै परिवापः । मित्रावरुणयोः पयस्याऽथ । कस्मादेतेषां हविषामिन्द्रमेव यजन्तीति । एता ह्येनं देवता इति ब्रूयात् । एतैर्हविर्भिरभिषज्यंस्तस्मादिति । तं वसवोऽष्टाकपालेन प्रातःसवनेऽभिषज्यन् । रुद्रा एकादशकपालेन माध्यन्दिने सवने । विश्वे देवा द्वादशकपालेन तृतीयसवने
text_mt: 'Since the parched grains belong to the two Aśvins, / the groats to Pūṣan, / the puffed grain to Bhāratī, / the curdled milk to Mitra and Varuṇa, / why then do they sacrifice to Indra with these oblations?' / 'Because these deities,' one should say, / 'healed him with these oblations; therefore [they do so].' / The Vasus healed him at the morning pressing with [a cake] on eight potsherds, / the Rudras with [a cake] on eleven potsherds at the midday pressing, / the All-gods with [a cake] on twelve potsherds at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadaṣṭākapālānprātaḥsavane kuryāt | ekādaśa kapālānmādhyandine savane | dvādaśakapālāṃstṛtīyasavane | viloma tadyajñasya kriyeta | ekādaśakapālāneva prātaḥsavane kuryāt | ekādaśakapālānmādhyandine savane | ekādaśakapālāṃstṛtīyasavane | yajñasya salomatvāya | tadāhuḥ | yadvasūnāṃ prātaḥsavanam | rudrāṇāṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam | viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ tṛtīyasavanam | atha kasmādeteṣāṃ haviṣāmindrameva yajantīti | etā hyenaṃ devatā iti brūyāt | etairhavirbhirabhiṣajyaṃstasmāditi
meaning: स यदष्टाकपालान्प्रातःसवने कुर्यात् । एकादश कपालान्माध्यन्दिने सवने । द्वादशकपालांस्तृतीयसवने । विलोम तद्यज्ञस्य क्रियेत । एकादशकपालानेव प्रातःसवने कुर्यात् । एकादशकपालान्माध्यन्दिने सवने । एकादशकपालांस्तृतीयसवने । यज्ञस्य सलोमत्वाय । तदाहुः । यद्वसूनां प्रातःसवनम् । रुद्राणां माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् । विश्वेषां देवानां तृतीयसवनम् । अथ कस्मादेतेषां हविषामिन्द्रमेव यजन्तीति । एता ह्येनं देवता इति ब्रूयात् । एतैर्हविर्भिरभिषज्यंस्तस्मादिति
text_mt: If he should prepare [cakes] on eight potsherds at the morning pressing, / [cakes] on eleven potsherds at the midday pressing, / [and cakes] on twelve potsherds at the third pressing, / that would be done against the grain of the sacrifice. / He should prepare [cakes] on eleven potsherds at the morning pressing, / [cakes] on eleven potsherds at the midday pressing, / [and cakes] on eleven potsherds at the third pressing, / for the regular flow of the sacrifice. / As to this they say: / 'Since the morning pressing belongs to the Vasus, / the midday pressing to the Rudras, / the third pressing to the All-gods, / why then do they sacrifice to Indra with these oblations?' / 'Because these deities,' one should say, / 'healed him with these oblations; therefore [they do so].'

sanskrit_iast: tasyā vāco'vapādādabibhayuḥ | tameteṣu saptasu chandaḥsvaśrayan | yadaśrayan | tacchrāyantīyasya śrāyantīyatvam | yadavārayan | tadvāravantīyasya vāravantīyatvam | tasyā vāca evāvapādādabibhayuḥ | tasmā etāni sapta caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsyupādadhuḥ | teṣāmati trīṇyaricyanta | na trīṇyudabhavan
meaning: तस्या वाचोऽवपादादबिभयुः । तमेतेषु सप्तसु छन्दःस्वश्रयन् । यदश्रयन् । तच्छ्रायन्तीयस्य श्रायन्तीयत्वम् । यदवारयन् । तद्वारवन्तीयस्य वारवन्तीयत्वम् । तस्या वाच एवावपादादबिभयुः । तस्मा एतानि सप्त चतुरुत्तराणि छन्दांस्युपादधुः । तेषामति त्रीण्यरिच्यन्त । न त्रीण्युदभवन्
text_mt: They feared his falling downward. / Him they supported on these seven meters. / In that they supported (aśrayan) [him], / that is the śrāyantīya nature of the Śrāyantīya [sāman]. / In that they warded off (avārayan), / that is the vāravantīya nature of the Vāravantīya [sāman]. / They feared indeed his falling downward; / for him they placed these seven meters, each increasing by four syllables. / Of them three were redundant; / three were insufficient.

sanskrit_iast: sa bṛhatīmevāspṛśat | dvābhyāmakṣarābhyām | ahorātrābhyāmeva | tadāhuḥ | katamā sā devākṣarā bṛhatī | yasyāṃ tatpratyatiṣṭhat | dvādaśa paurṇamāsyaḥ | dvādaśāṣṭakāḥ | dvādaśāmāvāsyāḥ | eṣā vāva sā devākṣarā bṛhatī
meaning: स बृहतीमेवास्पृशत् । द्वाभ्यामक्षराभ्याम् । अहोरात्राभ्यामेव । तदाहुः । कतमा सा देवाक्षरा बृहती । यस्यां तत्प्रत्यतिष्ठत् । द्वादश पौर्णमास्यः । द्वादशाष्टकाः । द्वादशामावास्याः । एषा वाव सा देवाक्षरा बृहती
text_mt: He reached the Bṛhatī itself / by two syllables, / indeed by day and night. / As to this they say: / 'Which is that Bṛhatī of divine syllables / upon which he then established himself?' / Twelve full-moon days, / twelve aṣṭakās, / twelve new-moon days: / this indeed is that Bṛhatī of divine syllables

sanskrit_iast: yasyāṃ tatpratyatiṣṭhaditi | yāni ca chandāṃsyatyaricyanta | yāni ca nodabhavan | tāni nirvīryāṇi hīnānyamanyanta | sā'bravīdbṛhatī | māmeva bhūtvā | māmupa saṃśrayateti | caturbhirakṣarairanuṣṭugbṛhatīṃ nodabhavat | caturbhirakṣaraiḥ paṅktirbṛhatīmatyaricyata | tasyāmetāni catvāryakṣarāṇyapacchidyādadhāt
meaning: यस्यां तत्प्रत्यतिष्ठदिति । यानि च छन्दांस्यत्यरिच्यन्त । यानि च नोदभवन् । तानि निर्वीर्याणि हीनान्यमन्यन्त । साऽब्रवीद्बृहती । मामेव भूत्वा । मामुप संश्रयतेति । चतुर्भिरक्षरैरनुष्टुग्बृहतीं नोदभवत् । चतुर्भिरक्षरैः पङ्क्तिर्बृहतीमत्यरिच्यत । तस्यामेतानि चत्वार्यक्षराण्यपच्छिद्यादधात्
text_mt: upon which he then established himself. / And those meters which were redundant, / and those which were insufficient, / those they considered powerless and defective. / The Bṛhatī said: / 'Becoming me, / rest upon me!' / By four syllables the Anuṣṭubh was insufficient for the Bṛhatī; / by four syllables the Paṅkti was redundant for the Bṛhatī. / Cutting off these four syllables from it [the Paṅkti], she placed [them in the Anuṣṭubh].

sanskrit_iast: te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā | bṛhatīmupa samaśrayatām | aṣṭābhirakṣarairuṣṇigbṛhatīṃ nodabhavat | aṣṭābhirakṣaraistriṣṭug bṛhatīmatyaricyata | tasyāmetānyaṣṭāvakṣarāṇyapacchidyādadhāt | te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā | bṛhatīmupa samaśrayatām | dvādaśabhirakṣarairgāyatrī bṛhatīṃ nodabhavat | dvādaśabhirakṣarairjagatī bṛhatīmatyaricyata | tasyāmetāni dvādaśākṣarāṇyapacchidyādadhāt
meaning: ते बृहती एव भूत्वा । बृहतीमुप समश्रयताम् । अष्टाभिरक्षरैरुष्णिग्बृहतीं नोदभवत् । अष्टाभिरक्षरैस्त्रिष्टुग् बृहतीमत्यरिच्यत । तस्यामेतान्यष्टावक्षराण्यपच्छिद्यादधात् । ते बृहती एव भूत्वा । बृहतीमुप समश्रयताम् । द्वादशभिरक्षरैर्गायत्री बृहतीं नोदभवत् । द्वादशभिरक्षरैर्जगती बृहतीमत्यरिच्यत । तस्यामेतानि द्वादशाक्षराण्यपच्छिद्यादधात्
text_mt: Those two, having become the Bṛhatī itself, / rested upon the Bṛhatī. / By eight syllables the Uṣṇih was insufficient for the Bṛhatī; / by eight syllables the Triṣṭubh was redundant for the Bṛhatī. / Cutting off these eight syllables from it [the Triṣṭubh], she placed [them in the Uṣṇih]. / Those two, having become the Bṛhatī itself, / rested upon the Bṛhatī. / By twelve syllables the Gāyatrī was insufficient for the Bṛhatī; / by twelve syllables the Jagatī was redundant for the Bṛhatī. / Cutting off these twelve syllables from it [the Jagatī], she placed [them in the Gāyatrī].

sanskrit_iast: te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā | bṛhatīmupa samaśrayatām | so'bravītprajāpatiḥ | chandāṃsi ratho me bhavata | yuṣmābhirahametamadhvānamanu saṃcarāṇīti | tasya gāyatrī ca jagatī ca pakṣāvabhavatām | uṣṇikca triṣṭupca praṣṭyau | anuṣṭupca paṅktiśca dhuryau | bṛhatyevoddhirabhavat | sa etaṃ chandorathamāsthāya | etamadhvānamanu samacarat | etaṃ ha vai chandorathamāsthāya | etamadhvānamanu saṃcarati | yenaiṣa etathsaṃcarati | ya evaṃ vidvānthsomena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
meaning: ते बृहती एव भूत्वा । बृहतीमुप समश्रयताम् । सोऽब्रवीत्प्रजापतिः । छन्दांसि रथो मे भवत । युष्माभिरहमेतमध्वानमनु संचराणीति । तस्य गायत्री च जगती च पक्षावभवताम् । उष्णिक्च त्रिष्टुप्च प्रष्ट्यौ । अनुष्टुप्च पङ्क्तिश्च धुर्यौ । बृहत्येवोद्धिरभवत् । स एतं छन्दोरथमास्थाय । एतमध्वानमनु समचरत् । एतं ह वै छन्दोरथमास्थाय । एतमध्वानमनु संचरति । येनैष एतथ्संचरति । य एवं विद्वान्थ्सोमेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
text_mt: Those two, having become the Bṛhatī itself, / rested upon the Bṛhatī. / Prajāpati said: / 'Meters, become my chariot! / By you may I travel along this way.' / His wings became the Gāyatrī and the Jagatī; / the side-horses, the Uṣṇih and the Triṣṭubh; / the yoke-horses, the Anuṣṭubh and the Paṅkti; / the chariot-frame became the Bṛhatī itself. / Having mounted this chariot of meters, / he traveled along this way. / Having mounted this chariot of meters, / he indeed travels along this way / by which this one [the sun] travels, / [namely, he] who, knowing thus, sacrifices with Soma, / and he who thus knows it.

sanskrit_iast: anumatyai puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | ye pratyañcaḥ śamyāyā avaśīyante | tannairṛtamekakapālam | iyaṃ vā anumatiḥ | iyaṃ nirṛtiḥ | nairṛtena pūrveṇa pracarati | pāpmānameva nirṛtiṃ pūrvāṃ niravadayate | ekakapālo bhavati | ekadhaiva nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | yadahutvā gārhapatya īyuḥ
meaning: अनुमत्यै पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निर्वपति । ये प्रत्यञ्चः शम्याया अवशीयन्ते । तन्नैरृतमेककपालम् । इयं वा अनुमतिः । इयं निरृतिः । नैरृतेन पूर्वेण प्रचरति । पाप्मानमेव निरृतिं पूर्वां निरवदयते । एककपालो भवति । एकधैव निरृतिं निरवदयते । यदहुत्वा गार्हपत्य ईयुः
text_mt: For Anumati he pours out a cake on eight potsherds. / The [grains] that fall down westward of the yoke-pin / are for Nirṛti on one potsherd. / This [earth] indeed is Anumati; / this [earth] is Nirṛti. / He proceeds first with the one for Nirṛti; / he appeases evil, Nirṛti, first. / It is on one potsherd; / singly indeed he appeases Nirṛti. / If without having offered [in it] they were to go from the Gārhapatya,

sanskrit_iast: rudro bhūtvā'gniranūtthāya | adhvaryuṃ ca yajamānaṃ ca hanyāt | vīhi svāhā''hutiṃ juṣāṇa ityāha | āhutyaivainaṃ śamayati | nārtimārcchatyadhvaryurna yajamānaḥ | ekolmukena yanti | taddhi nirṛtyai bhāgadheyam | imāṃ diśaṃ yanti | eṣā vai nirṛtyai dik | svāyāmeva diśi nirṛtiṃ niravadayate
meaning: रुद्रो भूत्वाऽग्निरनूत्थाय । अध्वर्युं च यजमानं च हन्यात् । वीहि स्वाहा'ऽहुतिं जुषाण इत्याह । आहुत्यैवैनं शमयति । नार्तिमार्च्छत्यध्वर्युर्न यजमानः । एकोल्मुकेन यन्ति । तद्धि निरृत्यै भागधेयम् । इमां दिशं यन्ति । एषा वै निरृत्यै दिक् । स्वायामेव दिशि निरृतिं निरवदयते
text_mt: Agni, having become Rudra, having risen up after them, / would strike both the Adhvaryu and the sacrificer. / 'Enjoy, Svāhā, relishing the oblation!' he says. / With the oblation he appeases him. / Neither the Adhvaryu nor the sacrificer meets with misfortune. / They go with a single firebrand; / for that is the share of Nirṛti. / They go toward this direction [the southwest]; / this indeed is Nirṛti's direction. / In her own direction he appeases Nirṛti.

sanskrit_iast: svakṛta iriṇe juhoti pradare vā | etadvai nirṛtyā āyatanam | sva evāyatane nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | eṣa te nirṛte bhāga ityāha | nirdiśatyevainām | bhūte haviṣmatyasītyāha | bhūtimevopāvartate | muñcemamaṃhasa ityāha | aṃhasa evainaṃ muñcati | aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ juhoti
meaning: स्वकृत इरिणे जुहोति प्रदरे वा । एतद्वै निरृत्या आयतनम् । स्व एवायतने निरृतिं निरवदयते । एष ते निरृते भाग इत्याह । निर्दिशत्येवैनाम् । भूते हविष्मत्यसीत्याह । भूतिमेवोपावर्तते । मुञ्चेममंहस इत्याह । अंहस एवैनं मुञ्चति । अङ्गुष्ठाभ्यां जुहोति

sanskrit_iast: antata eva nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣaṃ dakṣiṇā | etadvai nirṛtyai rūpam | rūpeṇaiva nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | apratīkṣamāyanti | nirṛtyā antarhityai | svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāreti punaretya gārhapatye juhoti | āhutyaiva namasyanto gārhapatyamupāvartante | ānumatena pracarati | iyaṃ vā anumatiḥ
meaning: अन्तत एव निरृतिं निरवदयते । कृष्णं वासः कृष्णतूषं दक्षिणा । एतद्वै निरृत्यै रूपम् । रूपेणैव निरृतिं निरवदयते । अप्रतीक्षमायन्ति । निरृत्या अन्तर्हित्यै । स्वाहा नमो य इदं चकारेति पुनरेत्य गार्हपत्ये जुहोति । आहुत्यैव नमस्यन्तो गार्हपत्यमुपावर्तन्ते । आनुमतेन प्रचरति । इयं वा अनुमतिः
text_mt:
From the very end he appeases Nirṛti.
A black garment with a black fringe is the sacrificial fee.
This indeed is the form of Nirṛti.
By means of the form itself he appeases Nirṛti.
They return without looking back,
for the concealment of Nirṛti.
Returning, he makes an offering on the Gārhapatya [fire], saying, 'Svāhā! Homage to him who has done this.'
By means of the offering, paying homage, they approach the Gārhapatya.
He proceeds with the [offering] to Anumati.
This [earth] indeed is Anumati.

sanskrit_iast: iyamevāsmai rājyamanu manyate | dhenurdakṣiṇā | imāmeva dhenuṃ kurute | ādityaṃ caruṃ nirvapati | ubhayīṣveva prajāsvabhiṣicyate | daivīṣu ca mānuṣīṣu ca | varo dakṣiṇā | varo hi rājyaṃ samṛddhyai | āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ
meaning: इयमेवास्मै राज्यमनु मन्यते । धेनुर्दक्षिणा । इमामेव धेनुं कुरुते । आदित्यं चरुं निर्वपति । उभयीष्वेव प्रजास्वभिषिच्यते । दैवीषु च मानुषीषु च । वरो दक्षिणा । वरो हि राज्यं समृद्ध्यै । आग्नावैष्णवमेकादशकपालं निर्वपति । अग्निः सर्वा देवताः
text_mt:
This [earth] approves royal power for him.
A milch cow is the sacrificial fee.
He makes this [earth] a milch cow.
He pours out a caru to the Ādityas.
He is consecrated among both kinds of offspring:
both divine and human.
A chosen boon is the sacrificial fee,
for royal power is a chosen boon, for prosperity.
He pours out [an offering] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu.
Agni is all the deities;

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇuryajñaḥ | devatāścaiva yajñaṃ cāvarundhe | vāmano vahī dakṣiṇā | yadvahī | tenāgneyaḥ | yadvāmanaḥ | tena vaiṣṇavaḥ samṛddhyai | agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | agnīṣomābhyāṃ vā indro vṛtramahanniti | yadagnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati
meaning: विष्णुर्यज्ञः । देवताश्चैव यज्ञं चावरुन्धे । वामनो वही दक्षिणा । यद्वही । तेनाग्नेयः । यद्वामनः । तेन वैष्णवः समृद्ध्यै । अग्नीषोमीयमेकादशकपालं निर्वपति । अग्नीषोमाभ्यां वा इन्द्रो वृत्रमहन्निति । यदग्नीषोमीयमेकादशकपालं निर्वपति
text_mt:
Viṣṇu is the sacrifice.
He wins both the deities and the sacrifice.
A dwarf draft-ox is the sacrificial fee.
In that it is a draft-ox,
thereby it belongs to Agni;
in that it is a dwarf,
thereby it belongs to Viṣṇu, for prosperity.
He pours out [an offering] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Soma.
'With Agni and Soma indeed Indra slew Vṛtra,' [it is said].
In that he pours out [an offering] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Soma,

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnameva vijityai | hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | devatābhiścendriyeṇa ca vyārdhyata | sa etamaindrāgnamekādaśakapālamapaśyat | tanniravapat | tena vai sa devatāścendriyaṃ cāvārundha | yadaindrāgnamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | devatāścaiva tenendriyaṃ ca yajamāno'varundhe | ṛṣabho vahī dakṣiṇā
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नमेव विजित्यै । हिरण्यं दक्षिणा समृद्ध्यै । इन्द्रो वृत्रं हत्वा । देवताभिश्चेन्द्रियेण च व्यार्ध्यत । स एतमैन्द्राग्नमेकादशकपालमपश्यत् । तन्निरवपत् । तेन वै स देवताश्चेन्द्रियं चावारुन्ध । यदैन्द्राग्नमेकादशकपालं निर्वपति । देवताश्चैव तेनेन्द्रियं च यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । ऋषभो वही दक्षिणा
text_mt:
it is of Vṛtra-slaying nature, for victory.
Gold is the sacrificial fee, for prosperity.
Indra, having slain Vṛtra,
was deprived of the deities and of physical power.
He saw this [offering] on eleven potsherds to Indra and Agni.
He poured it out.
Thereby he won both the deities and physical power.
In that he pours out [an offering] on eleven potsherds to Indra and Agni,
the sacrificer thereby wins both the deities and physical power.
A draft-bull is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: yadvahī | tenāgneyaḥ | yadṛṣabhaḥ | tenaindraḥ samṛddhyai | āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | aindraṃ dadhi | yadāgneyo bhavati | agnirvai yajñamukham | yajñamukhamevarddhiṃ purāstāddhatte | yadaindraṃ dadhi
meaning: यद्वही । तेनाग्नेयः । यदृषभः । तेनैन्द्रः समृद्ध्यै । आग्नेयमष्टाकपालं निर्वपति । ऐन्द्रं दधि । यदाग्नेयो भवति । अग्निर्वै यज्ञमुखम् । यज्ञमुखमेवर्द्धिं पुरास्ताद्धत्ते । यदैन्द्रं दधि
text_mt:
In that it is a draft-animal,
thereby it belongs to Agni;
in that it is a bull,
thereby it belongs to Indra, for prosperity.
He pours out [an offering] on eight potsherds to Agni,
and curd to Indra.
In that it belongs to Agni,
Agni is indeed the mouth of the sacrifice;
he places the mouth of the sacrifice, prosperity, at the forefront.
In that there is curd for Indra,

sanskrit_iast: indriyamevāvarundhe | ṛṣabho vahī dakṣiṇā | yadvahī | tenāgneyaḥ | yadṛṣabhaḥ | tenaindraḥ samṛddhyai | yāvatīrvai prajā oṣadhīnāmahutānāmāśnan | tāḥ parā'bhavan | āgrayaṇaṃ bhavati hutādyāya | yajamānasyāparābhāvāya
meaning: इन्द्रियमेवावरुन्धे । ऋषभो वही दक्षिणा । यद्वही । तेनाग्नेयः । यदृषभः । तेनैन्द्रः समृद्ध्यै । यावतीर्वै प्रजा ओषधीनामहुतानामाश्नन् । ताः पराऽभवन् । आग्रयणं भवति हुताद्याय । यजमानस्यापराभावाय
text_mt:
he wins physical power.
A draft-bull is the sacrificial fee.
In that it is a draft-animal,
thereby it belongs to Agni;
in that it is a bull,
thereby it belongs to Indra, for prosperity.
All the offspring that ate plants without their having been offered,
