meaning: कामो हि दाता । कामः प्रतिग्रहीता । कामं समुद्रमाविशेत्याह । समुद्र इव हि कामः । नेव हि कामस्यान्तोऽस्ति । न समुद्रस्य । कामेन त्वा प्रतिगृह्णामीत्याह । येन कामेन प्रतिगृह्णाति । स एवैनममुष्मिं ल्लोके काम आगच्छति । कामैतत्त एषा ते काम दक्षिणेत्याह । काम एव तद्यजमानोऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके दक्षिणामिच्छति । न प्रतिग्रहीतरि । य एवं विद्वान्दक्षिणां प्रतिगृह्णाति । अनृणामेवैनां प्रतिगृह्णाति
text_mt: For desire is the giver; / desire is the receiver. / He says, 'O desire, enter the ocean.' / For desire is like the ocean; / indeed there is no end to desire, / nor to the ocean. / He says, 'With desire I receive you.' / With whatever desire he receives it, / that very desire comes to him in yonder world. / He says, 'O desire, this is for you; this is your sacrificial gift, O desire.' / The sacrificer thus seeks the sacrificial gift in desire in yonder world, / not in the receiver. / He who, knowing thus, receives the sacrificial gift, / receives it free from debt.

sanskrit_iast: anto vā eṣa yajñasya | yaddaśamamahaḥ | daśame'hanthsarparājñiyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti | yajñasyaivāntaṃ gatvā | annādyamavarundhate | tisṛbhiḥ stuvanti | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya eva lokebhyo'nnādyamavarundhate | pṛśnivatīrbhavanti | annaṃ vai pṛśni
meaning: अन्तो वा एष यज्ञस्य । यद्दशममहः । दशमेऽहन्थ्सर्पराज्ञिया ऋग्भिः स्तुवन्ति । यज्ञस्यैवान्तं गत्वा । अन्नाद्यमवरुन्धते । तिसृभिः स्तुवन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एभ्य एव लोकेभ्योऽन्नाद्यमवरुन्धते । पृश्निवतीर्भवन्ति । अन्नं वै पृश्नि
text_mt: This is the end of the sacrifice, / namely the tenth day. / On the tenth day they praise with the verses of the Serpent Queen. / Having reached the end of the sacrifice, / they obtain proper food. / They praise with three [verses]. / Three are these worlds; / from these worlds alone they obtain proper food. / They contain [the word] 'pṛśni'; / food is indeed 'pṛśni'.

sanskrit_iast: annamevāvarundhate | manasā prastauti | manasodgāyati | manasā pratiharati | mana iva hi prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | devā vai sarpāḥ | teṣāmiyaṃ rājñī | yathsarparājñiyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: अन्नमेवावरुन्धते । मनसा प्रस्तौति । मनसोद्गायति । मनसा प्रतिहरति । मन इव हि प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । देवा वै सर्पाः । तेषामियं राज्ञी । यथ्सर्पराज्ञिया ऋग्भिः स्तुवन्ति । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: They obtain food itself. / With the mind he chants the prelude; / with the mind he sings the udgītha; / with the mind he chants the response. / For Prajāpati is mind-like; / [it is] for the attainment of Prajāpati. / The gods are the serpents; / of them this [earth] is the queen. / In that they praise with the verses of the Serpent Queen, / they become established on this [earth] itself.

sanskrit_iast: caturhotṝn hotā vyācaṣṭe | stutamanuśaṃsati śāntyai | anto vā eṣa yajñasya | yaddaśamamahaḥ | etatkhalu vai devānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ brahma | yaccaturhotāraḥ | daśame'haṃścaturhotṝnvyācaṣṭe | yajñasyaivāntaṃ gatvā | paramaṃ devānāṃ guhyaṃ brahmāvarundhe | tadeva prakāśaṃ gamayati
meaning: चतुर्होतॄन् होता व्याचष्टे । स्तुतमनुशंसति शान्त्यै । अन्तो वा एष यज्ञस्य । यद्दशममहः । एतत्खलु वै देवानां परमं गुह्यं ब्रह्म । यच्चतुर्होतारः । दशमेऽहंश्चतुर्होतॄन्व्याचष्टे । यज्ञस्यैवान्तं गत्वा । परमं देवानां गुह्यं ब्रह्मावरुन्धे । तदेव प्रकाशं गमयति
text_mt: The Hotṛ recites the Caturhotṛ formulas; / he recites along after the chant for appeasement. / For this is the end of the sacrifice, / namely, the tenth day. / This indeed is the supreme secret brahman of the gods, / namely, the Caturhotṛ formulas. / On the tenth day he recites the Caturhotṛ formulas: / having gone to the very end of the sacrifice, / he secures the supreme secret brahman of the gods. / He brings it to light.

sanskrit_iast: tadenaṃ prakāśaṃ gatam | prakāśaṃ prajānāṃ gamayati | vācaṃ yacchati | yajñasya dhṛtyai | yajamānadevatyaṃ vā ahaḥ | bhrātṛvyadevatyā rātriḥ | ahnā rātriṃ dhyāyet | bhrātṛvyasyaiva tallokaṃ vṛṅkte | yaddivā vācaṃ visṛjet | aharbhrātṛvyāyocchiṃṣet | yannaktaṃ visṛjet | rātriṃ bhrātṛvyāyocchiṃṣet | adhivṛkṣasūrye vācaṃ visṛjati | etāvantamevāsmai lokamucchiṃṣati | yāvadādityo'stameti
meaning: तदेनं प्रकाशं गतम् । प्रकाशं प्रजानां गमयति । वाचं यच्छति । यज्ञस्य धृत्यै । यजमानदेवत्यं वा अहः । भ्रातृव्यदेवत्या रात्रिः । अह्ना रात्रिं ध्यायेत् । भ्रातृव्यस्यैव तल्लोकं वृङ्क्ते । यद्दिवा वाचं विसृजेत् । अहर्भ्रातृव्यायोच्छिंषेत् । यन्नक्तं विसृजेत् । रात्रिं भ्रातृव्यायोच्छिंषेत् । अधिवृक्षसूर्ये वाचं विसृजति । एतावन्तमेवास्मै लोकमुच्छिंषति । यावदादित्योऽस्तमेति
text_mt: That [brahman], having gone to light, / brings him to the light of offspring. / He restrains his speech / for the support of the sacrifice. / Day belongs to the deity of the sacrificer; / night belongs to the deity of the rival. / By day he should meditate on the night; / thereby he deprives the rival of his world. / If he should release speech by day, / he would leave the day over for the rival. / If he should release [speech] by night, / he would leave the night over for the rival. / When the sun is above the trees, he releases his speech: / he leaves only so much of the world over for him / as [the time] while the sun sets.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ samaśliṣyan | tā rūpeṇānuprāviśat | tasmādāhuḥ | rūpaṃ vai prajāpatiriti | tā nāmnā'nuprāviśat | tasmādāhuḥ | nāma vai prajāpatiriti | tasmādapyā'mitrau saṃgatya | nāmnā ceddhvayete
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । ताः सृष्टाः समश्लिष्यन् । ता रूपेणानुप्राविशत् । तस्मादाहुः । रूपं वै प्रजापतिरिति । ता नाम्नाऽनुप्राविशत् । तस्मादाहुः । नाम वै प्रजापतिरिति । तस्मादप्याऽमित्रौ संगत्य । नाम्ना चेद्ध्वयेते
text_mt: Prajāpati created offspring. / Having been created, they clung closely together. / He entered into them with form; / therefore they say: / 'Prajāpati is indeed form.' / He entered into them with name; / therefore they say: / 'Prajāpati is indeed name.' / Therefore even two enemies, coming together, / if they call each other by name,

sanskrit_iast: mitrameva bhavataḥ | prajāpatirdevāsurānasṛjata | sa indramapi nāsṛjata | taṃ devā abruvan | indraṃ no janayeti | sa ātmannindramapaśyat | tamasṛjata | taṃ triṣṭugvīryaṃ bhūtvā'nuprāviśat | tasya vajraḥ pañcadaśo hasta āpadyata | tenodayyāsurānabhyabhavat
meaning: मित्रमेव भवतः । प्रजापतिर्देवासुरानसृजत । स इन्द्रमपि नासृजत । तं देवा अब्रुवन् । इन्द्रं नो जनयेति । स आत्मन्निन्द्रमपश्यत् । तमसृजत । तं त्रिष्टुग्वीर्यं भूत्वाऽनुप्राविशत् । तस्य वज्रः पञ्चदशो हस्त आपद्यत । तेनोदय्यासुरानभ्यभवत्
text_mt: become friends. / Prajāpati created the gods and asuras. / He had not yet created Indra. / The gods said to him: / 'Generate Indra for us.' / He saw Indra in himself; / he created him. / The Triṣṭubh meter, having become heroic power, entered into him. / The thunderbolt, fifteenfold, came into his hand. / Rising up with it, he overcame the asuras.

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ veda | abhi bhrātṛvyānbhavati | te devā asurairvijitya | suvargaṃ lokamāyan | te'muṣmiṃ lloke vyakṣudhyan | te'bruvan | amutaḥ pradānaṃ vā upajijīvimeti | te saptahotāraṃ yajñaṃ vidhāyāyāsyam | āṃgīrasaṃ prāhiṇvan | etenāmutra kalpayeti
meaning: य एवं वेद । अभि भ्रातृव्यान्भवति । ते देवा असुरैर्विजित्य । सुवर्गं लोकमायन् । तेऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके व्यक्षुध्यन् । तेऽब्रुवन् । अमुतः प्रदानं वा उपजिजीविमेति । ते सप्तहोतारं यज्ञं विधायायास्यम् । आंगीरसं प्राहिण्वन् । एतेनामुत्र कल्पयेति
text_mt: He who knows thus / overcomes his rivals. / Those gods, having conquered the asuras, / went to the heavenly realm. / In yonder world they grew hungry. / They said: / 'We have lived on what is offered from down there.' / Having arranged the sacrifice, the Saptahotṛ, they sent Ayāsya / Āṅgirasa, [saying]: / 'With this, make arrangements for us up there.'

sanskrit_iast: tasya vā iyaṃ klṛptiḥ | yadidaṃ kiṃca | ya evaṃ veda | kalpate'smai | sa vā ayaṃ manuṣyeṣu yajñaḥ saptahotā | amutra sadbhyo devebhyo havyaṃ vahati | ya evaṃ veda | upainaṃ yajño namati | so'manyata | abhi vā ime'smāṃ llokādamuṃ lokaṃ kamiṣyanta iti | sa vācaspate hṛditi vyāharat | tasmātputro hṛdayam | tasmādasmāllokādamuṃ lokaṃ nābhikāmayante | putro hi hṛdayam
meaning: तस्य वा इयं क्लृप्तिः । यदिदं किंच । य एवं वेद । कल्पतेऽस्मै । स वा अयं मनुष्येषु यज्ञः सप्तहोता । अमुत्र सद्भ्यो देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहति । य एवं वेद । उपैनं यज्ञो नमति । सोऽमन्यत । अभि वा इमेऽस्मां ल्लोकादमुं लोकं कमिष्यन्त इति । स वाचस्पते हृदिति व्याहरत् । तस्मात्पुत्रो हृदयम् । तस्मादस्माल्लोकादमुं लोकं नाभिकामयन्ते । पुत्रो हि हृदयम्
text_mt: Verily this is his arrangement, / whatever there is here. / He who knows thus, / for him it is arranged. / This very sacrifice among humans, the Saptahotṛ, / carries the oblation to the gods residing yonder. / He who knows thus, / to him the sacrifice bows down. / He thought: / 'These [mortals] will surely desire that world beyond this world.' / He uttered: 'O lord of speech, the heart!' / Therefore a son is the heart. / Therefore they do not desire that world beyond this world, / for a son is the heart.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai caturhotṛbhiryajñamatanvata | te vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇājayanta | abhi suvargaṃ lokamajayan | ya evaṃ vidvāṃścaturhotṛbhiryajñaṃ tanute | vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa jayate | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | ṣaḍḍhotrā prāyaṇīyamā sādayati | amuṣmai vai lokāya ṣaḍḍhotā | ghnanti khalu vā etathsomam | yadabhiṣuṇvanti
meaning: देवा वै चतुर्होतृभिर्यज्ञमतन्वत । ते वि पाप्मना भ्रातृव्येणाजयन्त । अभि सुवर्गं लोकमजयन् । य एवं विद्वांश्चतुर्होतृभिर्यज्ञं तनुते । वि पाप्मना भ्रातृव्येण जयते । अभि सुवर्गं लोकं जयति । षड्ढोत्रा प्रायणीयमा सादयति । अमुष्मै वै लोकाय षड्ढोता । घ्नन्ति खलु वा एतथ्सोमम् । यदभिषुण्वन्ति
text_mt: The gods indeed performed the sacrifice by means of the Caturhotṛ formulas. / They triumphed over evil, the rival; / they won the heavenly realm. / He who, knowing thus, performs the sacrifice with the Caturhotṛ formulas / triumphs over evil, the rival; / he wins the heavenly realm. / With the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula he sets down the introductory offering; / for that world indeed is the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ. / Truly they kill the soma / when they press [it].

sanskrit_iast: ṛjudhaivainamamuṃ lokaṃ gamayati | caturhotrā''tithyam | yaśo vai caturhotā | yaśa evātmandhatte | pañcahotrā paśumupasādayati | suvargyo vai pañcahotā | yajamānaḥ paśuḥ | yajamānameva suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | grahāngṛhītvā saptahotāraṃ juhoti | indriyaṃ vai saptahotā
meaning: ऋजुधैवैनममुं लोकं गमयति । चतुर्होत्रा'ऽतिथ्यम् । यशो वै चतुर्होता । यश एवात्मन्धत्ते । पञ्चहोत्रा पशुमुपसादयति । सुवर्ग्यो वै पञ्चहोता । यजमानः पशुः । यजमानमेव सुवर्गं लोकं गमयति । ग्रहान्गृहीत्वा सप्तहोतारं जुहोति । इन्द्रियं वै सप्तहोता
text_mt: Directly indeed he makes him go to that world. / With the Caturhotṛ formula [he sets down] the guest offering. / The Caturhotṛ is fame; / he establishes fame in himself. / With the Pañcahotṛ formula he brings near the sacrificial animal. / The Pañcahotṛ belongs to the heavenly realm; / the animal is the sacrificer: / he makes the sacrificer go to the heavenly realm. / Having drawn the cup offerings, he offers the Saptahotṛ formula; / the Saptahotṛ is sensory power:

sanskrit_iast: indriyamevātmandhatte | yo vai caturhotṝnanusavanaṃ tarpayati | tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ | upainaṃ somapītho namati | bahiṣpavamāne daśahotāraṃ vyācakṣīta | mādhyaṃdine pavamāne caturhotāram | ārbhave pavamāne pañcahotāram | pitṛyajñe ṣaḍḍhotāram | yajñāyajñiyasya stotre saptahotāram | anusavanamevaināṃstarpayati
meaning: इन्द्रियमेवात्मन्धत्ते । यो वै चतुर्होतॄननुसवनं तर्पयति । तृप्यति प्रजया पशुभिः । उपैनं सोमपीथो नमति । बहिष्पवमाने दशहोतारं व्याचक्षीत । माध्यंदिने पवमाने चतुर्होतारम् । आर्भवे पवमाने पञ्चहोतारम् । पितृयज्ञे षड्ढोतारम् । यज्ञायज्ञियस्य स्तोत्रे सप्तहोतारम् । अनुसवनमेवैनांस्तर्पयति
text_mt: he establishes sensory power in himself. / He who gratifies the Caturhotṛ formulas at each pressing / is gratified with offspring and domestic animals; / the draught of soma bows down to him. / At the Bahiṣpavamāna chant he should recite the Daśahotṛ formula; / at the midday Pavamāna chant, the Caturhotṛ formula; / at the Ārbhava Pavamāna chant, the Pañcahotṛ formula; / at the ancestral sacrifice, the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula; / at the chant of the Yajñāyajñīya, the Saptahotṛ formula. / At each pressing indeed he gratifies them:

sanskrit_iast: tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ | upainaṃ somapītho namati | devā vai caturhotṛbhiḥ satramāsata | ṛddhiparimitaṃ yaśaskāmāḥ | te'bruvan | yannaḥ prathamaṃ yaśa ṛcchāt | sarveṣāṃ nastathsahāsaditi | somaścaturhotrā | agniḥ pañcahotrā | dhātā ṣaḍḍhotrā
meaning: तृप्यति प्रजया पशुभिः । उपैनं सोमपीथो नमति । देवा वै चतुर्होतृभिः सत्रमासत । ऋद्धिपरिमितं यशस्कामाः । तेऽब्रुवन् । यन्नः प्रथमं यश ऋच्छात् । सर्वेषां नस्तथ्सहासदिति । सोमश्चतुर्होत्रा । अग्निः पञ्चहोत्रा । धाता षड्ढोत्रा
text_mt: he is gratified with offspring and domestic animals; / the draught of soma bows down to him. / The gods held a sacrificial session with the Caturhotṛ formulas, / limited by prosperity, desiring fame. / They said: / 'Whichever of us fame reaches first, / that shall belong to all of us together.' / Soma [offered] with the Caturhotṛ formula, / Agni with the Pañcahotṛ formula, / Dhātṛ with the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula,

sanskrit_iast: indraḥ saptahotrā | prajāpatirdaśahotrā | teṣāṃ somaṃ rājānaṃ yaśa ārcchat | tannyakāmayata | tenāpākrāmat | tena pralāyamacarat | taṃ devāḥ praiṣaiḥ praiṣamaicchan | tatpraiṣāṇāṃ praiṣatvam | nividbhirnyavedayan | tannividāṃ nivittvam
meaning: इन्द्रः सप्तहोत्रा । प्रजापतिर्दशहोत्रा । तेषां सोमं राजानं यश आर्च्छत् । तन्न्यकामयत । तेनापाक्रामत् । तेन प्रलायमचरत् । तं देवाः प्रैषैः प्रैषमैच्छन् । तत्प्रैषाणां प्रैषत्वम् । निविद्भिर्न्यवेदयन् । तन्निविदां निवित्त्वम्
text_mt: Indra with the Saptahotṛ formula, / Prajāpati with the Daśahotṛ formula. / Fame reached King Soma among them. / He coveted it; / he strode away with it; / he wandered about in hiding with it. / The gods sought to find him with summonses: / that is the nature of summonses (praiṣa). / They made him known with the nivid formulas: / that is the nature of the nivids (nivid).

sanskrit_iast: āprībhirāpnuvan | tadāprīṇāmāpritvam | tamaghnan | tasya yaśo vyagṛhṇata | te grahā abhavan | tadgrahāṇāṃ grahatvam | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo grahā gṛhyante | tasya tveva gṛhītāḥ | te'bruvan | yo vai naḥ śreṣṭho'bhūt
meaning: आप्रीभिराप्नुवन् । तदाप्रीणामाप्रित्वम् । तमघ्नन् । तस्य यशो व्यगृह्णत । ते ग्रहा अभवन् । तद्ग्रहाणां ग्रहत्वम् । यस्यैवं विदुषो ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते । तस्य त्वेव गृहीताः । तेऽब्रुवन् । यो वै नः श्रेष्ठोऽभूत्
text_mt: With the Āprī verses they reached (āpnuvan) [him]: / that is the nature of the Āprī verses (āprī). / They slew him; / they drew out his fame: / they became the cups (graha); / that is the nature of the cups (graha). / For that knowing one for whom the cups are drawn, / they are indeed drawn. / They said: / 'He who was the most excellent among us,

sanskrit_iast: tamavadhiṣma | punarimaṃ suvāmahā iti | taṃ chandobhirasuvanta | tacchandasāṃ chandastvam | sāmnā samānayan | tathsāmnaḥ sāmatvam | ukthairudasthāpayan | tadukthānāmukthatvam | ya evaṃ veda | pratyeva tiṣṭhati
meaning: तमवधिष्म । पुनरिमं सुवामहा इति । तं छन्दोभिरसुवन्त । तच्छन्दसां छन्दस्त्वम् । साम्ना समानयन् । तथ्साम्नः सामत्वम् । उक्थैरुदस्थापयन् । तदुक्थानामुक्थत्वम् । य एवं वेद । प्रत्येव तिष्ठति
text_mt: him we have slain. / Let us quicken him again.' / They quickened him with the meters (chandas): / that is the nature of the meters (chandas). / With the sāman chant they brought him together (samānayan): / that is the nature of the sāman chant (sāman). / With the recitations (uktha) they raised him up (udasthāpayan): / that is the nature of the recitations (uktha). / He who knows thus / firmly stands.

sanskrit_iast: sarvamāyureti | somo vai yaśaḥ | ya evaṃ vidvānthsomamāgacchati | yaśa evainamṛcchati | tasmādāhuḥ | yaścaivaṃ veda yaśca na | tāvubhau somamāgacchataḥ | somo hi yaśaḥ | taṃ tvāva yaśa ṛcchatītyāhuḥ | yaḥ some somaṃ prāheti | tasmāthsome somaḥ procyaḥ | yaśa evainamṛcchati
meaning: सर्वमायुरेति । सोमो वै यशः । य एवं विद्वान्थ्सोममागच्छति । यश एवैनमृच्छति । तस्मादाहुः । यश्चैवं वेद यश्च न । तावुभौ सोममागच्छतः । सोमो हि यशः । तं त्वाव यश ऋच्छतीत्याहुः । यः सोमे सोमं प्राहेति । तस्माथ्सोमे सोमः प्रोच्यः । यश एवैनमृच्छति
text_mt: He attains a full lifespan. / Soma is fame; / he who, knowing thus, approaches soma, / fame reaches him. / Therefore they say: / 'Both he who knows thus and he who does not, / both approach soma, / for soma is fame.' / But they say: 'Fame reaches him / who proclaims soma in soma.' / Therefore soma must be proclaimed in soma; / fame reaches him.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ vā agre naiva kiṃcanāsīt | na dyaurāsīt | na pṛthivī | nāntarikṣam | tadasadeva sanmano'kuruta syāmiti | tadatapyata | tasmāttepānāddhūmo'jāyata | tadbhūyo'tapyata | tasmāttepānādagnirajāyata | tadbhūyo'tapyata
meaning: इदं वा अग्रे नैव किंचनासीत् । न द्यौरासीत् । न पृथिवी । नान्तरिक्षम् । तदसदेव सन्मनोऽकुरुत स्यामिति । तदतप्यत । तस्मात्तेपानाद्धूमोऽजायत । तद्भूयोऽतप्यत । तस्मात्तेपानादग्निरजायत । तद्भूयोऽतप्यत
text_mt: In the beginning this [universe] was nothing at all. / There was no sky, / no earth, / no intermediate space. / That being non-existent, took thought: 'Let me be.' / It heated itself with ascetic heat; / from that [being], heated, smoke was born. / It heated itself further; / from that [being], heated, fire was born. / It heated itself further.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāttepānājjyotirajāyata | tadbhūyo'tapyata | tasmāttepānādarcirajāyata | tadbhūyo'tapyata | tasmāttepānānmarīcayo'jāyanta | tadbhūyo'tapyata | tasmāttepānādudārā ajāyanta | tadbhūyo'tapyata | tadabhramiva samahanyata | tadvastimabhinat
meaning: तस्मात्तेपानाज्ज्योतिरजायत । तद्भूयोऽतप्यत । तस्मात्तेपानादर्चिरजायत । तद्भूयोऽतप्यत । तस्मात्तेपानान्मरीचयोऽजायन्त । तद्भूयोऽतप्यत । तस्मात्तेपानादुदारा अजायन्त । तद्भूयोऽतप्यत । तदभ्रमिव समहन्यत । तद्वस्तिमभिनत्
text_mt:
From that [being] heated, light was born.
That was heated further.
From that [being] heated, a flame was born.
That was heated further.
From that [being] heated, rays were born.
That was heated further.
From that [being] heated, vaporous vapors were born.
That was heated further.
That massed together like a cloud.
It burst the bladder.

sanskrit_iast: sa samudro'bhavat | tasmāthsamudrasya na pibanti | prajananamiva hi manyante | tasmātpaśorjāyamānādāpaḥ purastādyanti | taddaśahotā'nvasṛjyata | prajāpatirvai daśahotā | ya evaṃ tapaso vīryaṃ vidvāṃstapyate | bhavatyeva | tadvā idamāpaḥ salilamāsīt | so'rodītprajāpatiḥ
meaning: स समुद्रोऽभवत् । तस्माथ्समुद्रस्य न पिबन्ति । प्रजननमिव हि मन्यन्ते । तस्मात्पशोर्जायमानादापः पुरस्ताद्यन्ति । तद्दशहोताऽन्वसृज्यत । प्रजापतिर्वै दशहोता । य एवं तपसो वीर्यं विद्वांस्तप्यते । भवत्येव । तद्वा इदमापः सलिलमासीत् । सोऽरोदीत्प्रजापतिः
text_mt:
It became the ocean.
Therefore they do not drink of the ocean,
for they regard it as being like the organ of generation.
Therefore waters come out first from an animal being born.
Then the Daśahotṛ was created along [with it].
Prajāpati, truly, is the Daśahotṛ.
He who, knowing thus the heroic power of heat, performs ascetic heat,
he indeed comes to be.
Now, this [all] was waters, surging water.
Prajāpati wept:

sanskrit_iast: sa kasmā ajñi | yadyasyā apratiṣṭhāyā iti | yadapsvavāpadyata | sā pṛthivyabhavat | yadvyamṛṣṭa | tadantarikṣamabhavat | yadūrdhvamudamṛṣṭa | sā dyaurabhavat | yadarodīt | tadanayo rodastvam
meaning: स कस्मा अज्ञि । यद्यस्या अप्रतिष्ठाया इति । यदप्स्ववापद्यत । सा पृथिव्यभवत् । यद्व्यमृष्ट । तदन्तरिक्षमभवत् । यदूर्ध्वमुदमृष्ट । सा द्यौरभवत् । यदरोदीत् । तदनयो रोदस्त्वम्
text_mt:
"Why was I born,
if [born] of this foundationless [water]?"
What fell down into the waters,
that became the earth.
What he wiped off,
that became the intermediate space.
What he wiped upward,
that became the sky.
Because he wept (árodīt),
that is why these two are the weeping ones (rodasī).

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ veda | nāsya gṛhe rudanti | etadvā eṣāṃ lokānāṃ janma | ya evameṣāṃ lokānāṃ janma veda | naiṣu lokeṣvārtimārcchati | sa imāṃ pratiṣṭhāmavindata | sa imāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vittvā'kāmayata prajāyeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | so'ntarvānabhavat | sa jaghanādasurānasṛjata
meaning: य एवं वेद । नास्य गृहे रुदन्ति । एतद्वा एषां लोकानां जन्म । य एवमेषां लोकानां जन्म वेद । नैषु लोकेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । स इमां प्रतिष्ठामविन्दत । स इमां प्रतिष्ठां वित्त्वाऽकामयत प्रजायेयेति । स तपोऽतप्यत । सोऽन्तर्वानभवत् । स जघनादसुरानसृजत
text_mt:
He who knows thus,
they do not weep in his house.
This, truly, is the birth of these worlds.
He who thus knows the birth of these worlds,
does not incur misfortune in these worlds.
He found this foundation.
Having found this foundation, he desired: "May I propagate!"
He performed ascetic heat.
He became pregnant.
He created the asuras from his buttocks.

sanskrit_iast: tebhyo mṛnmaye pātre'nnamaduhat | yā'sya sā tanūrāsīt | tāmapāhata | sā tamisrā'bhavat | so'kāmayata prajāyeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | so'ntarvānabhavat | sa prajananādeva prajā asṛjata | tasmādimā bhūyiṣṭhāḥ | prajananāddhyenā asṛjata
meaning: तेभ्यो मृन्मये पात्रेऽन्नमदुहत् । याऽस्य सा तनूरासीत् । तामपाहत । सा तमिस्राऽभवत् । सोऽकामयत प्रजायेयेति । स तपोऽतप्यत । सोऽन्तर्वानभवत् । स प्रजननादेव प्रजा असृजत । तस्मादिमा भूयिष्ठाः । प्रजननाद्ध्येना असृजत
text_mt:
For them he milked food in an earthen vessel.
That body of his which it was,
he cast that off.
It became darkness.
He desired: "May I propagate!"
He performed ascetic heat.
He became pregnant.
He created offspring from the organ of generation itself.
Therefore these are most numerous,
for he created them from the organ of generation itself.

sanskrit_iast: tābhyo dārumaye pātre payo'duhat | yā'sya sā tanūrāsīt | tāmapāhata | sā jyothsnā'bhavat | so'kāmayata prajāyeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | so'ntarvānabhavat | sa upapakṣābhyāmevartūnasṛjata | tebhyo rajate pātre ghṛtamaduhat | yā'sya sā tanūrāsīt |
meaning: ताभ्यो दारुमये पात्रे पयोऽदुहत् । याऽस्य सा तनूरासीत् । तामपाहत । सा ज्योथ्स्नाऽभवत् । सोऽकामयत प्रजायेयेति । स तपोऽतप्यत । सोऽन्तर्वानभवत् । स उपपक्षाभ्यामेवर्तूनसृजत । तेभ्यो रजते पात्रे घृतमदुहत् । याऽस्य सा तनूरासीत् ।
text_mt:
For them they milked milk in a wooden vessel.
That body of his which it was,
he cast that off; it became moonlight.
He desired: "May I propagate!"
He performed ascetic heat.
He became pregnant.
He created the seasons from the armpits.
For them he milked ghee in a silver vessel.
That body of his which it was,

sanskrit_iast: tāmapāhata | so'horātrayoḥ sandhirabhavat | so'kāmayata prajāyeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | so'ntarvānabhavat | sa mukhāddevānasṛjata | tebhyo harite pātre somamaduhat | yā'sya sā tanūrāsīt | tāmapāhata | tadaharabhavat
meaning: तामपाहत । सोऽहोरात्रयोः सन्धिरभवत् । सोऽकामयत प्रजायेयेति । स तपोऽतप्यत । सोऽन्तर्वानभवत् । स मुखाद्देवानसृजत । तेभ्यो हरिते पात्रे सोममदुहत् । याऽस्य सा तनूरासीत् । तामपाहत । तदहरभवत्
text_mt:
he cast that off.
It became the twilight of day and night.
He desired: "May I propagate!"
He performed ascetic heat.
He became pregnant.
He created the gods from his mouth.
For them they milked soma in a golden vessel.
That body of his which it was,
he cast that off.
That became the day.

sanskrit_iast: ete vai prajāpaterdohāḥ | ya evaṃ veda | duha eva prajāḥ | divā vai no'bhūditi | taddevānāṃ devatvam | ya evaṃ devānāṃ devatvaṃ veda | devavāneva bhavati | etadvā ahorātrāṇāṃ janma | ya evamahorātrāṇāṃ janma veda | nāhorātreṣvārtimārcchati
meaning: एते वै प्रजापतेर्दोहाः । य एवं वेद । दुह एव प्रजाः । दिवा वै नोऽभूदिति । तद्देवानां देवत्वम् । य एवं देवानां देवत्वं वेद । देववानेव भवति । एतद्वा अहोरात्राणां जन्म । य एवमहोरात्राणां जन्म वेद । नाहोरात्रेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति
text_mt:
These, truly, are the milkings of Prajāpati.
He who knows thus,
milks offspring.
"It has become daylight (dívā) for us!" [they said];
that is the divinity (devatvá) of the gods (devá).
He who thus knows the divinity of the gods,
he indeed possesses gods.
This, truly, is the birth of the days and nights.
He who thus knows the birth of the days and nights,
does not incur misfortune in the days and nights.

sanskrit_iast: asato'dhi mano'sṛjyata | manaḥ prajāpatimasṛjata | prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tadvā idaṃ manasyeva paramaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | yadidaṃ kiṃca | tadetacchovasyasaṃ nāma brahma | vyucchantī vyucchantyasmai vasyasī vasyasī vyucchati | prajāyate prajayā paśubhiḥ | pra parameṣṭhino mātrāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: असतोऽधि मनोऽसृज्यत । मनः प्रजापतिमसृजत । प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । तद्वा इदं मनस्येव परमं प्रतिष्ठितम् । यदिदं किंच । तदेतच्छोवस्यसं नाम ब्रह्म । व्युच्छन्ती व्युच्छन्त्यस्मै वस्यसी वस्यसी व्युच्छति । प्रजायते प्रजया पशुभिः । प्र परमेष्ठिनो मात्रामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद
text_mt:
From the non-existent, mind was created.
Mind created Prajāpati.
Prajāpati created offspring.
Now, this all is firmly established in mind alone—
whatever this is.
That is this brahman named "Better-tomorrow".
Ever dawning, it dawns better and better for him;
he propagates with offspring and domestic animals;
he reaches the measure of Parameṣṭhin,
he who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirindramasṛjatā''nujāvaraṃ devānām | taṃ prāhiṇot | parehi | eteṣāṃ devānāmadhipatiredhīti | taṃ devā abruvan | kastvamasi | vayaṃ vai tvacchreyāṃsaḥ sma iti | so'bravīt | kastvamasi vayaṃ vai tvacchreyāṃsaḥ sma iti mā devā avocanniti | atha vā idaṃ tarhi prajāpatau hara āsīt
meaning: प्रजापतिरिन्द्रमसृजता'ऽनुजावरं देवानाम् । तं प्राहिणोत् । परेहि । एतेषां देवानामधिपतिरेधीति । तं देवा अब्रुवन् । कस्त्वमसि । वयं वै त्वच्छ्रेयांसः स्म इति । सोऽब्रवीत् । कस्त्वमसि वयं वै त्वच्छ्रेयांसः स्म इति मा देवा अवोचन्निति । अथ वा इदं तर्हि प्रजापतौ हर आसीत्
text_mt:
Prajāpati created Indra as the junior among the gods.
He sent him forth:
"Go away;
become the overlord of these gods!"
The gods said to him:
"Who are you?
We, truly, are better than you!"
He said:
"'Who are you? We, truly, are better than you'—thus the gods have spoken to me."
Now at that time there was this fiery glow in Prajāpati,

sanskrit_iast: yadasminnāditye | tadenamabravīt | etanme prayaccha | athāhameteṣāṃ devānāmadhipatirbhaviṣyāmīti | ko'haṃ syāmityabravīt | etatpradāyeti | etathsyā ityabravīt | yadetadbravīṣīti | ko ha vai nāma prajāpatiḥ | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: यदस्मिन्नादित्ये । तदेनमब्रवीत् । एतन्मे प्रयच्छ । अथाहमेतेषां देवानामधिपतिर्भविष्यामीति । कोऽहं स्यामित्यब्रवीत् । एतत्प्रदायेति । एतथ्स्या इत्यब्रवीत् । यदेतद्ब्रवीषीति । को ह वै नाम प्रजापतिः । य एवं वेद
text_mt:
which is in this sun.
Then he said to him:
"Bestow this on me;
then I shall become the overlord of these gods."
"Who (kaḥ) should I become," he said,
"having given this away?"
"You should become this," he said,
"which you say: 'kaḥ'."
"Ka", indeed, is Prajāpati by name.
He who knows thus,

sanskrit_iast: vidurenaṃ nāmnā | tadasmai rukmaṃ kṛtvā pratyamuñcat | tato vā indro devānāmadhipatirabhavat | ya evaṃ veda | adhipatireva samānānāṃ bhavati | so'manyata | kiṃ kiṃ vā akaramiti | sa candraṃ ma āhareti prālapat | taccandramasaścandramastvam | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: विदुरेनं नाम्ना । तदस्मै रुक्मं कृत्वा प्रत्यमुञ्चत् । ततो वा इन्द्रो देवानामधिपतिरभवत् । य एवं वेद । अधिपतिरेव समानानां भवति । सोऽमन्यत । किं किं वा अकरमिति । स चन्द्रं म आहरेति प्रालपत् । तच्चन्द्रमसश्चन्द्रमस्त्वम् । य एवं वेद
text_mt:
they know him by name.
Having made a gold ornament for him, he fastened it on him.
Thereupon Indra became the overlord of the gods.
He who knows thus,
becomes the overlord of his peers.
He thought:
"What, indeed, have I done?"
"Bring me the moon (candram)!" he shouted.
That is the moonness of the moon (Candramas).
He who knows thus,

sanskrit_iast: candravāneva bhavati | taṃ devā abruvan | suvīryo maryā yathā gopāyata iti | tathsūryasya sūryatvam | ya evaṃ veda | nainaṃ dabhnoti | kaścanāsminvā idamindriyaṃ pratyasthāditi | tadindrasyendratvam | ya evaṃ veda | indriyāvyeva bhavati
meaning: चन्द्रवानेव भवति । तं देवा अब्रुवन् । सुवीर्यो मर्या यथा गोपायत इति । तथ्सूर्यस्य सूर्यत्वम् । य एवं वेद । नैनं दभ्नोति । कश्चनास्मिन्वा इदमिन्द्रियं प्रत्यस्थादिति । तदिन्द्रस्येन्द्रत्वम् । य एवं वेद । इन्द्रियाव्येव भवति
text_mt:
becomes possessed of glittering splendour.
The gods said to him:
"O men, protect him as one of good heroic power (suvīrya)!"
That is the sunness of the sun (Sūrya).
He who knows thus,
no one overpowers him.
"In him this Indra-power (indriya) has stood firm!" [they said];
that is the Indraness of Indra.
He who knows thus,
becomes full of Indra-power.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ vā idaṃ paramo'bhūditi | tatparameṣṭhinaḥ parameṣṭhitvam | ya evaṃ veda | paramāmeva kāṣṭhāṃ gacchati | taṃ devāḥ samantaṃ paryaviśan | vasavaḥ purastāt | rudrā dakṣiṇataḥ | ādityāḥ paścāt | viśve devā uttarataḥ | aṃgirasaḥ pratyañcam
meaning: अयं वा इदं परमोऽभूदिति । तत्परमेष्ठिनः परमेष्ठित्वम् । य एवं वेद । परमामेव काष्ठां गच्छति । तं देवाः समन्तं पर्यविशन् । वसवः पुरस्तात् । रुद्रा दक्षिणतः । आदित्याः पश्चात् । विश्वे देवा उत्तरतः । अंगिरसः प्रत्यञ्चम्
text_mt:
"This one, truly, has become supreme (parama)!" [they said];
that is the Parameṣṭhin-hood of Parameṣṭhin.
He who knows thus,
goes to the supreme summit.
The gods sat round him on every side:
the Vasus in the east,
the Rudras in the south,
the Ādityas in the west,
the Viśve Devas in the north,
the Aṅgirases behind,

sanskrit_iast: sādhyāḥ parāñcam | ya evaṃ veda | upainaṃ samānāḥ saṃviśanti | sa prajāpatireva bhūtvā prajā āvayat | tā asmai nātiṣṭhantānnādyāya | tā mukhaṃ purastātpaśyantīḥ | dakṣiṇataḥ paryāyan | sa dakṣiṇataḥ paryavartayata | tā mukhaṃ purastātpaśyantīḥ | mukhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ
meaning: साध्याः पराञ्चम् । य एवं वेद । उपैनं समानाः संविशन्ति । स प्रजापतिरेव भूत्वा प्रजा आवयत् । ता अस्मै नातिष्ठन्तान्नाद्याय । ता मुखं पुरस्तात्पश्यन्तीः । दक्षिणतः पर्यायन् । स दक्षिणतः पर्यवर्तयत । ता मुखं पुरस्तात्पश्यन्तीः । मुखं दक्षिणतः
text_mt:
the Sādhyas beyond.
He who knows thus,
his peers sit down around him.
Having become Prajāpati, he approached offspring.
They did not stay for him for eating food.
Seeing a face in front,
they went around to the south.
He turned around to the south.
Seeing a face in front,
[and] a face in the south,

sanskrit_iast: paścātparyāyan | sa paścātparyavartayata | tā mukhaṃ purastātpaśyantīḥ | mukhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ | mukhaṃ paścāt | uttarataḥ paryāyan | sa uttarataḥ paryavartayata | tā mukhaṃ purastātpaśyantīḥ | mukhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ | mukhaṃ paścāt |
meaning: पश्चात्पर्यायन् । स पश्चात्पर्यवर्तयत । ता मुखं पुरस्तात्पश्यन्तीः । मुखं दक्षिणतः । मुखं पश्चात् । उत्तरतः पर्यायन् । स उत्तरतः पर्यवर्तयत । ता मुखं पुरस्तात्पश्यन्तीः । मुखं दक्षिणतः । मुखं पश्चात् ।
text_mt:
They went around to the west.
He turned around to the west.
Seeing a face in front,
a face in the south,
a face in the west,
they went around to the north.
He turned around to the north.
Seeing a face in front,
a face in the south,
a face in the west,
a face in the north,
they flew up high.
He turned down from above.
Having become facing in all directions, he gathered them in.
Then indeed offspring stayed for him for food.
He who, knowing thus, turns around and turns down,
having become Prajāpati himself, eats offspring;
offspring stay for him for food;
he becomes an eater of food.

sanskrit_iast: mukhamuttarataḥ | ūrdhvā udāyan | sa upariṣṭānnyavartayata | tāḥ sarvatomukho bhūtvā''vayat | tato vai tasmai prajā atiṣṭhantānnādyāya | ya evaṃ vidvānpari ca vartayate ni ca | prajāpatireva bhūtvā prajā atti | tiṣṭhante'smai prajā annādyāya | annāda eva bhavati
meaning: मुखमुत्तरतः । ऊर्ध्वा उदायन् । स उपरिष्टान्न्यवर्तयत । ताः सर्वतोमुखो भूत्वा'ऽवयत् । ततो वै तस्मै प्रजा अतिष्ठन्तान्नाद्याय । य एवं विद्वान्परि च वर्तयते नि च । प्रजापतिरेव भूत्वा प्रजा अत्ति । तिष्ठन्तेऽस्मै प्रजा अन्नाद्याय । अन्नाद एव भवति

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirakāmayata bahorbhūyānthsyāmiti | sa etaṃ daśahotāramapaśyat | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayukti bahorbhūyānabhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta bahorbhūyānthsyāmiti | sa daśahotāraṃ prayuñjīta | bahoreva bhūyānbhavati | so'kāmayata vīro ma ājāyeteti | sa daśahotuścaturhotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta ||
meaning: प्रजापतिरकामयत बहोर्भूयान्थ्स्यामिति । स एतं दशहोतारमपश्यत् । तं प्रायुङ्क्त । तस्य प्रयुक्ति बहोर्भूयानभवत् । यः कामयेत बहोर्भूयान्थ्स्यामिति । स दशहोतारं प्रयुञ्जीत । बहोरेव भूयान्भवति । सोऽकामयत वीरो म आजायेतेति । स दशहोतुश्चतुर्होतारं निरमिमीत । तं प्रायुङ्क्त ॥
text_mt:
Prajāpati desired: 'May I become more numerous than much.'
He saw this Daśahotṛ formula.
He employed it.
Upon its employment, he became more numerous than much.
Whoever should desire: 'May I become more numerous than much,'
he should employ the Daśahotṛ formula.
He becomes more numerous than much.
He desired: 'May a hero be born to me.'
From the Daśahotṛ he fashioned the Caturhotṛ formula.
He employed it.

sanskrit_iast: tasya prayuktīndro'jāyata | yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti | sa caturhotāraṃ prayuñjīta | ā'sya vīro jāyate | so'kāmayata paśumānthsyāmiti | sa caturhotuḥ pañcahotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayukti paśumānabhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta paśumānthsyāmiti | sa pañcahotāraṃ prayuñjīta
meaning: तस्य प्रयुक्तीन्द्रोऽजायत । यः कामयेत वीरो म आजायेतेति । स चतुर्होतारं प्रयुञ्जीत । आऽस्य वीरो जायते । सोऽकामयत पशुमान्थ्स्यामिति । स चतुर्होतुः पञ्चहोतारं निरमिमीत । तं प्रायुङ्क्त । तस्य प्रयुक्ति पशुमानभवत् । यः कामयेत पशुमान्थ्स्यामिति । स पञ्चहोतारं प्रयुञ्जीत
text_mt:
Upon its employment, Indra was born.
Whoever should desire: 'May a hero be born to me,'
he should employ the Caturhotṛ formula.
A hero is born to him.
He desired: 'May I possess domestic animals.'
From the Caturhotṛ he fashioned the Pañcahotṛ formula.
He employed it.
Upon its employment, he came to possess domestic animals.
Whoever should desire: 'May I possess domestic animals,'
he should employ the Pañcahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: paśumāneva bhavati | so'kāmayatartavo me kalperanniti | sa pañcahotuḥ ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayuktyṛtavo'smā akalpanta | yaḥ kāmayetartavo me kalperanniti | sa ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ prayuñjīta | kalpante'smā ṛtavaḥ | so'kāmayata somapaḥ somayājī syām | ā me somapaḥ somayājī jāyeteti
meaning: पशुमानेव भवति । सोऽकामयतर्तवो मे कल्पेरन्निति । स पञ्चहोतुः षड्ढोतारं निरमिमीत । तं प्रायुङ्क्त । तस्य प्रयुक्त्यृतवोऽस्मा अकल्पन्त । यः कामयेतर्तवो मे कल्पेरन्निति । स षड्ढोतारं प्रयुञ्जीत । कल्पन्तेऽस्मा ऋतवः । सोऽकामयत सोमपः सोमयाजी स्याम् । आ मे सोमपः सोमयाजी जायेतेति
text_mt:
He indeed comes to possess domestic animals.
He desired: 'May the seasons be properly ordered for me.'
From the Pañcahotṛ he fashioned the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula.
He employed it.
Upon its employment, the seasons were properly ordered for him.
Whoever should desire: 'May the seasons be properly ordered for me,'
he should employ the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula.
The seasons are properly ordered for him.
He desired: 'May I be a soma-drinker, a soma-sacrificer;
may a soma-drinker, a soma-sacrificer be born to me.'

sanskrit_iast: sa ṣaḍḍhotuḥ saptahotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayukti somapaḥ somayājyabhavat | ā'sya somapaḥ somayājyajāyata | yaḥ kāmayeta somapaḥ somayājī syām | ā me somapaḥ somayājī jāyeteti | sa saptahotāraṃ prayuñjīta | somapa eva somayājī bhavati | ā'sya somapaḥ somayājī jāyate | sa vā eṣa paśuḥ pañcadhā pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: स षड्ढोतुः सप्तहोतारं निरमिमीत । तं प्रायुङ्क्त । तस्य प्रयुक्ति सोमपः सोमयाज्यभवत् । आऽस्य सोमपः सोमयाज्यजायत । यः कामयेत सोमपः सोमयाजी स्याम् । आ मे सोमपः सोमयाजी जायेतेति । स सप्तहोतारं प्रयुञ्जीत । सोमप एव सोमयाजी भवति । आऽस्य सोमपः सोमयाजी जायते । स वा एष पशुः पञ्चधा प्रतितिष्ठति

sanskrit_iast: padbhirmukhena | te devāḥ paśūn vittvā | suvargaṃ lokamāyan | te'muṣmiṃ lloke vyakṣudhyan | te'bruvan | amutaḥ pradānaṃ vā upajijīvimeti | te saptahotāraṃ yajñaṃ vidhāyāyāsyam | āṃgīrasaṃ prāhiṇvan | etenāmutra kalpayeti | tasya vā iyaṃ klṛptiḥ
meaning: पद्भिर्मुखेन । ते देवाः पशून् वित्त्वा । सुवर्गं लोकमायन् । तेऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके व्यक्षुध्यन् । तेऽब्रुवन् । अमुतः प्रदानं वा उपजिजीविमेति । ते सप्तहोतारं यज्ञं विधायायास्यम् । आंगीरसं प्राहिण्वन् । एतेनामुत्र कल्पयेति । तस्य वा इयं क्लृप्तिः
text_mt:
by the feet [and] by the mouth.
Those gods, having found domestic animals,
went to the heavenly realm.
They hungered in that realm.
They said:
'We have lived upon what was offered from there.'
Having arranged the sacrifice as the Saptahotṛ, they sent Ayāsya
Āṅgirasa, [saying]:
'Arrange [it] over there by means of this.'
His arrangement was this:

sanskrit_iast: yadidaṃ kiṃca | ya evaṃ veda | kalpate'smai | sa vā ayaṃ manuṣyeṣu yajñaḥ saptahotā | amutra sadbhyo devebhyo havyaṃ vahati | ya evaṃ veda | upainaṃ yajño namati | yo vai caturhotṛṇāṃ nidānaṃ veda | nidānavānbhavati | agnihotraṃ vai daśahoturnidānam | darśapūrṇamāsau caturhotuḥ | cāturmāsyāni pañcahotuḥ | paśubandhaḥ ṣaḍḍhotuḥ | saumyo'dhvaraḥ saptahotuḥ | etadvai caturhotṛṇāṃ nidānam | ya evaṃ veda | nidānavānbhavati
meaning: यदिदं किंच । य एवं वेद । कल्पतेऽस्मै । स वा अयं मनुष्येषु यज्ञः सप्तहोता । अमुत्र सद्भ्यो देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहति । य एवं वेद । उपैनं यज्ञो नमति । यो वै चतुर्होतृणां निदानं वेद । निदानवान्भवति । अग्निहोत्रं वै दशहोतुर्निदानम् । दर्शपूर्णमासौ चतुर्होतुः । चातुर्मास्यानि पञ्चहोतुः । पशुबन्धः षड्ढोतुः । सौम्योऽध्वरः सप्तहोतुः । एतद्वै चतुर्होतृणां निदानम् । य एवं वेद । निदानवान्भवति
text_mt:
whatever exists here.
For him who knows thus, it is properly ordered.
This sacrifice among humans, the Saptahotṛ,
bears the oblation to the gods residing over there.
He who knows thus,
to him the sacrifice inclines.
Whoever knows the foundational cause of the Caturhotṛ formulas,
he comes to possess a foundational cause.
The Agnihotra is the foundational cause of the Daśahotṛ;
the New and Full Moon sacrifices, of the Caturhotṛ;
the four-month sacrifices, of the Pañcahotṛ;
the animal sacrifice, of the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ;
the soma sacrificial rite, of the Saptahotṛ.
This indeed is the foundational cause of the Caturhotṛ formulas.
He who knows thus
comes to possess a foundational cause.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti | kiṃ caturhotṛṇāṃ caturhotṛtvamiti | yadevaiṣu caturdhā hotāraḥ | tena caturhotāraḥ | tasmāccaturhotāra ucyante | taccaturhotṛṇāṃ caturhotṛtvam | somo vai caturhotā | agniḥ pañcahotā | dhātā ṣaḍḍhotā | indraḥ saptahotā
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । किं चतुर्होतृणां चतुर्होतृत्वमिति । यदेवैषु चतुर्धा होतारः । तेन चतुर्होतारः । तस्माच्चतुर्होतार उच्यन्ते । तच्चतुर्होतृणां चतुर्होतृत्वम् । सोमो वै चतुर्होता । अग्निः पञ्चहोता । धाता षड्ढोता । इन्द्रः सप्तहोता

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirdaśahotā | ya evaṃ caturhotṛṇāmṛddhiṃ veda | ṛdhnotyeva | ya eṣāmevaṃ bandhutāṃ veda | bandhumānbhavati | ya eṣāmevaṃ klṛptiṃ veda | kalpate'smai | ya eṣāmevamāyatanaṃ veda | āyatanavānbhavati | ya eṣāmevaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ veda
meaning: प्रजापतिर्दशहोता । य एवं चतुर्होतृणामृद्धिं वेद । ऋध्नोत्येव । य एषामेवं बन्धुतां वेद । बन्धुमान्भवति । य एषामेवं क्लृप्तिं वेद । कल्पतेऽस्मै । य एषामेवमायतनं वेद । आयतनवान्भवति । य एषामेवं प्रतिष्ठां वेद
text_mt:
Prajāpati is the Daśahotṛ.
He who thus knows the prosperity of the Caturhotṛ formulas,
he indeed prospers.
He who thus knows their kinship,
he comes to possess kin.
He who thus knows their proper order,
it is properly ordered for him.
He who thus knows their proper domain,
he comes to possess a proper domain.
He who thus knows their firm foundation,

sanskrit_iast: pratyeva tiṣṭhati | brahmavādino vadanti | daśahotā caturhotā | pañcahotā ṣaḍḍhotā saptahotā | atha kasmāccaturhotāra ucyanta iti | indro vai caturhotā | indraḥ khalu vai śreṣṭho devatānāmupadeśanāt | ya evamindraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devatānāmupadeśanādveda | vasiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati | tasmācchreṣṭhamāyantaṃ prathamenaivānubudhyante | ayamāgan | ayamavāsāditi | kīrtirasya pūrvā''gacchati janatāmāyataḥ | atho enaṃ prathamenaivānu budhyante | ayamāgan | ayamavāsāditi
meaning: प्रत्येव तिष्ठति । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । दशहोता चतुर्होता । पञ्चहोता षड्ढोता सप्तहोता । अथ कस्माच्चतुर्होतार उच्यन्त इति । इन्द्रो वै चतुर्होता । इन्द्रः खलु वै श्रेष्ठो देवतानामुपदेशनात् । य एवमिन्द्रं श्रेष्ठं देवतानामुपदेशनाद्वेद । वसिष्ठः समानानां भवति । तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठमायन्तं प्रथमेनैवानुबुध्यन्ते । अयमागन् । अयमवासादिति । कीर्तिरस्य पूर्वा'ऽगच्छति जनतामायतः । अथो एनं प्रथमेनैवानु बुध्यन्ते । अयमागन् । अयमवासादिति
text_mt:
he stands firmly.
Discussers of sacred lore say:
'The Daśahotṛ, the Caturhotṛ,
the Pañcahotṛ, the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ, the Saptahotṛ—
then why are they called Caturhotṛs?'
Indra indeed is the Caturhotṛ;
Indra is indeed the highest of deities by instruction.
He who thus knows Indra to be the highest of deities by instruction,
he becomes the most distinguished among his peers.
Therefore, as the highest person approaches, they notice him at the first [step]:
'Here he has come;
here he has taken up residence.'
His fame arrives beforehand among the people as he approaches;
and they notice him at the first [step]:
'Here he has come;
here he has taken up residence.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāṃ pratigrahīṣyanthsaptadaśakṛtvo'pānyāt | ātmānameva samindhe | tejase vīryāya | atho prajāpatirevaināṃ bhūtvā pratigṛhṇāti | ātmano'nārtyai | yadyenamārtvijyādvṛtaṃ santaṃ nirhareran | āgnīdhre juhuyāddaśahotāram | caturgṛhītenājyena | purastātpratyaṅtiṣṭhan | pratilomaṃ vigrāham
meaning: दक्षिणां प्रतिग्रहीष्यन्थ्सप्तदशकृत्वोऽपान्यात् । आत्मानमेव समिन्धे । तेजसे वीर्याय । अथो प्रजापतिरेवैनां भूत्वा प्रतिगृह्णाति । आत्मनोऽनार्त्यै । यद्येनमार्त्विज्याद्वृतं सन्तं निर्हरेरन् । आग्नीध्रे जुहुयाद्दशहोतारम् । चतुर्गृहीतेनाज्येन । पुरस्तात्प्रत्यङ्तिष्ठन् । प्रतिलोमं विग्राहम्
text_mt:
When about to accept the sacrificial gift, he should breathe in seventeen times;
he kindles his own self
for fiery energy, for heroic power;
and having become Prajāpati himself, he accepts it,
for the non-injury of himself.
If they should dismiss him after he has been chosen for the priesthood,
he should offer the Daśahotṛ formula in the Āgnīdhra fire
with ghee scooped four times,
standing in the east facing west,
backwards and dividing [the mantras].

sanskrit_iast: prāṇānevāsyopadāsayati | yadyenaṃ punarupaśikṣeyuḥ | āgnīdhra eva juhuyāddaśahotāram | caturgṛhītenājyena | paścātprāṅāsīnaḥ | anulomamavigrāham | prāṇānevāsmai kalpayati | prāyaścittī vāgghotetyṛtumukha ṛtumukhe juhoti | ṛtūnevāsmai kalpayati | kalpante'smā ṛtavaḥ
meaning: प्राणानेवास्योपदासयति । यद्येनं पुनरुपशिक्षेयुः । आग्नीध्र एव जुहुयाद्दशहोतारम् । चतुर्गृहीतेनाज्येन । पश्चात्प्राङासीनः । अनुलोममविग्राहम् । प्राणानेवास्मै कल्पयति । प्रायश्चित्ती वाग्घोतेत्यृतुमुख ऋतुमुखे जुहोति । ऋतूनेवास्मै कल्पयति । कल्पन्तेऽस्मा ऋतवः

sanskrit_iast: klṛptā asmā ṛtava āyanti | ṣaḍḍhotā vai bhūtvā prajāpatiridaṃ sarvamasṛjata | sa mano'sṛjata | manaso'dhi gāyatrīmasṛjata | tadgāyatrīṃ yaśa ārcchat | tāmā'labhata | gāyatriyā adhi chandāṃsyasṛjata | chandobhyo'dhi sāma | tathsāma yaśa ārcchat | tadā'labhata
meaning: क्लृप्ता अस्मा ऋतव आयन्ति । षड्ढोता वै भूत्वा प्रजापतिरिदं सर्वमसृजत । स मनोऽसृजत । मनसोऽधि गायत्रीमसृजत । तद्गायत्रीं यश आर्च्छत् । तामाऽलभत । गायत्रिया अधि छन्दांस्यसृजत । छन्दोभ्योऽधि साम । तथ्साम यश आर्च्छत् । तदाऽलभत
text_mt:
the seasons come to him properly arranged.
Having become the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ, Prajāpati created all this.
He created the mind.
From the mind he created the gāyatrī.
Then glory came to the gāyatrī.
He seized it.
From the gāyatrī he created the meters.
From the meters, the sāman chant.
Then glory came to the sāman chant.
He seized it.

sanskrit_iast: sāmno'dhi yajūgṣyasṛjata | yajurbhyo'dhi viṣṇum | tadviṣṇuṃ yaśa ārcchat | tamā'labhata | viṣṇoradhyoṣadhīrasṛjata | oṣadhībhyo'dhi somam | tathsomaṃ yaśa ārcchat | tamā'labhata | somādadhi paśūnasṛjata | paśubhyo'dhīndram
meaning: साम्नोऽधि यजूग्ष्यसृजत । यजुर्भ्योऽधि विष्णुम् । तद्विष्णुं यश आर्च्छत् । तमाऽलभत । विष्णोरध्योषधीरसृजत । ओषधीभ्योऽधि सोमम् । तथ्सोमं यश आर्च्छत् । तमाऽलभत । सोमादधि पशूनसृजत । पशुभ्योऽधीन्द्रम्
text_mt: From the sāman he created the yajuses, / from the yajuses Viṣṇu. / Fame reached that Viṣṇu; / he seized it. / From Viṣṇu he created the plants, / from the plants Soma. / Fame reached that Soma; / he seized it. / From Soma he created the domestic animals, / from the domestic animals Indra.

sanskrit_iast: tadindraṃ yaśa ārcchat | tadenaṃ nātiprācyavata | indra iva yaśasvī bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | nainaṃ yaśo'ti pracyavate | yadvā idaṃ kiṃca | tathsarvamuttāna evāṃgīrasaḥ pratyagṛhṇāt | tadenaṃ pratigṛhītaṃ nāhinat | yatkiṃca pratigṛhṇīyāt | tathsarvamuttānastvā''ṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātvityeva pratigṛhṇīyāt | iyaṃ vā uttāna āṅgīrasaḥ | anayaivainatpratigṛhṇāti | nainaṃ hinasti | barhiṣā pratīyādgāṃ vā'śvaṃ vā | etadvai paśūnāṃ priyaṃ dhāma | priyeṇaivainaṃ dhāmnā pratyeti
meaning: तदिन्द्रं यश आर्च्छत् । तदेनं नातिप्राच्यवत । इन्द्र इव यशस्वी भवति । य एवं वेद । नैनं यशोऽति प्रच्यवते । यद्वा इदं किंच । तथ्सर्वमुत्तान एवांगीरसः प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तदेनं प्रतिगृहीतं नाहिनत् । यत्किंच प्रतिगृह्णीयात् । तथ्सर्वमुत्तानस्त्वा'ऽङ्गीरसः प्रतिगृह्णात्वित्येव प्रतिगृह्णीयात् । इयं वा उत्तान आङ्गीरसः । अनयैवैनत्प्रतिगृह्णाति । नैनं हिनस्ति । बर्हिषा प्रतीयाद्गां वाऽश्वं वा । एतद्वै पशूनां प्रियं धाम । प्रियेणैवैनं धाम्ना प्रत्येति
text_mt: Fame reached that Indra; / it did not slip away beyond him. / He becomes famous like Indra, / who knows thus; fame does not slip away beyond him. / Whatever there is here, / all that Uttāna Āṅgirasa accepted; / it did not injure him when accepted. / Whatever one accepts, / one should accept it all only with the words, 'May Uttāna Āṅgirasa accept you!' / This [earth] indeed is Uttāna Āṅgirasa; / by means of her he accepts it; / it does not injure him. / With sacrificial grass one should go to meet a cow or a horse; / this is the dear abode of domestic animals; / by means of their dear abode he goes to meet it.

sanskrit_iast: yo vā avidvānnivartayate | viśīrṣā sa pāpmā'muṣmiṃ lloke bhavati | atha yo vidvānnivartayate | saśīrṣā vipāpmā'muṣmiṃ lloke bhavati | devatā vai sapta puṣṭikāmā nyavartayanta | agniśca pṛthivī ca | vāyuścāntarikṣaṃ ca | ādityaśca dyauśca candramāḥ | agnirnyavartayata | sa sāhasramapuṣyat
meaning: यो वा अविद्वान्निवर्तयते । विशीर्षा स पाप्माऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके भवति । अथ यो विद्वान्निवर्तयते । सशीर्षा विपाप्माऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके भवति । देवता वै सप्त पुष्टिकामा न्यवर्तयन्त । अग्निश्च पृथिवी च । वायुश्चान्तरिक्षं च । आदित्यश्च द्यौश्च चन्द्रमाः । अग्निर्न्यवर्तयत । स साहस्रमपुष्यत्
text_mt: He who turns away unknowing / becomes headless, sinful in yonder world. / But he who turns away knowing / becomes head-possessing, sinless in yonder world. / Seven deities desiring nourishment turned away: / Agni and the earth, / Vāyu and the intermediate space, / and Āditya and the sky, and the moon. / Agni turned away; / he prospered a thousandfold.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivī nyavartayata | sauṣadhībhirvanaspatibhirapuṣyat | vāyurnyavartayata | sa marīcībhirapuṣyat | antarikṣaṃ nyavartayata | tadvayobhirapuṣyat | ādityo nyavartayata | sa raśmibhirapuṣyat | dyaurnyavartayata | sā nakṣatrairapuṣyat | candramā nyavartayata | so'horātrairardhamāsairmāsairṛtubhiḥ saṃvathsareṇāpuṣyat | tānpoṣānpuṣyati | yāṃste'puṣyan | ya evaṃ vidvānni ca vartayate pari ca
meaning: पृथिवी न्यवर्तयत । सौषधीभिर्वनस्पतिभिरपुष्यत् । वायुर्न्यवर्तयत । स मरीचीभिरपुष्यत् । अन्तरिक्षं न्यवर्तयत । तद्वयोभिरपुष्यत् । आदित्यो न्यवर्तयत । स रश्मिभिरपुष्यत् । द्यौर्न्यवर्तयत । सा नक्षत्रैरपुष्यत् । चन्द्रमा न्यवर्तयत । सोऽहोरात्रैरर्धमासैर्मासैरृतुभिः संवथ्सरेणापुष्यत् । तान्पोषान्पुष्यति । यांस्तेऽपुष्यन् । य एवं विद्वान्नि च वर्तयते परि च
text_mt: The earth turned away; / she prospered with plants [and] trees. / Vāyu turned away; / he prospered with rays of light. / The intermediate space turned away; / it prospered with birds. / Āditya turned away; / he prospered with rays. / The sky turned away; / it prospered with lunar mansions. / The moon turned away; / he prospered with day-and-nights, half-months, months, seasons, [and] the year. / He prospers with those nourishments / with which they prospered, / who, knowing thus, turns away and turns around.

sanskrit_iast: tasya vā agnerhiraṇyaṃ pratijagrahuṣaḥ | ardhamindriyasyāpākrāmat | tadetenaiva pratyagṛhṇāt | tena vai so'rdhamindriyasyātmannupādhatta | ardhamindriyasyātmannupā dhatte | ya evaṃ vidvān hiraṇyaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | atha yo'vidvānpratigṛhṇāti | ardhamasyendriyasyāpakrāmati | tasya vai somasya vāsaḥ pratijagrahuṣaḥ | tṛtīyamindriyasyāpākrāmat
meaning: तस्य वा अग्नेर्हिरण्यं प्रतिजग्रहुषः । अर्धमिन्द्रियस्यापाक्रामत् । तदेतेनैव प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तेन वै सोऽर्धमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्त । अर्धमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपा धत्ते । य एवं विद्वान् हिरण्यं प्रतिगृह्णाति । अथ योऽविद्वान्प्रतिगृह्णाति । अर्धमस्येन्द्रियस्यापक्रामति । तस्य वै सोमस्य वासः प्रतिजग्रहुषः । तृतीयमिन्द्रियस्यापाक्रामत्
text_mt: When Agni accepted gold, / half of his faculty departed. / He accepted it with this very [formula]; / by it he placed half of the faculty into himself. / Half of the faculty he places into himself, / who, knowing thus, accepts gold. / But he who accepts unknowing, / half of his faculty departs. / When Soma accepted a garment, / a third of his faculty departed.

sanskrit_iast: tadetenaiva pratyagṛhṇāt | tena vai sa tṛtīyamindriyasyātmannupādhatta | tṛtīyamindriyasyātmannupā dhatte | ya evaṃ vidvān vāsaḥ pratigṛhṇāti | atha yo'vidvānpratigṛhṇāti | tṛtīyamasyendriyasyāpakrāmati | tasya vai rudrasya gāṃ pratijagrahuṣaḥ | caturthamindriyasyāpākrāmat | tāmetenaiva pratyagṛhṇāt | tena vai sa caturthamindriyasyātmannupādhatta
meaning: तदेतेनैव प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तेन वै स तृतीयमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्त । तृतीयमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपा धत्ते । य एवं विद्वान् वासः प्रतिगृह्णाति । अथ योऽविद्वान्प्रतिगृह्णाति । तृतीयमस्येन्द्रियस्यापक्रामति । तस्य वै रुद्रस्य गां प्रतिजग्रहुषः । चतुर्थमिन्द्रियस्यापाक्रामत् । तामेतेनैव प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तेन वै स चतुर्थमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्त
text_mt:
He accepted it with this very [formula]; / by it he placed a third of the faculty into himself. / A third of the faculty he places into himself, / who, knowing thus, accepts a garment. / But he who accepts unknowing, / a third of his faculty departs. / When Rudra accepted a cow, / a fourth of his faculty departed. / He accepted it with this very [formula]; / by it he placed a fourth of the faculty into himself.

A fourth of the faculty he places into himself, / who, knowing thus, accepts a cow. / But he who accepts unknowing, / a fourth of his faculty departs. / When Varuṇa accepted a horse, / a fifth of his faculty departed. / He accepted it with this very [formula]; / by it he placed a fifth of the faculty into himself. / A fifth of the faculty he places into himself, / who, knowing thus, accepts a horse.

sanskrit_iast: caturthamindriyasyātmannupādhatte | ya evaṃ vidvāngāṃ pratigṛhṇāti | atha yo'vidvānpratigṛhṇāti | caturthamasyendriyasyāpakrāmati | tasya vai varuṇasyāśvaṃ pratijagrahuṣaḥ | pañcamamindriyasyāpākrāmat | tametenaiva pratyagṛhṇāt | tena vai sa pañcamamindriyasyātmannupādhatta | pañcamamindriyasyātmannupādhatte | ya evaṃ vidvānaśvaṃ pratigṛhṇāti
meaning: चतुर्थमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्ते । य एवं विद्वान्गां प्रतिगृह्णाति । अथ योऽविद्वान्प्रतिगृह्णाति । चतुर्थमस्येन्द्रियस्यापक्रामति । तस्य वै वरुणस्याश्वं प्रतिजग्रहुषः । पञ्चममिन्द्रियस्यापाक्रामत् । तमेतेनैव प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तेन वै स पञ्चममिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्त । पञ्चममिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्ते । य एवं विद्वानश्वं प्रतिगृह्णाति

sanskrit_iast: atha yo'vidvānpratigṛhṇāti | pañcamamasyendriyasyāpa krāmati | tasya vai prajāpateḥ puruṣaṃ pratijagrahuṣaḥ | ṣaṣṭhamindriyasyāpākrāmat | tametenaiva pratyagṛhṇāt | tena vai sa ṣaṣṭhamindriyasyātmannupādhatta | ṣaṣṭhamindriyasyātmannupādhatte | ya evaṃ vidvānpuruṣaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | atha yo'vidvānpratigṛhṇāti | ṣaṣṭhamasyendriyasyāpakrāmati
meaning: अथ योऽविद्वान्प्रतिगृह्णाति । पञ्चममस्येन्द्रियस्याप क्रामति । तस्य वै प्रजापतेः पुरुषं प्रतिजग्रहुषः । षष्ठमिन्द्रियस्यापाक्रामत् । तमेतेनैव प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तेन वै स षष्ठमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्त । षष्ठमिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्ते । य एवं विद्वान्पुरुषं प्रतिगृह्णाति । अथ योऽविद्वान्प्रतिगृह्णाति । षष्ठमस्येन्द्रियस्यापक्रामति
text_mt: But he who accepts unknowing, / a fifth of his faculty departs. / When Prajāpati accepted a human, / a sixth of his faculty departed. / He accepted him with this very [formula]; / by it he placed a sixth of the faculty into himself. / A sixth of the faculty he places into himself, / who, knowing thus, accepts a human. / But he who accepts unknowing, / a sixth of his faculty departs.

sanskrit_iast: tasya vai manostalpaṃ pratijagrahuṣaḥ | saptamamindriyasyāpākrāmat | tametenaiva pratyagṛhṇāt | tena vai sa saptamamindriyasyātmannupādhatta | saptamamindriyasyātmannupā dhatte | ya evaṃ vidvāṃstalpaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | atha yo'vidvānpratigṛhṇāti | saptamamasyendriyasyāpakrāmati | tasya vā uttānasyāṅgīrasasyāprāṇat pratijagrahuṣaḥ | aṣṭamamindriyasyāpākrāmat
meaning: तस्य वै मनोस्तल्पं प्रतिजग्रहुषः । सप्तममिन्द्रियस्यापाक्रामत् । तमेतेनैव प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तेन वै स सप्तममिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्त । सप्तममिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपा धत्ते । य एवं विद्वांस्तल्पं प्रतिगृह्णाति । अथ योऽविद्वान्प्रतिगृह्णाति । सप्तममस्येन्द्रियस्यापक्रामति । तस्य वा उत्तानस्याङ्गीरसस्याप्राणत् प्रतिजग्रहुषः । अष्टममिन्द्रियस्यापाक्रामत्
text_mt: When Manu accepted a couch, / a seventh of his faculty departed. / He accepted it with this very [formula]; / by it he placed a seventh of the faculty into himself. / A seventh of the faculty he places into himself, / who, knowing thus, accepts a couch. / But he who accepts unknowing, / a seventh of his faculty departs. / When Uttāna Āṅgirasa accepted an inanimate thing, / an eighth of his faculty departed.

sanskrit_iast: tadetenaiva pratyagṛhṇāt | tena vai so'ṣṭama mindriyasyātmannupādhatta | aṣṭamamindriyasyātmannupādhatte | ya evaṃ vidvānaprāṇatpratigṛhṇāti | atha yo'vidvānpratigṛhṇāti | aṣṭamamasyendriyasyāpakrāmati | yadvā idaṃ kiṃca | tathsarvamuttāna evāṃgīrasaḥ pratyagṛhṇāt | tadenaṃ pratigṛhītaṃ nāhinat | yatkiṃca pratigṛhṇīyāt | tathsarvamuttānastvā''ṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātvityeva pratigṛhṇīyāt | iyaṃ vā uttāna āṅgīrasaḥ | anayaivainatpratigṛhṇāti | nainaṃ hinasti
meaning: तदेतेनैव प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तेन वै सोऽष्टम मिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्त । अष्टममिन्द्रियस्यात्मन्नुपाधत्ते । य एवं विद्वानप्राणत्प्रतिगृह्णाति । अथ योऽविद्वान्प्रतिगृह्णाति । अष्टममस्येन्द्रियस्यापक्रामति । यद्वा इदं किंच । तथ्सर्वमुत्तान एवांगीरसः प्रत्यगृह्णात् । तदेनं प्रतिगृहीतं नाहिनत् । यत्किंच प्रतिगृह्णीयात् । तथ्सर्वमुत्तानस्त्वा'ऽङ्गीरसः प्रतिगृह्णात्वित्येव प्रतिगृह्णीयात् । इयं वा उत्तान आङ्गीरसः । अनयैवैनत्प्रतिगृह्णाति । नैनं हिनस्ति
text_mt: He accepted it with this very [formula]; / by it he placed an eighth of the faculty into himself. / An eighth of the faculty he places into himself, / who, knowing thus, accepts an inanimate thing. / But he who accepts unknowing, / an eighth of his faculty departs. / Whatever there is here, / all that Uttāna Āṅgirasa accepted; / it did not injure him when accepted. / Whatever one accepts, / one should accept it all only with the words, 'May Uttāna Āṅgirasa accept you!' / This [earth] indeed is Uttāna Āṅgirasa; / by means of her he accepts it; / it does not injure him.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti | yaddaśahotāraḥ satramāsata | kena te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | kena prajā asṛjanteti | prajāpatinā vai te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | tena prajā asṛjanta | yaccaturhotāraḥ satramāsata | kena te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | kenauṣadhīrasṛjanteti | somena vai te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । यद्दशहोतारः सत्रमासत । केन ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । केन प्रजा असृजन्तेति । प्रजापतिना वै ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । तेन प्रजा असृजन्त । यच्चतुर्होतारः सत्रमासत । केन ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । केनौषधीरसृजन्तेति । सोमेन वै ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन्
text_mt: The discussers of sacred lore say: / 'When the Daśahotṛs held a sacrificial session, / by means of what householder did they prosper? / By means of what did they create offspring?' / By means of Prajāpati as householder they prospered; / by means of him they created offspring. / 'When the Caturhotṛs held a sacrificial session, / by means of what householder did they prosper? / By means of what did they create plants?' / By means of Soma as householder they prospered.

sanskrit_iast: tenauṣadhīrasṛjanta | yatpañcahotāraḥ satramāsata | kena te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | kenaibhyo lokebhyo'surānprāṇudanta | kenaiṣāṃ paśūnavṛñjateti | agninā vai te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | tenaibhyo lokebhyo'surānprāṇudanta | tenaiṣāṃ paśūnavṛñjata | yatṣaḍḍhotāraḥ satramāsata | kena te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan
meaning: तेनौषधीरसृजन्त । यत्पञ्चहोतारः सत्रमासत । केन ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । केनैभ्यो लोकेभ्योऽसुरान्प्राणुदन्त । केनैषां पशूनवृञ्जतेति । अग्निना वै ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । तेनैभ्यो लोकेभ्योऽसुरान्प्राणुदन्त । तेनैषां पशूनवृञ्जत । यत्षड्ढोतारः सत्रमासत । केन ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन्
text_mt:
Through him they generated the plants.
When the five-hotṛ-formula deities sat for a sacrificial session,
with what householder did they prosper?
With whom did they drive away the asuras from these worlds?
With whom did they take away their domestic animals?"
With Agni as their householder they prospered.
Through him they drove away the asuras from these worlds.
Through him they took away their domestic animals.
When the six-hotṛ-formula deities sat for a sacrificial session,
with what householder did they prosper?

sanskrit_iast: kenartūnakalpayanteti | dhātrā vai te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | tenartūnakalpayanta | yathsaptahotāraḥ satramāsata | kena te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | kena suvarāyan | kenemān lokānthsamatanvanniti | aryamṇā vai te gṛhapatinā''rdhnuvan | tena suvarāyan | tenemān lokānthsamatanvanniti
meaning: केनर्तूनकल्पयन्तेति । धात्रा वै ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । तेनर्तूनकल्पयन्त । यथ्सप्तहोतारः सत्रमासत । केन ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । केन सुवरायन् । केनेमान् लोकान्थ्समतन्वन्निति । अर्यम्णा वै ते गृहपतिना'ऽर्ध्नुवन् । तेन सुवरायन् । तेनेमान् लोकान्थ्समतन्वन्निति
text_mt:
With whom did they arrange the seasons?"
With Dhātṛ as householder they prospered.
Through him they arranged the seasons.
When the seven-hotṛ-formula deities sat for a sacrificial session,
with what householder did they prosper?
With whom did they go to heaven?
With whom did they stretch across these worlds?"
With Aryaman as householder they prospered.
Through him they went to heaven.
Through him they stretched across these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: ete vai devā gṛhapatayaḥ | tān ya evaṃ vidvān | apyanyasya gārhapate dīkṣate | avāntarameva sattriṇāmṛdhnoti || yo vā aryamaṇaṃ veda | dānakāmā asmai prajā bhavanti | yajño vā aryamā | āryā vasatiriti vai tamāhuryaṃ praśaṃsanti | āryāvasatirbhavati | ya evaṃ veda ||
meaning: एते वै देवा गृहपतयः । तान् य एवं विद्वान् । अप्यन्यस्य गार्हपते दीक्षते । अवान्तरमेव सत्त्रिणामृध्नोति ॥ यो वा अर्यमणं वेद । दानकामा अस्मै प्रजा भवन्ति । यज्ञो वा अर्यमा । आर्या वसतिरिति वै तमाहुर्यं प्रशंसन्ति । आर्यावसतिर्भवति । य एवं वेद ॥
text_mt:
These gods indeed are the householders.
Knowing them thus, he who
undergoes initiation even at another's householder fire
prospers directly among the participants of the sacrificial session.
He who knows Aryaman,
for him offspring are eager to make gifts.
Aryaman is indeed the sacrifice.
"A noble abode," they say of him whom they praise.
A noble abode he becomes,
who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: yadvā idaṃ kiṃca | tathsarvaṃ caturhotāraḥ | caturhotṛbhyo'dhi yajño nirmitaḥ | sa ya evaṃ vidvān vivadeta | ahameva bhūyo veda | yaścaturhotṝn vedeti | sa hyeva bhūyo veda | yaścaturhotṝn veda | yo vai caturhotṛṇāṃ hotṝn veda | sarvāsu prajāsvannamatti
meaning: यद्वा इदं किंच । तथ्सर्वं चतुर्होतारः । चतुर्होतृभ्योऽधि यज्ञो निर्मितः । स य एवं विद्वान् विवदेत । अहमेव भूयो वेद । यश्चतुर्होतॄन् वेदेति । स ह्येव भूयो वेद । यश्चतुर्होतॄन् वेद । यो वै चतुर्होतृणां होतॄन् वेद । सर्वासु प्रजास्वन्नमत्ति
text_mt:
Whatever there is here,
all that is the cāturhotṛ formulae.
From the cāturhotṛ formulae the sacrifice was fashioned.
If one knowing thus should argue:
"I know more,
who know the cāturhotṛ formulae,"
he indeed knows more,
who knows the cāturhotṛ formulae.
He who knows the hotṛs of the cāturhotṛ formulae
eats food among all creatures;

sanskrit_iast: sarvā diśo'bhijayati | prajāpatirvai daśahotṛṇāṃ hotā | somaścaturhotṛṇāṃ hotā | agniḥ pañcahotṛṇāṃ hotā | dhātā ṣaḍḍhotṛṇāṃ hotā | aryamā saptahotṛṇāṃ hotā | ete vai caturhotṛṇāṃ hotāraḥ | tān ya evaṃ veda | sarvāsu prajāsvannamatti | sarvā diśo'bhijayati
meaning: सर्वा दिशोऽभिजयति । प्रजापतिर्वै दशहोतृणां होता । सोमश्चतुर्होतृणां होता । अग्निः पञ्चहोतृणां होता । धाता षड्ढोतृणां होता । अर्यमा सप्तहोतृणां होता । एते वै चतुर्होतृणां होतारः । तान् य एवं वेद । सर्वासु प्रजास्वन्नमत्ति । सर्वा दिशोऽभिजयति

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā vyasraṃsata | sa hṛdayaṃ bhūto'śayat | ātman hāityahvayat | āpaḥ pratyaśṛṇvan | tā agnihotreṇaiva yajñakratunopaparyāvartanta | tāḥ kusindhamupauhan | tasmādagnihotrasya yajñakratoḥ | eka ṛtvik | catuṣkṛtvo'hvayat | agnirvāyurādityaścandramāḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा व्यस्रंसत । स हृदयं भूतोऽशयत् । आत्मन् हाइत्यह्वयत् । आपः प्रत्यशृण्वन् । ता अग्निहोत्रेणैव यज्ञक्रतुनोपपर्यावर्तन्त । ताः कुसिन्धमुपौहन् । तस्मादग्निहोत्रस्य यज्ञक्रतोः । एक ऋत्विक् । चतुष्कृत्वोऽह्वयत् । अग्निर्वायुरादित्यश्चन्द्रमाः
text_mt:
Prajāpati, having generated offspring, fell apart.
He lay as a mere heart.
He called out: "O self!"
The waters answered him.
They approached with the rite of sacrifice which is the agnihotra.
They pushed together [his] trunk.
Therefore of the agnihotra rite of sacrifice
there is one officiating priest.
He called out four times:
Agni, Vāyu, Āditya, and the Moon.

sanskrit_iast: te pratyaśṛṇvan | te darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmeva yajñakratunopaparyāvartanta | ta upauhaṃścatvāryaṅgāni | tasmāddarśapūrṇamāsayoryajñakratoḥ | catvāra ṛtvijaḥ | pañcakṛtvo'hvayat | paśavaḥ pratyaśṛṇvan | te cāturmāsyaireva yajñakratunopaparyāvartanta | ta upauhaṃ lloma chavīṃ māṃsamasthi majjānam | tasmāccāturmāsyānāṃ yajñakratoḥ
meaning: ते प्रत्यशृण्वन् । ते दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्यामेव यज्ञक्रतुनोपपर्यावर्तन्त । त उपौहंश्चत्वार्यङ्गानि । तस्माद्दर्शपूर्णमासयोर्यज्ञक्रतोः । चत्वार ऋत्विजः । पञ्चकृत्वोऽह्वयत् । पशवः प्रत्यशृण्वन् । ते चातुर्मास्यैरेव यज्ञक्रतुनोपपर्यावर्तन्त । त उपौहं ल्लोम छवीं मांसमस्थि मज्जानम् । तस्माच्चातुर्मास्यानां यज्ञक्रतोः
text_mt:
They answered.
They approached with the rite of sacrifice which is the new- and full-moon rites.
They pushed together the four limbs.
Therefore of the new- and full-moon rite of sacrifice
there are four officiating priests.
He called out five times.
The domestic animals answered.
They approached with the rite of sacrifice which is the Cāturmāsyas.
They pushed together hair, skin, flesh, bone, and marrow.
Therefore of the Cāturmāsya rite of sacrifice

sanskrit_iast: pañcartvijaḥ | ṣaṭkṛtvo'hvayat | ṛtavaḥ pratyaśṛṇvan | te paśubandhenaiva yajñakratunopa paryāvartanta | ta upauhanthstanāvāṇḍau śiśnamavāñcaṃ prāṇam | tasmātpaśubandhasya yajñakratoḥ | ṣaḍṛtvijaḥ | saptakṛtvo'hvayat | hotrāḥ pratyaśṛṇvan | tāḥ saumyenaivādhvareṇa yajñakratunopaparyāvartanta
meaning: पञ्चर्त्विजः । षट्कृत्वोऽह्वयत् । ऋतवः प्रत्यशृण्वन् । ते पशुबन्धेनैव यज्ञक्रतुनोप पर्यावर्तन्त । त उपौहन्थ्स्तनावाण्डौ शिश्नमवाञ्चं प्राणम् । तस्मात्पशुबन्धस्य यज्ञक्रतोः । षडृत्विजः । सप्तकृत्वोऽह्वयत् । होत्राः प्रत्यशृण्वन् । ताः सौम्येनैवाध्वरेण यज्ञक्रतुनोपपर्यावर्तन्त
text_mt:
there are five officiating priests.
He called out six times.
The seasons answered.
They approached with the rite of sacrifice which is the animal sacrifice.
They pushed together the two breasts, the two testicles, the penis, and the downward breath.
Therefore of the animal sacrifice rite of sacrifice
there are six officiating priests.
He called out seven times.
The Hotrās answered.
They approached with the rite of sacrifice which is the soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tā upauhanthsaptaśīrṣaṇyānprāṇān | tasmāthsaumyasyādhvarasya yajñakratoḥ | sapta hotrāḥ prācīrvaṣaṭkurvanti | daśakṛtvo'hvayat | tapaḥ pratyaśṛṇot | tatkarmaṇaiva saṃvathsareṇa sarvairyajñakratubhirupa paryāvartata | tathsarvamātmānamaparivargamupauhat | tasmāthsaṃvathsare sarve yajñakratavo'varudhyante | tasmāddaśahotā caturhotā | pañcahotā ṣaḍḍhotā saptahotā | ekahotre baliṃ haranti | harantyasmai prajā balim | ainamapratikhyātaṃ gacchati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: ता उपौहन्थ्सप्तशीर्षण्यान्प्राणान् । तस्माथ्सौम्यस्याध्वरस्य यज्ञक्रतोः । सप्त होत्राः प्राचीर्वषट्कुर्वन्ति । दशकृत्वोऽह्वयत् । तपः प्रत्यशृणोत् । तत्कर्मणैव संवथ्सरेण सर्वैर्यज्ञक्रतुभिरुप पर्यावर्तत । तथ्सर्वमात्मानमपरिवर्गमुपौहत् । तस्माथ्संवथ्सरे सर्वे यज्ञक्रतवोऽवरुध्यन्ते । तस्माद्दशहोता चतुर्होता । पञ्चहोता षड्ढोता सप्तहोता । एकहोत्रे बलिं हरन्ति । हरन्त्यस्मै प्रजा बलिम् । ऐनमप्रतिख्यातं गच्छति । य एवं वेद
text_mt:
They pushed together the seven vital breaths of the head.
Therefore of the soma sacrifice rite of sacrifice
seven Hotrās pronounce the vaṣaṭ-call facing eastward.
He called out ten times.
Heat answered.
It approached by means of the ritual action, with the year, with all the rites of sacrifice.
It pushed together his entire self without omission.
Therefore in the year all rites of sacrifice are obtained.
Therefore the ten-hotṛ, the four-hotṛ,
the five-hotṛ, the six-hotṛ, the seven-hotṛ
bring tribute to the one-hotṛ; offspring bring tribute to him;
he attains [renown] that is never contradicted,
who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ puruṣamasṛjata | so'gnirabravīt | mamāyamannamastviti | so'bibhet | sarvaṃ vai mā'yaṃ pradhakṣyatīti | sa etāṃścaturhotṝnātmasparaṇānapaśyat | tānajuhot | tairvai sa ātmānamaspṛṇot | yadagnihotraṃ juhoti | ekahotārameva tadyajñakratumāpnotyagnihotram
meaning: प्रजापतिः पुरुषमसृजत । सोऽग्निरब्रवीत् । ममायमन्नमस्त्विति । सोऽबिभेत् । सर्वं वै माऽयं प्रधक्ष्यतीति । स एतांश्चतुर्होतॄनात्मस्परणानपश्यत् । तानजुहोत् । तैर्वै स आत्मानमस्पृणोत् । यदग्निहोत्रं जुहोति । एकहोतारमेव तद्यज्ञक्रतुमाप्नोत्यग्निहोत्रम्
text_mt:
Prajāpati created man.
Agni said:
"Let this one be my food!"
He was afraid:
"Indeed, this one will completely consume me!"
He saw these cāturhotṛ formulae that rescue the self.
He offered them.
By means of them he rescued himself.
When he offers the agnihotra,
he obtains that rite of sacrifice which is the one-hotṛ, the agnihotra;

sanskrit_iast: kusindhaṃ cā''tmanaḥ spṛṇoti | ādityasya ca sāyujyaṃ gacchati | caturunnayati | caturhotārameva tadyajñakratumāpnoti darśapūrṇamāsau | catvāri cātmano'ṅgāni spṛṇoti | ādityasya ca sāyujyaṃ gacchati | caturunnayati | samitpañcamī | pañcahotārameva tadyajñakratumāpnoti cāturmāsyāni | loma chavīṃ māṃsamasthi majjānam
meaning: कुसिन्धं चा'ऽत्मनः स्पृणोति । आदित्यस्य च सायुज्यं गच्छति । चतुरुन्नयति । चतुर्होतारमेव तद्यज्ञक्रतुमाप्नोति दर्शपूर्णमासौ । चत्वारि चात्मनोऽङ्गानि स्पृणोति । आदित्यस्य च सायुज्यं गच्छति । चतुरुन्नयति । समित्पञ्चमी । पञ्चहोतारमेव तद्यज्ञक्रतुमाप्नोति चातुर्मास्यानि । लोम छवीं मांसमस्थि मज्जानम्
text_mt:
and he rescues his own trunk,
and goes to unison with Āditya.
Four times he scoops up [the milk]:
he obtains that rite of sacrifice which is the four-hotṛ,
the new- and full-moon rites;
and he rescues his four limbs,
and goes to unison with Āditya.
Four times he scoops up;
a kindling stick is the fifth:
he obtains that rite of sacrifice which is the five-hotṛ,
the Cāturmāsyas;
hair, skin, flesh, bone, and marrow—

sanskrit_iast: tāni cātmanaḥ spṛṇoti | ādityasya ca sāyujyaṃ gacchati | caturunnayati | dvirjuhoti | ṣaḍḍhotārameva tadyajñakratumāpnoti paśubandham | stanāvāṇḍau śiśnamavāñcaṃ prāṇam | tāni cātmanaḥ spṛṇoti | ādityasya ca sāyujyaṃ gacchati | caturunnayati | dvirjuhoti
meaning: तानि चात्मनः स्पृणोति । आदित्यस्य च सायुज्यं गच्छति । चतुरुन्नयति । द्विर्जुहोति । षड्ढोतारमेव तद्यज्ञक्रतुमाप्नोति पशुबन्धम् । स्तनावाण्डौ शिश्नमवाञ्चं प्राणम् । तानि चात्मनः स्पृणोति । आदित्यस्य च सायुज्यं गच्छति । चतुरुन्नयति । द्विर्जुहोति

sanskrit_iast: samithsaptamī | saptahotārameva tadyajñakratumāpnoti saumyamadhvaram | sapta cātmanaḥ śīrṣaṇyānprāṇānthspṛṇoti | ādityasya ca sāyujyaṃ gacchati | caturunnayati | dvirjuhoti | dvirnimārṣṭi | dviḥ prāśnāti | daśahotārameva tadyajñakratumāpnoti saṃvathsaram | sarvaṃ cātmānamaparivargaṃ spṛṇoti | ādityasya ca sāyujyaṃ gacchati
meaning: समिथ्सप्तमी । सप्तहोतारमेव तद्यज्ञक्रतुमाप्नोति सौम्यमध्वरम् । सप्त चात्मनः शीर्षण्यान्प्राणान्थ्स्पृणोति । आदित्यस्य च सायुज्यं गच्छति । चतुरुन्नयति । द्विर्जुहोति । द्विर्निमार्ष्टि । द्विः प्राश्नाति । दशहोतारमेव तद्यज्ञक्रतुमाप्नोति संवथ्सरम् । सर्वं चात्मानमपरिवर्गं स्पृणोति । आदित्यस्य च सायुज्यं गच्छति
text_mt:
a kindling stick is the seventh:
he obtains that rite of sacrifice which is the seven-hotṛ, the soma sacrifice;
and he rescues the seven vital breaths of his head,
and goes to unison with Āditya.
Four times he scoops up,
twice he offers,
twice he wipes [the spoon],
twice he consumes:
he obtains that rite of sacrifice which is the ten-hotṛ, the year;
and he rescues his entire self without omission,
and goes to unison with Āditya.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirakāmayata prajāyeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | so'ntarvānabhavat | sa haritaḥ śyāvo'bhavat | tasmāthstryantarvatnī | hariṇī satī śyāvā bhavati | sa vijāyamāno garbheṇātāmyat | sa tāntaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śyāvo'bhavat | tasmāttāntaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śyāvo bhavati | tasyāsurevājīvat
meaning: प्रजापतिरकामयत प्रजायेयेति । स तपोऽतप्यत । सोऽन्तर्वानभवत् । स हरितः श्यावोऽभवत् । तस्माथ्स्त्र्यन्तर्वत्नी । हरिणी सती श्यावा भवति । स विजायमानो गर्भेणाताम्यत् । स तान्तः कृष्णः श्यावोऽभवत् । तस्मात्तान्तः कृष्णः श्यावो भवति । तस्यासुरेवाजीवत्
text_mt:
Prajāpati desired: "May I propagate!"
He practiced ascetic heat.
He became pregnant.
He turned pale-yellow and dark.
Therefore a pregnant woman,
being fair, turns dark.
Giving birth, he suffered exhaustion from the embryo.
Exhausted, he turned black and dark.
Therefore one who is exhausted turns black and dark.
His vital breath alone lived on.

sanskrit_iast: tenāsunā'surānasṛjata | tadasurāṇāmasuratvam | ya evamasurāṇāmasuratvaṃ veda | asumāneva bhavati | nainamasurjahāti | so'surānthsṛṣṭvā pitevāmanyata | tadanu pitṝnasṛjata | tatpitṛṇāṃ pitṛtvam | ya evaṃ pitṛṇāṃ pitṛtvaṃ veda | pitevaiva svānāṃ bhavati
meaning: तेनासुनाऽसुरानसृजत । तदसुराणामसुरत्वम् । य एवमसुराणामसुरत्वं वेद । असुमानेव भवति । नैनमसुर्जहाति । सोऽसुरान्थ्सृष्ट्वा पितेवामन्यत । तदनु पितॄनसृजत । तत्पितृणां पितृत्वम् । य एवं पितृणां पितृत्वं वेद । पितेवैव स्वानां भवति

sanskrit_iast: yantyasya pitaro havam | sa pitṝnthsṛṣṭvā'manasyat | tadanu manuṣyānasṛjata | tanmanuṣyāṇāṃ manuṣyatvam | ya evaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ manuṣyatvaṃ veda | manasvyeva bhavati | nainaṃ manurjahāti | tasmai manuṣyānthsasṛjānāya | divā devatrā'bhavat | tadanu devānasṛjata | taddevānāṃ devatvam | ya evaṃ devānāṃ devatvaṃ veda | divā haivāsya devatrā bhavati | tāni vā etāni catvāryambhāṃsi | devā manuṣyāḥ pitaro'surāḥ | teṣu sarveṣvambho nabha iva bhavati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: यन्त्यस्य पितरो हवम् । स पितॄन्थ्सृष्ट्वाऽमनस्यत् । तदनु मनुष्यानसृजत । तन्मनुष्याणां मनुष्यत्वम् । य एवं मनुष्याणां मनुष्यत्वं वेद । मनस्व्येव भवति । नैनं मनुर्जहाति । तस्मै मनुष्यान्थ्ससृजानाय । दिवा देवत्राऽभवत् । तदनु देवानसृजत । तद्देवानां देवत्वम् । य एवं देवानां देवत्वं वेद । दिवा हैवास्य देवत्रा भवति । तानि वा एतानि चत्वार्यम्भांसि । देवा मनुष्याः पितरोऽसुराः । तेषु सर्वेष्वम्भो नभ इव भवति । य एवं वेद

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti | yo vā imaṃ vidyāt | yato'yaṃ pavate | yadabhi pavate | yadabhi saṃpavate | sarvamāyuriyāt | na purā''yuṣaḥ pramīyeta | paśumānthsyāt | vindeta prajām | yo vā imaṃ veda
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । यो वा इमं विद्यात् । यतोऽयं पवते । यदभि पवते । यदभि संपवते । सर्वमायुरियात् । न पुरा'ऽयुषः प्रमीयेत । पशुमान्थ्स्यात् । विन्देत प्रजाम् । यो वा इमं वेद
text_mt: Discussers of sacred lore say: / Whosoever should know this, / whence this one purifies [and blows], / whither he purifies towards, / whither he completely purifies towards, / he would attain a full lifespan; / he would not die before his full lifespan; / he would be possessed of domestic animals; / he would obtain offspring. // Whosoever knows this:

sanskrit_iast: yato'yaṃ pavate | yadabhipavate | yadabhisaṃpavate | sarvamāyureti | na purā''yuṣaḥ pramīyate | paśumānbhavati | vindate prajām | adbhyaḥ pavate | apo'bhi pavate | apo'bhi saṃpavate
meaning: यतोऽयं पवते । यदभिपवते । यदभिसंपवते । सर्वमायुरेति । न पुरा'ऽयुषः प्रमीयते । पशुमान्भवति । विन्दते प्रजाम् । अद्भ्यः पवते । अपोऽभि पवते । अपोऽभि संपवते
text_mt: whence this one purifies, / whither he purifies towards, / whither he completely purifies towards, / he attains a full lifespan; / he does not die before his full lifespan; / he becomes possessed of domestic animals; / he obtains offspring. // From the waters he purifies; / towards the waters he purifies; / completely towards the waters he purifies.

sanskrit_iast: asyāḥ pavate | imāmabhi pavate | imāmabhi saṃpavate | agneḥ pavate | agnimabhi pavate | agnimabhi saṃpavate | antarikṣātpavate | antarikṣamabhi pavate | antarikṣamabhi saṃpavate | ādityātpavate
meaning: अस्याः पवते । इमामभि पवते । इमामभि संपवते । अग्नेः पवते । अग्निमभि पवते । अग्निमभि संपवते । अन्तरिक्षात्पवते । अन्तरिक्षमभि पवते । अन्तरिक्षमभि संपवते । आदित्यात्पवते
text_mt: From this [earth] he purifies; / towards this one he purifies; / completely towards this one he purifies. / From Agni he purifies; / towards Agni he purifies; / completely towards Agni he purifies. / From the intermediate space he purifies; / towards the intermediate space he purifies; / completely towards the intermediate space he purifies. / From the sun he purifies;

sanskrit_iast: ādityamabhi pavate | ādityamabhi saṃpavate | dyoḥ pavate | divamabhi pavate | divamabhi saṃpavate | digbhyaḥ pavate | diśo'bhi pavate | diśo'bhi saṃpavate | sa yatpurastādvāti | prāṇa eva bhūtvā purastādvāti
meaning: आदित्यमभि पवते । आदित्यमभि संपवते । द्योः पवते । दिवमभि पवते । दिवमभि संपवते । दिग्भ्यः पवते । दिशोऽभि पवते । दिशोऽभि संपवते । स यत्पुरस्ताद्वाति । प्राण एव भूत्वा पुरस्ताद्वाति
text_mt: towards the sun he purifies; / completely towards the sun he purifies. / From heaven he purifies; / towards heaven he purifies; / completely towards heaven he purifies. / From the quarters he purifies; / towards the quarters he purifies; / completely towards the quarters he purifies. // When he blows from the east, / having become exhalation indeed, he blows from the east.

sanskrit_iast: tasmātpurastādvāntam | sarvāḥ prajāḥ pratinandanti | prāṇo hi priyaḥ prajānām | prāṇa iva priyaḥ prajānāṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | sa vā eṣa prāṇa eva | atha yaddakṣiṇato vāti | mātariśvaiva bhūtvā dakṣiṇato vāti | tasmāddakṣiṇato vāntaṃ vidyāt | sarvā diśa āvāti
meaning: तस्मात्पुरस्ताद्वान्तम् । सर्वाः प्रजाः प्रतिनन्दन्ति । प्राणो हि प्रियः प्रजानाम् । प्राण इव प्रियः प्रजानां भवति । य एवं वेद । स वा एष प्राण एव । अथ यद्दक्षिणतो वाति । मातरिश्वैव भूत्वा दक्षिणतो वाति । तस्माद्दक्षिणतो वान्तं विद्यात् । सर्वा दिश आवाति
text_mt: Therefore, when he blows from the east, / all creatures rejoice. / For exhalation is dear to creatures. / Like exhalation, he becomes dear to creatures / who knows thus. / This one indeed is exhalation. // And when he blows from the south, / having become Mātariśvan indeed, he blows from the south. / Therefore one should know him blowing from the south: / he blows towards all quarters,

sanskrit_iast: sarvā diśo'nuvivāti | sarvā diśo'nu saṃvātīti | sa vā eṣa mātariśvaiva | atha yatpaścādvāti | pavamāna eva bhūtvā paścādvāti | pūtamasmā āharanti | pūtamupaharanti | pūtamaśnāti | ya evaṃ veda | sa vā eṣa pavamāna eva
meaning: सर्वा दिशोऽनुविवाति । सर्वा दिशोऽनु संवातीति । स वा एष मातरिश्वैव । अथ यत्पश्चाद्वाति । पवमान एव भूत्वा पश्चाद्वाति । पूतमस्मा आहरन्ति । पूतमुपहरन्ति । पूतमश्नाति । य एवं वेद । स वा एष पवमान एव
text_mt: he blows through all quarters, / he blows together through all quarters. / This one indeed is Mātariśvan. // And when he blows from the west, / having become the purifying Pavamāna indeed, he blows from the west. / They bring what is pure to him; / they offer what is pure [to him]; / he eats what is pure / who knows thus. / This one indeed is Pavamāna.

sanskrit_iast: atha yaduttarato vāti | savitaiva bhūtvottarato vāti | saviteva svānāṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | sa vā eṣa savitaiva | te ya enaṃ purastādāyantamupavadanti | ya evāsya purastātpāpmānaḥ | tāṃste'paghnanti | purastāditarānpāpmanaḥ sacante | atha ya enaṃ dakṣiṇata āyantamupavadanti
meaning: अथ यदुत्तरतो वाति । सवितैव भूत्वोत्तरतो वाति । सवितेव स्वानां भवति । य एवं वेद । स वा एष सवितैव । ते य एनं पुरस्तादायन्तमुपवदन्ति । य एवास्य पुरस्तात्पाप्मानः । तांस्तेऽपघ्नन्ति । पुरस्तादितरान्पाप्मनः सचन्ते । अथ य एनं दक्षिणत आयन्तमुपवदन्ति
text_mt: And when he blows from the north, / having become Savitṛ indeed, he blows from the north. / He becomes like Savitṛ to his own kin / who knows thus. / This one indeed is Savitṛ. // Those who revile him as he approaches from the east: / whatever are his evils in front, / those they strike away; / evils pursue the others from the front. // Now, those who revile him as he approaches from the south:

sanskrit_iast: ya evāsya dakṣiṇataḥ pāpmānaḥ | tāṃste'paghnanti | dakṣiṇata itarānpāpmanaḥ sacante | atha ya enaṃ paścādāyantamupa vadanti | ya evāsya paścātpāpmānaḥ | tāṃste'paghnanti | paścāditarānpāpmanaḥ sacante | atha ya enamuttarata āyantamupa vadanti | ya evāsyottarataḥ pāpmānaḥ | tāṃste'paghnanti
meaning: य एवास्य दक्षिणतः पाप्मानः । तांस्तेऽपघ्नन्ति । दक्षिणत इतरान्पाप्मनः सचन्ते । अथ य एनं पश्चादायन्तमुप वदन्ति । य एवास्य पश्चात्पाप्मानः । तांस्तेऽपघ्नन्ति । पश्चादितरान्पाप्मनः सचन्ते । अथ य एनमुत्तरत आयन्तमुप वदन्ति । य एवास्योत्तरतः पाप्मानः । तांस्तेऽपघ्नन्ति
text_mt: whatever are his evils on the south, / those they strike away; / evils pursue the others from the south. // Now, those who revile him as he approaches from the west: / whatever are his evils in the rear, / those they strike away; / evils pursue the others from the rear. // Now, those who revile him as he approaches from the north: / whatever are his evils on the north, / those they strike away;

sanskrit_iast: uttarata itarānpāpmanaḥ sacante | tasmādevaṃ vidvān | vīva nṛtyet | preva calet | vyasyevākṣyau bhāṣeta | maṇṭayediva | krāthayediva | śṛṅgāyeteva | uta mopa vadeyuḥ | uta me pāpmānamapahanyuriti | sa yāṃ diśaṃ sanimeṣyanthsyāt | yadā tāṃ diśaṃ vāto vāyāt | atha praveyāt | pra vā dhāvayet | sātameva raditaṃ vyūḍhaṃ gandhamabhi pracyavate | ā'sya taṃ janapadaṃ pūrvā kīrtirgacchati | dānakāmā asmai prajā bhavanti | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: उत्तरत इतरान्पाप्मनः सचन्ते । तस्मादेवं विद्वान् । वीव नृत्येत् । प्रेव चलेत् । व्यस्येवाक्ष्यौ भाषेत । मण्टयेदिव । क्राथयेदिव । शृङ्गायेतेव । उत मोप वदेयुः । उत मे पाप्मानमपहन्युरिति । स यां दिशं सनिमेष्यन्थ्स्यात् । यदा तां दिशं वातो वायात् । अथ प्रवेयात् । प्र वा धावयेत् । सातमेव रदितं व्यूढं गन्धमभि प्रच्यवते । आऽस्य तं जनपदं पूर्वा कीर्तिर्गच्छति । दानकामा अस्मै प्रजा भवन्ति । य एवं वेद
text_mt: evils pursue the others from the north. // Therefore one knowing thus / should as it were dance, / should as it were sway, / should roll his eyes as it were, / should as it were limp, / should as it were cough/groan, / should as it were act crazy, / [thinking]: 'May they revile me, / and may they strike away my evil.' // Towards whichever direction he intends to go for gain, / when the wind blows toward that direction, / then he should set out, / or drive [his chariot] forth. / He sets out towards gain, furrowed, dispersed fragrance. / His prior fame reaches that country; / creatures become desirous of giving to him, / who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ somaṃ rājānamasṛjata | taṃ trayo vedā anvasṛjyanta | tān haste'kuruta | atha ha sītā sāvitrī | somaṃ rājānaṃ cakame | śraddhāmu sa cakame | sā ha pitaraṃ prajāpatimupasasāra | taṃ hovāca | namaste astu bhagavaḥ | upa tvā'yāni
meaning: प्रजापतिः सोमं राजानमसृजत । तं त्रयो वेदा अन्वसृज्यन्त । तान् हस्तेऽकुरुत । अथ ह सीता सावित्री । सोमं राजानं चकमे । श्रद्धामु स चकमे । सा ह पितरं प्रजापतिमुपससार । तं होवाच । नमस्ते अस्तु भगवः । उप त्वाऽयानि
text_mt: Prajāpati created King Soma. / Along after him the three Vedas were created. / He held them in his hand. / Then Sītā Sāvitrī / loved King Soma; / and he loved Faith (Śraddhā). / She approached her father Prajāpati. / She said to him: / 'Homage to you, reverend sir; / I would approach you;

sanskrit_iast: pra tvā padye | somaṃ vai rājānaṃ kāmaye | śraddhāmu sa kāmayata iti | tasyā u ha sthāgaramalaṅkāraṃ kalpayitvā | daśahotāraṃ purastādvyākhyāya | caturhotāraṃ dakṣiṇataḥ | pañcahotāraṃ paścāt | ṣaḍḍhotāramuttarataḥ | saptahotāramupariṣṭāt | saṃbhāraiśca patnibhiśca mukhe'laṃkṛtya
