text_mt: This is the cow-consecration; / it is a thirty-six-verse ukthya having the Bṛhat-sāman. / At the pavamāna-laud the Kaṇvarathaṃtara is used. / That which is the Vājapeya, / that is the emperor's consecration. / That which is the rājasūya, / that is Varuṇa's consecration. / Prajāpati Parameṣṭhin is autonomous rule; / autonomous rule is indeed the cow. / Like a cow does he become

sanskrit_iast: ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | ubhe bṛhadrathaṃtare bhavataḥ | taddhi svārājyam | ayutaṃ dakṣiṇāḥ | taddhi svārājyam | pratidhuṣā'bhiṣiñcati | taddhi svārājyam | anuddhate vedyai dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya bṛhatastotraṃ pratyabhiṣiñcati | iyaṃ vāva rathaṃtaram |
meaning: य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । उभे बृहद्रथंतरे भवतः । तद्धि स्वाराज्यम् । अयुतं दक्षिणाः । तद्धि स्वाराज्यम् । प्रतिधुषाऽभिषिञ्चति । तद्धि स्वाराज्यम् । अनुद्धते वेद्यै दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य बृहतस्तोत्रं प्रत्यभिषिञ्चति । इयं वाव रथंतरम् ।
text_mt: who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / Both the Bṛhat and the Rathaṃtara are used, / for that is autonomous rule. / Ten thousand are the sacrificial gifts, / for that is autonomous rule. / He sprinkles him with fresh milk drawn right from the udder, / for that is autonomous rule. / On an unraised [ground] of the altar, south of the Āhavanīya, facing the laud of the Bṛhat, he sprinkles him. / This [earth] indeed is the Rathaṃtara;

sanskrit_iast: asau bṛhat | anayorevainamanantarhitamabhiṣiñcati | paśustomo vā eṣaḥ | tena gosavaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ sarvaḥ | revajjātaḥ sahasā vṛddhaḥ | kṣatrāṇāṃ kṣattrabhṛttamo vayodhāḥ | mahānmahitve tastabhānaḥ | kṣattre rāṣṭre ca jāgṛhi | prajāpatestvā parameṣṭhinaḥ svārājyenābhiṣiñcāmītyāha | svārājyamevainaṃ gamayati
meaning: असौ बृहत् । अनयोरेवैनमनन्तर्हितमभिषिञ्चति । पशुस्तोमो वा एषः । तेन गोसवः । षट्त्रिंशः सर्वः । रेवज्जातः सहसा वृद्धः । क्षत्राणां क्षत्त्रभृत्तमो वयोधाः । महान्महित्वे तस्तभानः । क्षत्त्रे राष्ट्रे च जागृहि । प्रजापतेस्त्वा परमेष्ठिनः स्वाराज्येनाभिषिञ्चामीत्याह । स्वाराज्यमेवैनं गमयति
text_mt: that [sky] is the Bṛhat. / Between these two, uninterrupted, he sprinkles him. / An animal praise-song indeed is this; / therefore it is the cow-consecration. / The thirty-six-verse [rite] is complete. / “Richly born, grown by might, / the best bearer of regal power among regal powers, bestower of youthful vigor, / great, standing firm in greatness, / be wakeful in regal power and in the realm! / With the autonomous rule of Prajāpati Parameṣṭhin I sprinkle you,” he says. / To autonomous rule indeed he leads him.

sanskrit_iast: siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākau | tviṣiragnau brāhmaṇe sūrye yā | indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | yā rājanye dundubhāvāyatāyām | aśvasya krandye puruṣasya māyau | indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | yā hastini dvīpini yā hiraṇye | tviṣiraśveṣu puruṣeṣu goṣu
meaning: सिंहे व्याघ्र उत या पृदाकौ । त्विषिरग्नौ ब्राह्मणे सूर्ये या । इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । या राजन्ये दुन्दुभावायतायाम् । अश्वस्य क्रन्द्ये पुरुषस्य मायौ । इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । या हस्तिनि द्वीपिनि या हिरण्ये । त्विषिरश्वेषु पुरुषेषु गोषु
text_mt:
The brilliance that is in the lion, in the tiger, and in the viper, / the fiery energy in fire, in the Brahmin, in the sun, / the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / That which is in the Rājanya, in the drum, in the drawn [bow], / in the whinny of the horse, in the roar of man, / the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / That which is in the elephant, in the panther, that which is in gold, / the brilliance in horses, in men, in cows,

the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / In the chariot, in the dice, in the bull's vigor, / in the wind, in Parjanya, in Varuṇa's fury, / the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / You are king, you are sovereign ruler, / you are emperor, you are autonomous ruler. / For Indra full of fiery energy, I mix you full of fiery energy. / For Indra full of splendorous might, I mix you full of splendorous might.

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | rathe akṣeṣu vṛṣabhasya vāje | vāte parjanye varuṇasya śuṣme | indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | rāḍasi virāḍasi | samrāḍasi svarāḍasi | indrāya tvā tejasvate tejasvantaṃ śrīṇāmi | indrāya tvaujasvata ojasvantaṃ śrīṇāmi
meaning: इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । रथे अक्षेषु वृषभस्य वाजे । वाते पर्जन्ये वरुणस्य शुष्मे । इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । राडसि विराडसि । सम्राडसि स्वराडसि । इन्द्राय त्वा तेजस्वते तेजस्वन्तं श्रीणामि । इन्द्राय त्वौजस्वत ओजस्वन्तं श्रीणामि

meaning: इन्द्राय त्वा पयस्वते पयस्वन्तं श्रीणामि । इन्द्राय त्वा'ऽयुष्मत आयुष्मन्तं श्रीणामि । तेजोऽसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि । तेजस्वदस्तु मे मुखम् । तेजस्वच्छिरो अस्तु मे । तेजस्वान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । तेजसा संपिपृग्धि मा । ओजोऽसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि
text_mt: For Indra full of milk, I mix you full of milk. / For Indra endowed with a lifespan, I mix you endowed with a lifespan. / “You are fiery energy; / that I bestow on you. / Fiery may my face be; / fiery may my head be; / fiery facing in all directions. / Unite me with fiery energy!” / “You are splendorous might; / that I bestow on you.

sanskrit_iast: ojasvadastu me mukham | ojasvacchiro astu me | ojasvān viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | ojasā saṃpipṛgdhi mā | payo'si | tatte prayacchāmi | payasvadastu me mukham | payasvacchiro astu me | payasvān viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | payasā saṃpipṛgdhi mā
meaning: ओजस्वदस्तु मे मुखम् । ओजस्वच्छिरो अस्तु मे । ओजस्वान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । ओजसा संपिपृग्धि मा । पयोऽसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि । पयस्वदस्तु मे मुखम् । पयस्वच्छिरो अस्तु मे । पयस्वान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । पयसा संपिपृग्धि मा
text_mt: Might-filled may my face be; / might-filled may my head be; / might-filled facing in all directions. / Unite me with splendorous might!” / “You are milk; / that I bestow on you. / Full of milk may my face be; / full of milk may my head be; / full of milk facing in all directions. / Unite me with milk!”

sanskrit_iast: āyurasi | tatte prayacchāmi | āyuṣmadastu me mukham | āyuṣmacchiro astu me | āyuṣmān viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | āyuṣā saṃpipṛgdhi mā | imamagna āyuṣe varcase kṛdhi | priyaṃ reto varuṇa soma rājan | mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha | viśve devā jaradaṣṭiryathā sat
meaning: आयुरसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि । आयुष्मदस्तु मे मुखम् । आयुष्मच्छिरो अस्तु मे । आयुष्मान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । आयुषा संपिपृग्धि मा । इममग्न आयुषे वर्चसे कृधि । प्रियं रेतो वरुण सोम राजन् । मातेवास्मा अदिते शर्म यच्छ । विश्वे देवा जरदष्टिर्यथा सत्
text_mt: “You are lifespan; / that I bestow on you. / Endowed with a lifespan may my face be; / endowed with a lifespan may my head be; endowed with a lifespan facing in all directions. / Unite me with lifespan!” / “Make this man, O Agni, [ready] for lifespan, for luster, / a dear seed, O Varuṇa, O king Soma; / like a mother, O Aditi, grant him protection, / O All-gods, so that he may reach old age!”

sanskrit_iast: āyurasi viśvāyurasi | sarvāyurasi sarvamāyurasi | yato vāto manojavāḥ | yataḥ kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | tāsāṃ tvā sarvāsāṃ rucā | abhiṣiñcāmi varcasā | samudra ivāsi gahmanā | soma ivāsyadābhyaḥ | agniriva viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | sūrya iva jyotiṣā vibhūḥ
meaning: आयुरसि विश्वायुरसि । सर्वायुरसि सर्वमायुरसि । यतो वातो मनोजवाः । यतः क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः । तासां त्वा सर्वासां रुचा । अभिषिञ्चामि वर्चसा । समुद्र इवासि गह्मना । सोम इवास्यदाभ्यः । अग्निरिव विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । सूर्य इव ज्योतिषा विभूः
text_mt: “You are lifespan, you are all lifespan, / you are the complete lifespan, you are entire lifespan.” / “From where the wind swift as thought blows, / whence the rivers flow, / with the brilliance of all of them, / with luster I sprinkle you.” / “Like the ocean are you in depth; / like Soma are you unassailable; / like Agni facing in all directions; / like the sun pervading with light.”

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ yo dravaṇe rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | tejase brahmavarcasāya gṛhṇāmi | apāṃ ya ūrmau rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | ojase vīryāya gṛhṇāmi | apāṃ yo madhyato rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | puṣṭyai prajananāya gṛhṇāmi | apāṃ yo yajñiyo rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | āyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya gṛhṇāmi
meaning: अपां यो द्रवणे रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय गृह्णामि । अपां य ऊर्मौ रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । ओजसे वीर्याय गृह्णामि । अपां यो मध्यतो रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । पुष्ट्यै प्रजननाय गृह्णामि । अपां यो यज्ञियो रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । आयुषे दीर्घायुत्वाय गृह्णामि
text_mt: “The essence of the waters which is in their flowing, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for fiery energy, for spiritual preeminence. / The essence of the waters which is in the wave, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for splendorous might, for heroic power. / The essence of the waters which is in the middle, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for nourishment, for procreation. / The essence of the waters which is fit for sacrifice, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for lifespan, for long life.”

sanskrit_iast: abhiprehi vīrayasva | ugraścettā sapatnahā | ātiṣṭha mitravardhanaḥ | tubhyaṃ devā adhibravan | aṅkau nyaṅkāvabhita ātiṣṭha vṛtrahanratham | ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣan | śriyaṃ vasānaścarati svarocāḥ | mahattadasyāsurasya nāma | ā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau | anu tvendro madatvanu bṛhaspatiḥ
meaning: अभिप्रेहि वीरयस्व । उग्रश्चेत्ता सपत्नहा । आतिष्ठ मित्रवर्धनः । तुभ्यं देवा अधिब्रवन् । अङ्कौ न्यङ्कावभित आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथम् । आतिष्ठन्तं परि विश्वे अभूषन् । श्रियं वसानश्चरति स्वरोचाः । महत्तदस्यासुरस्य नाम । आ विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ । अनु त्वेन्द्रो मदत्वनु बृहस्पतिः
text_mt: “Step forth, show your heroism, / fierce avenger, slayer of rivals! / Mount [the chariot], advancer of friends; / on your behalf the gods have spoken.” / Mount the chariot on its curved parts, O slayer of Vṛtra! / Around him mounting, all [creatures] adorned themselves; / clothed in splendor, self-luminous he moves; / great is that name of this Asura; / of manifold form, he has mounted the immortals. / May Indra delight after you, may Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast: anu somo anvagnirāvīt | anu tvā viśve devā avantu | anu sapta rājāno ya utābhiṣiktāḥ | anu tvā mitrāvaruṇāvihāvatam | anudyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśaṃbhū | sūryo ahobhiranu tvā'vatu | candramā nakṣatrairanu tvā'vatu | dyauśca tvā pṛthivī ca pracetasā | śukro bṛhaddakṣiṇā tvā pipartu | anu svadhā cikitāṃ somo agniḥ | ā'yaṃ pṛṇaktu rajasī upastham
meaning: अनु सोमो अन्वग्निरावीत् । अनु त्वा विश्वे देवा अवन्तु । अनु सप्त राजानो य उताभिषिक्ताः । अनु त्वा मित्रावरुणाविहावतम् । अनुद्यावापृथिवी विश्वशंभू । सूर्यो अहोभिरनु त्वाऽवतु । चन्द्रमा नक्षत्रैरनु त्वाऽवतु । द्यौश्च त्वा पृथिवी च प्रचेतसा । शुक्रो बृहद्दक्षिणा त्वा पिपर्तु । अनु स्वधा चिकितां सोमो अग्निः । आऽयं पृणक्तु रजसी उपस्थम्
text_mt: may Soma, may Agni have protected [you]! / May the All-gods help you, / and the seven kings who have also been consecrated. / May Mitra and Varuṇa help you here, / and heaven and earth that bring welfare to all. / May the sun help you with the days; / may the moon help you with the lunar mansions. / May heaven and earth, wise ones, / may the clear soma cup and the lofty sacrificial gift protect you! / Attentive to the ancestral oblation, may Soma and Agni, / may this one fill both realms and the lap!”

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tā asmāthsṛṣṭāḥ parācīrāyan | sa etaṃ prajāpatirodanamapaśyat | so'nnaṃ bhūto'tiṣṭhat | tā anyatrānnādyamavittvā | prajāpatiṃ prajā upāvartanta | annamevainaṃ bhūtaṃ paśyantīḥ prajā upāvartante | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | sarvāṇyannāni bhavanti
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । ता अस्माथ्सृष्टाः पराचीरायन् । स एतं प्रजापतिरोदनमपश्यत् । सोऽन्नं भूतोऽतिष्ठत् । ता अन्यत्रान्नाद्यमवित्त्वा । प्रजापतिं प्रजा उपावर्तन्त । अन्नमेवैनं भूतं पश्यन्तीः प्रजा उपावर्तन्ते । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । सर्वाण्यन्नानि भवन्ति
text_mt: Prajāpati created offspring. / Having been created, they went away from him. / Prajāpati saw this boiled rice mess. / Having become food, he stood. / They, having found no food elsewhere, / the offspring returned to Prajāpati. / Seeing him having become food, offspring return to him / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / All foods become his.

sanskrit_iast: sarve puruṣāḥ | sarvāṇyevānnānyavarundhe | sarvānpuruṣān | rāḍasi virāḍasītyāha | svārājyamevainaṃ gamayati | yaddhiraṇyaṃ dadāti | tejastenāvarundhe | yattisṛdhanvam | vīryaṃ tena | yadaṣṭrām
meaning: सर्वे पुरुषाः । सर्वाण्येवान्नान्यवरुन्धे । सर्वान्पुरुषान् । राडसि विराडसीत्याह । स्वाराज्यमेवैनं गमयति । यद्धिरण्यं ददाति । तेजस्तेनावरुन्धे । यत्तिसृधन्वम् । वीर्यं तेन । यदष्ट्राम्
text_mt: All men [are offspring]. / He secures all foods, / [and] all men. / "You are king, you are sovereign," he says. / He brings him to self-rule. / That he gives gold, / thereby he secures fiery energy. / That [he gives] a three-arrow bow, / thereby heroic power. / That [he gives] a goad,

sanskrit_iast: puṣṭiṃ tena | yatkamaṇḍalum | āyuṣṭena | yaddhiraṇyamābadhnāti | jyotirvai hiraṇyam | jyotirevāsmindadhāti | atho tejo vai hiraṇyam | teja evātmandhatte | yadodanaṃ prāśnāti | etadeva sarvamavarudhya
meaning: पुष्टिं तेन । यत्कमण्डलुम् । आयुष्टेन । यद्धिरण्यमाबध्नाति । ज्योतिर्वै हिरण्यम् । ज्योतिरेवास्मिन्दधाति । अथो तेजो वै हिरण्यम् । तेज एवात्मन्धत्ते । यदोदनं प्राश्नाति । एतदेव सर्वमवरुध्य
text_mt: thereby nourishment. / That [he gives] a water pot, / thereby lifespan. / That he fastens gold [upon himself]— / gold indeed is light— / he places light in him. / Furthermore, gold indeed is fiery energy; / he places fiery energy in himself. / That he eats the boiled rice mess, / having secured all this,

sanskrit_iast: tadasminnekadhā'dhāt | rohiṇyāṃ kāryaḥ | yadbrāhmaṇa eva rohiṇī | tasmādeva | atho varṣmaivainaṃ samānānāṃ karoti | udyatā sūryeṇa kāryaḥ | udyantaṃ vā etaṃ sarvāḥ prajāḥ pratinandanti | didṛkṣeṇyo darśanīyo bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | brahmavādino vadanti
meaning: तदस्मिन्नेकधाऽधात् । रोहिण्यां कार्यः । यद्ब्राह्मण एव रोहिणी । तस्मादेव । अथो वर्ष्मैवैनं समानानां करोति । उद्यता सूर्येण कार्यः । उद्यन्तं वा एतं सर्वाः प्रजाः प्रतिनन्दन्ति । दिदृक्षेण्यो दर्शनीयो भवति । य एवं वेद । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति
text_mt: he placed it at once in him. / It is to be performed under Rohiṇī. / Because Rohiṇī is indeed the Brahmin, / therefore [it is performed under it]. / Furthermore, it makes him the summit among his peers. / It is to be performed with the sun rising; / all creatures rejoice at this [sun] as it rises. / He becomes desirable to look upon, worthy of sight, / who knows thus. / The discussers of sacred lore say:

sanskrit_iast: avetyo'vabhṛthānāiti | yaddarbhapuṃjīlaiḥ pavayati | tathsvidevāvaiti | tannāvaiti | tribhiḥ pavayati | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhirevainaṃ lokaiḥ pavayati | atho apāṃ vā etattejo varcaḥ | yaddarbhāḥ | yaddarbhapuṃjīlaiḥ pavayati | apāmevainaṃ tejasā varcasā'bhiṣiñcati
meaning: अवेत्योऽवभृथानाइति । यद्दर्भपुंजीलैः पवयति । तथ्स्विदेवावैति । तन्नावैति । त्रिभिः पवयति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एभिरेवैनं लोकैः पवयति । अथो अपां वा एतत्तेजो वर्चः । यद्दर्भाः । यद्दर्भपुंजीलैः पवयति । अपामेवैनं तेजसा वर्चसाऽभिषिञ्चति
text_mt: "Is the final bath to be entered [by him] or not?" / That he purifies [him] with bunches of darbha grass, / just that is entering [the final bath]; / he does not [physically] enter. / He purifies with three [bunches]; / three are these worlds; / by these worlds he purifies him. / Furthermore, the darbha grass is the fiery energy, the luster of the waters; / that he purifies with bunches of darbha grass, / he sprinkles him with the fiery energy and luster of the waters.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirakāmayata bahorbhūyānthsyāmiti | sa etaṃ pañcaśāradīyamapaśyat | tamāharat | tenāyajata | tato vai sa bahorbhūyānabhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta bahorbhūyānthsyāmiti | sa pañca śāradīyena yajeta | bahoreva bhūyānbhavati | maruthstomo vā eṣaḥ | maruto hi devānāṃ bhūyiṣṭhāḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिरकामयत बहोर्भूयान्थ्स्यामिति । स एतं पञ्चशारदीयमपश्यत् । तमाहरत् । तेनायजत । ततो वै स बहोर्भूयानभवत् । यः कामयेत बहोर्भूयान्थ्स्यामिति । स पञ्च शारदीयेन यजेत । बहोरेव भूयान्भवति । मरुथ्स्तोमो वा एषः । मरुतो हि देवानां भूयिष्ठाः
text_mt: Prajāpati desired: "May I become more numerous than the many." / He saw this Pañcaśāradīya [rite]; / he fetched it; / he sacrificed with it. / Thereupon indeed he became more numerous than the many. / Whoever should desire: "May I become more numerous than the many," / he should sacrifice with the Pañcaśāradīya; / he becomes more numerous than the many. / This indeed is a Marutstoma; / for the Maruts are the most numerous of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: bahurbhavati | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | pañcaśāradīyo bhavati | pañca vā ṛtavaḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | ṛtuṣveva saṃvathsare pratitiṣṭhati | atho pañcākṣarā paṅktiḥ | pāṅkto yajñaḥ | yajñamevāvarundhe | saptadaśaṃ stomā nātiyanti | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai
meaning: बहुर्भवति । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । पञ्चशारदीयो भवति । पञ्च वा ऋतवः संवथ्सरः । ऋतुष्वेव संवथ्सरे प्रतितिष्ठति । अथो पञ्चाक्षरा पङ्क्तिः । पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः । यज्ञमेवावरुन्धे । सप्तदशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति । सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै
text_mt: He becomes numerous / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / It is a Pañcaśāradīya; / five are the seasons, the year; / he is established in the seasons, in the year. / Furthermore, the paṅkti verse has five syllables; / sacrifice belongs to the fivefold paṅkti; / he secures the sacrifice. / The chants do not exceed the seventeenfold [stoma]; / Prajāpati is seventeenfold; / [it is] for the attainment of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: agastyo marudbhya ukṣṇaḥ praukṣat | tānindra ādatta | ta enaṃ vajramudyatyābhyāyanta | tānagastyaścaivendraśca kayāśubhīyenāśamayatām | tāñchāntānupāhvayata | yatkayāśubhīyaṃ bhavati śāntyai | tasmādeta aindrā mārutā ukṣāṇaḥ savanīyā bhavanti | trayaḥ prathame'hannālabhyante | evaṃ dvitīye | evaṃ tṛtīye
meaning: अगस्त्यो मरुद्भ्य उक्ष्णः प्रौक्षत् । तानिन्द्र आदत्त । त एनं वज्रमुद्यत्याभ्यायन्त । तानगस्त्यश्चैवेन्द्रश्च कयाशुभीयेनाशमयताम् । ताञ्छान्तानुपाह्वयत । यत्कयाशुभीयं भवति शान्त्यै । तस्मादेत ऐन्द्रा मारुता उक्षाणः सवनीया भवन्ति । त्रयः प्रथमेऽहन्नालभ्यन्ते । एवं द्वितीये । एवं तृतीये
text_mt: Agastya consecrated oxen for the Maruts; / Indra took them away. / Raising the vajra, they approached him. / Agastya and Indra appeased them with the Kayāśubhīya hymn; / he summoned them when appeased. / In that the Kayāśubhīya is [recited], it is for appeasement. / Therefore these oxen dedicated to Indra and the Maruts are sacrificial offerings. / Three are seized on the first day, / likewise on the second, / likewise on the third,

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ caturthe | pañcottame'hannālabhyante | varṣiṣṭhamiva hyetadahaḥ | varṣiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | svārājyaṃ vā eṣa yajñaḥ | etena vā ekayāvā kāndamaḥ svārājyamagacchat | svārājyaṃ gacchati | ya etena yajate
meaning: एवं चतुर्थे । पञ्चोत्तमेऽहन्नालभ्यन्ते । वर्षिष्ठमिव ह्येतदहः । वर्षिष्ठः समानानां भवति । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । स्वाराज्यं वा एष यज्ञः । एतेन वा एकयावा कान्दमः स्वाराज्यमगच्छत् । स्वाराज्यं गच्छति । य एतेन यजते
text_mt: likewise on the fourth; / five are seized on the final day, / for this day is the greatest, as it were. / He becomes the greatest among his peers / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / This sacrifice is indeed self-rule; / by this Ékayāvan Kāndama went to self-rule. / He goes to self-rule / who sacrifices with this,

sanskrit_iast: ya u cainamevaṃ veda | māruto vā eṣa stomaḥ | etena vai maruto devānāṃ bhūyiṣṭhā abhavan | bhūyiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | pañcaśāradīyo vā eṣa yajñaḥ | ā pañcamātpuruṣādannamatti | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | saptadaśaṃ stomā nātiyanti | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpatereva naiti
meaning: य उ चैनमेवं वेद । मारुतो वा एष स्तोमः । एतेन वै मरुतो देवानां भूयिष्ठा अभवन् । भूयिष्ठः समानानां भवति । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । पञ्चशारदीयो वा एष यज्ञः । आ पञ्चमात्पुरुषादन्नमत्ति । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । सप्तदशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति । सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेरेव नैति
text_mt: and who knows it thus. / This chant belongs to the Maruts; / by this the Maruts became the most numerous of the gods. / He becomes the most numerous among his peers / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / This sacrifice is the Pañcaśāradīya; / unto the fifth generation he eats food, / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / The chants do not exceed the seventeenfold [stoma]; / Prajāpati is seventeenfold; / he does not depart from Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: asyājarāso damā maritrāḥ | arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ | śvicīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavaḥ | vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ | yajā no mitrāvaruṇā | yajā devāṃ ṛtaṃ bṛhat | agne yakṣi svaṃ damam | aśvinā pibataṃ sutam | dīdyagnī śucivratā | ṛtunā yajñavāhasā
meaning: अस्याजरासो दमा मरित्राः । अर्चद्धूमासो अग्नयः पावकाः । श्विचीचयः श्वात्रासो भुरण्यवः । वनर्षदो वायवो न सोमाः । यजा नो मित्रावरुणा । यजा देवां ऋतं बृहत् । अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम् । अश्विना पिबतं सुतम् । दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता । ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा
text_mt: His unaging, destructive fires in the house, / with blazing smoke, are purifying, / white-gleaming, invigorating, active, / dwelling in the woods, like winds, like soma draughts. / Sacrifice for us to Mitra and Varuṇa, / sacrifice to the gods, to the great truth; / Agni, sacrifice in your own house! / Aśvins, drink the pressed [soma], / you two whose fires shine, whose vows are pure, / carrying the sacrifice in due season!

sanskrit_iast: dve virūpe carataḥ svarthe | anyā'nyā vathsamupadhāpayete | hariranyasyāṃ bhavati svadhāvān | śukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcāḥ | pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau | śiśū krīḍantau pariyāto adhvaram | viśvānyanyo bhuvanā'bhicaṣṭe | ṛtūnanyo vidadhajjāyate punaḥ | trīṇi śatā trīṣahasrāṇyagnim | triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan
meaning: द्वे विरूपे चरतः स्वर्थे । अन्याऽन्या वथ्समुपधापयेते । हरिरन्यस्यां भवति स्वधावान् । शुक्रो अन्यस्यां ददृशे सुवर्चाः । पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ । शिशू क्रीडन्तौ परियातो अध्वरम् । विश्वान्यन्यो भुवनाऽभिचष्टे । ऋतूनन्यो विदधज्जायते पुनः । त्रीणि शता त्रीषहस्राण्यग्निम् । त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन्
text_mt: Two of different forms wander with a single purpose; / each in turn suckles the calf. / The tawny one is in the one, possessing the customary offering; / the clear, bright-lustered one is seen in the other. / These two young ones, moving from east to west through their wondrous power, / playing, go around the sacrifice; / the one looks upon all worlds, / the other, disposing the seasons, is born anew. / Three hundred, three thousand, / and thirty-nine gods served Agni.

sanskrit_iast: aukṣanghṛtairāstṛṇanbarhirasmai | ādiddhotāraṃ nyaṣādayanta | agninā'gniḥ samidhyate | kavirgṛhapatiryuvā | havyavāḍjuhvāsyaḥ | agnirdevānāṃ jaṭharam | pūtadakṣaḥ kavikratuḥ | devo devebhirāgamat | agniśriyo maruto viśvakṛṣṭayaḥ | ā tveṣamugramava īmahe vayam
meaning: औक्षन्घृतैरास्तृणन्बर्हिरस्मै । आदिद्धोतारं न्यषादयन्त । अग्निनाऽग्निः समिध्यते । कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा । हव्यवाड्जुह्वास्यः । अग्निर्देवानां जठरम् । पूतदक्षः कविक्रतुः । देवो देवेभिरागमत् । अग्निश्रियो मरुतो विश्वकृष्टयः । आ त्वेषमुग्रमव ईमहे वयम्
text_mt: They sprinkled [him] with clarified butter, they spread the sacrificial grass for him; / then they seated him as the Hotṛ priest. / Agni is kindled by Agni, / the sage, master of the house, the youth, / the bearer of oblations, whose mouth is the ladle. / Agni is the belly of the gods, / of purified skill, whose will is wisdom; / may the god come with the gods! / The Maruts, of fiery splendor, belonging to all peoples, / we ask for their brilliant, mighty favor.

sanskrit_iast: te svānino rudriyā varṣanirṇijaḥ | siṃhā na heṣakratavaḥ sudānavaḥ | yaduttame maruto madhyame vā | yadvā'vame subhagāso diviṣṭha | tato no rudrā uta vā'nvasya | agne vittāddhaviṣo yadyajāmaḥ | īḍe agniṃ svavasaṃ namobhiḥ | iha prasapto vicayatkṛtaṃ naḥ | rathairiva prabhare vājayadbhiḥ | pradakṣiṇinmarutāg stomamṛdhyām
meaning: ते स्वानिनो रुद्रिया वर्षनिर्णिजः । सिंहा न हेषक्रतवः सुदानवः । यदुत्तमे मरुतो मध्यमे वा । यद्वाऽवमे सुभगासो दिविष्ठ । ततो नो रुद्रा उत वाऽन्वस्य । अग्ने वित्ताद्धविषो यद्यजामः । ईडे अग्निं स्ववसं नमोभिः । इह प्रसप्तो विचयत्कृतं नः । रथैरिव प्रभरे वाजयद्भिः । प्रदक्षिणिन्मरुताग् स्तोममृध्याम्
text_mt: They are masters, Rudra's sons, rain-attired, / like lions, of roaring strength, very generous. / Whether, O Maruts, O fortunate ones dwelling in heaven, / you are in the highest, the middle, / or the lowest, / from there, O Rudras, or also from here, / know our oblation, O Agni, when we sacrifice! / I praise Agni of great aid with homages; / crawling forth here, may he examine our deed. / As if on swift-footed chariots, I offer [praise]; / circling to the right, may I succeed with the chant of the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhiḥ | devairagne sayāvabhiḥ | āsīdantu barhiṣi | mitro varuṇo aryamā | prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram | viśveṣāmaditiryajñiyānām | viśveṣāmatithirmānuṣāṇām | agnirdevānāmava āvṛṇānaḥ | sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ | tve agne sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ
meaning: श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिः । देवैरग्ने सयावभिः । आसीदन्तु बर्हिषि । मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमा । प्रातर्यावाणो अध्वरम् । विश्वेषामदितिर्यज्ञियानाम् । विश्वेषामतिथिर्मानुषाणाम् । अग्निर्देवानामव आवृणानः । सुमृडीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः । त्वे अग्ने सुमतिं भिक्षमाणाः
text_mt: Listen, O keen-eared one, along with the conveyers, / the gods, Agni, who travel with you! / Let them sit on the sacrificial grass: / Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman, / who go early in the morning to the sacrificial rite. / Aditi of all the worshipful ones, / the guest of all men, / Agni, granting the aid of the gods, / very gracious, knowing all things, may he be! / Begging good favor in you, O Agni,

sanskrit_iast: divi śravo dadhire yajñiyāsaḥ | naktā ca cakruruṣasā virūpe | kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇamaruṇaṃ ca saṃdhuḥ | tvāmagna ādityāsa āsyam | tvāṃ jihvāṃ śucayaścakrire kave | tvāṃ rātiṣāco adhvareṣu saścire | tve devā haviradantyāhutam | ni tvā yajñasya sādhanam | agne hotāramṛtvijam | vanuṣvaddeva dhīmahi pracetasam | jīraṃ dūtamamartyam
meaning: दिवि श्रवो दधिरे यज्ञियासः । नक्ता च चक्रुरुषसा विरूपे । कृष्णं च वर्णमरुणं च संधुः । त्वामग्न आदित्यास आस्यम् । त्वां जिह्वां शुचयश्चक्रिरे कवे । त्वां रातिषाचो अध्वरेषु सश्चिरे । त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् । नि त्वा यज्ञस्य साधनम् । अग्ने होतारमृत्विजम् । वनुष्वद्देव धीमहि प्रचेतसम् । जीरं दूतममर्त्यम्
text_mt: the worshipful ones have established renown in heaven, / and have made Night and Dawn of different forms, / and have set together the black and the ruddy color. / You, O Agni, the Ādityas made their mouth; / you, O sage, the pure ones made their tongue; / you, the bestowers of gifts, attended at the sacrificial rites; / in you the gods eat the offered oblation. / We install you, the accomplisher of sacrifice, / Agni, the Hotṛ, the ṛtvij priest, / zealously, O god, we set you, the wise, / the swift messenger, the immortal!

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhā harī ratha ā yujyamānā yāhi | vāyurna niyuto no accha | pibāsyandho abhisṛṣṭo asme | indra svāhā rarimā te madāya | kasya vṛṣā sute sacā | niyutvānvṛṣabho raṇat | vṛtrahā somapītaye | indraṃ vayaṃ mahādhane | indramarbhe havāmahe | yujaṃ vṛtreṣu vajriṇam
meaning: तिष्ठा हरी रथ आ युज्यमाना याहि । वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छ । पिबास्यन्धो अभिसृष्टो अस्मे । इन्द्र स्वाहा ररिमा ते मदाय । कस्य वृषा सुते सचा । नियुत्वान्वृषभो रणत् । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये । इन्द्रं वयं महाधने । इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे । युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम्
text_mt:
Mount the two bay steeds being harnessed to your chariot, and drive forth; / like Vāyu with his teams, come toward us. / Drink this pressed juice, sent forth for us; / O Indra, Svāhā! We have offered it for your exhilaration.
By whose pressed [soma] does the bull, / with his teams, the virile one, delight— / the slayer of Vṛtra, to drink soma?
Indra in the great contest, / Indra in the small do we invoke, / as an ally against the foes, the wielder of the vajra.

sanskrit_iast: dvitāyo vṛtrahantamaḥ | vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ | upa no haribhiḥ sutam | sa sūra ā janayañjyotirindram | ayā dhiyā taraṇiradribarhāḥ | ṛtena śuṣmīnavamāno arkaiḥ | vyusridho asro adrirbibheda | uta tyadāśvaśviyam | yadindra nāhuṣīṣvā | agre vikṣu pratīdayat
meaning: द्वितायो वृत्रहन्तमः । विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् । स सूर आ जनयञ्ज्योतिरिन्द्रम् । अया धिया तरणिरद्रिबर्हाः । ऋतेन शुष्मीनवमानो अर्कैः । व्युस्रिधो अस्रो अद्रिर्बिभेद । उत त्यदाश्वश्वियम् । यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा । अग्रे विक्षु प्रतीदयत्
text_mt:
Indra of a hundred resolves, / who is indeed the best slayer of Vṛtra, / knows our pressed [soma]; [come] with your two bay steeds.
That sun, generating light, [found] Indra; / through this prayer, the swift one, firm like a rock, / mighty through truth, purified by hymns of praise, / the weapon broke the rock of the hostile ones.
And that wealth of swift horses, / which, O Indra, among the Nahuṣa clans / shone forth at the head of the peoples.

sanskrit_iast: bhareṣvindraṃ suhavaṃ havāmahe | aṃhomucaṃ sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ janam | agniṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagam | dyāvāpṛthivī marutaḥ svastaye | mahi kṣetraṃ puruścandraṃ vividvān | ādithsakhibhyaśca rathaṃ samairat | indro nṛbhirajanaddīdyānaḥ sākam | sūryamuṣasaṃ gātumagnim | uruṃ no lokamanuneṣi vidvān | suvarvajjyotirabhayaṃ svasti
meaning: भरेष्विन्द्रं सुहवं हवामहे । अंहोमुचं सुकृतं दैव्यं जनम् । अग्निं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगम् । द्यावापृथिवी मरुतः स्वस्तये । महि क्षेत्रं पुरुश्चन्द्रं विविद्वान् । आदिथ्सखिभ्यश्च रथं समैरत् । इन्द्रो नृभिरजनद्दीद्यानः साकम् । सूर्यमुषसं गातुमग्निम् । उरुं नो लोकमनुनेषि विद्वान् । सुवर्वज्ज्योतिरभयं स्वस्ति
text_mt:
In battles we invoke Indra, easily invoked, / the deliverer from distress, the well-acting divine race, / Agni, Mitra, Varuṇa, Bhaga for gain, / heaven and earth, the Maruts for well-being.
Having found a wide domain and much delight, / straightway he sped the chariot onward for his companions; / Indra, shining forth, generated with the men all at once / the sun, the dawn, a path, and Agni.
Knowing [the way], you guide us to a broad world, / light endowed with the heavenly realm, freedom from fear, and well-being.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣvā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū | upastheyāma śaraṇā bṛhantā | ā no viśvābhirūtibhiḥ sajoṣāḥ | brahma juṣāṇo haryaśva yāhi | varīvṛjathsthavirebhiḥ suśipra | asme dadhadvṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindra | indrāya gāva āśiram | duduhre vajriṇe madhu | yathsīmupahvare'vidat | tāste vajrindhenavo jojayurnaḥ
meaning: ऋष्वा त इन्द्र स्थविरस्य बाहू । उपस्थेयाम शरणा बृहन्ता । आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः सजोषाः । ब्रह्म जुषाणो हर्यश्व याहि । वरीवृजथ्स्थविरेभिः सुशिप्र । अस्मे दधद्वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्र । इन्द्राय गाव आशिरम् । दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । यथ्सीमुपह्वरेऽविदत् । तास्ते वज्रिन्धेनवो जोजयुर्नः
text_mt:
Lofty are your two arms, O ancient Indra; / may we take shelter under their broad protection.
With all your aids, being in agreement, / enjoying the sacred word, O you of bay steeds, drive forth, / casting down [the foes] with your mighty [arms], O fine-lipped one, / placing virile power in us, O Indra.
For Indra, the cows have milked / the sweet milk admixture for the wielder of the vajra, / when he found it in the secret recess.
May those milk cows of yours, O wielder of the vajra, refresh us.

sanskrit_iast: gabhastayo niyuto viśvavārāḥ | aharaharbhūya ijjoguvānāḥ | pūrṇā indra kṣumato bhojanasya | imāṃ te dhiyaṃ prabhare maho mahīm | asya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje | tamuthsave ca prasave ca sāsahim | indraṃ devāsaḥ śavasā madannanu
meaning: गभस्तयो नियुतो विश्ववाराः । अहरहर्भूय इज्जोगुवानाः । पूर्णा इन्द्र क्षुमतो भोजनस्य । इमां ते धियं प्रभरे महो महीम् । अस्य स्तोत्रे धिषणा यत्त आनजे । तमुथ्सवे च प्रसवे च सासहिम् । इन्द्रं देवासः शवसा मदन्ननु
text_mt:
Your rays, your teams, bringing all desirable things, / resounding ever more day by day, / are full of rich food, O Indra.
To the great one I bring forth this great prayer, / since the sacred word has anointed itself in praise of him; / in the festival and in the contest, Indra the conqueror, / him the gods cheered following his might.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ paśūnasṛjata | te'smāthsṛṣṭāḥ parāñca āyan | tānagniṣṭomena nāpnot | tānukthyena nāpnot | tānthṣoḍaśinā nāpnot | tānrātriyā nāpnot | tānthsaṃdhinā nāpnot | so'gnimabravīt | imānma īpseti | tānagnistrivṛtā stomena nāpnot
meaning: प्रजापतिः पशूनसृजत । तेऽस्माथ्सृष्टाः पराञ्च आयन् । तानग्निष्टोमेन नाप्नोत् । तानुक्थ्येन नाप्नोत् । तान्थ्षोडशिना नाप्नोत् । तान्रात्रिया नाप्नोत् । तान्थ्संधिना नाप्नोत् । सोऽग्निमब्रवीत् । इमान्म ईप्सेति । तानग्निस्त्रिवृता स्तोमेन नाप्नोत्
text_mt: Prajāpati created domestic animals. / Created by him, they went away. / He did not reach them with the Agniṣṭoma. / He did not reach them with the Ukthya. / He did not reach them with the Ṣoḍaśin. / He did not reach them with the Rātri. / He did not reach them with the Saṃdhi. / He said to Agni: / "Wish to obtain these for me." / Agni did not reach them with the trivṛt stoma.

sanskrit_iast: sa indramabravīt | imānma īpseti | tānindraḥ pañcadaśena stomena nāpnot | sa viśvāndevānabravīt | imānma īpsateti | tān viśve devāḥ saptadaśena stomena nāpnuvan | sa viṣṇumabravīt | imānma īpseti | tān viṣṇurekaviṃśena stomenāpnot | vāravantīyenāvārayata
meaning: स इन्द्रमब्रवीत् । इमान्म ईप्सेति । तानिन्द्रः पञ्चदशेन स्तोमेन नाप्नोत् । स विश्वान्देवानब्रवीत् । इमान्म ईप्सतेति । तान् विश्वे देवाः सप्तदशेन स्तोमेन नाप्नुवन् । स विष्णुमब्रवीत् । इमान्म ईप्सेति । तान् विष्णुरेकविंशेन स्तोमेनाप्नोत् । वारवन्तीयेनावारयत
text_mt: He said to Indra: / "Wish to obtain these for me." / Indra did not reach them with the fifteenfold stoma. / He said to the All-gods: / "Wish to obtain these for me." / The All-gods did not reach them with the seventeenfold stoma. / He said to Viṣṇu: / "Wish to obtain these for me." / Viṣṇu reached them with the twenty-onefold stoma. / He warded them off with the Vāravantīya [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama iti vyakramata | yasmātpaśavaḥ pra preva bhraṃśeran | sa etena yajeta | yadāpnot | tadaptoryāmasyāptoryāmatvam | etena vai devā jaitvāni jitvā | yaṃ kāmamakāmayanta tamāpnuvan | yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate | tametenāpnoti
meaning: इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रम इति व्यक्रमत । यस्मात्पशवः प्र प्रेव भ्रंशेरन् । स एतेन यजेत । यदाप्नोत् । तदप्तोर्यामस्याप्तोर्यामत्वम् । एतेन वै देवा जैत्वानि जित्वा । यं काममकामयन्त तमाप्नुवन् । यं कामं कामयते । तमेतेनाप्नोति
text_mt:
"Through this Viṣṇu strode,"—saying this, he strode forth.
He from whom domestic animals should scatter away, as it were, / should sacrifice with this [rite].
Because he obtained (āpnot) [them], / that is why the Aptoryāma has the nature of the Aptoryāma. / Having won what was to be won by this, the gods / attained whatever desire they desired. / Whatever desire he desires, / that he attains by this.

sanskrit_iast: vyāghro'yamagnau carati praviṣṭaḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ putro abhiśastipā ayam | namaskāreṇa namasā te juhomi | mā devānāṃ mithuyā karma bhāgam | sāvīrhi deva prasavāya pitre | varṣmāṇamasmai varimāṇamasmai | athāsmabhyaṃ savitaḥ sarvatātā | dive diva āsuvā bhūripaśvaḥ | bhūto bhūteṣu carati praviṣṭaḥ | sa bhūtānāmadhipatirbabhūva
meaning: व्याघ्रोऽयमग्नौ चरति प्रविष्टः । ऋषीणां पुत्रो अभिशस्तिपा अयम् । नमस्कारेण नमसा ते जुहोमि । मा देवानां मिथुया कर्म भागम् । सावीर्हि देव प्रसवाय पित्रे । वर्ष्माणमस्मै वरिमाणमस्मै । अथास्मभ्यं सवितः सर्वताता । दिवे दिव आसुवा भूरिपश्वः । भूतो भूतेषु चरति प्रविष्टः । स भूतानामधिपतिर्बभूव
text_mt:
This tiger has entered and moves within the fire; / this son of the ṛṣis is the protector from curse. / With homage, / with reverence, I offer unto you; / let us not wrongfully treat the portion of the gods.
Impel, O god, for propagation to the father / height for him, width for him; / then for us, O Savitṛ, in full integrity, / day by day impel abundance of domestic animals.
As a being he has entered and moves among beings; / he has become the overlord of beings.

sanskrit_iast: tasya mṛtyau carati rājasūyam | sa rājā rājyamanumanyatāmidam | yebhiḥ śilpaiḥ paprathānāmadṛṃhat | yebhirdyāmabhyapiṃśatprajāpatiḥ | yebhirvācaṃ viśvarūpāṃ samavyayat | tenemamagna iha varcasā samaṅgdhi | yebhirādityastapati praketubhiḥ | yebhiḥ sūryo dadṛśe citrabhānuḥ | yebhirvācaṃ puṣkalebhiravyayat | tenemamagna iha varcasā samaṅgdhi
meaning: तस्य मृत्यौ चरति राजसूयम् । स राजा राज्यमनुमन्यतामिदम् । येभिः शिल्पैः पप्रथानामदृंहत् । येभिर्द्यामभ्यपिंशत्प्रजापतिः । येभिर्वाचं विश्वरूपां समव्ययत् । तेनेममग्न इह वर्चसा समङ्ग्धि । येभिरादित्यस्तपति प्रकेतुभिः । येभिः सूर्यो ददृशे चित्रभानुः । येभिर्वाचं पुष्कलेभिरव्ययत् । तेनेममग्न इह वर्चसा समङ्ग्धि
text_mt:
His royal unction proceeds unto death; / may that king give assent to this sovereignty.
With which artistic wonders he strengthened the expanding [earth], / with which Prajāpati adorned the sky, / with which he enveloped Speech, assuming all forms— / with that splendor, O Agni, anoint him here.
With which manifest rays the Āditya burns, / with which the sun of wondrous brightness is seen, / with which abundant ones he enveloped Speech— / with that splendor, O Agni, anoint him here.

sanskrit_iast: ā'yaṃ bhātu śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ | indra iva jyeṣṭho bhavatu prajāvān | asmā astu puṣkalaṃ citrabhānu | ā'yaṃ pṛṇaktu rajasī upastham | yatte śilpaṃ kaśyapa rocanāvat | indriyāvatpuṣkalaṃ citrabhānu | yasminthsūryā arpitāḥ sapta sākam | tasminrājānamadhiviśrayemam | dyaurasi pṛthivyasi | vyāghro vaiyāghre'dhi
meaning: आऽयं भातु शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः । इन्द्र इव ज्येष्ठो भवतु प्रजावान् । अस्मा अस्तु पुष्कलं चित्रभानु । आऽयं पृणक्तु रजसी उपस्थम् । यत्ते शिल्पं कश्यप रोचनावत् । इन्द्रियावत्पुष्कलं चित्रभानु । यस्मिन्थ्सूर्या अर्पिताः सप्त साकम् । तस्मिन्राजानमधिविश्रयेमम् । द्यौरसि पृथिव्यसि । व्याघ्रो वैयाघ्रेऽधि
text_mt:
May he shine with might over the five peoples; / like Indra, may he be the eldest, endowed with offspring; / to him may there be abundant, wondrous brightness; / may he unite the two midspaces in his lap.
What artistic wonder is yours, O Kaśyapa, luminous, / endowed with virile power, abundant, of wondrous brightness, / wherein the seven suns are set together— / upon that set this king.
You are heaven; you are earth.
A tiger upon the tiger skin.

sanskrit_iast: viśrayasva diśo mahīḥ | viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu | mā tvadrāṣṭramadhibhraśat | yā divyā āpaḥ payasā saṃbabhūvuḥ | yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīryāḥ | tāsāṃ tvā sarvāsāṃ rucā | abhiṣiñcāmi varcasā | abhi tvā varcasā sicaṃ divyena | payasā saha | yathā''sā rāṣṭravardhanaḥ
meaning: विश्रयस्व दिशो महीः । विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु । मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधिभ्रशत् । या दिव्या आपः पयसा संबभूवुः । या अन्तरिक्ष उत पार्थिवीर्याः । तासां त्वा सर्वासां रुचा । अभिषिञ्चामि वर्चसा । अभि त्वा वर्चसा सिचं दिव्येन । पयसा सह । यथा'ऽसा राष्ट्रवर्धनः
text_mt:
Rest upon the great quarters. / Let all the clans desire you; / let not sovereignty fall away from you.
The waters that are divine, which have arisen with milk, / those in the intermediate space and those that are earthly— / with the luster of them all / I sprinkle you with splendor. / I sprinkle you with divine splendor / together with milk, / so that you shall be an increaser of sovereignty;

sanskrit_iast: tathā tvā savitā karat | indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan | samudravyacasaṃ giraḥ | rathītamaṃ rathīnām | vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim | vasavastvā purastādabhiṣiñcantu gāyatreṇa chandasā | rudrāstvā dakṣiṇato'bhiṣiñcantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā | ādityāstvā paścādabhiṣiñcantu jāgatena chandasā | viśve tvā devā uttarato'bhiṣiñcantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā | bṛhaspatistvopariṣṭādabhiṣiñcatu pāṅktena chandasā
meaning: तथा त्वा सविता करत् । इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् । समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमं रथीनाम् । वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम् । वसवस्त्वा पुरस्तादभिषिञ्चन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसा । रुद्रास्त्वा दक्षिणतोऽभिषिञ्चन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा । आदित्यास्त्वा पश्चादभिषिञ्चन्तु जागतेन छन्दसा । विश्वे त्वा देवा उत्तरतोऽभिषिञ्चन्त्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसा । बृहस्पतिस्त्वोपरिष्टादभिषिञ्चतु पाङ्क्तेन छन्दसा
text_mt: so may Savitṛ make you. / All songs have magnified Indra, / expansive as the sea, / the best chariot-fighter of chariot-fighters, / the true lord, master of spoils. / May the Vasus sprinkle you from the east with the gāyatrī meter. / May the Rudras sprinkle you from the south with the triṣṭubh meter. / May the Ādityas sprinkle you from the west with the jagatī meter. / May the All-gods sprinkle you from the north with the anuṣṭubh meter. / May Bṛhaspati sprinkle you from above with the paṅkti meter.

sanskrit_iast: aruṇaṃ tvā vṛkamugraṃ khajaṃkaram | rocamānaṃ marutāmagre arciṣaḥ | sūryavantaṃ maghavānaṃ viṣāsahim | indramukthyeṣu nāmahūtamaṃ huvema | pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase naḥ | ā no gavyūtimukṣataṃ ghṛtena | ā no jane śravayataṃ yuvānā | śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemā | indrasya te vīryakṛtaḥ | bāhū upāvaharāmi
meaning: अरुणं त्वा वृकमुग्रं खजंकरम् । रोचमानं मरुतामग्रे अर्चिषः । सूर्यवन्तं मघवानं विषासहिम् । इन्द्रमुक्थ्येषु नामहूतमं हुवेम । प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे नः । आ नो गव्यूतिमुक्षतं घृतेन । आ नो जने श्रवयतं युवाना । श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमा । इन्द्रस्य ते वीर्यकृतः । बाहू उपावहरामि
text_mt:
You, the ruddy wolf, the fierce one, maker of turmoil, / shining at the head of the Maruts' blaze, / accompanied by the sun, the generous, the conqueror, / Indra, most invoked by name in the ukthyas, may we invoke.
Stretch forth your two arms that we may live; / sprinkle our pasture with ghee; / make us renowned among the people, O youthful ones; / hear this invocation of mine, O Mitra and Varuṇa.
Your two arms, doing the heroic deeds of Indra, / I bring down.

sanskrit_iast: abhi prehi vīrayasva | ugraścettā sapatnahā | ātiṣṭha vṛtrahantamaḥ | tubhyaṃ devā adhibravan | aṅkau nyaṅkāvabhito rathaṃ yau | dhvāntaṃ vātāgramanusaṃcarantau | dūre hetirindriyāvānpatatrī | te no'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pārayantu | namasta ṛṣe gada | avyathāyai tvā svadhāyai tvā
meaning: अभि प्रेहि वीरयस्व । उग्रश्चेत्ता सपत्नहा । आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन्तमः । तुभ्यं देवा अधिब्रवन् । अङ्कौ न्यङ्कावभितो रथं यौ । ध्वान्तं वाताग्रमनुसंचरन्तौ । दूरे हेतिरिन्द्रियावान्पतत्री । ते नोऽग्नयः पप्रयः पारयन्तु । नमस्त ऋषे गद । अव्यथायै त्वा स्वधायै त्वा
text_mt:
Go forward, display your heroism; / fierce, mindful, slayer of rivals.
Mount [the chariot], supreme slayer of Vṛtra; / the gods have spoken on your behalf.
The two hooks and nooks on both sides of the chariot, / moving along through the darkness, following the front of the wind, / far-darting, possessing sensory power, winged— / may those Agnis, fulfilling, bear us across.
Homage to you, O seer; utter [your words]; / for harmlessness to you, for self-sustenance to you!

sanskrit_iast: mā na indrābhitastvadṛṣvāriṣṭāsaḥ | evā brahmantavedastu | tiṣṭhā rathe adhi yadvajrahastaḥ | ā raśmīndeva yuvase svaśvaḥ | ātiṣṭha vṛtrahannātiṣṭhantaṃ pari | anu tvendro madatvanu tvā mitrāvaruṇau | dyauśca tvā pṛthivī ca pracetasā | śukro bṛhaddakṣiṇā tvā pipartu | anu svadhā cikitāṃ somo agniḥ | anu tvā'vatu savitā savena
meaning: मा न इन्द्राभितस्त्वदृष्वारिष्टासः । एवा ब्रह्मन्तवेदस्तु । तिष्ठा रथे अधि यद्वज्रहस्तः । आ रश्मीन्देव युवसे स्वश्वः । आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन्नातिष्ठन्तं परि । अनु त्वेन्द्रो मदत्वनु त्वा मित्रावरुणौ । द्यौश्च त्वा पृथिवी च प्रचेतसा । शुक्रो बृहद्दक्षिणा त्वा पिपर्तु । अनु स्वधा चिकितां सोमो अग्निः । अनु त्वाऽवतु सविता सवेन
text_mt:
Let not [enemies] harm us from around you, O lofty Indra; / thus, O brahman, let it be yours.
Stand upon the chariot, you who hold the vajra in your hand; / O god, having good horses, gather in the reins.
Mount, O slayer of Vṛtra, around him who mounts; / let Indra exult along with you, let Mitra and Varuṇa exult along with you.
And heaven and earth, the two attentive ones; / may the clear [soma cup], the great sacrificial gift, preserve you.
May Soma and Agni be attentive according to self-sustenance; / may Savitṛ aid you according to his impulsion.

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan | samudravyacasaṃ giraḥ | rathītamaṃ rathīnām | vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim | pari mā senyā ghoṣāḥ | jyānāṃ vṛñjantu gṛdhnavaḥ | methiṣṭhāḥ pinvamānā iha | māṃ gopatimabhisaṃviśantu | tanme'numatiranumanyatām | tanmātā pṛthivī tatpitā dyauḥ
meaning: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् । समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमं रथीनाम् । वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम् । परि मा सेन्या घोषाः । ज्यानां वृञ्जन्तु गृध्नवः । मेथिष्ठाः पिन्वमाना इह । मां गोपतिमभिसंविशन्तु । तन्मेऽनुमतिरनुमन्यताम् । तन्माता पृथिवी तत्पिता द्यौः

sanskrit_iast: tadgrāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvaḥ | tadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ saubhagā yuvam | avate heḍa uduttamam | enā vyāghraṃ pariṣasvajānāḥ | siṃhaṃ hinvanti mahate saubhagāya | samudraṃ na suhavaṃ tasthivāṃsam | marmṛjyante dvīpinamapsvantaḥ | udasāvetu sūryaḥ | udidaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ | udihi deva sūrya | saha vagnunā mama | ahaṃ vāco vivācanam | mayi vāgastu dharṇasiḥ | yantu nadayo varṣantu parjanyāḥ | supippalā oṣadhayo bhavantu | annavatāmodanavatāmāmikṣavatām | eṣāṃ rājā bhūyāsam
meaning: तद्ग्रावाणः सोमसुतो मयोभुवः । तदश्विना शृणुतं सौभगा युवम् । अवते हेड उदुत्तमम् । एना व्याघ्रं परिषस्वजानाः । सिंहं हिन्वन्ति महते सौभगाय । समुद्रं न सुहवं तस्थिवांसम् । मर्मृज्यन्ते द्वीपिनमप्स्वन्तः । उदसावेतु सूर्यः । उदिदं मामकं वचः । उदिहि देव सूर्य । सह वग्नुना मम । अहं वाचो विवाचनम् । मयि वागस्तु धर्णसिः । यन्तु नदयो वर्षन्तु पर्जन्याः । सुपिप्पला ओषधयो भवन्तु । अन्नवतामोदनवतामामिक्षवताम् । एषां राजा भूयासम्
text_mt:
may the soma-pressing, delightful pressing-stones [hear] that; / hear that, O Aśvins, you two who bring good fortune!
[I have removed] your wrath; lift up the highest [plank].
Clasping the tiger with this [formula], / they urge the lion toward great good fortune; / like the easily invoked sea standing firm, / they cleanse the leopard within the waters.
May that sun rise; / may this utterance of mine rise.
Rise up, O divine sun, / along with my voice.
I am the arbiter of speech; / in me let speech remain steadfast.
May the rivers flow, may the rain-gods rain, / may the plants have abundant fruit;
may I become the king of those possessing food, / possessing boiled rice messes, possessing curds!

sanskrit_iast: ye keśinaḥ prathamāḥ satramāsata | yebhirābhṛtaṃ yadidaṃ virocate | tebhyo juhomi bahudhā ghṛtena | rāyaspoṣeṇemaṃ varcasā saṃsṛjātha | narte brahmaṇastapaso vimokaḥ | dvināmnī dīkṣā vaśinī hyugrā | pra keśāḥ suvate kāṇḍino bhavanti | teṣāṃ brahmedīśe vapanasya nānyaḥ | āroha proṣṭhaṃ viṣahasva śatrūn | avāsrāgdīkṣā vaśinī hyugrā
meaning: ये केशिनः प्रथमाः सत्रमासत । येभिराभृतं यदिदं विरोचते । तेभ्यो जुहोमि बहुधा घृतेन । रायस्पोषेणेमं वर्चसा संसृजाथ । नर्ते ब्रह्मणस्तपसो विमोकः । द्विनाम्नी दीक्षा वशिनी ह्युग्रा । प्र केशाः सुवते काण्डिनो भवन्ति । तेषां ब्रह्मेदीशे वपनस्य नान्यः । आरोह प्रोष्ठं विषहस्व शत्रून् । अवास्राग्दीक्षा वशिनी ह्युग्रा
text_mt:
Those long-haired ones who first sat at the sacrificial session, / by whom that which shines forth here was brought near— / to them I offer abundantly with ghee; / unite him with prosperity of wealth, with brilliance!
Without brahman and ascetic fervor there is no release; / having two names, the consecration is indeed dominant and fierce; / the hairs sprout, they become jointed stalks; / brahman alone has power over their shaving, no other.
Mount the bench, overcome the enemies; / the consecration has come down, dominant and fierce.

sanskrit_iast: dehi dakṣiṇāṃ pratirasvāyuḥ | athā mucyasva varuṇasya pāśāt | yenāvapathsavitā kṣureṇa | somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān | tena brahmāṇo vapatedamasyorjemam | rayyā varcasā saṃsṛjātha | mā te keśānanu gādvarca etat | tathā dhātā karotu te | tubhyamindro bṛhaspatiḥ | savitā varca ādadhāt
meaning: देहि दक्षिणां प्रतिरस्वायुः । अथा मुच्यस्व वरुणस्य पाशात् । येनावपथ्सविता क्षुरेण । सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य विद्वान् । तेन ब्रह्माणो वपतेदमस्योर्जेमम् । रय्या वर्चसा संसृजाथ । मा ते केशाननु गाद्वर्च एतत् । तथा धाता करोतु ते । तुभ्यमिन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः । सविता वर्च आदधात्
text_mt:
Give the sacrificial gift, extend your lifespan; / then be released from Varuṇa's noose.
With which razor Savitṛ shaved, / knowing [the head] of King Soma and of Varuṇa, / with that, O Brahmins, shave this [head] of his; / unite him with vigor, with wealth, with brilliance!
Let not this brilliance depart following your hairs; / so may Dhātṛ do for you; / to you Indra, Bṛhaspati, / and Savitṛ have bestowed brilliance.

sanskrit_iast: tebhyo nidhānaṃ bahudhā vyaicchan | antarā dyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ suvaḥ | darbhastambe vīryakṛte nidhāya | pauṃsyenemaṃ varcasā saṃsṛjātha | balaṃ te bāhuvoḥ savitā dadhātu | somastvā'naktu payasā ghṛtena | strīṣu rūpamaśvinaitannidhattam | pauṃsyenemaṃ varcasā saṃsṛjātha | yathsīmantaṃ kaṅkataste lilekha | yadvā kṣuraḥ parivavarja vapaṃste | strīṣu rūpamaśvinaitannidhattam | pauṃsyenemaṃ saṃsṛjātho vīryeṇa
meaning: तेभ्यो निधानं बहुधा व्यैच्छन् । अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी अपः सुवः । दर्भस्तम्बे वीर्यकृते निधाय । पौंस्येनेमं वर्चसा संसृजाथ । बलं ते बाहुवोः सविता दधातु । सोमस्त्वाऽनक्तु पयसा घृतेन । स्त्रीषु रूपमश्विनैतन्निधत्तम् । पौंस्येनेमं वर्चसा संसृजाथ । यथ्सीमन्तं कङ्कतस्ते लिलेख । यद्वा क्षुरः परिववर्ज वपंस्ते । स्त्रीषु रूपमश्विनैतन्निधत्तम् । पौंस्येनेमं संसृजाथो वीर्येण
text_mt:
For them they sought out a deposit in many places / between heaven and earth, the waters, and the sun; / placing it upon a clump of darbha grass made into heroic power, / unite him with virility, with brilliance!
May Savitṛ place strength in your two arms; / may Soma anoint you with milk and ghee; / place this form in women, O Aśvins; / unite him with virility, with brilliance!
Where the comb scratched your parting, / or where the razor passed over as it shaved you, / place this form in women, O Aśvins; / unite him with virility, with heroic power!

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ vai svā viśo maruto nāpācāyan | so'napacāyyamāna etaṃ vighanamapaśyat | tamāharat | tenāyajata | tenaivāsāṃ taṃ saṃstambhaṃ vyahan | yadvyahan | tadvighanasya vighanatvam | vi pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hate | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
meaning: इन्द्रं वै स्वा विशो मरुतो नापाचायन् । सोऽनपचाय्यमान एतं विघनमपश्यत् । तमाहरत् । तेनायजत । तेनैवासां तं संस्तम्भं व्यहन् । यद्व्यहन् । तद्विघनस्य विघनत्वम् । वि पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं हते । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
text_mt:
Indeed, his own subjects, the Maruts, did not show respect to Indra. / Not being respected, he saw this Vighana [sacrifice]. / He brought it forward; / he sacrificed with it. / By it he struck down their obstruction. / Because he struck down (vyáhan), / that is the nature of the Vighana (vighanatvá).
He strikes down evil, his rival, / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ rājānaṃ viśo nāpacāyeyuḥ | yo vā brāhmaṇastamasā pāpmanā prāvṛtaḥ syāt | sa etena yajeta | vighanenaivainadvihatya | viśāmādhipatyaṃ gacchati | tasya dve dvādaśe stotre bhavataḥ | dve caturviṃśe | audbhidyameva tat | etadvai kṣattrasyaudbhidyam | yadasmai svā viśo baliṃ haranti
meaning: यं राजानं विशो नापचायेयुः । यो वा ब्राह्मणस्तमसा पाप्मना प्रावृतः स्यात् । स एतेन यजेत । विघनेनैवैनद्विहत्य । विशामाधिपत्यं गच्छति । तस्य द्वे द्वादशे स्तोत्रे भवतः । द्वे चतुर्विंशे । औद्भिद्यमेव तत् । एतद्वै क्षत्त्रस्यौद्भिद्यम् । यदस्मै स्वा विशो बलिं हरन्ति
text_mt:
The king whom his subjects do not respect, / or the Brahmin who is enveloped in darkness and evil, / should sacrifice with this [Vighana]. / Having struck it down with the Vighana, / he attains the supremacy over the subjects.
There are two twelve-verse stotras for it, / and two twenty-four-verse ones; / that is indeed an eruption. / This indeed is the eruption of regal power, / that his own subjects bring tribute to him.

sanskrit_iast: harantyasmai viśo balim | ainamapratikhyātaṃ gacchati | ya evaṃ veda | prabāhugvā agre kṣattrāṇyātepuḥ | teṣāmindraḥ kṣattrāṇyādatta | na vā imāni kṣattrāṇyabhūvanniti | tannakṣatrāṇāṃ nakṣatratvam | ā śreyaso bhrātṛvyasya teja indriyaṃ dhatte | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
meaning: हरन्त्यस्मै विशो बलिम् । ऐनमप्रतिख्यातं गच्छति । य एवं वेद । प्रबाहुग्वा अग्रे क्षत्त्राण्यातेपुः । तेषामिन्द्रः क्षत्त्राण्यादत्त । न वा इमानि क्षत्त्राण्यभूवन्निति । तन्नक्षत्राणां नक्षत्रत्वम् । आ श्रेयसो भ्रातृव्यस्य तेज इन्द्रियं धत्ते । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
text_mt:
The subjects bring tribute to him; / he attains undisputed [power], / who knows thus.
Originally, the regal powers shone forth simultaneously; / of them Indra took the regal powers, [saying]: / "Indeed, these have ceased to be regal powers (na kṣatrāṇi)"; / that is the nature of the lunar mansions (nakṣatratvá).
He takes away the fiery energy and sensory power of his rival who is more distinguished, / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus.

sanskrit_iast: tadyathā ha vai sacakriṇau kaplakāvupāvahitau syātām | evametau yugmantau stomau | ayukṣu stomeṣu kriyete | pāpmano'pahatyai | apa pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hate | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | tadyathā ha vai sūtagrāmaṇyaḥ | evaṃ chandāṃsi | teṣvasāvādityo bṛhatīrabhyūḍhaḥ
meaning: तद्यथा ह वै सचक्रिणौ कप्लकावुपावहितौ स्याताम् । एवमेतौ युग्मन्तौ स्तोमौ । अयुक्षु स्तोमेषु क्रियेते । पाप्मनोऽपहत्यै । अप पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं हते । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । तद्यथा ह वै सूतग्रामण्यः । एवं छन्दांसि । तेष्वसावादित्यो बृहतीरभ्यूढः
text_mt:
Just as two wheels on axles would be set in place, / so these two even stomas / are performed among odd stomas / to strike away evil.
He strikes away evil, his rival, / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus.
Just as are the charioteer and the village headman, / so are the meters; / upon them that sun, having mounted, ascends the Bṛhatī verses.

sanskrit_iast: satobṛhatīṣu stuvate sato bṛhan | prajayā paśubhirasānītyeva | vyatiṣaktābhiḥ stuvate | vyatiṣaktaṃ vai kṣattraṃ viśā | viśaivainaṃ kṣattreṇa vyatiṣajati | vyatiṣaktābhiḥ stuvate | vyatiṣakto vai grāmaṇīḥ sajātaiḥ | sajātairevainaṃ vyatiṣajati | vyatiṣaktābhiḥ stuvate | vyatiṣakto vai puruṣaḥ pāpmabhiḥ | vyatiṣaktābhirevāsya pāpmano nudate
meaning: सतोबृहतीषु स्तुवते सतो बृहन् । प्रजया पशुभिरसानीत्येव । व्यतिषक्ताभिः स्तुवते । व्यतिषक्तं वै क्षत्त्रं विशा । विशैवैनं क्षत्त्रेण व्यतिषजति । व्यतिषक्ताभिः स्तुवते । व्यतिषक्तो वै ग्रामणीः सजातैः । सजातैरेवैनं व्यतिषजति । व्यतिषक्ताभिः स्तुवते । व्यतिषक्तो वै पुरुषः पाप्मभिः । व्यतिषक्ताभिरेवास्य पाप्मनो नुदते
text_mt:
They praise with Satobṛhatī verses, [thinking]: / "May I become truly great (satobṛhat) in offspring and domestic animals."
They praise with interwoven [verses]; / regal power is indeed interwoven with the subject; / with the subject he interweaves regal power.
They praise with interwoven [verses]; / the village headman is indeed interwoven with his own people; / with his own people he interweaves him.
They praise with interwoven [verses]; / man is indeed interwoven with evils; / with interwoven [verses] he dispels his evils.

sanskrit_iast: pīvonnāṃ rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ | śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutāmabhiśrīḥ | te vāyave samanaso vitasthuḥ | viśvennaraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ | rāye'nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasī ubhe | rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam | adhā vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svāḥ | uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke | ā vāyo prayābhiḥ | pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā
meaning: पीवोन्नां रयिवृधः सुमेधाः । श्वेतः सिषक्ति नियुतामभिश्रीः । ते वायवे समनसो वितस्थुः । विश्वेन्नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः । रायेऽनु यं जज्ञतू रोदसी उभे । राये देवी धिषणा धाति देवम् । अधा वायुं नियुतः सश्चत स्वाः । उत श्वेतं वसुधितिं निरेके । आ वायो प्रयाभिः । प्र वायुमच्छा बृहती मनीषा
text_mt:
Abounding in fatness, increasing wealth, highly wise, / white, the beauty of the team of horses attaches itself [to him]; / they, of one mind, have dispersed for Vāyu; / all the heroes have produced good offspring.
Following wealth, both heaven and earth brought him forth; / for wealth the divine Dhiṣaṇā establishes the god; / then his own teams attend upon Vāyu, / and upon the white vessel of treasures in seclusion.
[The hymns] "O Vāyu, [come] hither", "Forward with those [teams]", / and "Forward toward Vāyu the lofty prayer..." [are recited].

sanskrit_iast: bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavārāṃ rathaprām | dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ | kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo | ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaram | sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi yajñam | vāyo asmin haviṣi mādayasva | yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ | prajāpate na tvadetānyanyaḥ | viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu
meaning: बृहद्रयिं विश्ववारां रथप्राम् । द्युतद्यामा नियुतः पत्यमानः । कविः कविमियक्षसि प्रयज्यो । आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिरध्वरम् । सहस्रिणीभिरुप याहि यज्ञम् । वायो अस्मिन् हविषि मादयस्व । यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः । प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यः । विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव । यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु
text_mt: [Possessing] great wealth, desirable to all, chariot-filling, / of shining path, master of the teams of steeds, / as a poet to a poet do you sacrifice, O worthy of sacrifice! / Come to our sacrificial rite with your teams by the hundreds, / approach our sacrifice with thousands! / O Vāyu, rejoice in this oblation! / Do you ever protect us with blessings! / O Prajāpati, none other than you / has encompassed all these creatures; / that desire with which we offer to you, let that be ours!

sanskrit_iast: vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām | rayīṇāṃ patiṃ yajataṃ bṛhantam | asminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | prajāpatiṃ prathamajāmṛtasya | yajāma devamadhi no bravītu | prajāpate tvaṃ nidhipāḥ purāṇaḥ | devānāṃ pitā janitā prajānām | patirviśvasya jagataḥ paraspāḥ | havirno deva vihave juṣasva | taveme lokāḥ pradiśo diśaśca
meaning: वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् । रयीणां पतिं यजतं बृहन्तम् । अस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । प्रजापतिं प्रथमजामृतस्य । यजाम देवमधि नो ब्रवीतु । प्रजापते त्वं निधिपाः पुराणः । देवानां पिता जनिता प्रजानाम् । पतिर्विश्वस्य जगतः परस्पाः । हविर्नो देव विहवे जुषस्व । तवेमे लोकाः प्रदिशो दिशश्च
text_mt: May we be masters of wealth! / The lord of wealth, the adorable, the great, / the most heroic in this contest for winning spoils, / Prajāpati, the firstborn of truth (ṛta), / let us worship the god; may he speak on our behalf! / O Prajāpati, you are the ancient guardian of treasure, / the father of the gods, the progenitor of offspring, / the master of all that moves, the guardian beyond; / O god, enjoy our oblation at our invocation! / Yours are these worlds, the intermediate directions and the cardinal directions,

sanskrit_iast: parāvato nivata udvataśca | prajāpate viśvasṛjjīvadhanya idaṃ no deva | pratiharya havyam | prajāpatiṃ prathamaṃ yajñiyānām | devānāmagre yajataṃ yajadhvam | sa no dadātu draviṇaṃ suvīryam | rāyaspoṣaṃ viṣyatu nābhimasme | yo rāya īśe śatadāya ukthyaḥ | yaḥ paśūnāṃ rakṣitā viṣṭhitānām | prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya
meaning: परावतो निवत उद्वतश्च । प्रजापते विश्वसृज्जीवधन्य इदं नो देव । प्रतिहर्य हव्यम् । प्रजापतिं प्रथमं यज्ञियानाम् । देवानामग्रे यजतं यजध्वम् । स नो ददातु द्रविणं सुवीर्यम् । रायस्पोषं विष्यतु नाभिमस्मे । यो राय ईशे शतदाय उक्थ्यः । यः पशूनां रक्षिता विष्ठितानाम् । प्रजापतिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य
text_mt: the distant lands, the valleys and the heights! / O Prajāpati, all-creator, wealthy in life, O god, / welcome this our sacrificial oblation! / Prajāpati, the foremost of those worthy of sacrifice, / worship the adorable one at the head of the gods! / May he grant us wealth and heroic sons; / may he untie for us the navel [source] of increase of wealth! / He who rules wealth, giving hundredfold, worthy of hymns, / who is the guardian of the scattered domestic animals, / Prajāpati, the firstborn of truth,

sanskrit_iast: sahasradhāmā juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ | somāpūṣaṇemau devau | somāpūṣaṇā rajaso vimānam | saptacakraṃ rathamaviśvaminvam | viṣūvṛtaṃ manasā yujyamānam | taṃ jinvatho vṛṣaṇā pañcaraśmim | divyanyaḥ sadanaṃ cakra uccā | pṛthivyāmanyo adhyantarikṣe | tāvasmabhyaṃ puruvāraṃ purukṣum | rāyaspoṣaṃ viṣyatāṃ nābhimasme
meaning: सहस्रधामा जुषतां हविर्नः । सोमापूषणेमौ देवौ । सोमापूषणा रजसो विमानम् । सप्तचक्रं रथमविश्वमिन्वम् । विषूवृतं मनसा युज्यमानम् । तं जिन्वथो वृषणा पञ्चरश्मिम् । दिव्यन्यः सदनं चक्र उच्चा । पृथिव्यामन्यो अध्यन्तरिक्षे । तावस्मभ्यं पुरुवारं पुरुक्षुम् । रायस्पोषं विष्यतां नाभिमस्मे
text_mt: having a thousand abodes, may he enjoy our oblation! / Soma and Pūṣan, these two gods— / Soma and Pūṣan, the measurers of space, / [they drive] the seven-wheeled chariot, not urged by all, / turning in all directions, harnessed by the mind; / that five-reined one the two bulls stimulate. / One has made his seat high in heaven, / the other on earth and in the intermediate space; / may they two untie for us, rich in variety and rich in cattle, / the navel [source] of increase of wealth!

sanskrit_iast: dhiyaṃ pūṣā jinvatu viśvaminvaḥ | rayiṃ somo rayipatirdadhātu | avatu devyaditiranarvā | bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ | viśvānyanyo bhuvanā jajāna | viśvamanyo abhicakṣāṇa eti | somāpūṣaṇāvavataṃ dhiyaṃ me | yuvabhyāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayema | uduttamaṃ varuṇāstabhnāddyām | yatkiṃcedaṃ kitavāsaḥ | ava te heḍastattvā yāmi | ādityānāmavasā na dakṣiṇā | dhārayanta ādityāsastisro bhūmīrdhārayan | yajño devānāṃ śucirapaḥ
meaning: धियं पूषा जिन्वतु विश्वमिन्वः । रयिं सोमो रयिपतिर्दधातु । अवतु देव्यदितिरनर्वा । बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः । विश्वान्यन्यो भुवना जजान । विश्वमन्यो अभिचक्षाण एति । सोमापूषणाववतं धियं मे । युवभ्यां विश्वाः पृतना जयेम । उदुत्तमं वरुणास्तभ्नाद्द्याम् । यत्किंचेदं कितवासः । अव ते हेडस्तत्त्वा यामि । आदित्यानामवसा न दक्षिणा । धारयन्त आदित्यासस्तिस्रो भूमीर्धारयन् । यज्ञो देवानां शुचिरपः
text_mt: May Pūṣan, all-impelling, inspire our vision; / may Soma, the lord of wealth, grant wealth; / may the goddess Aditi, unassailed, help [us]; / accompanied by good heroes, may we speak great things at the assembly! / One has engendered all beings; / the other goes surveying everything. / O Soma and Pūṣan, favor my vision; / through you two may we conquer all battle-hosts! / Up, the highest, Varuṇa supported heaven; / whatever this [sin is], O gamblers; / away your wrath; that I entreat of you; / not by the aid of the Ādityas is the sacrificial gift; / the Ādityas upheld, they upheld the three earths; / the sacrifice of the gods, bright water.

sanskrit_iast: te śukrāsaḥ śucayo raśmivantaḥ | sīdannādityā adhi barhiṣi priye | kāmena devāḥ sarathaṃ divo naḥ | āyāntu yajñamupa no juṣāṇāḥ | te sūnavo aditeḥ pīvasāmiṣam | ghṛtaṃ pinvatpratiharyannṛtejāḥ | pra yajñiyā yajamānāya yemure | ādityāḥ kāmaṃ pitumantamasme | ā naḥ putrā aditeryāntu yajñam | ādityāsaḥ pathibhirdevayānaiḥ
meaning: ते शुक्रासः शुचयो रश्मिवन्तः । सीदन्नादित्या अधि बर्हिषि प्रिये । कामेन देवाः सरथं दिवो नः । आयान्तु यज्ञमुप नो जुषाणाः । ते सूनवो अदितेः पीवसामिषम् । घृतं पिन्वत्प्रतिहर्यन्नृतेजाः । प्र यज्ञिया यजमानाय येमुरे । आदित्याः कामं पितुमन्तमस्मे । आ नः पुत्रा अदितेर्यान्तु यज्ञम् । आदित्यासः पथिभिर्देवयानैः
text_mt: May they, radiant, bright, ray-possessing, / the Ādityas, sit upon the dear sacred grass! / According to [our] desire, gods riding together from heaven, / let them come to our sacrifice, enjoying [it]! / Those sons of Aditi, born of truth, swelling with ghee, / will welcome the fat refreshment; / worthy of sacrifice, they have extended toward the sacrificer, / the Ādityas, a food-rich desire for us. / May the sons of Aditi come to our sacrifice, / the Ādityas, along the paths traveled by the gods,

sanskrit_iast: asme kāmaṃ dāśuṣe sannamantaḥ | puroḍāśaṃ ghṛtavantaṃ juṣantām | skabhāyata nirṛtiṃ sedhatāmatim | pra raśmibhiryatamānā amṛdhrāḥ | ādityāḥ kāma prayatāṃ vaṣaṭkṛtim | juṣadhvaṃ no havyadātiṃ yajatrāḥ | ādityānkāmamavase huvema | ye bhūtāni janayanto vicikhyuḥ | sīdantu putrā aditerupastham | stīrṇaṃ barhirhaviradyāya devāḥ
meaning: अस्मे कामं दाशुषे सन्नमन्तः । पुरोडाशं घृतवन्तं जुषन्ताम् । स्कभायत निरृतिं सेधतामतिम् । प्र रश्मिभिर्यतमाना अमृध्राः । आदित्याः काम प्रयतां वषट्कृतिम् । जुषध्वं नो हव्यदातिं यजत्राः । आदित्यान्काममवसे हुवेम । ये भूतानि जनयन्तो विचिख्युः । सीदन्तु पुत्रा अदितेरुपस्थम् । स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्हविरद्याय देवाः
text_mt: granting desire to us, to the giver; / may they enjoy the ghee-anointed sacrificial cake! / Ward off perdition, drive away poverty, / striving forward with your rays, unflagging ones! / O Ādityas, according to your desire, at the offered vaṣaṭ-utterance / enjoy our offering of oblations, O adorable ones! / Let us call the Ādityas according to desire for assistance, / who, generating beings, looked forth; / may the sons of Aditi sit in the lap, / the gods on the strewn sacred grass, to eat the oblation!

sanskrit_iast: stīrṇaṃ barhiḥ sīdatā yajñe asmin | dhrājāḥ sedhanto amatiṃ durevām | asmabhyaṃ putrā aditeḥ prayaṃsata | ādityāḥ kāma haviṣo juṣāṇāḥ | agne naya supathā rāye asmān | viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇamenaḥ | bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te namauktiṃ vidhema | pra vaḥ śukrāya bhānave bharadhvam | havyaṃ matiṃ cāgnaye supūtam
meaning: स्तीर्णं बर्हिः सीदता यज्ञे अस्मिन् । ध्राजाः सेधन्तो अमतिं दुरेवाम् । अस्मभ्यं पुत्रा अदितेः प्रयंसत । आदित्याः काम हविषो जुषाणाः । अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् । विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् । युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनः । भूयिष्ठां ते नमौक्तिं विधेम । प्र वः शुक्राय भानवे भरध्वम् । हव्यं मतिं चाग्नये सुपूतम्
text_mt: Sit on the strewn sacred grass at this sacrifice, / swiftly driving away ill-fortune and poverty! / May the sons of Aditi extend to us [blessings], / the Ādityas, according to desire, enjoying the oblation! / O Agni, lead us along a good path to wealth, / knowing, O god, all the ways! / Remove from us the crooked sin; / we would offer to you the most ample utterance of praise! / Offer forward for the radiant beam of light, / oblation and pure thought, to Agni!

sanskrit_iast: yo daivyāni mānuṣā janūṃṣi | antarviśvāni vidmanā jigāti | acchā giro matayo devayantīḥ | agniṃ yanti draviṇaṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ | susaṃdṛśaṃ supratīkaṃ svañcam | havyavāhamaratiṃ mānuṣāṇām | agne tvamasmadyuyodhyamīvāḥ | anagnitrā abhyamanta kṛṣṭīḥ | punarasmabhyaṃ suvitāya deva | kṣāṃ viśvebhirajarebhiryajatra
meaning: यो दैव्यानि मानुषा जनूंषि । अन्तर्विश्वानि विद्मना जिगाति । अच्छा गिरो मतयो देवयन्तीः । अग्निं यन्ति द्रविणं भिक्षमाणाः । सुसंदृशं सुप्रतीकं स्वञ्चम् । हव्यवाहमरतिं मानुषाणाम् । अग्ने त्वमस्मद्युयोध्यमीवाः । अनग्नित्रा अभ्यमन्त कृष्टीः । पुनरस्मभ्यं सुविताय देव । क्षां विश्वेभिरजरेभिर्यजत्र
text_mt: Who through knowledge passes between all births, / both divine and human. / Forward the songs, the thoughts seeking the gods, / go to Agni, begging for wealth; / beautiful in appearance, of fair face, advancing well, / the bearer of oblations, the regulator of mortal men! / O Agni, keep sickness away from us; / [diseases] have afflicted the peoples without fires; / again for our well-being, O god, / worship the earth with all the ageless [gods], O adorable one!

sanskrit_iast: agne tvaṃ pārayā navyo asmān | svastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā | pūśca pṛthvī bahulā na urvī | bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ | pra kāravo mananā vacyamānāḥ | devadrīcīṃ nayatha devayantaḥ | dakṣiṇāvāḍvājinī prācyeti | havirbharantyagnaye ghṛtācī | indraṃ naro yuje ratham | jagṛbhṇā te dakṣiṇamindra hastam
meaning: अग्ने त्वं पारया नव्यो अस्मान् । स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा । पूश्च पृथ्वी बहुला न उर्वी । भवा तोकाय तनयाय शं योः । प्र कारवो मनना वच्यमानाः । देवद्रीचीं नयथ देवयन्तः । दक्षिणावाड्वाजिनी प्राच्येति । हविर्भरन्त्यग्नये घृताची । इन्द्रं नरो युजे रथम् । जगृभ्णा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तम्
text_mt: O Agni, you, fresh, ferry us across / all perils with blessings! / And be a broad, thick, wide stronghold for us, / well-being and freedom from harm for offspring and posterity! / Forth, O poets, [words] spoken through thought, / seeking the gods, do you lead toward the gods! / Bearing the sacrificial gift, full of prize, she goes forward, / ghee-dripping, bringing the oblation to Agni. / Indra the heroes, I yoke the chariot; / I have grasped your right hand, O Indra,

sanskrit_iast: vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām | vidmā hi tvā gopatiṃ śūra gonām | asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ | tavedaṃ viśvamabhitaḥ paśavyam | yatpaśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya | gavāmasi gopatireka indra | bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ | samindra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ | saṃ sūribhirmaghavanthsaṃ svastyā | saṃ brahmaṇā devakṛtaṃ yadasti
meaning: वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनाम् । विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिं शूर गोनाम् । अस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः । तवेदं विश्वमभितः पशव्यम् । यत्पश्यसि चक्षसा सूर्यस्य । गवामसि गोपतिरेक इन्द्र । भक्षीमहि ते प्रयतस्य वस्वः । समिन्द्र णो मनसा नेषि गोभिः । सं सूरिभिर्मघवन्थ्सं स्वस्त्या । सं ब्रह्मणा देवकृतं यदस्ति
text_mt: seeking goods, O lord of goods of all goods! / For we know you, O hero, as lord of cattle of cows; / give us wondrous, fecund wealth! / Yours is all this around that has cattle, / whatever you behold through the eye of the sun; / you alone, O Indra, are the lord of cows of the cattle; / may we partake of your offered treasure! / Unite us with wisdom, O Indra, with cows, / unite us with the patron-singers, O bounteous one, unite us with well-being, / unite us with brahman, whatever is made by the gods,

sanskrit_iast: saṃ devānāṃ sumatyā yajñiyānām | ārācchatrumapabādhasva dūram | ugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena | asme dhehi yavamadgomadindra | kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām | āvedhasaṃ sa hi śuciḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānaḥ | mahojyotiṣaḥ parame vyoman | saptāsyastuvijāto raveṇa | vi saptaraśmiradhamattamāṃsi
meaning: सं देवानां सुमत्या यज्ञियानाम् । आराच्छत्रुमपबाधस्व दूरम् । उग्रो यः शम्बः पुरुहूत तेन । अस्मे धेहि यवमद्गोमदिन्द्र । कृधी धियं जरित्रे वाजरत्नाम् । आवेधसं स हि शुचिः । बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानः । महोज्योतिषः परमे व्योमन् । सप्तास्यस्तुविजातो रवेण । वि सप्तरश्मिरधमत्तमांसि
text_mt: unite us with the favor of the gods worthy of sacrifice! / Ward off the enemy far away from near, / with that fierce bolt, O much-invoked one! / Bestow upon us [wealth] rich in barley and rich in cattle, O Indra; / make vision bringing prizes of wealth for the singer! / To the creator, for he is pure; / Bṛhaspati, first being born / from the great light in the highest firmament, / seven-mouthed, born of manifold powers, with a roar, / seven-rayed, blew away the darknesses.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatiḥ samajayadvasūni | maho vrajāngomato deva eṣaḥ | apaḥ siṣāsanthsuvara pratīttaḥ | bṛhaspatirhantyamitramarkaiḥ | bṛhaspate paryevā pitre | ā no divaḥ pāvīravī | imā juhvānā yaste stanaḥ | sarasvatyabhi no neṣi | iyaṃ śuṣmebhirbisakhā ivārujat | sānu girīṇāṃ taviṣebhirūrmibhiḥ | pārāvadaghnīmavase suvṛktibhiḥ | sarasvatīmāvivāsema dhītibhiḥ
meaning: बृहस्पतिः समजयद्वसूनि । महो व्रजान्गोमतो देव एषः । अपः सिषासन्थ्सुवर प्रतीत्तः । बृहस्पतिर्हन्त्यमित्रमर्कैः । बृहस्पते पर्येवा पित्रे । आ नो दिवः पावीरवी । इमा जुह्वाना यस्ते स्तनः । सरस्वत्यभि नो नेषि । इयं शुष्मेभिर्बिसखा इवारुजत् । सानु गिरीणां तविषेभिरूर्मिभिः । पारावदघ्नीमवसे सुवृक्तिभिः । सरस्वतीमाविवासेम धीतिभिः
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati won the treasures,
this god, the great pens full of cattle.
Wishing to win the waters and the sun, unopposed,
Bṛhaspati slays the enemy with his songs.
[The pratīkas:] "O Bṛhaspati, around," "Thus to the father,"
"Hither to us from heaven," "Belonging to the lance,"
"These offering," "What breast of yours,"
"O Sarasvatī, lead us forward."
This [river] has broken with her torrents, like a lotus-digger,
the back of the mountains with her powerful waves.
Her who strikes far and near, let us invite for aid
with well-fashioned hymns and with prayers, Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: somo dhenuṃ somo arvantamāśum | somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadātu | sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyam | pituḥśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasmai | aṣāḍhaṃ yuthsu tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ | yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti | tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāḥ | tvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ | tvamātatanthorvantarikṣam | tvaṃ jyotiṣā vitamo vavartha
meaning: सोमो धेनुं सोमो अर्वन्तमाशुम् । सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददातु । सादन्यं विदथ्यं सभेयम् । पितुःश्रवणं यो ददाशदस्मै । अषाढं युथ्सु त्वं सोम क्रतुभिः । या ते धामानि हविषा यजन्ति । त्वमिमा ओषधीः सोम विश्वाः । त्वमपो अजनयस्त्वं गाः । त्वमाततन्थोर्वन्तरिक्षम् । त्वं ज्योतिषा वितमो ववर्थ

sanskrit_iast: yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyām | yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu | tebhirno viśvaiḥ sumanā aheḍan | rājanthsoma prati havyā gṛbhāya | viṣṇornu kaṃ tadasya priyam | pra tadviṣṇuḥ | paro mātrayā tanuvā vṛdhāna | na te mahitvamanvaśñuvanti | ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvam | paramasya vithse
meaning: या ते धामानि दिवि या पृथिव्याम् । या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु । तेभिर्नो विश्वैः सुमना अहेडन् । राजन्थ्सोम प्रति हव्या गृभाय । विष्णोर्नु कं तदस्य प्रियम् । प्र तद्विष्णुः । परो मात्रया तनुवा वृधान । न ते महित्वमन्वश्ञुवन्ति । उभे ते विद्म रजसी पृथिव्या विष्णो देव त्वम् । परमस्य विथ्से
text_mt:
Those abodes of yours that are in heaven, those on earth,
those on the mountains, in the plants, in the waters—
with all of them, being gracious, not being wrathful,
O king Soma, accept our oblations.
[The pratīkas:] "Now indeed of Viṣṇu," "That dear [abode] of his,"
"Forth that Viṣṇu."
Growing in body beyond all measure,
they do not attain your greatness.
We know both of your spaces on the earth, O god Viṣṇu;
you know the highest [space].

sanskrit_iast: vicakrame trirdevaḥ | ā te maho yo jāta eva | abhi gotrāṇi | ābhiḥ spṛdho mithatīrariṣaṇyan | amitrasya vyathayā manyumindra | ābhirviśvā abhiyujo viṣūcīḥ | āryāya viśo'vatārīrdāsīḥ | ayaṃ śṛṇve adha jayannuta ghnan | ayamuta prakṛṇute yudhā gāḥ | yadā satyaṃ kṛṇute manyumindraḥ
meaning: विचक्रमे त्रिर्देवः । आ ते महो यो जात एव । अभि गोत्राणि । आभिः स्पृधो मिथतीररिषण्यन् । अमित्रस्य व्यथया मन्युमिन्द्र । आभिर्विश्वा अभियुजो विषूचीः । आर्याय विशोऽवतारीर्दासीः । अयं शृण्वे अध जयन्नुत घ्नन् । अयमुत प्रकृणुते युधा गाः । यदा सत्यं कृणुते मन्युमिन्द्रः
text_mt:
[The pratīkas:] "He strode forth," "Three times the god,"
"Hither your great," "Who as soon as born."
[Pratīka:] "Toward the cowpens."
With these [allies], not suffering harm, [defeating] the competing rivals,
confound the fury of the enemy, O Indra; with these, scatter all the assailants in all directions;
cast down the Dāsa clans for the Ārya.
He is heard of, winning and striking;
and he brings forth the cattle through battle,
whenever Indra makes true his fury.

sanskrit_iast: viśvaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhayata ejadasmāt | anu svadhāmakṣarannāpo asya | avardhata madhya ā nāvyānām | sadhrīcīnena manasā tamindra ojiṣṭhena | hanmanā'hannabhidyūn | marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānam | akavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsamindram | viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāya | ugraṃ sahodāmiha taṃ huvema | janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya
meaning: विश्वं दृढं भयत एजदस्मात् । अनु स्वधामक्षरन्नापो अस्य । अवर्धत मध्य आ नाव्यानाम् । सध्रीचीनेन मनसा तमिन्द्र ओजिष्ठेन । हन्मनाऽहन्नभिद्यून् । मरुत्वन्तं वृषभं वावृधानम् । अकवारिं दिव्यं शासमिन्द्रम् । विश्वासाहमवसे नूतनाय । उग्रं सहोदामिह तं हुवेम । जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय

sanskrit_iast: mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ | avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra | mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā | kva syā vo marutaḥ svadhā''sīt | yanmāmekaṃ samadhattāhihatye | ahaṃ hyugrastaviṣastuviṣmān | viśvasya śatroranamaṃ vadhasnaiḥ | vṛtrasya tvā śvasathādīṣamāṇāḥ | viśve devā ajahurye sakhāyaḥ | marudbhirindra sakhyaṃ te astu
meaning: मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः । अवर्धन्निन्द्रं मरुतश्चिदत्र । माता यद्वीरं दधनद्धनिष्ठा । क्व स्या वो मरुतः स्वधा'ऽसीत् । यन्मामेकं समधत्ताहिहत्ये । अहं ह्युग्रस्तविषस्तुविष्मान् । विश्वस्य शत्रोरनमं वधस्नैः । वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणाः । विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः । मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्तु
text_mt:
Delightful, mightiest, of abundant pride,
the Maruts magnified Indra even there,
when the most generous mother bore the hero.
"Where was that inherent power of yours, O Maruts,
when you left me alone in the dragon-slaying?
For I am mighty, powerful, full of strength;
I bowed every enemy with weapons."
Fleeing from the snorting of Vṛtra,
all the gods, who were your companions, abandoned you;
with the Maruts let your friendship be, O Indra.

sanskrit_iast: athemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāsi | vadhīṃ vṛtraṃ maruta indriyeṇa | svena bhāmena taviṣo babhūvān | ahametā manave viśvaścandrāḥ | sugā apaścakara vajrabāhuḥ | sa yo vṛṣā vṛṣṇiyebhiḥ samokāḥ | maho divaḥ pṛthivyāśca samrāṭ | satīnasattvā havyo bhareṣu | marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī | indro vṛtramataradvṛtratūrye
meaning: अथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि । वधीं वृत्रं मरुत इन्द्रियेण । स्वेन भामेन तविषो बभूवान् । अहमेता मनवे विश्वश्चन्द्राः । सुगा अपश्चकर वज्रबाहुः । स यो वृषा वृष्णियेभिः समोकाः । महो दिवः पृथिव्याश्च सम्राट् । सतीनसत्त्वा हव्यो भरेषु । मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती । इन्द्रो वृत्रमतरद्वृत्रतूर्ये
text_mt:
Then you will conquer all these armies.
"I slew Vṛtra, O Maruts, by Indra-power,
having become powerful through my own fury.
I made these all-gladdening waters
easy to traverse for Manu, I with the vajra in arm."
He who is the bull, sharing a common dwelling with bull-like powers,
sovereign of great heaven and earth,
of true nature, to be invoked in battles—
may Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, be present for our aid.
Indra crossed over Vṛtra in the fight against Vṛtra.

sanskrit_iast: anādhṛṣyo maghavā śūra indraḥ | anvenaṃ viśo amadanta pūrvīḥ | ayaṃ rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnām | sa eva vīraḥ sa u vīryāvān | sa ekarājo jagataḥ paraspāḥ | yadā vṛtramataracchūra indraḥ | athābhavaddamitā'bhikratūnām | indro yajñaṃ vardhayanviśvavedāḥ | puroḍāśasya juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ | vṛtraṃ tīrtvā dānavaṃ vajrabāhuḥ
meaning: अनाधृष्यो मघवा शूर इन्द्रः । अन्वेनं विशो अमदन्त पूर्वीः । अयं राजा जगतश्चर्षणीनाम् । स एव वीरः स उ वीर्यावान् । स एकराजो जगतः परस्पाः । यदा वृत्रमतरच्छूर इन्द्रः । अथाभवद्दमिताऽभिक्रतूनाम् । इन्द्रो यज्ञं वर्धयन्विश्ववेदाः । पुरोडाशस्य जुषतां हविर्नः । वृत्रं तीर्त्वा दानवं वज्रबाहुः
text_mt:
Irresistible, bounteous, the hero Indra,
after him the many clans rejoiced.
He is the king of the moving world, of the peoples;
he alone is the hero, he possesses heroic power;
he is the sole ruler, the supreme protector of the moving world.
When the hero Indra crossed over Vṛtra,
then he became the subduer of the attackers.
Indra, magnifying the sacrifice, all-knowing,
may he enjoy the oblation of our sacrificial cake.
Having overcome Vṛtra, the Dānava, with the vajra in arm,

sanskrit_iast: diśo'dṛṃhaddṛṃhitā dṛṃhaṇena | imaṃ yajñaṃ vardhayanviśvavedāḥ | puroḍāśaṃ pratigṛbhṇātvindraḥ | yadā vṛtramataracchūra indraḥ | athaikarājo abhavajjanānām | indro devāñchambarahatya āvat | indro devānāmabhavatpurogāḥ | indro yajñe haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ | vṛtratūrṇo abhayaṃ śarma yaṃsat | yaḥ sapta sindhūṃradadhātpṛthivyām | yaḥ sapta lokānakṛṇoddiśaśca | indro haviṣmānthsagaṇo marudbhiḥ | vṛtratūrṇo yajñamihopayāsat
meaning: दिशोऽदृंहद्दृंहिता दृंहणेन । इमं यज्ञं वर्धयन्विश्ववेदाः । पुरोडाशं प्रतिगृभ्णात्विन्द्रः । यदा वृत्रमतरच्छूर इन्द्रः । अथैकराजो अभवज्जनानाम् । इन्द्रो देवाञ्छम्बरहत्य आवत् । इन्द्रो देवानामभवत्पुरोगाः । इन्द्रो यज्ञे हविषा वावृधानः । वृत्रतूर्णो अभयं शर्म यंसत् । यः सप्त सिन्धूंरदधात्पृथिव्याम् । यः सप्त लोकानकृणोद्दिशश्च । इन्द्रो हविष्मान्थ्सगणो मरुद्भिः । वृत्रतूर्णो यज्ञमिहोपयासत्
text_mt:
he made firm the directions that were made firm by his firming.
Magnifying this sacrifice, all-knowing,
may Indra accept the sacrificial cake.
When the hero Indra crossed over Vṛtra,
then he became the sole king of the peoples.
Indra helped the gods in the slaying of Śambara;
Indra became the leader of the gods.
Indra, magnified by the oblation at the sacrifice,
slayer of Vṛtra, shall extend to us fearless protection.
He who placed the seven streams on the earth,
who made the seven worlds and the directions—
Indra, possessing the oblation, with the troop of Maruts,
slayer of Vṛtra, shall approach our sacrifice here.

sanskrit_iast: indrastarasvānabhimāti hograḥ | hiraṇyavāśīriṣiraḥ suvarṣāḥ | tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasya | api bhadre saumanase syāma | hiraṇyavarṇo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu | abhimātihendraḥ pṛtanāsu jiṣṇuḥ | sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ viyaṃsat | yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ | indraṃ stuhi vajriṇaṃ stomapṛṣṭham | puroḍāśasya juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ
meaning: इन्द्रस्तरस्वानभिमाति होग्रः । हिरण्यवाशीरिषिरः सुवर्षाः । तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्य । अपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम । हिरण्यवर्णो अभयं कृणोतु । अभिमातिहेन्द्रः पृतनासु जिष्णुः । स नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वियंसत् । यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः । इन्द्रं स्तुहि वज्रिणं स्तोमपृष्ठम् । पुरोडाशस्य जुषतां हविर्नः
text_mt:
Indra is swift, slayer of the assailant, fierce,
