He says, 'For the work of you two, for the gods, may I be able,' for capability. / Along with the continuity of the sacrifice the offspring and domestic animals of the sacrificer are continued. / Along with the disruption of the sacrifice the offspring and domestic animals of the sacrificer are disrupted. / With 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; for the continuity of the sacrifice I strew you; for the continuity of the sacrifice [I strew] you,' he stretches [a line of straw] continuously up to the āhavanīya fire, / for the continuity of the sacrificer's offspring and domestic animals. / He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are faith; having undertaken and led forward faith, he proceeds. / He leads forward the waters. / The sacrifice indeed is the waters.

Having undertaken and led forward the sacrifice, he proceeds. / He leads forward the waters. / The thunderbolt indeed is the waters. / Having hurled the thunderbolt at his rivals and led it forward, he proceeds. / He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are slayers of the Rakṣases; / [it is] for the warding off of the Rakṣases. / He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are the dear domain of the gods. / Having led forward the dear domain of the gods, he proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: yajñamevārabhya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | vajro vā āpaḥ | vajrameva bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ prahṛtya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai rakṣoghnīḥ | rakṣasāmapahatyai | apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai devānāṃ priyaṃ dhāma | devānāmeva priyaṃ dhāma praṇīya pracarati
meaning: यज्ञमेवारभ्य प्रणीय प्रचरति । अपः प्रणयति । वज्रो वा आपः । वज्रमेव भ्रातृव्येभ्यः प्रहृत्य प्रणीय प्रचरति । अपः प्रणयति । आपो वै रक्षोघ्नीः । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अपः प्रणयति । आपो वै देवानां प्रियं धाम । देवानामेव प्रियं धाम प्रणीय प्रचरति
text_mt: He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are all the deities. / Having undertaken and led forward the deities, he proceeds. / He says, 'For the garb, [I take] you'; / for it is for the garb that he takes it. / He says, 'Scorched is the Rakṣas, scorched are the enemies,' / for the warding off of the Rakṣases. / He says, 'You are the yoke-pole.' / This fire indeed belongs to the yoke-pole. / If he were to pass beyond it without touching [it],

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ | devatā evārabhya praṇīya pracarati | veṣāya tvetyāha | veṣāya hyenadādatte | pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | dhūrasītyāha | eṣa vai dhuryo'gniḥ | taṃ yadanupaspṛśyātīyāt
meaning: अपः प्रणयति । आपो वै सर्वा देवताः । देवता एवारभ्य प्रणीय प्रचरति । वेषाय त्वेत्याह । वेषाय ह्येनदादत्ते । प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रत्युष्टा अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । धूरसीत्याह । एष वै धुर्योऽग्निः । तं यदनुपस्पृश्यातीयात्

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuṃ ca yajamānaṃ ca pradahet | upaspṛśyātyeti | adhvaryośca yajamānasya cāpradāhāya | dhūrvataṃ yo'smāndhūrvati taṃ dhūrvayaṃ vayaṃ dhūrvāma ityāha | dvau vāva puruṣau | yaṃ caiva dhūrvati | yaścainaṃ dhūrvati | tāvubhau śucā'rpayati | tvaṃ devānāmasi sasnitamaṃ papritamaṃ juṣṭatamaṃ vahnitamaṃ devahūtamamityāha | yathā yajurevaitat
meaning: अध्वर्युं च यजमानं च प्रदहेत् । उपस्पृश्यात्येति । अध्वर्योश्च यजमानस्य चाप्रदाहाय । धूर्वतं योऽस्मान्धूर्वति तं धूर्वयं वयं धूर्वाम इत्याह । द्वौ वाव पुरुषौ । यं चैव धूर्वति । यश्चैनं धूर्वति । तावुभौ शुचाऽर्पयति । त्वं देवानामसि सस्नितमं पप्रितमं जुष्टतमं वह्नितमं देवहूतममित्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत्
text_mt: it would burn up both the adhvaryu and the sacrificer. / He passes beyond having touched it, / so that neither the adhvaryu nor the sacrificer may be burned. / He says, 'Injure him who injures us; injure him whom we injure.' / There are two men indeed: / the one whom he injures, / and the one who injures him. / Both of them he pierces with anguish. / He says, 'You among the gods are the most successful, the most fulfilling, the most agreeable, the most transporting, the best invoker of the gods.' / This is precisely according to the Yajus formula.

sanskrit_iast: ahrutamasi havirdhānamityāhānārtyai | dṛṃhasva mā hvārityāha dhṛtyai | mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā prekṣa ityāha mitratvāya | mā bhermā saṃvikthā mā tvā hiṃsiṣamityāhāhiṃsāyai | yadvai kiṃca vāto nābhivāti | tathsarvaṃ varuṇadevatyam | uruvātāyetyāha | avāruṇamevainatkaroti | devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityāha prasūtyai | aśvinorbāhubhyāmityāha
meaning: अह्रुतमसि हविर्धानमित्याहानार्त्यै । दृंहस्व मा ह्वारित्याह धृत्यै । मित्रस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रेक्ष इत्याह मित्रत्वाय । मा भेर्मा संविक्था मा त्वा हिंसिषमित्याहाहिंसायै । यद्वै किंच वातो नाभिवाति । तथ्सर्वं वरुणदेवत्यम् । उरुवातायेत्याह । अवारुणमेवैनत्करोति । देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्याह प्रसूत्यै । अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यामित्याह
text_mt: He says, 'You are the uncrooked cart for oblations,' to prevent failure. / He says, 'Be firm, do not stagger,' for stability. / He says, 'I look upon you with the eye of Mitra,' for friendship. / He says, 'Do not fear, do not tremble, may I not harm you,' for harmlessness. / Whatever the wind does not blow upon, / that all belongs to Varuṇa. / He says, 'Wide for the wind.' / He thereby makes it free from Varuṇa. / He says, 'At the instigation of the divine Savitṛ,' for impulsion. / He says, 'With the arms of the Aśvins,'

sanskrit_iast: aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmityāha yatyai | agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmītyāha | agnaya evaināṃ juṣṭaṃ nirvapati | triryajuṣā | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | tūṣṇīṃ caturtham | aparimitamevāvarundhe | sa evamevānu pūrvaṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati
meaning: अश्विनौ हि देवानामध्वर्यू आस्ताम् । पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामित्याह यत्यै । अग्नये जुष्टं निर्वपामीत्याह । अग्नय एवैनां जुष्टं निर्वपति । त्रिर्यजुषा । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् । अपरिमितमेवावरुन्धे । स एवमेवानु पूर्वं हवींषि निर्वपति
text_mt: for the Aśvins were the two adhvaryus of the gods. / He says, 'With the hands of Pūṣan,' / for proper order. / He says, 'Agreeable to Agni I measure out [you].' / He measures it out agreeable to Agni. / Three times with a Yajus formula; / three are these worlds; / [it is] for the attainment of these worlds. / Silently a fourth time; / he thereby secures the unlimited. / In this very manner he measures out the oblations in order.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ devānāmidamunaḥ sahetyāha vyāvṛttyai | sphātyai tvā nārātyā ityāha guptyai | tamasīva vā eṣo'ntaścarati | yaḥ parīṇahi | suvarabhi vikhyeṣaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ jyotirityāha | suvarevābhi vipaśyati vaiśvānaraṃ jyotiḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī haviṣi gṛhīta udavepetām | dṛṃhantāṃ duryā dyāvāpṛthivyorityāha | gṛhāṇāṃ dyāvāpṛthivyordhṛtyai | urvantarikṣamanvihītyāha gatyai | adityāstvopasthe sādayāmītyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainadupasthe sādayati | agne havyaṃ rakṣasvetyāha guptyai
meaning: इदं देवानामिदमुनः सहेत्याह व्यावृत्त्यै । स्फात्यै त्वा नारात्या इत्याह गुप्त्यै । तमसीव वा एषोऽन्तश्चरति । यः परीणहि । सुवरभि विख्येषं वैश्वानरं ज्योतिरित्याह । सुवरेवाभि विपश्यति वैश्वानरं ज्योतिः । द्यावापृथिवी हविषि गृहीत उदवेपेताम् । दृंहन्तां दुर्या द्यावापृथिव्योरित्याह । गृहाणां द्यावापृथिव्योर्धृत्यै । उर्वन्तरिक्षमन्विहीत्याह गत्यै । अदित्यास्त्वोपस्थे सादयामीत्याह । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्या एवैनदुपस्थे सादयति । अग्ने हव्यं रक्षस्वेत्याह गुप्त्यै
text_mt: He says, 'This for the gods, this in turn together for us,' for separation. / He says, 'For abundance [I take] you, not for malice,' for protection. / Indeed, he moves as if in darkness, / he who is within the cart-frame. / He says, 'May I behold the sun, the Vaiśvānara light.' / He thereby looks upon the sun, the Vaiśvānara light. / Heaven and earth trembled when the oblation was taken. / He says, 'May the dwellings of heaven and earth be firm,' / for the stability of heaven and earth, the two dwellings. / He says, 'Follow the wide intermediate space,' for passage. / He says, 'I place you in the lap of Aditi.' / Aditi indeed is this [earth]. / He sets it down in her lap. / He says, 'O Agni, protect the oblation,' for protection.

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtramahann | so'paḥ | abhyamriyata | tāsāṃ yanmedhyaṃ yajñiyaṃ sadevamāsīt | tadapodakrāmat | te darbhā abhavann | yaddarbhairapa utpunāti | yā eva medhyā yajñiyāḥ sadevā āpaḥ | tābhirevainā utpunāti | dvābhyāmutpunāti
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्रमहन्न् । सोऽपः । अभ्यम्रियत । तासां यन्मेध्यं यज्ञियं सदेवमासीत् । तदपोदक्रामत् । ते दर्भा अभवन्न् । यद्दर्भैरप उत्पुनाति । या एव मेध्या यज्ञियाः सदेवा आपः । ताभिरेवैना उत्पुनाति । द्वाभ्यामुत्पुनाति
text_mt: Indra slew Vṛtra. / He died upon the waters. / What of them was fit for sacrifice, sacrificial, and accompanied by the gods, / that stepped out. / They became darbha grass. / When he purifies the waters with blades of darbha grass, / with those very waters that are fit for sacrifice, sacrificial, and accompanied by the gods, / with them he purifies these [waters]. / With two [blades] he purifies,

sanskrit_iast: dvipādyajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai | devo vaḥ savitotpunātvityāha | savitṛprasūta evainā utpunāti | acchidreṇa pavitreṇetyāha | asau vā ādityo'cchidraṃ pavitram | tenaivainā utpunāti | vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhirityāha | prāṇā vā āpaḥ | prāṇā vasavaḥ | prāṇā raśmayaḥ
meaning: द्विपाद्यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्यै । देवो वः सवितोत्पुनात्वित्याह । सवितृप्रसूत एवैना उत्पुनाति । अच्छिद्रेण पवित्रेणेत्याह । असौ वा आदित्योऽच्छिद्रं पवित्रम् । तेनैवैना उत्पुनाति । वसोः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिरित्याह । प्राणा वा आपः । प्राणा वसवः । प्राणा रश्मयः
text_mt: for the sacrificer is two-footed, for firm standing. / He says, 'May the divine Savitṛ purify you.' / Instigated by Savitṛ he purifies them. / He says, 'With an unslit strainer.' / Yonder sun indeed is an unslit strainer. / With that he purifies them. / He says, 'With the rays of the good Sūrya.' / The waters indeed are the vital breaths; the Vasus are the vital breaths; / the rays are the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇaireva prāṇānthsaṃpṛṇakti | sāvitriyarcā | savitṛprasūtaṃ me karmāsaditi | savitṛprasūtamevāsya karma bhavati | paccho gāyatriyā triṣṣamṛddhatvāya | āpo devīragrepuvo agre guva ityāha | rūpamevāsāmetanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | agra imaṃ yajñaṃ nayatāgre yajñapatimityāha | agra eva yajñaṃ nayanti | agre yajñapatim
meaning: प्राणैरेव प्राणान्थ्संपृणक्ति । सावित्रियर्चा । सवितृप्रसूतं मे कर्मासदिति । सवितृप्रसूतमेवास्य कर्म भवति । पच्छो गायत्रिया त्रिष्षमृद्धत्वाय । आपो देवीरग्रेपुवो अग्रे गुव इत्याह । रूपमेवासामेतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । अग्र इमं यज्ञं नयताग्रे यज्ञपतिमित्याह । अग्र एव यज्ञं नयन्ति । अग्रे यज्ञपतिम्
text_mt: With the vital breaths he unites the vital breaths. / With a verse dedicated to Savitṛ [he purifies], / thinking, 'May my action be instigated by Savitṛ.' / His action indeed becomes instigated by Savitṛ. / Pāda by pāda with the Gāyatrī verse, for triple prosperity. / He says, 'O divine waters, purifying in front, moving in front.' / He thereby declares their form and their greatness. / He says, 'Lead this sacrifice in front, in front the lord of the sacrifice.' / They lead the sacrifice in front, / in front the lord of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yuṣmānindro'vṛṇīta vṛtratūrye yūyamindramavṛṇīdhvaṃ vṛtratūrya ityāha | vṛtraṃ ha haniṣyannindra āpo vavre | āpo hendraṃ vavrire | saṃjñāmevāsāmetathsāmānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | prokṣitāḥ sthetyāha | tenāpaḥ prokṣitāḥ | agnaye vo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmyagnīṣomābhyāmityāha | yathādevatamevainānprokṣati | triḥ prokṣati | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ
meaning: युष्मानिन्द्रोऽवृणीत वृत्रतूर्ये यूयमिन्द्रमवृणीध्वं वृत्रतूर्य इत्याह । वृत्रं ह हनिष्यन्निन्द्र आपो वव्रे । आपो हेन्द्रं वव्रिरे । संज्ञामेवासामेतथ्सामानं व्याचष्टे । प्रोक्षिताः स्थेत्याह । तेनापः प्रोक्षिताः । अग्नये वो जुष्टं प्रोक्षाम्यग्नीषोमाभ्यामित्याह । यथादेवतमेवैनान्प्रोक्षति । त्रिः प्रोक्षति । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः
text_mt: "Indra chose you in the contest with Vṛtra; you chose Indra in the contest with Vṛtra," he says. / For Indra, about to slay Vṛtra, chose the waters. / The waters chose Indra. / He thus explains their agreement and harmony. / "You are sprinkled," he says. / Thereby the waters are sprinkled. / "Agreeable to Agni I sprinkle you, to Agni and Soma," he says. / According to deity he sprinkles them. / Three times he sprinkles. / For threefold is the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: atho rakṣasāmapahatyai | śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāyā ityāha | devayajyāyā evaināni śundhati | triḥ prokṣati | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ | atho medhyatvāya | avadhūtaṃ rakṣo'vadhūtā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | adityāstvagasītyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ
meaning: अथो रक्षसामपहत्यै । शुन्धध्वं दैव्याय कर्मणे देवयज्याया इत्याह । देवयज्याया एवैनानि शुन्धति । त्रिः प्रोक्षति । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः । अथो मेध्यत्वाय । अवधूतं रक्षोऽवधूता अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अदित्यास्त्वगसीत्याह । इयं वा अदितिः
text_mt: And [it is] for the smiting away of the rakṣases. / "Be cleansed for the divine work, for the sacrifice to the gods," he says. / For the sacrifice to the gods he cleanses them. / Three times he sprinkles. / For threefold is the sacrifice. / And [it is] for fitness for sacrifice. / "Shaken away is the rakṣas, shaken away are the enemies," he says. / For the smiting away of the rakṣases. / "You are the skin of Aditi," he says. / Aditi indeed is this [earth].

sanskrit_iast: asyā evainattvacaṃ karoti | prati tvā pṛthivī vettvityāha pratiṣṭhityai | purastātpratīcīna grīvamuttaralomopa stṛṇāti medhyatvāya | tasmātpurastātpratyañcaḥ paśavo medhamupatiṣṭhante | tasmātprajā mṛgaṃ grāhukāḥ | yajño devebhyo nilāyata | kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | yatkṛṣṇājine haviradhyavahanti | yajñādeva tadyajñaṃ prayuṅkte | haviṣo'skandāya
meaning: अस्या एवैनत्त्वचं करोति । प्रति त्वा पृथिवी वेत्त्वित्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । पुरस्तात्प्रतीचीन ग्रीवमुत्तरलोमोप स्तृणाति मेध्यत्वाय । तस्मात्पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चः पशवो मेधमुपतिष्ठन्ते । तस्मात्प्रजा मृगं ग्राहुकाः । यज्ञो देवेभ्यो निलायत । कृष्णो रूपं कृत्वा । यत्कृष्णाजिने हविरध्यवहन्ति । यज्ञादेव तद्यज्ञं प्रयुङ्क्ते । हविषोऽस्कन्दाय
text_mt: He makes it her skin. / "May earth recognize you," he says, for stability. / In front, with neck pointing westward, with fleece uppermost, he spreads it out, for fitness for sacrifice. / Therefore domestic animals in front, facing west, attend the sacrifice. / Therefore creatures capture wild game. / The sacrifice concealed itself from the gods, / having assumed a black form. / When he pounds the oblation on the black antelope skin, / from the sacrifice itself he harnesses the sacrifice, / for non-spilling of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: adhiṣavaṇamasi vānaspatyamityāha | adhiṣavaṇamevainatkaroti | prati tvā'dityāstvagvetvityāha sayatvāya | agnestanūrasītyāha | agnervā eṣā tanūḥ | yadoṣadhayaḥ | vāco visarjanamityāha | yadā hi prajā oṣadhīnāmaśnanti | atha vācaṃ visṛjante | devavītaye tvā gṛhṇāmītyāha
meaning: अधिषवणमसि वानस्पत्यमित्याह । अधिषवणमेवैनत्करोति । प्रति त्वाऽदित्यास्त्वग्वेत्वित्याह सयत्वाय । अग्नेस्तनूरसीत्याह । अग्नेर्वा एषा तनूः । यदोषधयः । वाचो विसर्जनमित्याह । यदा हि प्रजा ओषधीनामश्नन्ति । अथ वाचं विसृजन्ते । देववीतये त्वा गृह्णामीत्याह
text_mt: "You are the pressing-board made of wood," he says. / He makes it a pressing-board. / "May the skin of Aditi recognize you," he says, for union. / "You are the body of Agni," he says. / This is indeed the body of Agni: / the plants. / "The release of speech," he says. / For when creatures eat of the plants, / then they release speech. / "For the feast of the gods I take you," he says.

sanskrit_iast: devatābhirevainathsamardhayati | adrirasi vānaspatya ityāha | grāvāṇamevainatkaroti | sa idaṃ devebhyo havyaṃ suśami śamiṣvetyāha śāntyai | haviṣkṛdehītyāha | ya eva devānāṃ haviṣkṛtaḥ | tānhvayati | trirhvayati | triṣatyā hi devāḥ | iṣamā vadorjamā vadetyāha
meaning: देवताभिरेवैनथ्समर्धयति । अद्रिरसि वानस्पत्य इत्याह । ग्रावाणमेवैनत्करोति । स इदं देवेभ्यो हव्यं सुशमि शमिष्वेत्याह शान्त्यै । हविष्कृदेहीत्याह । य एव देवानां हविष्कृतः । तान्ह्वयति । त्रिर्ह्वयति । त्रिषत्या हि देवाः । इषमा वदोर्जमा वदेत्याह
text_mt: With the deities he causes it to prosper. / "You are the rock made of wood," he says. / He makes it a grinding stone. / "May you prepare this oblation well for the gods," he says, for peace. / "Maker of the oblation, come!" he says. / Those who are makers of the oblation for the gods, / them he summons. / Three times he summons. / For the gods are threefold in truth. / "Speak forth refreshment! Speak forth vigor!" he says.

sanskrit_iast: iṣamevorjaṃ yajamāne dadhāti | dyumadvadata vayaṃ saṃghātaṃ jeṣmetyāha bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai | manoḥ śraddhādevasya yajamānasyāsuraghnī vāk | yajñāyudheṣu praviṣṭā''sīt | te'surā yāvanto yajñāyudhānāmudvadatāmupāśṛṇvann | te parābhavann | tasmāthsvānāṃ madhye'vasāya yajeta | yāvanto'sya bhrātṛvyā yajñāyudhānāmudvadatāmupaśṛṇvanti | te parābhavanti | uccaiḥ samāhantavā āha vijityai
meaning: इषमेवोर्जं यजमाने दधाति । द्युमद्वदत वयं संघातं जेष्मेत्याह भ्रातृव्याभिभूत्यै । मनोः श्रद्धादेवस्य यजमानस्यासुरघ्नी वाक् । यज्ञायुधेषु प्रविष्टा'ऽसीत् । तेऽसुरा यावन्तो यज्ञायुधानामुद्वदतामुपाशृण्वन्न् । ते पराभवन्न् । तस्माथ्स्वानां मध्येऽवसाय यजेत । यावन्तोऽस्य भ्रातृव्या यज्ञायुधानामुद्वदतामुपशृण्वन्ति । ते पराभवन्ति । उच्चैः समाहन्तवा आह विजित्यै
text_mt: Refreshment and vigor he places in the sacrificer. / "Speak brilliantly, so that we may conquer the gathering!" he says, to overcome the rival. / The voice of Manu, who had faith in the gods, the sacrificer, was a slayer of asuras; / it had entered the sacrificial implements. / As many asuras as heard the sacrificial implements sounding, / they perished. / Therefore one should settle and sacrifice in the midst of one's own people. / As many rivals of his as hear the sacrificial implements sounding, / they perish. / "Pound together loudly!" he says, for victory.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṅkta eṣāmindriyaṃ vīryam | śreṣṭha eṣāṃ bhavati | varṣavṛddhamasi prati tvā varṣavṛddhaṃ vettvityāha | varṣavṛddhā vā oṣadhayaḥ | varṣavṛddhā iṣīkāḥ samṛddhyai | yajñaṃ rakṣāṃsyanuprāviśann | tānyasnā paśubhyo niravādayanta | tuṣairoṣadhībhyaḥ | parāpūtaṃ rakṣaḥ parāpūtā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai
meaning: वृङ्क्त एषामिन्द्रियं वीर्यम् । श्रेष्ठ एषां भवति । वर्षवृद्धमसि प्रति त्वा वर्षवृद्धं वेत्त्वित्याह । वर्षवृद्धा वा ओषधयः । वर्षवृद्धा इषीकाः समृद्ध्यै । यज्ञं रक्षांस्यनुप्राविशन्न् । तान्यस्ना पशुभ्यो निरवादयन्त । तुषैरोषधीभ्यः । परापूतं रक्षः परापूता अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै
text_mt: He takes away their power and heroic power. / He becomes the best of them. / "You are grown by rain; may what is grown by rain recognize you," he says. / The plants are indeed grown by rain; / the reeds are grown by rain, for prosperity. / The rakṣases entered into the sacrifice. / Them they excluded from domestic animals with blood, / from plants with husks. / "Winnowed away is the rakṣas, winnowed away are the enemies," he says, / for the smiting away of the rakṣases.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣasāṃ bhāgo'sītyāha | tuṣaireva rakṣāṃsi niravadayate | apa upaspṛśati medhyatvāya | vāyurvo vivinaktvityāha | pavitraṃ vai vāyuḥ | punātyevainān | antarikṣādiva vā ete praskandanti | ye śūrpāt | devo vaḥ savitā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratigṛhṇātvityāha pratiṣṭhityai | haviṣo'skandāya | triṣphalī kartavā āha | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ | atho medhyatvāya
meaning: रक्षसां भागोऽसीत्याह । तुषैरेव रक्षांसि निरवदयते । अप उपस्पृशति मेध्यत्वाय । वायुर्वो विविनक्त्वित्याह । पवित्रं वै वायुः । पुनात्येवैनान् । अन्तरिक्षादिव वा एते प्रस्कन्दन्ति । ये शूर्पात् । देवो वः सविता हिरण्यपाणिः प्रतिगृह्णात्वित्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । हविषोऽस्कन्दाय । त्रिष्फली कर्तवा आह । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः । अथो मेध्यत्वाय
text_mt: "You are the portion of the rakṣases," he says. / With the husks he excludes the rakṣases. / He touches water, for fitness for sacrifice. / "May Vāyu separate you," he says. / Vāyu is indeed a purifier. / He purifies them. / As if from the intermediate space these leap forth, / which [fall] from the winnowing basket. / "May divine Savitṛ of golden hand receive you," he says, for stability, / for non-spilling of the oblation. / "Thrice shall it be husked," he says. / For threefold is the sacrifice, / and [it is] for fitness for sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: avadhūtaṃ rakṣo'vadhūtā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | adityāstvagasītyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainattvacaṃ karoti | prati tvā pṛthivī vettvityāha pratiṣṭhityai | purastātpratīcīna grīvamuttara lomopastṛṇāti medhyatvāya | tasmātpurastātpratyañcaḥ paśavo medhamupatiṣṭhante | tasmātprajā mṛgaṃ grāhukāḥ | yajño devebhyo nilāyata
meaning: अवधूतं रक्षोऽवधूता अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अदित्यास्त्वगसीत्याह । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्या एवैनत्त्वचं करोति । प्रति त्वा पृथिवी वेत्त्वित्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । पुरस्तात्प्रतीचीन ग्रीवमुत्तर लोमोपस्तृणाति मेध्यत्वाय । तस्मात्पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चः पशवो मेधमुपतिष्ठन्ते । तस्मात्प्रजा मृगं ग्राहुकाः । यज्ञो देवेभ्यो निलायत
text_mt: "Shaken away is the rakṣas, shaken away are the enemies," he says, / for the smiting away of the rakṣases. / "You are the skin of Aditi," he says. / Aditi indeed is this [earth]. / He makes it her skin. / "May earth recognize you," he says, for stability. / In front, with neck pointing westward, with fleece uppermost, he spreads it out, for fitness for sacrifice. / Therefore domestic animals in front, facing west, attend the sacrifice. / Therefore creatures capture wild game. / The sacrifice concealed itself from the gods,

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | yatkṛṣṇājine haviradhi pinaṣṭi | yajñādeva tadyajñaṃ prayuṅkte | haviṣo'skandāya | dyāvāpṛthivī sahāstām | te śamyāmātramekamaharvyaitāṃ śamyāmātramekamahaḥ | divaḥ skambhanirasi prati tvā'dityāstvagvetvityāha | dyāvāpṛthivyorvītyai | dhiṣaṇā'si parvatyā prati tvā divaḥ skambha nirvetvittyāha | dyāvāpṛthivyorvidhṛtyai
meaning: कृष्णो रूपं कृत्वा । यत्कृष्णाजिने हविरधि पिनष्टि । यज्ञादेव तद्यज्ञं प्रयुङ्क्ते । हविषोऽस्कन्दाय । द्यावापृथिवी सहास्ताम् । ते शम्यामात्रमेकमहर्व्यैतां शम्यामात्रमेकमहः । दिवः स्कम्भनिरसि प्रति त्वाऽदित्यास्त्वग्वेत्वित्याह । द्यावापृथिव्योर्वीत्यै । धिषणाऽसि पर्वत्या प्रति त्वा दिवः स्कम्भ निर्वेत्वित्त्याह । द्यावापृथिव्योर्विधृत्यै
text_mt: having assumed a black form. / When he grinds the oblation on the black antelope skin, / from the sacrifice itself he harnesses the sacrifice, / for non-spilling of the oblation. / Heaven and earth were together. / They separated by the measure of a yoke-pin for one day, by the measure of a yoke-pin for one day. / "You are the prop of heaven; may the skin of Aditi recognize you," he says, / for the course of heaven and earth. / "You are the mountain-bowl; may the prop of heaven recognize you," he says, / for the wide separation of heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast: dhiṣaṇā'si pārvateyī prati tvā parvatirvettvityāha | dyāvāpṛthivyordhṛtyai | devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityāha prasūtyai | aśvinorbāhubhyāmityāha | aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmityāha yatyai | adhivapāmītyāha | yathādevatamevainānadhivapati | dhānyamasi dhinuhi devānityāha | etasya yajuṣo vīryeṇa
meaning: धिषणाऽसि पार्वतेयी प्रति त्वा पर्वतिर्वेत्त्वित्याह । द्यावापृथिव्योर्धृत्यै । देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्याह प्रसूत्यै । अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यामित्याह । अश्विनौ हि देवानामध्वर्यू आस्ताम् । पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामित्याह यत्यै । अधिवपामीत्याह । यथादेवतमेवैनानधिवपति । धान्यमसि धिनुहि देवानित्याह । एतस्य यजुषो वीर्येण
text_mt: "You are the mountain-born bowl; may the mountain recognize you," he says, / for the supporting of heaven and earth. / "At the impulse of divine Savitṛ," he says, for impulsion. / "With the arms of the Aśvins," he says. / For the Aśvins were the Adhvaryus of the gods. / "With the hands of Pūṣan," he says, for restraining. / "I pour on," he says. / According to deity he pours them on. / "You are grain; gladden the gods," he says. / Through the heroic power of this yajus,

sanskrit_iast: yāvadekā devatā kāmayate yāvadekā | tāvadāhutiḥ prathate | na hi tadasti | yattāvadeva syāt | yāvajjuhoti | prāṇāya tvā'pānāyatvetyāha | prāṇāneva yajamāne dadhāti | dīrghāmanu prasitimāyuṣe dhāmityāha | āyurevāsmindadhāti | antarikṣādiva vā etāni praskandanti | yāni dṛṣadaḥ | devo vaḥ savitā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratigṛhṇātvityāha pratiṣṭhityai | haviṣo'skandāya | asaṃvapantī piṃṣāṇūni kurutādityāha medhyatvāya
meaning: यावदेका देवता कामयते यावदेका । तावदाहुतिः प्रथते । न हि तदस्ति । यत्तावदेव स्यात् । यावज्जुहोति । प्राणाय त्वाऽपानायत्वेत्याह । प्राणानेव यजमाने दधाति । दीर्घामनु प्रसितिमायुषे धामित्याह । आयुरेवास्मिन्दधाति । अन्तरिक्षादिव वा एतानि प्रस्कन्दन्ति । यानि दृषदः । देवो वः सविता हिरण्यपाणिः प्रतिगृह्णात्वित्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । हविषोऽस्कन्दाय । असंवपन्ती पिंषाणूनि कुरुतादित्याह मेध्यत्वाय
text_mt: as much as one deity desires, as much as one, / so far does the offering extend. / For there is nothing / that could be only as much / as he offers. / "For exhalation you, for inhalation you," he says. / Exhalations he places in the sacrificer. / "Along a long path of life I place [you] for lifespan," he says. / Lifespan he places in him. / As if from the intermediate space these leap forth, / which [fall] from the mill-stones. / "May divine Savitṛ of golden hand receive you," he says, for stability, / for non-spilling of the oblation. / "Grind without scattering, make it fine," he says, for fitness for sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: dhṛṣṭirasi brahma yacchetyāha dhṛtyai | apāgne'gni mā mādaṃ jahi niṣkravyādaṃ sedhā devayajaṃ vahetyāha | ya evāmātkravyāt | tamapahatya | medhye'gnau kapālamupadadhāti | nirdagdhaṃ rakṣo nirdagdhā arātaya ityāha | rakṣāṃsyeva nirdahati | agnivatyupadadhāti | asminneva loke jyotirdhatte | aṅgāramadhi vartayati
meaning: धृष्टिरसि ब्रह्म यच्छेत्याह धृत्यै । अपाग्नेऽग्नि मा मादं जहि निष्क्रव्यादं सेधा देवयजं वहेत्याह । य एवामात्क्रव्यात् । तमपहत्य । मेध्येऽग्नौ कपालमुपदधाति । निर्दग्धं रक्षो निर्दग्धा अरातय इत्याह । रक्षांस्येव निर्दहति । अग्निवत्युपदधाति । अस्मिन्नेव लोके ज्योतिर्धत्ते । अङ्गारमधि वर्तयति
text_mt:
"You are the fire-shovel; uphold the brahman," he says, for firmness.
"O Agni, drive away the raw-flesh-eating Agni; drive out the corpse-eating one; bring hither the sacrifice-to-the-gods," he says.
Whichever is raw-eating and corpse-eating,
having struck that away,
he sets down the potsherd upon the sacrificial Agni.
"Burnt is the demon, burnt are the enemies," he says;
he burns away the demons.
He sets it down on what is accompanied by Agni;
he places light in this world.
He rolls an ember over [it].

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣa eva jyotirdhatte | ādityamevāmuṣmiṃ lloke jyotirdhatte | jyotiṣmanto'smā ime lokā bhavanti | ya evaṃ veda | dhruvamasi pṛthivīṃ dṛṃhetyāha | pṛthivīmevaitena dṛṃhati | dhartramasyantarikṣaṃ dṛṃhetyāha | antarikṣamevaitena dṛṃhati | dharuṇamasi divaṃ dṛṃhetyāha | divamevaitena dṛṃhati
meaning: अन्तरिक्ष एव ज्योतिर्धत्ते । आदित्यमेवामुष्मिं ल्लोके ज्योतिर्धत्ते । ज्योतिष्मन्तोऽस्मा इमे लोका भवन्ति । य एवं वेद । ध्रुवमसि पृथिवीं दृंहेत्याह । पृथिवीमेवैतेन दृंहति । धर्त्रमस्यन्तरिक्षं दृंहेत्याह । अन्तरिक्षमेवैतेन दृंहति । धरुणमसि दिवं दृंहेत्याह । दिवमेवैतेन दृंहति

sanskrit_iast: dharmā'si diśo dṛṃhetyāha | diśa evaitena dṛṃhati | imānevaitairlokāndṛṃhati | dṛṃhante'smā ime lokāḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ | ya evaṃ veda | trīṇyagre kapālānyupadadhāti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | ekamagre kapālamupadadhāti | ekaṃ vā agre kapālaṃ puruṣasya saṃbhavati
meaning: धर्माऽसि दिशो दृंहेत्याह । दिश एवैतेन दृंहति । इमानेवैतैर्लोकान्दृंहति । दृंहन्तेऽस्मा इमे लोकाः प्रजया पशुभिः । य एवं वेद । त्रीण्यग्रे कपालान्युपदधाति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । एकमग्रे कपालमुपदधाति । एकं वा अग्रे कपालं पुरुषस्य संभवति

sanskrit_iast: atha dve | atha trīṇi | atha catvāri | athāṣṭau | tasmādaṣṭākapālaṃ puruṣasya śiraḥ | yadevaṃ kapālānyupadadhāti | yajño vai prajāpatiḥ | yajñameva prajāpatiṃ saṃskaroti | ātmānameva tathsaṃskaroti | taṃ saṃskṛtamātmānam
meaning: अथ द्वे । अथ त्रीणि । अथ चत्वारि । अथाष्टौ । तस्मादष्टाकपालं पुरुषस्य शिरः । यदेवं कपालान्युपदधाति । यज्ञो वै प्रजापतिः । यज्ञमेव प्रजापतिं संस्करोति । आत्मानमेव तथ्संस्करोति । तं संस्कृतमात्मानम्
text_mt:
Then two,
then three,
then four,
then eight.
Therefore the head of a man consists of eight potsherds [cranial bones].
When he thus sets down the potsherds,
Prajāpati, indeed, is the sacrifice;
he prepares Prajāpati, the sacrifice;
he prepares his own self.
With that self prepared,

sanskrit_iast: amuṣmiṃ lloke'nu paraiti | yadaṣṭāvupadadhāti | gāyatriyā tathsaṃmitam | yannava | trivṛtā tat | yaddaśa | virājā tat | yadekādaśa | triṣṭubhā tat | yaddvādaśa
meaning: अमुष्मिं ल्लोकेऽनु परैति । यदष्टावुपदधाति । गायत्रिया तथ्संमितम् । यन्नव । त्रिवृता तत् । यद्दश । विराजा तत् । यदेकादश । त्रिष्टुभा तत् । यद्द्वादश
text_mt:
he goes along into yonder world.
When he sets down eight,
that is commensurate with the Gāyatrī.
When nine,
that [is commensurate] with the Trivṛt [stoma].
When ten,
that with the Virāj.
When eleven,
that with the Triṣṭubh.
When twelve,

sanskrit_iast: jagatyā tat | chandaḥsaṃmitāni sa upadadhatkapālāni | imān lokānanupūrvaṃ diśo vidhṛtyai dṛṃhati | athāyuḥ prāṇānprajāṃ paśūn yajamāne dadhāti | sajātānasmā abhito bahulānkaroti | citaḥ sthetyāha | yathā yajurevaitat | bhṛgūṇāmaṃgirasāṃ tapasā tapyadhvamityāha | devatānāmevaināni tapasā tapati | tāni tataḥ saṃsthite | yāni gharme kapālānyupacinvanti vedhasa iti catuṣpadayarcā vimuñcati | catuṣpādaḥ paśavaḥ | paśuṣvevopariṣṭātpratitiṣṭhati
meaning: जगत्या तत् । छन्दःसंमितानि स उपदधत्कपालानि । इमान् लोकाननुपूर्वं दिशो विधृत्यै दृंहति । अथायुः प्राणान्प्रजां पशून् यजमाने दधाति । सजातानस्मा अभितो बहुलान्करोति । चितः स्थेत्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । भृगूणामंगिरसां तपसा तप्यध्वमित्याह । देवतानामेवैनानि तपसा तपति । तानि ततः संस्थिते । यानि घर्मे कपालान्युपचिन्वन्ति वेधस इति चतुष्पदयर्चा विमुञ्चति । चतुष्पादः पशवः । पशुष्वेवोपरिष्टात्प्रतितिष्ठति

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityāha prasūtyai | aśvinorbāhubhyāmityāha | aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmityāha yatyai | saṃ vapāmītyāha | yathādevatamevaināni saṃvapati | samāpo adbhiragmata samoṣadhayo rasenetyāha | āpo vā oṣadhīrjinvanti | oṣadhayo'po jinvanti | anyā vā etāsāmanyā jinvanti
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्याह प्रसूत्यै । अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यामित्याह । अश्विनौ हि देवानामध्वर्यू आस्ताम् । पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामित्याह यत्यै । सं वपामीत्याह । यथादेवतमेवैनानि संवपति । समापो अद्भिरग्मत समोषधयो रसेनेत्याह । आपो वा ओषधीर्जिन्वन्ति । ओषधयोऽपो जिन्वन्ति । अन्या वा एतासामन्या जिन्वन्ति

sanskrit_iast: tasmādevamāha | saṃ revatīrjagatībhirmadhumatīrmadhumatībhiḥ sṛjyadhvamityāha | āpo vai revatīḥ | paśavo jagatīḥ | oṣadhayo madhumatīḥ | āpa oṣadhīḥ paśūn | tānevāsmā ekadhā saṃsṛjya | madhumataḥ karoti | adbhyaḥ pari prajātāḥ stha samadbhiḥ pṛcyadhvamiti paryāplāvayati | yathā suvṛṣṭa imāmanu visṛtya
meaning: तस्मादेवमाह । सं रेवतीर्जगतीभिर्मधुमतीर्मधुमतीभिः सृज्यध्वमित्याह । आपो वै रेवतीः । पशवो जगतीः । ओषधयो मधुमतीः । आप ओषधीः पशून् । तानेवास्मा एकधा संसृज्य । मधुमतः करोति । अद्भ्यः परि प्रजाताः स्थ समद्भिः पृच्यध्वमिति पर्याप्लावयति । यथा सुवृष्ट इमामनु विसृत्य
text_mt:
Therefore he says thus.
"O wealthy ones, unite with the moving ones, honeyed ones with honeyed ones," he says.
The wealthy ones are the waters;
the moving ones are domestic animals;
the honeyed ones are the plants.
Waters, plants, domestic animals—
having united them for him into one,
he makes them full of sweetness.
"You are born from the waters; blend with the waters," thus he sprinkles around.
Just as, when it has rained well, spreading out along this [earth],

sanskrit_iast: āpa oṣadhīrmahayanti | tādṛgeva tat | janayatyai tvā saṃyaumītyāha | prajā evaitena dādhāra | agnaye tvā'gnīṣomābhyāmityāha vyāvṛttyai | makhasya śiro'sītyāha | yajño vai makhaḥ | tasyaitacchiraḥ | yatpuroḍāśaḥ | tasmādevamāha
meaning: आप ओषधीर्महयन्ति । तादृगेव तत् । जनयत्यै त्वा संयौमीत्याह । प्रजा एवैतेन दाधार । अग्नये त्वाऽग्नीषोमाभ्यामित्याह व्यावृत्त्यै । मखस्य शिरोऽसीत्याह । यज्ञो वै मखः । तस्यैतच्छिरः । यत्पुरोडाशः । तस्मादेवमाह
text_mt:
waters magnify the plants,
such indeed is that.
"For generation I mix you," he says;
thereby he maintains offspring.
"For Agni, for Agni-and-Soma," he says, for distinction.
"You are the head of Makha," he says.
Makha, indeed, is the sacrifice;
its head is this
which is the sacrificial cake.
Therefore he says thus.

sanskrit_iast: gharmosi viśvāyurityāha | viśvamevāyuryajamāne dadhāti | uru prathasvoru te yajñapatiḥ prathatāmityāha | yajamānameva prajayā paśubhiḥ prathayati | tvacaṃ gṛhṇīṣvetyāha | sarvamevainaṃ satanuṃ karoti | athāpa ānīya parimārṣṭi | māṃsa eva tattvacaṃ dadhāti | tasmāttvacā māṃsaṃ channam | gharmo vā eṣo'śāntaḥ
meaning: घर्मोसि विश्वायुरित्याह । विश्वमेवायुर्यजमाने दधाति । उरु प्रथस्वोरु ते यज्ञपतिः प्रथतामित्याह । यजमानमेव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रथयति । त्वचं गृह्णीष्वेत्याह । सर्वमेवैनं सतनुं करोति । अथाप आनीय परिमार्ष्टि । मांस एव तत्त्वचं दधाति । तस्मात्त्वचा मांसं छन्नम् । घर्मो वा एषोऽशान्तः

sanskrit_iast: ardhamāse'rdhamāse pravṛjyate | yatpuroḍāśaḥ | sa īśvaro yajamānaṃ śucā'pradahaḥ | paryagni karoti | paśumevainamakaḥ | śāntyā apradāhāya | triḥ paryagni karoti | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ | atho rakṣasāmapahatyai | antaritaṃ rakṣo'ntaritā arātaya ityāha
meaning: अर्धमासेऽर्धमासे प्रवृज्यते । यत्पुरोडाशः । स ईश्वरो यजमानं शुचाऽप्रदहः । पर्यग्नि करोति । पशुमेवैनमकः । शान्त्या अप्रदाहाय । त्रिः पर्यग्नि करोति । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः । अथो रक्षसामपहत्यै । अन्तरितं रक्षोऽन्तरिता अरातय इत्याह

sanskrit_iast: rakṣasāmantarhityai | puroḍāśaṃ vā adhiśritaṃ rakṣāṃsyajighāṃsann | divi nāko nāmāgnī rakṣohā | sa evāsmādrakṣāṃsyapāhann | devastvā savitā śrapayatvityāha | savitṛprasūta evainaṃ śrapayati | varṣiṣṭhe adhināka ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | agniste tanuvaṃ mā'ti dhāgityāhānatidāhāya | agne havyaṃ rakṣasvetyāha guptyai
meaning: रक्षसामन्तर्हित्यै । पुरोडाशं वा अधिश्रितं रक्षांस्यजिघांसन्न् । दिवि नाको नामाग्नी रक्षोहा । स एवास्माद्रक्षांस्यपाहन्न् । देवस्त्वा सविता श्रपयत्वित्याह । सवितृप्रसूत एवैनं श्रपयति । वर्षिष्ठे अधिनाक इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अग्निस्ते तनुवं माऽति धागित्याहानतिदाहाय । अग्ने हव्यं रक्षस्वेत्याह गुप्त्यै
text_mt:
for the exclusion of the demons.
The demons wished to strike the sacrificial cake when it was set upon [the fire].
In heaven there was an Agni named Nāka, slayer of demons;
he struck away the demons from it.
"May the divine Savitṛ bake you," he says;
impelled by Savitṛ he bakes it.
"Upon the highest firmament," he says,
for striking away the demons.
"May Agni not scorch your body," he says, so that it will not scorch.
"O Agni, protect the oblation," he says, for safeguarding.

sanskrit_iast: avidahanta śrapayateti vācaṃ visṛjate | yajñameva havīgṣyabhivyāhṛtya pratanute | purorucamavidāhāya śṛtyai karoti | mastiṣko vai puroḍāśaḥ | taṃ yannābhivāsayet | āvirmastiṣkaḥ syāt | abhivāsayati | tasmādguhā mastiṣkaḥ | bhasmanā'bhivāsayati | tasmānmāṃsenāsthi channam
meaning: अविदहन्त श्रपयतेति वाचं विसृजते । यज्ञमेव हवीग्ष्यभिव्याहृत्य प्रतनुते । पुरोरुचमविदाहाय शृत्यै करोति । मस्तिष्को वै पुरोडाशः । तं यन्नाभिवासयेत् । आविर्मस्तिष्कः स्यात् । अभिवासयति । तस्माद्गुहा मस्तिष्कः । भस्मनाऽभिवासयति । तस्मान्मांसेनास्थि छन्नम्
text_mt:
"Bake without scorching!"—saying this, he releases his speech.
Having pronounced over the sacrifice and oblations, he extends [them].
He makes a preliminary recitation, for non-scorching, for baking.
The brain, indeed, is the sacrificial cake.
If he were not to cover it,
the brain would be exposed.
He covers it;
therefore the brain is hidden.
He covers it with ashes;
therefore the bone is covered by flesh.

sanskrit_iast: vedenābhi vāsayati | tasmātkeśaiḥ śiraśchannam | akhalatibhāvuko bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | paśorvai pratimā puroḍāśaḥ | sa nāyajuṣkamabhivāsyaḥ | vṛtheva syāt | īśvarā yajamānasya paśavaḥ prametoḥ | saṃ brahmaṇā pṛcyasvetyāha | prāṇā vai brahma
meaning: वेदेनाभि वासयति । तस्मात्केशैः शिरश्छन्नम् । अखलतिभावुको भवति । य एवं वेद । पशोर्वै प्रतिमा पुरोडाशः । स नायजुष्कमभिवास्यः । वृथेव स्यात् । ईश्वरा यजमानस्य पशवः प्रमेतोः । सं ब्रह्मणा पृच्यस्वेत्याह । प्राणा वै ब्रह्म

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāḥ paśavaḥ | prāṇaireva paśūnthsaṃ pṛṇakti | na pramāyukā bhavanti | yajamāno vai puroḍāśaḥ | prajā paśavaḥ purīṣam | yadevamabhi vāsayati | yajamānameva prajayā paśubhiḥ samardhayati | devā vai havirbhṛtvā'bruvann | kasminnidaṃ mrakṣyāmaha iti | so'gnirabravīt
meaning: प्राणाः पशवः । प्राणैरेव पशून्थ्सं पृणक्ति । न प्रमायुका भवन्ति । यजमानो वै पुरोडाशः । प्रजा पशवः पुरीषम् । यदेवमभि वासयति । यजमानमेव प्रजया पशुभिः समर्धयति । देवा वै हविर्भृत्वाऽब्रुवन्न् । कस्मिन्निदं म्रक्ष्यामह इति । सोऽग्निरब्रवीत्
text_mt:
Domestic animals are exhalations.
With the exhalations he unites the domestic animals;
they do not perish.
The cake is the sacrificer;
offspring and domestic animals are the loose earth.
When he covers [it] thus,
he enriches the sacrificer with offspring and domestic animals.
The gods, having borne the offering, said:
‘On whom shall we wipe this off?’
Agni said:

sanskrit_iast: mayi tanūḥ saṃnidhadhvam | ahaṃ vastaṃ janayiṣyāmi | yasmin mrakṣyadhva iti | te devā agnau tanūḥ saṃnyadadhata | tasmādāhuḥ | agniḥ sarvā devatā iti | so'ṅgāreṇāpaḥ | abhyapātayat | tata ekato'jāyata | sa dvitīyamabhyapātayat
meaning: मयि तनूः संनिधध्वम् । अहं वस्तं जनयिष्यामि । यस्मिन् म्रक्ष्यध्व इति । ते देवा अग्नौ तनूः संन्यदधत । तस्मादाहुः । अग्निः सर्वा देवता इति । सोऽङ्गारेणापः । अभ्यपातयत् । तत एकतोऽजायत । स द्वितीयमभ्यपातयत्

sanskrit_iast: tato dvito'jāyata | sa tṛtīyamabhyapātayat | tatastrito'jāyata | yadadbhyo'jāyanta | tadāpyānāmāpyatvam | yadātmabhyo'jāyanta | tadātmyānāmātmyatvam | te devā āpyeṣvamṛjata | āpyā amṛjata sūryābhyudite | sūryābhyuditaḥ sūryābhinimrukte
meaning: ततो द्वितोऽजायत । स तृतीयमभ्यपातयत् । ततस्त्रितोऽजायत । यदद्भ्योऽजायन्त । तदाप्यानामाप्यत्वम् । यदात्मभ्योऽजायन्त । तदात्म्यानामात्म्यत्वम् । ते देवा आप्येष्वमृजत । आप्या अमृजत सूर्याभ्युदिते । सूर्याभ्युदितः सूर्याभिनिम्रुक्ते

sanskrit_iast: sūryābhinimruktaḥ kunakhini | kunakhī śyāvadati | śyāvadannagradidhiṣau | agradidhiṣuḥ parivitte | parivitto vīrahaṇi | vīrahā brahmahaṇi | tadbrahmahaṇaṃ nātyacyavata | antarvedi ninayatyavarudhyai | ulmukenābhi gṛhṇāti śṛtatvāya | śṛtakāmā iva hi devāḥ
meaning: सूर्याभिनिम्रुक्तः कुनखिनि । कुनखी श्यावदति । श्यावदन्नग्रदिधिषौ । अग्रदिधिषुः परिवित्ते । परिवित्तो वीरहणि । वीरहा ब्रह्महणि । तद्ब्रह्महणं नात्यच्यवत । अन्तर्वेदि निनयत्यवरुध्यै । उल्मुकेनाभि गृह्णाति शृतत्वाय । शृतकामा इव हि देवाः

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti sphyamādatte prasūtyai | aśvinorbāhubhyāmityāha | aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmityāha yatyai | ādada indrasya bāhurasi dakṣiṇa ityāha | indriyameva yajamāne dadhāti | sahasrabhṛṣṭiḥ śatatejā ityāha | rūpamevāsyaitanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | vāyurasi tigmatejā ityāha | tejo vai vāyuḥ
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इति स्फ्यमादत्ते प्रसूत्यै । अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यामित्याह । अश्विनौ हि देवानामध्वर्यू आस्ताम् । पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामित्याह यत्यै । आदद इन्द्रस्य बाहुरसि दक्षिण इत्याह । इन्द्रियमेव यजमाने दधाति । सहस्रभृष्टिः शततेजा इत्याह । रूपमेवास्यैतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । वायुरसि तिग्मतेजा इत्याह । तेजो वै वायुः

sanskrit_iast: teja evāsmindadhāti | viṣādvai nāmāsura āsīt | so'bibhet | yajñena mā devā abhibhaviṣyantīti | sa pṛthivīmabhyavamīt | sā'medhyā'bhavat | atho yadindro vṛtramahann | tasya lohitaṃ pṛthivīmanu vyadhāvat | sā'medhyā'bhavat | pṛthivi deva yajanītyāha
meaning: तेज एवास्मिन्दधाति । विषाद्वै नामासुर आसीत् । सोऽबिभेत् । यज्ञेन मा देवा अभिभविष्यन्तीति । स पृथिवीमभ्यवमीत् । साऽमेध्याऽभवत् । अथो यदिन्द्रो वृत्रमहन्न् । तस्य लोहितं पृथिवीमनु व्यधावत् । साऽमेध्याऽभवत् । पृथिवि देव यजनीत्याह

sanskrit_iast: medhyāmevaināṃ devayajanīṃ karoti | oṣadhyāste mūlaṃ mā hiṃsiṣamityāha | oṣadhīnāmahiṃsāyai | vrajaṃ gaccha gosthānamityāha | chandāṃsi vai vrajo gosthānaḥ | chandāṃsyevāsmai vrajaṃ gosthānaṃ karoti | varṣatu te dyaurityāha | vṛṣṭirvai dyauḥ | vṛṣṭimevāvarundhe | badhāna deva savitaḥ paramasyāṃ parāvatītyāha
meaning: मेध्यामेवैनां देवयजनीं करोति । ओषध्यास्ते मूलं मा हिंसिषमित्याह । ओषधीनामहिंसायै । व्रजं गच्छ गोस्थानमित्याह । छन्दांसि वै व्रजो गोस्थानः । छन्दांस्येवास्मै व्रजं गोस्थानं करोति । वर्षतु ते द्यौरित्याह । वृष्टिर्वै द्यौः । वृष्टिमेवावरुन्धे । बधान देव सवितः परमस्यां परावतीत्याह

sanskrit_iast: dvau vāva puruṣau | yaṃ caiva dveṣṭi | yaścainaṃ dveṣṭi | tāvubhau badhnāti paramasyāṃ parāvati śatena pāśaiḥ | yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmastamato mā maugityāhānimruktyai | ararurvai nāmāsura āsīt | sa pṛthivyāmupamlupto'śayat | taṃ devā apahato'raruḥ pṛthivyā iti pṛthivyā apāghnann | bhrātṛvyo vā araruḥ | apahato'raruḥ pṛthivyā iti yadāha
meaning: द्वौ वाव पुरुषौ । यं चैव द्वेष्टि । यश्चैनं द्वेष्टि । तावुभौ बध्नाति परमस्यां परावति शतेन पाशैः । योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस्तमतो मा मौगित्याहानिम्रुक्त्यै । अररुर्वै नामासुर आसीत् । स पृथिव्यामुपम्लुप्तोऽशयत् । तं देवा अपहतोऽररुः पृथिव्या इति पृथिव्या अपाघ्नन्न् । भ्रातृव्यो वा अररुः । अपहतोऽररुः पृथिव्या इति यदाह
text_mt:
there are two men:
he whom he hates
and he who hates him;
he binds both of them in the furthest distance with a hundred fetters.
‘He who hates us and whom we hate, release him not from thence,’ he says so that there is no escape.
There was an asura named Araru;
he lay hiding on the earth.
The gods struck him away from the earth, saying: ‘Araru is struck away from the earth.’
Araru is the rival.
When he says, ‘Araru is struck away from the earth,’

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛvyameva pṛthivyā apahanti | te'manyanta | divaṃ vā ayamitaḥ patiṣyatīti | tamararuste divaṃ mā skāniti divaḥ paryabādhanta | bhrātṛvyo vā araruḥ | araruste divaṃ mā skāniti yadāha | bhrātṛvyameva divaḥ paribādhate | stambayajur harati | pṛthivyā eva bhrātṛvyamapahanti | dvitīyaṃ harati
meaning: भ्रातृव्यमेव पृथिव्या अपहन्ति । तेऽमन्यन्त । दिवं वा अयमितः पतिष्यतीति । तमररुस्ते दिवं मा स्कानिति दिवः पर्यबाधन्त । भ्रातृव्यो वा अररुः । अररुस्ते दिवं मा स्कानिति यदाह । भ्रातृव्यमेव दिवः परिबाधते । स्तम्बयजुर् हरति । पृथिव्या एव भ्रातृव्यमपहन्ति । द्वितीयं हरति
text_mt:
he strikes the rival away from the earth.
They thought:
‘He will fly up from here to heaven.’
They warded him off from heaven, saying: ‘May Araru not leap to heaven for thee.’
Araru is the rival.
When he says: ‘May Araru not leap to heaven for thee,’
he wards off the rival from heaven.
He carries away the grass-stems [cut] with yajus;
he strikes the rival away from the earth.
He carries away a second [handful];

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣādevainamapahanti | tṛtīyaṃ harati | diva evainamapahanti | tūṣṇīṃ caturthaṃ harati | aparimitādevainamapahanti | asurāṇāṃ vā iyamagra āsīt | yāvadāsīnaḥ parāpaśyati | tāvaddevānām | te devā abruvan | astveva no syāmapīti
meaning: अन्तरिक्षादेवैनमपहन्ति । तृतीयं हरति । दिव एवैनमपहन्ति । तूष्णीं चतुर्थं हरति । अपरिमितादेवैनमपहन्ति । असुराणां वा इयमग्र आसीत् । यावदासीनः परापश्यति । तावद्देवानाम् । ते देवा अब्रुवन् । अस्त्वेव नो स्यामपीति

sanskrit_iast: kyanno dāsyatheti | yāvathsvayaṃ parigṛhṇītheti | te vasavastveti dakṣiṇataḥ paryagṛhṇann | rudrāstveti paścāt | ādityāstvetyuttarataḥ | te'gninā prāñco'jayann | vasubhirdakṣiṇā | rudraiḥ pratyañcaḥ | ādityairudañcaḥ | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo vediṃ parigṛhṇanti
meaning: क्यन्नो दास्यथेति । यावथ्स्वयं परिगृह्णीथेति । ते वसवस्त्वेति दक्षिणतः पर्यगृह्णन्न् । रुद्रास्त्वेति पश्चात् । आदित्यास्त्वेत्युत्तरतः । तेऽग्निना प्राञ्चोऽजयन्न् । वसुभिर्दक्षिणा । रुद्रैः प्रत्यञ्चः । आदित्यैरुदञ्चः । यस्यैवं विदुषो वेदिं परिगृह्णन्ति

sanskrit_iast: bhavatyātmanā | parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | devasya savituḥ sava ityāha prasūtyai | karma kṛṇvanti vedhasa ityāha | iṣitaṃ hi karma kriyate | pṛthivyai medhyaṃ cāmedhyaṃ ca vyudakrāmatām | prācīnamudīcīnaṃ medhyam | pratīcīnaṃ dakṣiṇā'medhyam | prācīmudīcīṃ pravaṇāṃ karoti | medhyāmevaināṃ devayajanīṃ karoti
meaning: भवत्यात्मना । पराऽस्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति । देवस्य सवितुः सव इत्याह प्रसूत्यै । कर्म कृण्वन्ति वेधस इत्याह । इषितं हि कर्म क्रियते । पृथिव्यै मेध्यं चामेध्यं च व्युदक्रामताम् । प्राचीनमुदीचीनं मेध्यम् । प्रतीचीनं दक्षिणाऽमेध्यम् । प्राचीमुदीचीं प्रवणां करोति । मेध्यामेवैनां देवयजनीं करोति

sanskrit_iast: prāñcau vedyaṃsāvunnayati | āhavanīyasya parigṛhītyai | praticī śroṇī | gārhapatyasya parigṛhītyai | atho mithunatvāya | uddhanti | yadevāsyā amedhyam | tadapahanti | uddhanti | tasmādoṣadhayaḥ parābhavanti
meaning: प्राञ्चौ वेद्यंसावुन्नयति । आहवनीयस्य परिगृहीत्यै । प्रतिची श्रोणी । गार्हपत्यस्य परिगृहीत्यै । अथो मिथुनत्वाय । उद्धन्ति । यदेवास्या अमेध्यम् । तदपहन्ति । उद्धन्ति । तस्मादोषधयः पराभवन्ति

sanskrit_iast: mūlaṃ chinatti | bhrātṛvyasyaiva mūlaṃ chinatti | mūlaṃ vā atitiṣṭhadrakṣāṃsyanūtpipate | yaddhastena chindyāt | kunakhinīḥ prajāḥ syuḥ | sphyena chinatti | vajro vai sphyaḥ | vajreṇaiva yajñādrakṣāṃsyapahanti | pitṛdevatyā'tikhātā | iyatīṃ khanati
meaning: मूलं छिनत्ति । भ्रातृव्यस्यैव मूलं छिनत्ति । मूलं वा अतितिष्ठद्रक्षांस्यनूत्पिपते । यद्धस्तेन छिन्द्यात् । कुनखिनीः प्रजाः स्युः । स्फ्येन छिनत्ति । वज्रो वै स्फ्यः । वज्रेणैव यज्ञाद्रक्षांस्यपहन्ति । पितृदेवत्याऽतिखाता । इयतीं खनति

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatinā yajñamukhena saṃmitām | vedirdevebhyo nilāyata | tāṃ caturaṅgule'nvavindann | tasmāccaturaṅgulaṃ kheyā | caturaṅgulaṃ khanati | caturaṅgule hyoṣadhayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti | āpratiṣṭhāyai khanati | yajamānameva pratiṣṭhāṃ gamayati | dakṣiṇato varṣīyasīṃ karoti | devayajanasyaiva rūpamakaḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिना यज्ञमुखेन संमिताम् । वेदिर्देवेभ्यो निलायत । तां चतुरङ्गुलेऽन्वविन्दन्न् । तस्माच्चतुरङ्गुलं खेया । चतुरङ्गुलं खनति । चतुरङ्गुले ह्योषधयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । आप्रतिष्ठायै खनति । यजमानमेव प्रतिष्ठां गमयति । दक्षिणतो वर्षीयसीं करोति । देवयजनस्यैव रूपमकः

sanskrit_iast: purīṣavatīṃ karoti | prajā vai paśavaḥ purīṣam | prajayaivainaṃ paśubhiḥ purīṣavantaṃ karoti | uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti | etāvatī vai pṛthivī | yāvatī vediḥ | tasyā etāvata eva bhrātṛvyaṃ nirbhajya | ātmana uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti | ṛtamasyṛta sadanamasyṛta śrīrasītyāha | yathāyajurevaitat
meaning: पुरीषवतीं करोति । प्रजा वै पशवः पुरीषम् । प्रजयैवैनं पशुभिः पुरीषवन्तं करोति । उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति । एतावती वै पृथिवी । यावती वेदिः । तस्या एतावत एव भ्रातृव्यं निर्भज्य । आत्मन उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति । ऋतमस्यृत सदनमस्यृत श्रीरसीत्याह । यथायजुरेवैतत्
text_mt:
He makes it possessed of loose soil.
Loose soil is offspring and domestic animals.
He makes him possessed of loose soil through offspring and domestic animals.
He traces the northern boundary.
The earth is just as large
as the altar is.
Having excluded the rival from just this much of it,
he traces the northern boundary for himself.
'You are cosmic order, you are the seat of cosmic order, you are the beauty of cosmic order,' he says.
That is according to the formula.

sanskrit_iast: krūramiva vā etatkaroti | yadvediṃ karoti | dhā asi svadhā asīti yoyupyate śāntyai | urvī cāsi vasvī cāsītyāha | urvīmevaināṃ vasvīṃ karoti | purā krūrasya visṛpo viraphśinnityāha medhyatvāya | udādāya pṛthivīṃ jīradānuryāmairayañcandramasi svadhābhirityāha | yadevāsyā amedhyam | tadapahatya | medhyāṃ devayajanīṃ kṛtvā
meaning: क्रूरमिव वा एतत्करोति । यद्वेदिं करोति । धा असि स्वधा असीति योयुप्यते शान्त्यै । उर्वी चासि वस्वी चासीत्याह । उर्वीमेवैनां वस्वीं करोति । पुरा क्रूरस्य विसृपो विरफ्शिन्नित्याह मेध्यत्वाय । उदादाय पृथिवीं जीरदानुर्यामैरयञ्चन्द्रमसि स्वधाभिरित्याह । यदेवास्या अमेध्यम् । तदपहत्य । मेध्यां देवयजनीं कृत्वा
text_mt:
He performs what is cruel, as it were,
when he prepares the altar.
'You are nourishment, you are the ancestral oblation,' [with this formula] he smooths it down for appeasement.
'You are broad and you are good,' he says.
He makes it broad and good.
'Before the cruel one crept forth, O exuberant one,' he says for fitness for sacrifice.
'Taking up the earth, which the giver of life impelled into the moon with ancestral oblations,' he says;
whatever in it was unholy,
that having struck away,
having made it fit for sacrifice as the place of sacrifice for the gods,

sanskrit_iast: yadadaścandramasi medhyam | tadasyāmerayati | tāṃ dhīrāso anudṛśya yajanta ityāhānukhyātyai | prokṣaṇīrāsādaya | idhmābarhirupasādaya | sruvaṃ ca srucaśca saṃmṛḍhḍhi | patnīṃ saṃnahya | ājyenodehītyāhānupūrvatāyai | prokṣaṇīrāsādayati | āpo vai rakṣoghnīḥ
meaning: यददश्चन्द्रमसि मेध्यम् । तदस्यामेरयति । तां धीरासो अनुदृश्य यजन्त इत्याहानुख्यात्यै । प्रोक्षणीरासादय । इध्माबर्हिरुपसादय । स्रुवं च स्रुचश्च संमृढ्ढि । पत्नीं संनह्य । आज्येनोदेहीत्याहानुपूर्वतायै । प्रोक्षणीरासादयति । आपो वै रक्षोघ्नीः
text_mt:
that which is fit for sacrifice yonder in the moon,
that he impels into it.
'Discerning it, the wise offer sacrifice,' he says for clear perception.
'Set down the sprinkling waters!
Set near the kindling wood and sacrificial grass!
Cleanse the dipping spoon and the offering ladles!
Gird the wife!
Come up with the clarified butter!' he says for the sake of orderly sequence.
He sets down the sprinkling waters.
Waters are destroyers of the rakṣases;

sanskrit_iast: rakṣasāmapahatyai | sphyasya vartmanthsādayati | yajñasya saṃtatyai | uvāca hāsito daivalaḥ | etāvatīrvā amuṣmiṃ lloka āpa āsann | yāvatīḥ prokṣaṇīriti | tasmādbahvīrāsādyāḥ | sphyamudasyann | yaṃ dviṣyāttaṃ dhyāyet | śucaivainamarpayati
meaning: रक्षसामपहत्यै । स्फ्यस्य वर्त्मन्थ्सादयति । यज्ञस्य संतत्यै । उवाच हासितो दैवलः । एतावतीर्वा अमुष्मिं ल्लोक आप आसन्न् । यावतीः प्रोक्षणीरिति । तस्माद्बह्वीरासाद्याः । स्फ्यमुदस्यन्न् । यं द्विष्यात्तं ध्यायेत् । शुचैवैनमर्पयति
text_mt:
it is to strike away the rakṣases.
He sets [them] in the track of the wooden sword,
for the continuity of the sacrifice.
Asita Devala said:
'There were only so many waters in yonder world
as there are sprinkling waters.'
Therefore many [waters] should be set down.
Flourishing the wooden sword,
he should meditate upon whom he hates;
he afflicts him with torment.

sanskrit_iast: vajro vai sphyaḥ | yadanvañcaṃ dhārayet | vajre'dhvaryuḥ kṣaṇvīta | purastāttiryañcaṃ dhārayati | vajro vai sphyaḥ | vajreṇaiva yajñasya dakṣiṇato rakṣāṃsyapahanti | agnibhyāṃ prācaśca pratīcaśca | sphyenodīcaścādharācaśca | sphyena vā eṣa vajreṇāsyai pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyamapahatya | utkare'dhi pravṛścati
meaning: वज्रो वै स्फ्यः । यदन्वञ्चं धारयेत् । वज्रेऽध्वर्युः क्षण्वीत । पुरस्तात्तिर्यञ्चं धारयति । वज्रो वै स्फ्यः । वज्रेणैव यज्ञस्य दक्षिणतो रक्षांस्यपहन्ति । अग्निभ्यां प्राचश्च प्रतीचश्च । स्फ्येनोदीचश्चाधराचश्च । स्फ्येन वा एष वज्रेणास्यै पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यमपहत्य । उत्करेऽधि प्रवृश्चति
text_mt:
The wooden sword is a thunderbolt.
If he should hold it pointing lengthwise,
the Adhvaryu would injure himself on the thunderbolt.
He holds it crosswise in front.
The wooden sword is a thunderbolt.
With the thunderbolt he strikes away the rakṣases to the south of the sacrifice:
with the two fires, those in the east and the west;
with the wooden sword, those in the north and down below.
With the wooden sword as a thunderbolt, having struck away evil, his rival,
he cuts [him] down onto the rubbish heap,

sanskrit_iast: yathopadhāya vṛścantyevam | hastāvavanenikte | ātmānameva pavayate | sphyaṃ prakṣālayati medhyatvāya | atho pāpmana eva bhrātṛvyasya nyaṅgaṃ chinatti | idhmābarhirupasādayati yuktyai | yajñasya mithunatvāya | atho purorucamevaitāṃ dadhāti | uttarasya karmaṇo'nukhyātyai | na purastātpratyagupasādayet
meaning: यथोपधाय वृश्चन्त्येवम् । हस्ताववनेनिक्ते । आत्मानमेव पवयते । स्फ्यं प्रक्षालयति मेध्यत्वाय । अथो पाप्मन एव भ्रातृव्यस्य न्यङ्गं छिनत्ति । इध्माबर्हिरुपसादयति युक्त्यै । यज्ञस्य मिथुनत्वाय । अथो पुरोरुचमेवैतां दधाति । उत्तरस्य कर्मणोऽनुख्यात्यै । न पुरस्तात्प्रत्यगुपसादयेत्
text_mt:
just as they cut down [a victim] having laid it on a block.
He washes his hands;
he purifies himself.
He rinses the wooden sword for fitness for sacrifice;
then he cuts away the trace of evil, the rival.
He sets near the kindling wood and sacrificial grass for joining,
for forming a pair in the sacrifice.
Then he establishes this as a preliminary illumination,
for the clear perception of the subsequent ritual action.
He should not set them near from east to west.

sanskrit_iast: yatpurastātpratyagupasādayet | anyatrā''hutipathādidhmaṃ pratipādayet | prajā vai barhiḥ | aparādhnuyādbarhiṣā prajānāṃ prajananam | paścātprāgupasādayati | āhutipathenedhmaṃ pratipādayati | saṃpratyeva barhiṣā prajānāṃ prajananamupaiti | dakṣiṇamidhmam | uttaraṃ barhiḥ | ātmā vā idhmaḥ | prajā barhiḥ | prajā hyātmana uttaratarā tīrthe | tato medhamupanīya | yathādevatamevainatpratiṣṭhāpayati | pratitiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhiryajamānaḥ
meaning: यत्पुरस्तात्प्रत्यगुपसादयेत् । अन्यत्रा'ऽहुतिपथादिध्मं प्रतिपादयेत् । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । अपराध्नुयाद्बर्हिषा प्रजानां प्रजननम् । पश्चात्प्रागुपसादयति । आहुतिपथेनेध्मं प्रतिपादयति । संप्रत्येव बर्हिषा प्रजानां प्रजननमुपैति । दक्षिणमिध्मम् । उत्तरं बर्हिः । आत्मा वा इध्मः । प्रजा बर्हिः । प्रजा ह्यात्मन उत्तरतरा तीर्थे । ततो मेधमुपनीय । यथादेवतमेवैनत्प्रतिष्ठापयति । प्रतितिष्ठति प्रजया पशुभिर्यजमानः

sanskrit_iast: pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | agnervastejiṣṭhena tejasā niṣṭapāmītyāha medhyatvāya | srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi | sruvamagre | pumāṃsamevābhyaḥ saṃśyati mithunatvāya | atha juhūm | athopabhṛtam | atha dhruvām | asau vai juhūḥ
meaning: प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रत्युष्टा अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अग्नेर्वस्तेजिष्ठेन तेजसा निष्टपामीत्याह मेध्यत्वाय । स्रुचः संमार्ष्टि । स्रुवमग्रे । पुमांसमेवाभ्यः संश्यति मिथुनत्वाय । अथ जुहूम् । अथोपभृतम् । अथ ध्रुवाम् । असौ वै जुहूः

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣamupabhṛt | pṛthivī dhruvā | ime vai lokāḥ srucaḥ | vṛṣṭiḥ saṃmārjanāni | vṛṣṭirvā imān lokānanupūrvaṃ kalpayati | te tataḥ klṛptāḥ samedhante | samedhante'smā ime lokāḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ | ya evaṃ veda | yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāditi | agrataḥ saṃmṛjyāt
meaning: अन्तरिक्षमुपभृत् । पृथिवी ध्रुवा । इमे वै लोकाः स्रुचः । वृष्टिः संमार्जनानि । वृष्टिर्वा इमान् लोकाननुपूर्वं कल्पयति । ते ततः क्लृप्ताः समेधन्ते । समेधन्तेऽस्मा इमे लोकाः प्रजया पशुभिः । य एवं वेद । यदि कामयेत वर्षुकः पर्जन्यः स्यादिति । अग्रतः संमृज्यात्

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭimeva niyacchati | avācīnāgrā hi vṛṣṭiḥ | yadi kāmayetāvarṣukaḥ syāditi | mūlataḥ saṃmṛjyāt | vṛṣṭimevodyacchati | tadu vā āhuḥ | agrata evopariṣṭāthsaṃmṛjyāt | mūlato'dhastāt | tadanupūrvaṃ kalpate | varṣuko bhavatīti
meaning: वृष्टिमेव नियच्छति । अवाचीनाग्रा हि वृष्टिः । यदि कामयेतावर्षुकः स्यादिति । मूलतः संमृज्यात् । वृष्टिमेवोद्यच्छति । तदु वा आहुः । अग्रत एवोपरिष्टाथ्संमृज्यात् । मूलतोऽधस्तात् । तदनुपूर्वं कल्पते । वर्षुको भवतीति
text_mt:
He directs the rain downwards,
for rain has its tip turned downwards.
If he should desire that he should not rain,
he should cleanse from the root;
he lifts up the rain.
Concerning that, however, they say:
He should cleanse from the tip above,
and from the root below.
That is arranged in proper sequence;
[the god] becomes rainy.

sanskrit_iast: prācīmabhyākāram | agrairantarataḥ | evamiva hyannamadyate | atho agrādvā oṣadhīnāmūrjaṃ prajā upajīvanti | ūrja evānnādyasyāvarudhyai | adhastātpratīcīm | daṇḍamuttamataḥ | mūlena mūlaṃ pratiṣṭhityai | tasmādaratnau prāñcyupariṣṭāllomāni | pratyañcyadhastāt
meaning: प्राचीमभ्याकारम् । अग्रैरन्तरतः । एवमिव ह्यन्नमद्यते । अथो अग्राद्वा ओषधीनामूर्जं प्रजा उपजीवन्ति । ऊर्ज एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै । अधस्तात्प्रतीचीम् । दण्डमुत्तमतः । मूलेन मूलं प्रतिष्ठित्यै । तस्मादरत्नौ प्राञ्च्युपरिष्टाल्लोमानि । प्रत्यञ्च्यधस्तात्
text_mt:
[He cleanses it] pointing eastward, drawing it toward [himself],
with the tips on the inside;
for food is eaten in this manner, as it were.
Moreover, offspring sustain life upon the vigor of plants from the tip;
[it is done] for the securing of vigor and food.
[He cleanses] the underside pointing westward,
the handle last of all,
root to root for stability.
Therefore the hairs on the forearm point eastward on the upper side,
and westward on the underside.

sanskrit_iast: srugghyeṣā | prāṇo vai sruvaḥ | juhūrdakṣiṇo hastaḥ | upabhṛthsavyaḥ | ātmā dhruvā | annaṃ saṃmārjanāni | mukhato vai prāṇo'pāno bhūtvā | ātmānamannaṃ praviśya | bāhyatastanuvaṃ śubhayati | tasmāthsruvamevāgre saṃmārṣṭi | mukhato hi prāṇo'pāno bhūtvā | ātmānamannamāviśati | tau prāṇāpānau | avyardhukaḥ prāṇāpānābhyāṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: स्रुग्घ्येषा । प्राणो वै स्रुवः । जुहूर्दक्षिणो हस्तः । उपभृथ्सव्यः । आत्मा ध्रुवा । अन्नं संमार्जनानि । मुखतो वै प्राणोऽपानो भूत्वा । आत्मानमन्नं प्रविश्य । बाह्यतस्तनुवं शुभयति । तस्माथ्स्रुवमेवाग्रे संमार्ष्टि । मुखतो हि प्राणोऽपानो भूत्वा । आत्मानमन्नमाविशति । तौ प्राणापानौ । अव्यर्धुकः प्राणापानाभ्यां भवति । य एवं वेद

sanskrit_iast: divaḥ śilpamavatatam | pṛthivyāḥ kakubhi śritam | tena vayaṃ sahasravalśena | sapatnaṃ nāśayāmasi svāheti srukhsaṃmārjanānyagnau praharati | āpo vai darbhāḥ | rūpamevaiṣāmetanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | anuṣṭubharcā | ānuṣṭubhaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prājāpatyo vedaḥ | vedasyāgragg srukhsaṃmārjanāni
meaning: दिवः शिल्पमवततम् । पृथिव्याः ककुभि श्रितम् । तेन वयं सहस्रवल्शेन । सपत्नं नाशयामसि स्वाहेति स्रुख्संमार्जनान्यग्नौ प्रहरति । आपो वै दर्भाः । रूपमेवैषामेतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । अनुष्टुभर्चा । आनुष्टुभः प्रजापतिः । प्राजापत्यो वेदः । वेदस्याग्रग्ग् स्रुख्संमार्जनानि

sanskrit_iast: svenaivaināni chandasā | svayā devatayā samardhayati | atho ṛgvāva yoṣā | darbho vṛṣā | tanmithunam | mithunamevāsya tadyajñe karoti prajananāya | prajāyate prajayā paśubhiryajamānaḥ | tānyeke vṛthaivāpāsyanti | tattathā na kāryam | ārabdhasya yajñiyasya karmaṇaḥ saḥ vidohaḥ
meaning: स्वेनैवैनानि छन्दसा । स्वया देवतया समर्धयति । अथो ऋग्वाव योषा । दर्भो वृषा । तन्मिथुनम् । मिथुनमेवास्य तद्यज्ञे करोति प्रजननाय । प्रजायते प्रजया पशुभिर्यजमानः । तान्येके वृथैवापास्यन्ति । तत्तथा न कार्यम् । आरब्धस्य यज्ञियस्य कर्मणः सः विदोहः

sanskrit_iast: yadyenāni paśavo'bhitiṣṭheyuḥ | na tatpaśubhyaḥ kam | adbhirmārjayitvotkare nyasyet | yadvai yajñiyasya karmaṇo'nyatrāhutībhyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate | utkaro vāva tasya pratiṣṭhā | etāṃ hi tasmai pratiṣṭhāṃ devāḥ samabharan | yadadbhirmārjayati | tena śāntam | yadutkare nyasyati | pratiṣṭhāmevaināni tadgamayati
meaning: यद्येनानि पशवोऽभितिष्ठेयुः । न तत्पशुभ्यः कम् । अद्भिर्मार्जयित्वोत्करे न्यस्येत् । यद्वै यज्ञियस्य कर्मणोऽन्यत्राहुतीभ्यः संतिष्ठते । उत्करो वाव तस्य प्रतिष्ठा । एतां हि तस्मै प्रतिष्ठां देवाः समभरन् । यदद्भिर्मार्जयति । तेन शान्तम् । यदुत्करे न्यस्यति । प्रतिष्ठामेवैनानि तद्गमयति
text_mt: If domestic animals were to step upon them, / that would not be pleasant for the domestic animals. / Having wiped them with water, he should throw them down on the rubbish-heap. / When anything of a sacrificial act remains over, other than the oblations, / the rubbish-heap is indeed its firm foundation. / For the gods brought together this firm foundation for it. / In that he wipes them with water, / thereby it is appeased. / In that he throws them down on the rubbish-heap, / he thereby causes them to go to their firm foundation.

sanskrit_iast: pratitiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhiryajamānaḥ | atho stambasya vā etadrūpam | yathsrukhsaṃmārjanāni | stambaśo vā oṣadhayaḥ | tāsāṃ jaratkakṣe paśavo na ramante | apriyo hyeṣāṃ jaratkakṣaḥ | yāvadapriyo ha vai jaratkakṣaḥ paśūnām | tāvadapriyaḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati | yasyaitānyanyatrāgnerdadhati | navadāvyāsu vā oṣadhīṣu paśavo ramante
meaning: प्रतितिष्ठति प्रजया पशुभिर्यजमानः । अथो स्तम्बस्य वा एतद्रूपम् । यथ्स्रुख्संमार्जनानि । स्तम्बशो वा ओषधयः । तासां जरत्कक्षे पशवो न रमन्ते । अप्रियो ह्येषां जरत्कक्षः । यावदप्रियो ह वै जरत्कक्षः पशूनाम् । तावदप्रियः पशूनां भवति । यस्यैतान्यन्यत्राग्नेर्दधति । नवदाव्यासु वा ओषधीषु पशवो रमन्ते
text_mt: The sacrificer stands firm with offspring and domestic animals. / Moreover, this is the form of a clump of grass, / namely the ladle-wipers. / Plants indeed [grow] in clumps. / In their dry thicket domestic animals do not take pleasure; / for a dry thicket is unpleasant to them. / As unpleasant as a dry thicket is to domestic animals, / so unpleasant becomes [the sacrificer] to domestic animals / whose [wipers] they place elsewhere than in the fire. / But in plants springing up anew after fire domestic animals take pleasure;

sanskrit_iast: navadāvo hyeṣāṃ priyaḥ | yāvatpriyo ha vai navadāvaḥ paśūnām | tāvatpriyaḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati | yasyaitānyagnau praharanti | tasmādetānyagnāveva praharet | yatarasminthsaṃmṛjyāt | paśūnāṃ dhṛtyai | yo bhūtānāmadhipatiḥ | rudrastanticaro vṛṣā | paśūnasmākaṃ mā hiṃsīḥ | etadastu hutaṃ tava svāhetyagnisaṃmārjanānyagnau praharati | eṣā vā eteṣāṃ yoniḥ | eṣā pratiṣṭhā | svāmevaināni yonim | svāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ gamayati | pratitiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhiryajamānaḥ
meaning: नवदावो ह्येषां प्रियः । यावत्प्रियो ह वै नवदावः पशूनाम् । तावत्प्रियः पशूनां भवति । यस्यैतान्यग्नौ प्रहरन्ति । तस्मादेतान्यग्नावेव प्रहरेत् । यतरस्मिन्थ्संमृज्यात् । पशूनां धृत्यै । यो भूतानामधिपतिः । रुद्रस्तन्तिचरो वृषा । पशूनस्माकं मा हिंसीः । एतदस्तु हुतं तव स्वाहेत्यग्निसंमार्जनान्यग्नौ प्रहरति । एषा वा एतेषां योनिः । एषा प्रतिष्ठा । स्वामेवैनानि योनिम् । स्वां प्रतिष्ठां गमयति । प्रतितिष्ठति प्रजया पशुभिर्यजमानः
text_mt: for fresh pasture after fire is dear to them. / As dear as fresh pasture after fire is to domestic animals, / so dear becomes [the sacrificer] to domestic animals / whose [wipers] they cast into the fire. / Therefore he should cast them right into the fire, / in whichever [fire] he wipes [the spoons], / for the holding-fast of domestic animals. / 'He who is the overlord of beings, / Rudra who wanders on the tether, the bull— / do not injure our domestic animals! / Let this be sacrificed to you, svāhā!' Saying this, he casts the fire-wipers into the fire. / This indeed is their womb; / this is their firm foundation. / He causes them to go to their own womb, / to their own firm foundation. / The sacrificer stands firm with offspring and domestic animals.

sanskrit_iast: ayajño vā eṣaḥ | yo'patnīkaḥ | na prajāḥ prajāyeran | patnyanvāste | yajñamevākaḥ | prajānāṃ prajananāya | yattiṣṭhantī saṃnahyeta | priyaṃ jñātiṃ rundhyāt | āsīnā saṃnahyate | āsīnā hyeṣā vīryaṃ karoti
meaning: अयज्ञो वा एषः । योऽपत्नीकः । न प्रजाः प्रजायेरन् । पत्न्यन्वास्ते । यज्ञमेवाकः । प्रजानां प्रजननाय । यत्तिष्ठन्ती संनह्येत । प्रियं ज्ञातिं रुन्ध्यात् । आसीना संनह्यते । आसीना ह्येषा वीर्यं करोति
text_mt: He is indeed without sacrifice / who is without a wife. / Offspring would not be brought forth. / The wife sits nearby: / he has thereby made the sacrifice / for the bringing forth of offspring. / If she were to be girded while standing, / she would exclude a dear kinsman. / She is girded while seated; / for while seated she produces heroic power.

sanskrit_iast: yatpaścātprācyanvāsīta | anayā samadaṃ dadhīta | devānāṃ patniyā samadaṃ dadhīta | deśāddakṣiṇata udīcyanvāste | ātmano gopīthāya | āśāsānā saumanasamityāha | medhyāmevaināṃ kevalīṃ kṛtvā | āśiṣā samardhayati | agneranuvratā bhūtvā saṃnahye sukṛtāya kamityāha | etadvai patniyai vratopanayanam
meaning: यत्पश्चात्प्राच्यन्वासीत । अनया समदं दधीत । देवानां पत्निया समदं दधीत । देशाद्दक्षिणत उदीच्यन्वास्ते । आत्मनो गोपीथाय । आशासाना सौमनसमित्याह । मेध्यामेवैनां केवलीं कृत्वा । आशिषा समर्धयति । अग्नेरनुव्रता भूत्वा संनह्ये सुकृताय कमित्याह । एतद्वै पत्नियै व्रतोपनयनम्
text_mt: If she were to sit behind [the fires] facing east, / she would enter into conflict with this [earth]; / she would enter into conflict with the wife of the gods. / She sits south of the place, facing north, / for the protection of herself. / 'Praying for favor,' she says; / having made her fit for sacrifice and single-minded, / he enriches her with a blessing. / 'Having become obedient to Agni, I gird myself for good deeds,' she says. / This indeed is the initiation into the vow for the wife.

sanskrit_iast: tenaivaināṃ vratamupanayati | tasmādāhuḥ | yaścaivaṃ veda yaśca na | yoktrameva yute | yamanvāste | tasyāmuṣmiṃ lloke bhavatīti yoktreṇa | yadyoktram | sa yogaḥ | yadāste | sa kṣemaḥ
meaning: तेनैवैनां व्रतमुपनयति । तस्मादाहुः । यश्चैवं वेद यश्च न । योक्त्रमेव युते । यमन्वास्ते । तस्यामुष्मिं ल्लोके भवतीति योक्त्रेण । यद्योक्त्रम् । स योगः । यदास्ते । स क्षेमः
text_mt: By this he initiates her into the vow. / Therefore they say: / 'Both he who knows thus and he who does not— / the girdle is tied; / [the wife] who sits nearby him, / becomes his in yonder world by the girdle.' / In that it is a girdle (yoktra), / that is acquisition (yoga). / In that she sits, / that is preservation (kṣema).

sanskrit_iast: yogakṣemasya klṛptyai | yuktaṃ kriyātā āśīḥkāme yujyātā iti | āśiṣaḥ samṛddhyai | granthiṃ grathnāti | āśiṣa evāsyāṃ parigṛhṇāti | pumān vai granthiḥ | strī patnī | tanmithunam | mithunamevāsya tadyajñe karoti prajananāya | prajāyate prajayā paśubhiryajamānaḥ
meaning: योगक्षेमस्य क्लृप्त्यै । युक्तं क्रियाता आशीःकामे युज्याता इति । आशिषः समृद्ध्यै । ग्रन्थिं ग्रथ्नाति । आशिष एवास्यां परिगृह्णाति । पुमान् वै ग्रन्थिः । स्त्री पत्नी । तन्मिथुनम् । मिथुनमेवास्य तद्यज्ञे करोति प्रजननाय । प्रजायते प्रजया पशुभिर्यजमानः
text_mt: For the accomplishment of acquisition and preservation. / 'May the blessing be undertaken, may it be joined to desire,' he says, / for the success of the blessing. / He ties a knot; / he thereby fastens the blessings upon her. / The knot is male, / the wife is female: / that is a pair. / A pair he thereby makes in his sacrifice for propagation. / The sacrificer propagates with offspring and domestic animals.

sanskrit_iast: atho ardho vā eṣa ātmanaḥ | yatpatnī | yajñasya dhṛtyā aśithilaṃ bhāvāya | suprajasastvā vayaṃ supatnīrupasedimetyāha | yajñameva tanmithunī karoti | ūne'tiriktaṃ dhīyātā iti prajātyai | mahīnāṃ payo'syoṣadhīnāṃ rasa ityāha | rūpamevāsyaitanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | tasya te'kṣīyamāṇasya nirvapāmi devayajyāyā ityāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste
meaning: अथो अर्धो वा एष आत्मनः । यत्पत्नी । यज्ञस्य धृत्या अशिथिलं भावाय । सुप्रजसस्त्वा वयं सुपत्नीरुपसेदिमेत्याह । यज्ञमेव तन्मिथुनी करोति । ऊनेऽतिरिक्तं धीयाता इति प्रजात्यै । महीनां पयोऽस्योषधीनां रस इत्याह । रूपमेवास्यैतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । तस्य तेऽक्षीयमाणस्य निर्वपामि देवयज्याया इत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते
text_mt: Moreover, she is half of oneself, / namely the wife, / for the holding-fast of the sacrifice, that it may not become slack. / 'With good offspring, we have approached you, having good wives,' she says; / thereby she makes the sacrifice paired. / 'Let the excess be put into the deficient,' so [he acts] for procreation. / 'You are the milk of the great ones, the sap of the plants,' she says; / she thereby explains its form and majesty. / 'For the worship of the gods, I pour you out, who are undecaying,' she says; / she thereby invokes this blessing.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtaṃ ca vai madhu ca prajāpatirāsīt | yato madhvāsīt | tataḥ prajā asṛjata | tasmānmadhuṣi prajananamivāsti | tasmānmadhuṣā na pracaranti | yātayāma hi | ājyena pracaranti | yajño vā ājyam | yajñenaiva yajñaṃ pracarantyayātayāmatvāya | patnyavekṣate
meaning: घृतं च वै मधु च प्रजापतिरासीत् । यतो मध्वासीत् । ततः प्रजा असृजत । तस्मान्मधुषि प्रजननमिवास्ति । तस्मान्मधुषा न प्रचरन्ति । यातयाम हि । आज्येन प्रचरन्ति । यज्ञो वा आज्यम् । यज्ञेनैव यज्ञं प्रचरन्त्ययातयामत्वाय । पत्न्यवेक्षते
text_mt: Prajāpati was both ghee and honey. / From where honey was, / from there he created offspring. / Therefore in honey there is, as it were, generative power. / Therefore they do not perform rites with honey; / for it is stale. / They perform rites with clarified butter. / Clarified butter is the sacrifice; / with the sacrifice they perform the sacrifice so that it is not stale. / The wife looks at it,

sanskrit_iast: mithunatvāya prajātyai | yadvai patnī yajñasya karoti | mithunaṃ tat | atho patniyā evaiṣa yajñasyānvārambho'navacchittyai | amedhyaṃ vā etatkaroti | yatpatnyavekṣate | gārhapatye'dhiśrayati medhyatvāya | āhavanīyamabhyuddravati | yajñasya santatyai | tejo'si tejo'nu prehītyāha
meaning: मिथुनत्वाय प्रजात्यै । यद्वै पत्नी यज्ञस्य करोति । मिथुनं तत् । अथो पत्निया एवैष यज्ञस्यान्वारम्भोऽनवच्छित्त्यै । अमेध्यं वा एतत्करोति । यत्पत्न्यवेक्षते । गार्हपत्येऽधिश्रयति मेध्यत्वाय । आहवनीयमभ्युद्द्रवति । यज्ञस्य सन्तत्यै । तेजोऽसि तेजोऽनु प्रेहीत्याह
text_mt: for pairing, for procreation. / What the wife does in the sacrifice, / that is a pair. / Moreover, this is the wife’s taking hold of the sacrifice, that there be no disruption. / Unfit for sacrifice she makes it, / in that the wife looks at it. / He sets it over the Gārhapatya [fire] to make it fit for sacrifice. / He runs toward the Āhavanīya [fire], / for the continuity of the sacrifice. / 'You are fiery energy; go after fiery energy,' he says.

sanskrit_iast: tejo vā agniḥ | teja ājyam | tejasaiva tejaḥ samardhayati | agniste tejo mā vinaidityāhāhiṃsāyai | sphyasya vartmanthsādayati | yajñasya santatyai | agnerjihvā'si subhūrdevānāmityāha | yathāyajurevaitat | dhāmne dhāmne devebhyo yajuṣe yajuṣe bhavetyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste
meaning: तेजो वा अग्निः । तेज आज्यम् । तेजसैव तेजः समर्धयति । अग्निस्ते तेजो मा विनैदित्याहाहिंसायै । स्फ्यस्य वर्त्मन्थ्सादयति । यज्ञस्य सन्तत्यै । अग्नेर्जिह्वाऽसि सुभूर्देवानामित्याह । यथायजुरेवैतत् । धाम्ने धाम्ने देवेभ्यो यजुषे यजुषे भवेत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते
text_mt: Fiery energy is Agni; / fiery energy is clarified butter. / With fiery energy he enriches fiery energy. / 'May Agni not take away your fiery energy,' he says, for non-injury. / He sets it down in the furrow of the wooden sword, / for the continuity of the sacrifice. / 'You are the tongue of Agni, the good abode of the gods,' he says; / this is just according to the Yajus. / 'For every abode, for the gods, for every yajus, be present,' he says; / he thereby invokes this blessing.

sanskrit_iast: tadvā ataḥ pavitrābhyāmevotpunāti | yajamāno vā ājyam | prāṇāpānau pavitre | yajamāna eva prāṇāpānau dadhāti | punarāhāram | evamiva hi prāṇāpānau saṃcarataḥ | śukramasi jyotirasi tejo'sītyāha | rūpamevāsyaitanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | triryajuṣā | traya ime lokāḥ
meaning: तद्वा अतः पवित्राभ्यामेवोत्पुनाति । यजमानो वा आज्यम् । प्राणापानौ पवित्रे । यजमान एव प्राणापानौ दधाति । पुनराहारम् । एवमिव हि प्राणापानौ संचरतः । शुक्रमसि ज्योतिरसि तेजोऽसीत्याह । रूपमेवास्यैतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । त्रिर्यजुषा । त्रय इमे लोकाः
text_mt: Then, from here, he purifies it with two strainers. / Clarified butter is the sacrificer; / the two strainers are exhalation and inhalation. / He places exhalation and inhalation into the sacrificer / repeatedly; / for exhalation and inhalation circulate in just this way. / 'You are the bright, you are light, you are fiery energy,' he says; / he thereby explains its form and majesty. / Three times with a yajus; / three are these worlds,

sanskrit_iast: eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | triḥ | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ | atho medhyatvāya | athājyavatībhyāmapaḥ | rūpamevāsāmetadvarṇaṃ dadhāti | api vā utāhuḥ | yathā ha vai yoṣā suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ peśalaṃ bibhratī rūpāṇyāste | evametā etarhīti | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ
meaning: एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । त्रिः । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः । अथो मेध्यत्वाय । अथाज्यवतीभ्यामपः । रूपमेवासामेतद्वर्णं दधाति । अपि वा उताहुः । यथा ह वै योषा सुवर्णं हिरण्यं पेशलं बिभ्रती रूपाण्यास्ते । एवमेता एतर्हीति । आपो वै सर्वा देवताः
text_mt: for the winning of these worlds. / Three times; / for the sacrifice is threefold; / moreover, to make it fit for sacrifice. / Then [he purifies] the water with the two [strainers] having clarified butter; / he thereby imparts form and color to them. / They also say: / 'Just as a young woman sits bearing beautiful, golden ornaments [in varied] forms, / so are these [waters] now.' / Waters indeed are all the deities.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā hi viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ tanūḥ | yadājyam | tatrobhayormīmāṃsā | jāmiḥ syāt | yadyajuṣā''jyaṃ yajuṣā'pa utpunīyāt | chandasā'pa utpunātyajāmitvāya | atho mithunatvāya | sāvitriyarcā | savitṛprasūtaṃ me karmāsaditi | savitṛprasūtamevāsya karma bhavati | paccho gāyatriyā triḥṣamṛddhatvāya | adbhirevauṣadhīḥ saṃnayati | oṣadhībhiḥ paśūn | paśubhiryajamānam | śukraṃ tvā śukrāyāṃ jyotistvā jyotiṣyarcistvā'rciṣītyāha sarvatvāya | paryāptyā anantarāyāya
meaning: एषा हि विश्वेषां देवानां तनूः । यदाज्यम् । तत्रोभयोर्मीमांसा । जामिः स्यात् । यद्यजुषा'ऽज्यं यजुषाऽप उत्पुनीयात् । छन्दसाऽप उत्पुनात्यजामित्वाय । अथो मिथुनत्वाय । सावित्रियर्चा । सवितृप्रसूतं मे कर्मासदिति । सवितृप्रसूतमेवास्य कर्म भवति । पच्छो गायत्रिया त्रिःषमृद्धत्वाय । अद्भिरेवौषधीः संनयति । ओषधीभिः पशून् । पशुभिर्यजमानम् । शुक्रं त्वा शुक्रायां ज्योतिस्त्वा ज्योतिष्यर्चिस्त्वाऽर्चिषीत्याह सर्वत्वाय । पर्याप्त्या अनन्तरायाय
text_mt: For this is the body of all the gods, / namely clarified butter. / There is a deliberation between the two: / it would be monotonous / if he were to purify the clarified butter with a yajus and the water with a yajus. / He purifies the water with a meter to avoid monotony, / and also for pairing. / With a verse to Savitṛ: / 'May my work be impelled by Savitṛ,' he thinks; / impelled by Savitṛ his work becomes. / Quarter-verse by quarter-verse with the Gāyatrī, for threefold success. / Through water he unites the plants, / through plants the domestic animals, / through domestic animals the sacrificer. / 'You, the bright, in the bright; you, the light, in the light; you, the flame, in the flame,' he says, for completeness, / for attainment, without interruption.

sanskrit_iast: devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | sa etamindra ājyasyāvakāśamapaśyat | tenāvaikṣata | tato devā abhavan | parā'surāḥ | ya evaṃ vidvānājyamavekṣate | bhavatyātmanā | parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | brahmavādino vadanti | yadājyenānyāni havīgṣyabhi ghārayati
meaning: देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । स एतमिन्द्र आज्यस्यावकाशमपश्यत् । तेनावैक्षत । ततो देवा अभवन् । पराऽसुराः । य एवं विद्वानाज्यमवेक्षते । भवत्यात्मना । पराऽस्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । यदाज्येनान्यानि हवीग्ष्यभि घारयति
text_mt: The gods and the asuras were in conflict. / Indra saw this gaze at the clarified butter. / With it he gazed down. / Thereupon the gods came to be; / the asuras were defeated. / He who, knowing thus, gazes at the clarified butter / thrives in his own person; / his rival is defeated. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / ‘When with clarified butter he sprinkles the other oblations,

sanskrit_iast: atha kenājyamiti | satyeneti brūyāt | cakṣurvai satyam | satyenaivainadabhi ghārayati | īśvaro vā eṣo'ndho bhavitoḥ | yaścakṣuṣā''jyamavekṣate | nimīlyāvekṣeta | dādhārātmancakṣuḥ | abhyājyaṃ ghārayati | ājyaṃ gṛhṇāti
meaning: अथ केनाज्यमिति । सत्येनेति ब्रूयात् । चक्षुर्वै सत्यम् । सत्येनैवैनदभि घारयति । ईश्वरो वा एषोऽन्धो भवितोः । यश्चक्षुषा'ऽज्यमवेक्षते । निमील्यावेक्षेत । दाधारात्मन्चक्षुः । अभ्याज्यं घारयति । आज्यं गृह्णाति
text_mt: then with what [does he sprinkle] the clarified butter?’ / ‘With truth,’ he should say. / Truth indeed is the eye; / with truth indeed he sprinkles it. / Liable to become blind is he / who gazes at the clarified butter with his eye. / Having closed [his eyes], he should gaze; / he retains the eye in himself. / He sprinkles the clarified butter; / he ladles the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: chandāṃsi vā ājyam | chandāṃsyeva prīṇāti | caturjuhvāṃ gṛhṇāti | catuṣpādaḥ paśavaḥ | paśūnevāvarundhe | aṣṭāvupabhṛti | aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī | gāyatraḥ prāṇaḥ | prāṇameva paśuṣu dadhāti | caturdhruvāyām
meaning: छन्दांसि वा आज्यम् । छन्दांस्येव प्रीणाति । चतुर्जुह्वां गृह्णाति । चतुष्पादः पशवः । पशूनेवावरुन्धे । अष्टावुपभृति । अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री । गायत्रः प्राणः । प्राणमेव पशुषु दधाति । चतुर्ध्रुवायाम्
text_mt: The metres indeed are clarified butter; / he gratifies the metres themselves. / Four times he ladles into the juhū spoon; / four-footed are domestic animals; / he secures domestic animals. / Eight times into the upabhṛt spoon; / of eight syllables is the gāyatrī; / of gāyatrī nature is exhalation; / he places exhalation in domestic animals. / Four times into the dhruvā spoon.

sanskrit_iast: catuṣpādaḥ paśavaḥ | paśuṣvevopariṣṭātpratitiṣṭhati | yajamānadevatyā vai juhūḥ | bhrātṛvyadevatyopabhṛt | caturjuhvāṃ gṛhṇanbhūyo gṛhṇīyāt | aṣṭāvupabhṛti gṛhṇankanīyaḥ | yajamānāyaiva bhrātṛvyamupastiṃ karoti | gaurvai srucaḥ | caturjuhvāṃ gṛhṇāti | tasmāccatuṣpadī
meaning: चतुष्पादः पशवः । पशुष्वेवोपरिष्टात्प्रतितिष्ठति । यजमानदेवत्या वै जुहूः । भ्रातृव्यदेवत्योपभृत् । चतुर्जुह्वां गृह्णन्भूयो गृह्णीयात् । अष्टावुपभृति गृह्णन्कनीयः । यजमानायैव भ्रातृव्यमुपस्तिं करोति । गौर्वै स्रुचः । चतुर्जुह्वां गृह्णाति । तस्माच्चतुष्पदी
text_mt: Four-footed are domestic animals; / he establishes himself on domestic animals from above. / Dedicated to the sacrificer is the juhū; / dedicated to the rival is the upabhṛt. / Ladling four times into the juhū, he should ladle more; / ladling eight times into the upabhṛt, less; / he makes the rival subservient to the sacrificer. / A cow is the sruva spoon. / Four times he ladles into the juhū; / therefore she is four-footed.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāvupabhṛti | tasmādaṣṭāśaphā | caturdhruvāyām | tasmāccatusstanā | gāmeva tathsaṃskaroti | sā'smai saṃskṛteṣamūrjaṃ duhe | yajjuhvāṃ gṛhṇāti | prayājebhyastat | yadupabhṛti | prayājānūyājebhyastat | sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate | yaddhruvāyāmājyam
meaning: अष्टावुपभृति । तस्मादष्टाशफा । चतुर्ध्रुवायाम् । तस्माच्चतुस्स्तना । गामेव तथ्संस्करोति । साऽस्मै संस्कृतेषमूर्जं दुहे । यज्जुह्वां गृह्णाति । प्रयाजेभ्यस्तत् । यदुपभृति । प्रयाजानूयाजेभ्यस्तत् । सर्वस्मै वा एतद्यज्ञाय गृह्यते । यद्ध्रुवायामाज्यम्
text_mt: Eight times into the upabhṛt; / therefore she has eight hooves. / Four times into the dhruvā; / therefore she has four teats. / He thus prepares the cow; / she, prepared, yields refreshment and vigor for him. / That which he ladles into the juhū, / that is for the fore-offerings; / that which [he ladles] into the upabhṛt, / that is for the fore-offerings and after-offerings; / for the entire sacrifice, indeed, is that ladled / which is the clarified butter in the dhruvā.

sanskrit_iast: āpo devīragrepuvo agre guva ityāha | rūpamevāsāmetanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | agra imaṃ yajñaṃ nayatāgre yajñapatimityāha | agra eva yajñaṃ nayanti | agre yajñapatim | yuṣmānindro'vṛṇīta vṛtratūrye yūyamindramavṛṇīdhvaṃ vṛtratūrya ityāha | vṛtraṃ ha haniṣyannindra āpo vavre | āpo hendraṃ vavrire | saṃjñāmevāsāmetathsāmānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | prokṣitāḥ sthetyāha
meaning: आपो देवीरग्रेपुवो अग्रे गुव इत्याह । रूपमेवासामेतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । अग्र इमं यज्ञं नयताग्रे यज्ञपतिमित्याह । अग्र एव यज्ञं नयन्ति । अग्रे यज्ञपतिम् । युष्मानिन्द्रोऽवृणीत वृत्रतूर्ये यूयमिन्द्रमवृणीध्वं वृत्रतूर्य इत्याह । वृत्रं ह हनिष्यन्निन्द्र आपो वव्रे । आपो हेन्द्रं वव्रिरे । संज्ञामेवासामेतथ्सामानं व्याचष्टे । प्रोक्षिताः स्थेत्याह
text_mt: ‘O divine waters, purifying first, going first,’ he says; / he thereby declares their form and their greatness. / ‘Lead this sacrifice forward, lead the lord of the sacrifice forward,’ he says; / forward indeed they lead the sacrifice, / forward the lord of the sacrifice. / ‘Indra chose you in the slaying of Vṛtra; you chose Indra in the slaying of Vṛtra,’ he says; / Indra, about to slay Vṛtra, chose the waters; / the waters chose Indra; / he declares their agreement and concord. / ‘You are sprinkled,’ he says;

sanskrit_iast: tenāpaḥ prokṣitāḥ | agnirdevebhyo nilāyata | kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | sa vanaspatīnprāviśat | kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭho'gnaye tvā svāhetyāha | agnaya evainaṃ juṣṭaṃ karoti | atho agnereva medhamavarundhe | vedirasi barhiṣe tvā svāhetyāha | prajā vai barhiḥ | pṛthivī vediḥ
meaning: तेनापः प्रोक्षिताः । अग्निर्देवेभ्यो निलायत । कृष्णो रूपं कृत्वा । स वनस्पतीन्प्राविशत् । कृष्णोऽस्याखरेष्ठोऽग्नये त्वा स्वाहेत्याह । अग्नय एवैनं जुष्टं करोति । अथो अग्नेरेव मेधमवरुन्धे । वेदिरसि बर्हिषे त्वा स्वाहेत्याह । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । पृथिवी वेदिः
text_mt: thereby the waters are sprinkled. / Agni hid from the gods; / having assumed a black form, / he entered the trees. / ‘You are black, dwelling in the lair; to Agni svāhā!’ he says; / he makes him agreeable to Agni; / moreover, he secures the sacrificial essence of Agni. / ‘You are the vedi; to the barhis svāhā!’ he says; / offspring indeed are the barhis; / the earth is the vedi.

sanskrit_iast: prajā eva pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | barhirasi srugbhyastvā svāhetyāha | prajā vai barhiḥ | yajamānaḥ srucaḥ | yajamānameva prajāsu pratiṣṭhāpayati | dive tvā'ntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tveti barhirāsādya prokṣati | ebhya evainaṃ llokebhyaḥ prokṣati | atha tataḥ saha srucā purastātpratyañcaṃ granthiṃ pratyukṣati | prajā vai barhiḥ | yathā sūtyai kāla āpaḥ purastādyanti
meaning: प्रजा एव पृथिव्यां प्रतिष्ठापयति । बर्हिरसि स्रुग्भ्यस्त्वा स्वाहेत्याह । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । यजमानः स्रुचः । यजमानमेव प्रजासु प्रतिष्ठापयति । दिवे त्वाऽन्तरिक्षाय त्वा पृथिव्यै त्वेति बर्हिरासाद्य प्रोक्षति । एभ्य एवैनं ल्लोकेभ्यः प्रोक्षति । अथ ततः सह स्रुचा पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चं ग्रन्थिं प्रत्युक्षति । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । यथा सूत्यै काल आपः पुरस्ताद्यन्ति
