that is a hundred million.
He secures the fullness of speech.
He says, 'To the ocean, svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: samudramevāpnoti | madhyāya svāhetyāha | madhyamevāpnoti | antāya svāhetyāha | antamevāpnoti | parārdhāya svāhetyāha | parārdhamevāpnoti | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhetyāha | rātrirvā uṣāḥ | aharvyuṣṭiḥ | ahorātre evāvarundhe | atho ahorātrayoreva pratitiṣṭhati | tā yadubhayīrdivā vā naktaṃ vā juhuyāt | ahorātre mohayet | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhodeṣyate svāhodyate svāhetyanudite juhoti | uditāya svāhā suvargāya svāhā lokāya svāhetyudite juhoti | ahorātrayoravyatimohāya
meaning: समुद्रमेवाप्नोति । मध्याय स्वाहेत्याह । मध्यमेवाप्नोति । अन्ताय स्वाहेत्याह । अन्तमेवाप्नोति । परार्धाय स्वाहेत्याह । परार्धमेवाप्नोति । उषसे स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहेत्याह । रात्रिर्वा उषाः । अहर्व्युष्टिः । अहोरात्रे एवावरुन्धे । अथो अहोरात्रयोरेव प्रतितिष्ठति । ता यदुभयीर्दिवा वा नक्तं वा जुहुयात् । अहोरात्रे मोहयेत् । उषसे स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहोदेष्यते स्वाहोद्यते स्वाहेत्यनुदिते जुहोति । उदिताय स्वाहा सुवर्गाय स्वाहा लोकाय स्वाहेत्युदिते जुहोति । अहोरात्रयोरव्यतिमोहाय
text_mt:
He reaches the ocean.
He says, 'To the middle, svāhā.'
He reaches the middle.
He says, 'To the end, svāhā.'
He reaches the end.
He says, 'To the highest number, svāhā.'
He reaches the highest number.
He says, 'To dawn, svāhā; to daybreak, svāhā.'
Night is dawn;
day is daybreak.
He secures day and night.
Furthermore, he firmly establishes himself in day and night.
If he were to offer both by day or by night,
he would confuse day and night.
He offers before sunrise, saying, 'To dawn, svāhā; to daybreak, svāhā; to him about to rise, svāhā; to him rising, svāhā.'
He offers after sunrise, saying, 'To him who has risen, svāhā; to the heavenly, svāhā; to the realm, svāhā,'
so that day and night are not confused.

sanskrit_iast: vibhūrmātrā prabhūḥ pitretyaśvanāmāni juhoti | ubhayorevainaṃ lokayornāmadheyaṃ gamayati | āyanāya svāhā prāyaṇāya svāhetyuddrāvāñjuhoti | sarvamevainamaskannaṃ suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | agnaye svāhā somāya svāheti pūrvahomāñjuhoti | pūrva eva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamatikrāmati | pṛthivyai svāhā'ntarikṣāya svāhetyāha | yathā yajurevaitat | agnaye svāhā somāya svāheti pūrvadīkṣā juhoti | pūrva eva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamatikrāmati
meaning: विभूर्मात्रा प्रभूः पित्रेत्यश्वनामानि जुहोति । उभयोरेवैनं लोकयोर्नामधेयं गमयति । आयनाय स्वाहा प्रायणाय स्वाहेत्युद्द्रावाञ्जुहोति । सर्वमेवैनमस्कन्नं सुवर्गं लोकं गमयति । अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहेति पूर्वहोमाञ्जुहोति । पूर्व एव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमतिक्रामति । पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहेत्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहेति पूर्वदीक्षा जुहोति । पूर्व एव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमतिक्रामति
text_mt:
He offers the names of the horse, saying, 'Extensive through its mother, mighty through its father.'
He causes its name to go to both realms.
He offers the departures, saying, 'To approach, svāhā; to setting forth, svāhā.'
He causes it to go whole, unspilled, to the heavenly realm.
He offers the preceding offerings, saying, 'To Agni, svāhā; to Soma, svāhā.'
He surpasses the hostile rival from the outset.
He says, 'To the earth, svāhā; to the intermediate space, svāhā.'
That is in accordance with the formula.
He offers the preceding consecration offerings, saying, 'To Agni, svāhā; to Soma, svāhā.'
He surpasses the hostile rival from the outset.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyai svāhā'ntarikṣāya svāhetyekaviṃśinīṃ dīkṣāṃ juhoti | ekaviṃśatirvai devalokāḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ | traya ime lokāḥ | asāvāditya ekaviṃśaḥ | eṣa suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | bhuvo devānāṃ karmaṇetyṛtudīkṣā juhoti | ṛtūnevāsmai kalpayati | agnaye svāhā vāyave svāheti juhotyanantarityai
meaning: पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहेत्येकविंशिनीं दीक्षां जुहोति । एकविंशतिर्वै देवलोकाः । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः । त्रय इमे लोकाः । असावादित्य एकविंशः । एष सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । भुवो देवानां कर्मणेत्यृतुदीक्षा जुहोति । ऋतूनेवास्मै कल्पयति । अग्नये स्वाहा वायवे स्वाहेति जुहोत्यनन्तरित्यै
text_mt:
He offers the twenty-one-fold consecration, saying, 'To the earth, svāhā; to the intermediate space, svāhā.'
The realms of the gods are twenty-one:
twelve months, five seasons,
these three worlds;
yonder sun is the twenty-first.
This is the heavenly realm;
[this is] for the attainment of the heavenly realm.
He offers the season consecration offerings, saying, 'Become through the rite of the gods.'
He prepares the seasons for him.
He offers, saying, 'To Agni, svāhā; to Vāyu, svāhā,' so as not to omit [any].

sanskrit_iast: arvāṅyajñaḥ saṃkrāmatvityāptīrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasyāptyai | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaditi paryāptīrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya paryāptyai | ā me gṛhā bhavantvityābhūrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasyābhūtyai | agninā tapo'nvabhavadityanubhūrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasyānubhūtyai | svāhā''dhimādhītāya svāheti samastāni vaiśvadevāni juhoti | samastameva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamatikrāmati
meaning: अर्वाङ्यज्ञः संक्रामत्वित्याप्तीर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याप्त्यै । भूतं भव्यं भविष्यदिति पर्याप्तीर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य पर्याप्त्यै । आ मे गृहा भवन्त्वित्याभूर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभूत्यै । अग्निना तपोऽन्वभवदित्यनुभूर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्यानुभूत्यै । स्वाहा'ऽधिमाधीताय स्वाहेति समस्तानि वैश्वदेवानि जुहोति । समस्तमेव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमतिक्रामति
text_mt:
He offers the reaching-mantras (āptis), saying, 'May the sacrifice proceed hither,'
for the reaching of the heavenly realm.
He offers the pervasive-mantras (paryāptis), saying, 'What was, what is, what will be,'
for the pervasion of the heavenly realm.
He offers the originating-mantras (ābhūs), saying, 'May houses be mine,'
for the origination of the heavenly realm.
He offers the experiencing-mantras (anubhūs), saying, 'With Agni he experienced heat,'
for the experience of the heavenly realm.
He offers the combined Vaiśvadeva offerings, saying, 'Svāhā to longing, to what is longed for svāhā.'
He completely surpasses the hostile rival.

sanskrit_iast: dadbhyaḥ svāhā hanūbhyāg svāhetyaṅgahomāñjuhoti | aṅge aṅge vai puruṣasya pāpmopaśliṣṭaḥ | aṅgādaṅgādevainaṃ pāpmanastena muñcati | añjyetāya svāhā kṛṣṇāya svāhā śvetāya svāhetyaśvarūpāṇi juhoti | rūpairevainaṃ samardhayati | oṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā mūlebhyaḥ svāhetyoṣadhi homāñjuhoti | dvayyo vā oṣadhayaḥ | puṣpebhyo'nyāḥ phalaṃ gṛhṇanti | mūlebhyo'nyāḥ | tā evobhayīravarundhe
meaning: दद्भ्यः स्वाहा हनूभ्याग् स्वाहेत्यङ्गहोमाञ्जुहोति । अङ्गे अङ्गे वै पुरुषस्य पाप्मोपश्लिष्टः । अङ्गादङ्गादेवैनं पाप्मनस्तेन मुञ्चति । अञ्ज्येताय स्वाहा कृष्णाय स्वाहा श्वेताय स्वाहेत्यश्वरूपाणि जुहोति । रूपैरेवैनं समर्धयति । ओषधीभ्यः स्वाहा मूलेभ्यः स्वाहेत्योषधि होमाञ्जुहोति । द्वय्यो वा ओषधयः । पुष्पेभ्योऽन्याः फलं गृह्णन्ति । मूलेभ्योऽन्याः । ता एवोभयीरवरुन्धे
text_mt:
He offers the limb offerings, saying, 'To the teeth, svāhā; to the jaws, svāhā.'
Evil adheres to limb after limb of a man.
From limb after limb he frees him from evil thereby.
He offers the horse's colors, saying, 'To the spotted, svāhā; to the black, svāhā; to the white, svāhā.'
He endows him with forms.
He offers the plant offerings, saying, 'To the plants, svāhā; to the roots, svāhā.'
Plants are of two kinds:
some bear fruit from blossoms,
others from roots.
He secures both of them.

sanskrit_iast: vanaspatibhyaḥ svāheti vanaspatihomāñjuhoti | āraṇyasyānnādyasyāvarudhyai | meṣastvā pacatairavatvityapāvyāni juhoti | prāṇā vai devā apāvyāḥ | prāṇānevāvarundhe | kūpyābhyaḥ svāhā'dbhyaḥ svāhetyapāṃ homāñjuhoti | apsu vā āpaḥ | annaṃ vā āpaḥ | adbhyo vā annaṃ jāyate | yadevādbhyo'nnaṃ jāyate | tadavarundhe
meaning: वनस्पतिभ्यः स्वाहेति वनस्पतिहोमाञ्जुहोति । आरण्यस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै । मेषस्त्वा पचतैरवत्वित्यपाव्यानि जुहोति । प्राणा वै देवा अपाव्याः । प्राणानेवावरुन्धे । कूप्याभ्यः स्वाहाऽद्भ्यः स्वाहेत्यपां होमाञ्जुहोति । अप्सु वा आपः । अन्नं वा आपः । अद्भ्यो वा अन्नं जायते । यदेवाद्भ्योऽन्नं जायते । तदवरुन्धे
text_mt: With "Svāhā to the lords of the forest!" he offers the forest-lord offerings, / to secure forest food. / With "May the ram assist thee with cooked meats!" he offers the apāvya offerings. / The gods who are the apāvyas are indeed the breaths; / he secures the breaths. / With "Svāhā to the waters from the well! Svāhā to the waters!" he offers the water offerings. / Water is indeed in waters; / food is indeed water; / food is indeed born from water. / What food is born from water, / that he secures.

sanskrit_iast: ambhāṃsi juhoti | ayaṃ vai loko'mbhāṃsi | tasya vasavo'dhipatayaḥ | agnirjyotiḥ | yadambhāṃsi juhoti | imameva lokamavarundhe | vasūnāṃ sāyujyaṃ gacchati | agniṃ jyotiravarundhe | nabhāṃsi juhoti | antarikṣaṃ vai nabhāṃsi
meaning: अम्भांसि जुहोति । अयं वै लोकोऽम्भांसि । तस्य वसवोऽधिपतयः । अग्निर्ज्योतिः । यदम्भांसि जुहोति । इममेव लोकमवरुन्धे । वसूनां सायुज्यं गच्छति । अग्निं ज्योतिरवरुन्धे । नभांसि जुहोति । अन्तरिक्षं वै नभांसि
text_mt: He offers the ambhas offerings. / This world indeed is the waters (ambhas). / Its overlords are the Vasus. / Agni is its light. / When he offers the ambhas offerings, / he wins this very world; / he attains unison with the Vasus; / he wins Agni as light. / He offers the nabhas offerings. / The intermediate space indeed is the mists (nabhas).

sanskrit_iast: tasya rudrā adhipatayaḥ | vāyurjyotiḥ | yannabhāṃsi juhoti | antarikṣamevāvarundhe | rudrāṇāṃ sāyujyaṃ gacchati | vāyuṃ jyotiravarundhe | mahāṃsi juhoti | asau vai loko mahāṃsi | tasyādityā adhipatayaḥ | sūryo jyotiḥ
meaning: तस्य रुद्रा अधिपतयः । वायुर्ज्योतिः । यन्नभांसि जुहोति । अन्तरिक्षमेवावरुन्धे । रुद्राणां सायुज्यं गच्छति । वायुं ज्योतिरवरुन्धे । महांसि जुहोति । असौ वै लोको महांसि । तस्यादित्या अधिपतयः । सूर्यो ज्योतिः
text_mt: Its overlords are the Rudras. / Vāyu is its light. / When he offers the nabhas offerings, / he wins the intermediate space; / he attains unison with the Rudras; / he wins Vāyu as light. / He offers the mahas offerings. / That world indeed is the splendors (mahas). / Its overlords are the Ādityas. / Sūrya is its light.

sanskrit_iast: yanmahāṃsi juhoti | amumeva lokamavarundhe | ādityānāṃ sāyujyaṃ gacchati | sūryaṃ jyotiravarundhe | namo rājñe namo varuṇāyeti yavyāni juhoti | annādyasyāvarudhyai | mayobhūrvāto abhi vātūsrā iti gavyāni juhoti | paśūnāmavarudhyai | prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāheti saṃtatihomāñjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya saṃtatyai
meaning: यन्महांसि जुहोति । अमुमेव लोकमवरुन्धे । आदित्यानां सायुज्यं गच्छति । सूर्यं ज्योतिरवरुन्धे । नमो राज्ञे नमो वरुणायेति यव्यानि जुहोति । अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै । मयोभूर्वातो अभि वातूस्रा इति गव्यानि जुहोति । पशूनामवरुध्यै । प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहेति संततिहोमाञ्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य संतत्यै
text_mt: When he offers the mahas offerings, / he wins that very world; / he attains unison with the Ādityas; / he wins Sūrya as light. / With 'Homage to the king, homage to Varuṇa', he offers the barley-offerings, / to secure edible food. / With 'May the blessing-bringing wind blow toward the cows', he offers the cow-offerings, / to secure domestic animals. / With 'To exhalation, svāhā; to diffused breath, svāhā', he offers the continuity-offerings, / for the continuity of the heavenly realm.

sanskrit_iast: itāya svāhā'sitāya svāheti pramuktīrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya pramuktyai | pṛthivyai svāhā'ntarikṣāya svāhetyāha | yathā yajurevaitat | dattvate svāhā'dantakāya svāheti śarīrahomāñjuhoti | pitṛlokameva tairyajamāno'varundhe | kastvā yunakti sa tvā yunaktviti paridhīn yunakti | ime vai lokāḥ paridhayaḥ | imānevāsmai lokān yunakti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: इताय स्वाहाऽसिताय स्वाहेति प्रमुक्तीर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रमुक्त्यै । पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहेत्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । दत्त्वते स्वाहाऽदन्तकाय स्वाहेति शरीरहोमाञ्जुहोति । पितृलोकमेव तैर्यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । कस्त्वा युनक्ति स त्वा युनक्त्विति परिधीन् युनक्ति । इमे वै लोकाः परिधयः । इमानेवास्मै लोकान् युनक्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: With 'To the bound, svāhā; to the unbound, svāhā', he offers the release-offerings, / for release unto the heavenly realm. / He says, 'To earth, svāhā; to the intermediate space, svāhā'; / this is just in accordance with the yajus. / With 'To the one with teeth, svāhā; to the toothless, svāhā', he offers the body-offerings; / through them the sacrificer wins the world of the ancestors. / With 'Who yokes thee? Let him yoke thee', he yokes the enclosing-sticks. / These worlds indeed are the enclosing-sticks; / these worlds he yokes for him, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ prāṇato ya ātmadā iti mahimānau juhoti | suvargo vai loko mahaḥ | suvargameva tābhyāṃ lokaṃ yajamāno'varundhe | ā brahmanbrāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyatāmiti samastāni brahmavarcasāni juhoti | brahmavarcasameva tairyajamāno'varundhe | jajñi bījamiti juhotyanantarityai | agnaye samanamatpṛthivyai samanamaditi sannati homāñjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya saṃnatyai | bhūtāya svāhā bhaviṣyate svāheti bhūtābhavyau homau juhoti | ayaṃ vai loko bhūtam
meaning: यः प्राणतो य आत्मदा इति महिमानौ जुहोति । सुवर्गो वै लोको महः । सुवर्गमेव ताभ्यां लोकं यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । आ ब्रह्मन्ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसी जायतामिति समस्तानि ब्रह्मवर्चसानि जुहोति । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेव तैर्यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । जज्ञि बीजमिति जुहोत्यनन्तरित्यै । अग्नये समनमत्पृथिव्यै समनमदिति सन्नति होमाञ्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य संनत्यै । भूताय स्वाहा भविष्यते स्वाहेति भूताभव्यौ होमौ जुहोति । अयं वै लोको भूतम्
text_mt: With 'He who breathing...' [and] 'He who is giver of self...', he offers the two Mahiman cups; / the heavenly realm is indeed greatness (mahas); / through them the sacrificer wins the heavenly realm. / With 'In the brahman, may a Brahmin endowed with spiritual preeminence be born...', he offers the combined spiritual preeminence offerings; / through them the sacrificer wins spiritual preeminence. / With 'The seed was generated...', he offers for uninterrupted continuity. / With 'It bowed to Agni; it bowed to earth...', he offers the obeisance-offerings, / for yielding to the heavenly realm. / With 'To that which has been, svāhā; to that which shall be, svāhā', he offers the two offerings of past and future. / This world is that which has been;

sanskrit_iast: asau bhaviṣyat | anayoreva lokayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati | sarvasyāptyai | sarvasyāvaruddhyai | yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna ityaśvastomīyaṃ juhoti | sarvasyāptyai | sarvasya jityai | sarvameva tenāpnoti | sarvaṃ jayati | yo'śvamedhena yajate
meaning: असौ भविष्यत् । अनयोरेव लोकयोः प्रतितिष्ठति । सर्वस्याप्त्यै । सर्वस्यावरुद्ध्यै । यदक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमान इत्यश्वस्तोमीयं जुहोति । सर्वस्याप्त्यै । सर्वस्य जित्यै । सर्वमेव तेनाप्नोति । सर्वं जयति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते
text_mt: that [world] is that which shall be. / In these two worlds he firmly establishes himself, / to obtain everything, / to win everything. / With 'When first at birth thou didst neigh...', he offers the horse-praise offering, / to obtain everything, / to conquer everything. / Everything he obtains through it, / everything he conquers, / who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast: ya u cainamevaṃ veda | yajñaṃ rakṣāṃsyajighāṃsan | sa etānprajāpatirnaktaṃ homānapaśyat | tānajuhot | tairvai sa yajñādrakṣāṃsyapāhan | yannaktaṃhomāñjuhoti | yajñādeva tairyajamāno rakṣāṃsyapahanti | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhetyantato juhoti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: य उ चैनमेवं वेद । यज्ञं रक्षांस्यजिघांसन् । स एतान्प्रजापतिर्नक्तं होमानपश्यत् । तानजुहोत् । तैर्वै स यज्ञाद्रक्षांस्यपाहन् । यन्नक्तंहोमाञ्जुहोति । यज्ञादेव तैर्यजमानो रक्षांस्यपहन्ति । उषसे स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहेत्यन्ततो जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: and who knows it thus. / The evil spirits wished to slay the sacrifice. / Prajāpati saw these night-offerings; / he offered them; / through them he smote away the evil spirits from the sacrifice. / When he offers the night-offerings, / through them the sacrificer smites away the evil spirits from the sacrifice. / With 'To dawn, svāhā; to dawn-break, svāhā', he offers at the end, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm.

sanskrit_iast: ekayūpo vaikādaśinī vā | anyeṣāṃ yajñānāṃ yūpā bhavanti | ekaviṃśinyaśvamedhasya | suvargasya lokasyābhijityai | bailvo vā khādiro vā pālāśo vā | anyeṣāṃ yajñakratūnāṃ yūpā bhavanti | rājjudāla ekaviṃśatyaratniraśvamedhasya | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | nānyeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ tejanyā avadyanti | avadyantyaśvasya
meaning: एकयूपो वैकादशिनी वा । अन्येषां यज्ञानां यूपा भवन्ति । एकविंशिन्यश्वमेधस्य । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिजित्यै । बैल्वो वा खादिरो वा पालाशो वा । अन्येषां यज्ञक्रतूनां यूपा भवन्ति । राज्जुदाल एकविंशत्यरत्निरश्वमेधस्य । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । नान्येषां पशूनां तेजन्या अवद्यन्ति । अवद्यन्त्यश्वस्य
text_mt: Either of a single post or of eleven posts / are the sacrificial posts of other sacrifices; / of twenty-one posts is that of the horse sacrifice, / for the conquest of the heavenly realm. / Either of bilva, of khadira, or of palāśa / are the sacrificial posts of other sacrificial rites; / of rā́jjudāla wood, twenty-one cubits long, is [the central post] of the horse sacrifice, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / Not on a mat of reeds do they cut off portions for the other domestic animals; / they cut off portions for the horse [on one].

sanskrit_iast: pāpmā vai tejanī | pāpmano'pahatyai | plakṣaśākhāyāmanyeṣāṃ paśūnāmavadyanti | vetasaśākhāyāmaśvasya | apsuyonirvā aśvaḥ | apsujo vetasaḥ | sva evāsya yonāvavadyati | yūpeṣu grāmyānpaśūnniyuñjanti | ārokeṣvāraṇyāndhārayanti | paśūnāṃ vyāvṛttyai | ā grāmyān paśūnlabhante | prāraṇyānthsṛjanti | pāpmano'pahatyai
meaning: पाप्मा वै तेजनी । पाप्मनोऽपहत्यै । प्लक्षशाखायामन्येषां पशूनामवद्यन्ति । वेतसशाखायामश्वस्य । अप्सुयोनिर्वा अश्वः । अप्सुजो वेतसः । स्व एवास्य योनाववद्यति । यूपेषु ग्राम्यान्पशून्नियुञ्जन्ति । आरोकेष्वारण्यान्धारयन्ति । पशूनां व्यावृत्त्यै । आ ग्राम्यान् पशून्लभन्ते । प्रारण्यान्थ्सृजन्ति । पाप्मनोऽपहत्यै
text_mt: The reed-mat is evil; / [it is done] for the destruction of evil. / On a plakṣa branch they cut off portions for the other domestic animals; / on a reed branch for the horse; / for the horse has its origin in the waters, / the reed is born in the waters; / in its own origin he cuts off portions for it. / To the posts they tie the domestic animals; / in the gaps between they hold the wild animals, / for the distinction of domestic animals. / They seize the domestic animals; / they release the wild animals, / for the destruction of evil.

sanskrit_iast: rājjudālamagniṣṭhaṃ minoti | bhrūṇahatyāyā apahatyai | pautudravāvabhito bhavataḥ | puṇyasya gandhasyāvarudhyai | bhrūṇahatyāmevāsmādapahatya | puṇyena gandhenobhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | ṣaḍbailvā bhavanti | brahmavarcasasyāvaruddhyai | ṣaṭkhādirāḥ | tejaso'varudhyai
meaning: राज्जुदालमग्निष्ठं मिनोति । भ्रूणहत्याया अपहत्यै । पौतुद्रवावभितो भवतः । पुण्यस्य गन्धस्यावरुध्यै । भ्रूणहत्यामेवास्मादपहत्य । पुण्येन गन्धेनोभयतः परिगृह्णाति । षड्बैल्वा भवन्ति । ब्रह्मवर्चसस्यावरुद्ध्यै । षट्खादिराः । तेजसोऽवरुध्यै
text_mt: He sets up a post of rājjudāla wood facing the fire, / for the destruction of the slaying of an embryo. / There are two [posts] of pūtudru wood on either side, / to secure a sacred fragrance; / having struck away the slaying of an embryo from him, / he encloses him on both sides with a sacred fragrance. / There are six of bilva wood, / to secure spiritual preeminence; / six of khadira wood, / to secure fiery energy;

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭpālāśāḥ | somapīthasyāvarudhyai | ekaviṃśatiḥ saṃpadyante | ekaviṃśatirvai devalokāḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ | traya ime lokāḥ | asāvāditya ekaviṃśaḥ | eṣa suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | śataṃ paśavo bhavanti
meaning: षट्पालाशाः । सोमपीथस्यावरुध्यै । एकविंशतिः संपद्यन्ते । एकविंशतिर्वै देवलोकाः । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः । त्रय इमे लोकाः । असावादित्य एकविंशः । एष सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । शतं पशवो भवन्ति
text_mt: six of palāśa wood, / to secure the drinking of soma. / They amount to twenty-one. / Twenty-one indeed are the divine realms: / twelve months, five seasons, / these three worlds; / that sun is the twenty-first; / this is the heavenly realm, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / A hundred are the animals;

sanskrit_iast: śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ | āyuṣyevendriye pratitiṣṭhati | sarvaṃ vā aśvamedhyāpnoti | aparimitā bhavanti | aparimitasyāvaruddhyai | brahmavādino vadanti | kasmāthsatyāt | dakṣiṇato'nyeṣāṃ paśūnāmavadyanti | uttarato'śvasyeti | vāruṇo vā aśvaḥ
meaning: शतायुः पुरुषः शतेन्द्रियः । आयुष्येवेन्द्रिये प्रतितिष्ठति । सर्वं वा अश्वमेध्याप्नोति । अपरिमिता भवन्ति । अपरिमितस्यावरुद्ध्यै । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । कस्माथ्सत्यात् । दक्षिणतोऽन्येषां पशूनामवद्यन्ति । उत्तरतोऽश्वस्येति । वारुणो वा अश्वः
text_mt: a man has a lifespan of a hundred years, a hundred faculties; / he firmly establishes himself in lifespan, in faculties. / The performer of the horse sacrifice obtains everything. / They are unlimited, / to secure the unlimited. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / 'For what true reason / do they cut off portions for other animals on the south, / and on the north for the horse?' / The horse is sacred to Varuṇa;

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vai varuṇasya dik | svāyāmevāsya diśyavadyati | yaditareṣāṃ paśūnāmavadyati | śatadevatyaṃ tenāvarundhe | cite'gnāvadhivaitase kaṭe'śvaṃ cinoti | apsuyonirvā aśvaḥ | apsujo vetasaḥ | sva evainaṃ yonau pratiṣṭhāpayati | purastātpratyañcaṃ tūparaṃ cinoti | paścātprācīnaṃ gomṛgam
meaning: एषा वै वरुणस्य दिक् । स्वायामेवास्य दिश्यवद्यति । यदितरेषां पशूनामवद्यति । शतदेवत्यं तेनावरुन्धे । चितेऽग्नावधिवैतसे कटेऽश्वं चिनोति । अप्सुयोनिर्वा अश्वः । अप्सुजो वेतसः । स्व एवैनं योनौ प्रतिष्ठापयति । पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चं तूपरं चिनोति । पश्चात्प्राचीनं गोमृगम्
text_mt: this indeed is Varuṇa's quarter; / in its own quarter he cuts off portions for it. / When he cuts off portions for the other animals, / thereby he secures [the favor of] a hundred deities. / He piles the horse upon the piled fire on a reed mat; / the horse has its origin in the waters, the reed is born in the waters; / in its own origin he establishes it. / In front, facing west, he piles the hornless [goat]; / behind, facing east, the wild ox.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāpānāvevāsminthsamyañcau dadhāti | aśvaṃ tūparaṃ gomṛgamiti sarvahuta etāñjuhoti | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai | ātmanā'bhijuhoti | sātmānamevainaṃ satanuṃ karoti | sātmā'muṣmiṃ lloke bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | atho vasoreva dhārāṃ tenāvarundhe | iluvardāya svāhā balivardāya svāhetyāha | saṃvathsaro vā iluvardaḥ | parivathsaro balivardaḥ | saṃvathsarādeva parivathsarādāyuravarundhe | āyurevāsmindadhāti | tasmādaśvamedhayājī jarasā visrasā'muṃ lokameti
meaning: प्राणापानावेवास्मिन्थ्सम्यञ्चौ दधाति । अश्वं तूपरं गोमृगमिति सर्वहुत एताञ्जुहोति । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै । आत्मनाऽभिजुहोति । सात्मानमेवैनं सतनुं करोति । सात्माऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके भवति । य एवं वेद । अथो वसोरेव धारां तेनावरुन्धे । इलुवर्दाय स्वाहा बलिवर्दाय स्वाहेत्याह । संवथ्सरो वा इलुवर्दः । परिवथ्सरो बलिवर्दः । संवथ्सरादेव परिवथ्सरादायुरवरुन्धे । आयुरेवास्मिन्दधाति । तस्मादश्वमेधयाजी जरसा विस्रसाऽमुं लोकमेति
text_mt:
He thus places exhalation and inhalation together in him.
The horse, the hornless goat, and the wild ox: he offers these as completely burnt offerings,
for the conquest of these worlds.
He offers [the horse's body] together with its own self;
he thereby makes him possessed of a self, possessed of a body.
Possessed of a self he becomes in yonder world,
he who knows thus.
Moreover, by this he obtains the stream of wealth.
'To Iluvarda svāhā! To Balivarda svāhā!' he says.
The year is indeed Iluvarda;
the subsequent year is Balivarda.
From the year and from the subsequent year he secures lifespan;
he places lifespan in him.
Therefore the performer of the horse sacrifice goes to yonder world through old age, through decay.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo'gnirbhavati | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | yathā vā aśvā varṣabhā vā vṛṣāṇaḥ saṃsphureran | evametathstomāḥ saṃsphurante | yadekaviṃśāḥ | te yathsamṛccheran | hanyetāsya yajñaḥ | dvādaśa evāgniḥ syādityāhuḥ | dvādaśaḥ stomaḥ |
meaning: एकविंशोऽग्निर्भवति । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । यथा वा अश्वा वर्षभा वा वृषाणः संस्फुरेरन् । एवमेतथ्स्तोमाः संस्फुरन्ते । यदेकविंशाः । ते यथ्समृच्छेरन् । हन्येतास्य यज्ञः । द्वादश एवाग्निः स्यादित्याहुः । द्वादशः स्तोमः ।
text_mt:
The fire is twenty-one-fold;
the chant is twenty-one-fold;
there are twenty-one sacrificial posts.
Just as horses or bulls, being virile, might jostle one another,
even so do the chants jostle one another
when they are twenty-one-fold.
If they should collide,
his sacrifice would be destroyed.
They say: 'Let the fire be twelve-fold,
the chant twelve-fold,

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa yūpāḥ | yaddvādaśo'gnirbhavati | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsareṇaivāsmā annamavarundhe | yaddaśa yūpā bhavanti | daśākṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyamavarundhe | ya ekādaśaḥ | stana evāsyai saḥ |
meaning: एकादश यूपाः । यद्द्वादशोऽग्निर्भवति । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सरेणैवास्मा अन्नमवरुन्धे । यद्दश यूपा भवन्ति । दशाक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । य एकादशः । स्तन एवास्यै सः ।
text_mt:
and the sacrificial posts eleven.'
Since the fire is twelve-fold—
twelve months are the year—
by means of the year he secures food for him.
Since there are ten sacrificial posts—
the Virāj has ten syllables,
the Virāj is food—
by means of the Virāj he secures food.
The one which is the eleventh,
that is her teat.

sanskrit_iast: duha evaināṃ tena | tadāhuḥ | yaddvādaśo'gniḥ syāddvādaśaḥ stoma ekādaśa yūpāḥ | yathā sthūriṇā yāyāt | tādṛktat | ekaviṃśa evāgniḥ syādityāhuḥ | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | yathā praṣṭibhiryāti | tādṛgeva tat
meaning: दुह एवैनां तेन । तदाहुः । यद्द्वादशोऽग्निः स्याद्द्वादशः स्तोम एकादश यूपाः । यथा स्थूरिणा यायात् । तादृक्तत् । एकविंश एवाग्निः स्यादित्याहुः । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । यथा प्रष्टिभिर्याति । तादृगेव तत्
text_mt:
He milks her by means of it.
Regarding this they say:
'If the fire were twelve-fold, the chant twelve-fold, and the sacrificial posts eleven,
that would be just as if one were to drive with an uneven team.'
They say: 'Let the fire be twenty-one-fold,
the chant twenty-one-fold,
and the sacrificial posts twenty-one.'
Just as one drives with evenly matched side-horses,
such indeed is that.

sanskrit_iast: yo vā aśvamedhe tisraḥ kakubho veda | kakuddha rājñāṃ bhavati | ekaviṃśo'gnirbhavati | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | etā vā aśvamedhe tisraḥ kakubhaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | kakuddha rājñāṃ bhavati | yo vā aśvamedhe trīṇi śīrṣāṇi veda | śiro ha rājñāṃ bhavati | ekaviṃśo'gnirbhavati | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | etāni vā aśvamedhe trīṇi śīrṣāṇi | ya evaṃ veda | śiro ha rājñāṃ bhavati
meaning: यो वा अश्वमेधे तिस्रः ककुभो वेद । ककुद्ध राज्ञां भवति । एकविंशोऽग्निर्भवति । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । एता वा अश्वमेधे तिस्रः ककुभः । य एवं वेद । ककुद्ध राज्ञां भवति । यो वा अश्वमेधे त्रीणि शीर्षाणि वेद । शिरो ह राज्ञां भवति । एकविंशोऽग्निर्भवति । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । एतानि वा अश्वमेधे त्रीणि शीर्षाणि । य एवं वेद । शिरो ह राज्ञां भवति
text_mt:
He who knows the three summits in the horse sacrifice
becomes the summit of kings.
The fire is twenty-one-fold,
the chant is twenty-one-fold,
and there are twenty-one sacrificial posts:
these indeed are the three summits in the horse sacrifice.
He who knows thus
becomes the summit of kings.
He who knows the three heads in the horse sacrifice
becomes the head of kings.
The fire is twenty-one-fold,
the chant is twenty-one-fold,
and there are twenty-one sacrificial posts:
these indeed are the three heads in the horse sacrifice.
He who knows thus
becomes the head of kings.

sanskrit_iast: devā vā aśvamedhe pavamāne | suvargaṃ lokaṃ na prājānan | tamaśvaḥ prājānāt | yadaśvamedhe'śvena medhyenodañco bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti | suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai | na vai manuṣyaḥ suvargaṃ lokamañjasā veda | aśvo vai suvargaṃ lokamañjasā veda | yadudgātodgāyet | yathā'kṣetrajño'nyena pathā pratipādayet | tādṛktat
meaning: देवा वा अश्वमेधे पवमाने । सुवर्गं लोकं न प्राजानन् । तमश्वः प्राजानात् । यदश्वमेधेऽश्वेन मेध्येनोदञ्चो बहिष्पवमानं सर्पन्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रज्ञात्यै । न वै मनुष्यः सुवर्गं लोकमञ्जसा वेद । अश्वो वै सुवर्गं लोकमञ्जसा वेद । यदुद्गातोद्गायेत् । यथाऽक्षेत्रज्ञोऽन्येन पथा प्रतिपादयेत् । तादृक्तत्
text_mt:
When the horse sacrifice was being purified,
the gods did not know the way to the heavenly realm;
the horse knew it.
When in the horse sacrifice they creep northward with the sacrificial horse for the outward-purifying chant,
it is for the knowing of the heavenly realm.
A human does not directly know the heavenly realm;
the horse directly knows the heavenly realm.
If the Udgātṛ were to chant,
that would be just as if one ignorant of the terrain were to lead along another path.

sanskrit_iast: udgātāramaparuddhya | aśvamudgīthāya vṛṇīte | yathā kṣetrajño'ñjasā nayati | evamevainamaśvaḥ suvargaṃ lokamañjasā nayati | pucchamanvārabhante | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | hiṃ karoti | sāmaivākaḥ | hiṃ karoti | udgītha evāsya saḥ
meaning: उद्गातारमपरुद्ध्य । अश्वमुद्गीथाय वृणीते । यथा क्षेत्रज्ञोऽञ्जसा नयति । एवमेवैनमश्वः सुवर्गं लोकमञ्जसा नयति । पुच्छमन्वारभन्ते । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । हिं करोति । सामैवाकः । हिं करोति । उद्गीथ एवास्य सः
text_mt:
Setting aside the Udgātṛ,
he chooses the horse for the chanting of the udgītha.
Just as one who knows the terrain leads directly,
even so the horse leads him directly to the heavenly realm.
They hold on to its tail,
for the attainment of the heavenly realm.
It neighs;
it has made the sāman.
It neighs;
that is its udgītha.

sanskrit_iast: vaḍabā uparundhanti | mithunatvāya prajātyai | atho yathopagātāra upagāyanti | tādṛgeva tat | udagāsīdaśvo medhya ityāha | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | prajāpatirudgīthaḥ | udgīthamevāvarundhe | atho ṛkhsāmayoreva pratitiṣṭhati | hiraṇyenopākaroti | jyotirvai hiraṇyam | jyotireva mukhato dadhāti | yajamāne ca prajāsu ca | atho hiraṇyajyotireva yajamānaḥ suvargaṃ lokameti
meaning: वडबा उपरुन्धन्ति । मिथुनत्वाय प्रजात्यै । अथो यथोपगातार उपगायन्ति । तादृगेव तत् । उदगासीदश्वो मेध्य इत्याह । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । प्रजापतिरुद्गीथः । उद्गीथमेवावरुन्धे । अथो ऋख्सामयोरेव प्रतितिष्ठति । हिरण्येनोपाकरोति । ज्योतिर्वै हिरण्यम् । ज्योतिरेव मुखतो दधाति । यजमाने च प्रजासु च । अथो हिरण्यज्योतिरेव यजमानः सुवर्गं लोकमेति

sanskrit_iast: puruṣo vai yajñaḥ | yajñaḥ prajāpatiḥ | yadaśve paśūnniyuñjanti | yajñādeva tadyajñaṃ prayuṅkte | aśvaṃ tūparaṃ gomṛgam | tānagniṣṭha ālabhate | senāmukhameva tathsaṃśyati | tasmādrājamukhaṃ bhīṣmaṃ bhāvukam | āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvaṃ purastāllalāṭe | pūrvāgnimeva taṃ kurute
meaning: पुरुषो वै यज्ञः । यज्ञः प्रजापतिः । यदश्वे पशून्नियुञ्जन्ति । यज्ञादेव तद्यज्ञं प्रयुङ्क्ते । अश्वं तूपरं गोमृगम् । तानग्निष्ठ आलभते । सेनामुखमेव तथ्संश्यति । तस्माद्राजमुखं भीष्मं भावुकम् । आग्नेयं कृष्णग्रीवं पुरस्ताल्ललाटे । पूर्वाग्निमेव तं कुरुते
text_mt:
The sacrifice is the Man;
the sacrifice is Prajāpati.
When they fasten the animals to the horse,
he joins sacrifice to sacrifice.
The horse, the hornless goat, and the wild ox:
these he binds to the central post facing the fire.
Thereby he sharpens the front of the army;
therefore the face of a king is terrible to behold.
One dedicated to Agni, black-necked, in front on the forehead:
he makes that the front fire.

sanskrit_iast: tasmātpūrvāgniṃ purastāthsthāpayanti | pauṣṇamanvañcam | annaṃ vai pūṣā | tasmātpūrvāgnāvāhāryamāharanti | aindrāpauṣṇamupariṣṭāt | aindro vai rājanyo'nnaṃ pūṣā | annādyenaivainamubhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | tasmādrājanyo'nnādo bhāvukaḥ | āgneyau kṛṣṇagrīvau bāhuvoḥ | bāhuvoreva vīryaṃ dhatte
meaning: तस्मात्पूर्वाग्निं पुरस्ताथ्स्थापयन्ति । पौष्णमन्वञ्चम् । अन्नं वै पूषा । तस्मात्पूर्वाग्नावाहार्यमाहरन्ति । ऐन्द्रापौष्णमुपरिष्टात् । ऐन्द्रो वै राजन्योऽन्नं पूषा । अन्नाद्येनैवैनमुभयतः परिगृह्णाति । तस्माद्राजन्योऽन्नादो भावुकः । आग्नेयौ कृष्णग्रीवौ बाहुवोः । बाहुवोरेव वीर्यं धत्ते

sanskrit_iast: tasmādrājanyo bāhubalī bhāvukaḥ | tvāṣṭrau lomaśasakthau sakthyoḥ | sakthyoreva vīryaṃ dhatte | tasmādrājanya ūrubalī bhāvukaḥ | śitipṛṣṭhau bārhaspatyau pṛṣṭhe | brahmavarcasamevopariṣṭāddhatte | atho kavace evaite abhitaḥ paryūhate | tasmādrājanyaḥ saṃnaddho vīryaṃ karoti | dhātre pṛṣodaramadhastāt | pratiṣṭhāmevaitāṃ kurute | atho iyaṃ vai dhātā | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | sauryaṃ balakṣaṃ pucche | uthsedhameva taṃ kurute | tasmāduthsedhaṃ bhaye prajā abhisaṃśrayanti
meaning: तस्माद्राजन्यो बाहुबली भावुकः । त्वाष्ट्रौ लोमशसक्थौ सक्थ्योः । सक्थ्योरेव वीर्यं धत्ते । तस्माद्राजन्य ऊरुबली भावुकः । शितिपृष्ठौ बार्हस्पत्यौ पृष्ठे । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवोपरिष्टाद्धत्ते । अथो कवचे एवैते अभितः पर्यूहते । तस्माद्राजन्यः संनद्धो वीर्यं करोति । धात्रे पृषोदरमधस्तात् । प्रतिष्ठामेवैतां कुरुते । अथो इयं वै धाता । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति । सौर्यं बलक्षं पुच्छे । उथ्सेधमेव तं कुरुते । तस्मादुथ्सेधं भये प्रजा अभिसंश्रयन्ति

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiraśvamedhamasṛjata | so'smāthsṛṣṭo'pākrāmat | tamaṣṭādaśibhiranu prāyuṅkta | tamāpnot | tamāptvā'ṣṭādaśibhiravārundha | yadaṣṭādaśina ālabhyante | yajñameva tairāptvā yajamāno'varundhe | saṃvathsarasya vā eṣā pratimā | yadaṣṭādaśinaḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिरश्वमेधमसृजत । सोऽस्माथ्सृष्टोऽपाक्रामत् । तमष्टादशिभिरनु प्रायुङ्क्त । तमाप्नोत् । तमाप्त्वाऽष्टादशिभिरवारुन्ध । यदष्टादशिन आलभ्यन्ते । यज्ञमेव तैराप्त्वा यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । संवथ्सरस्य वा एषा प्रतिमा । यदष्टादशिनः । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः
text_mt:
Prajāpati created the horse sacrifice.
Having been created, it went away from him.
He pursued it with sets of eighteen [animals];
he reached it;
having reached it, he secured it with sets of eighteen.
Since animals in sets of eighteen are bound,
the sacrificer, having reached the sacrifice with them, secures it.
That which is the sets of eighteen
is the counterpart of the year:
twelve months, five seasons,

sanskrit_iast: saṃvathsaro'ṣṭādaśaḥ | yadaṣṭādaśina ālabhyante | saṃvathsarameva tairāptvā yajamāno'varundhe | agniṣṭhe'nyānpaśūnupākaroti | itareṣu yūpeṣvaṣṭādaśino'jāmitvāya | nava navālabhyante savīryatvāya | yadāraṇyaiḥ saṃsthāpayet | vyavasyetāṃ pitāputrau | vyadhvānaḥ krāmeyuḥ | vidūraṃ grāmayorgrāmāntau syātām
meaning: संवथ्सरोऽष्टादशः । यदष्टादशिन आलभ्यन्ते । संवथ्सरमेव तैराप्त्वा यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । अग्निष्ठेऽन्यान्पशूनुपाकरोति । इतरेषु यूपेष्वष्टादशिनोऽजामित्वाय । नव नवालभ्यन्ते सवीर्यत्वाय । यदारण्यैः संस्थापयेत् । व्यवस्येतां पितापुत्रौ । व्यध्वानः क्रामेयुः । विदूरं ग्रामयोर्ग्रामान्तौ स्याताम्
text_mt:
and the year is the eighteenth.
Since animals in sets of eighteen are bound,
the sacrificer, having reached the year with them, secures it.
At the central post facing the fire he presents the other animals,
and at the remaining posts those in sets of eighteen, for the sake of variety;
nine and nine are bound, for the sake of heroic power.
If he were to conclude [the sacrifice] with wild animals,
father and son would part company,
paths would diverge,
and the borders of two villages would be far apart.

sanskrit_iast: ṛkṣīkāḥ puruṣavyāghrāḥ parimoṣiṇa āvyādhinīstaskarā araṇyeṣvājāyeran | tadāhuḥ | apaśavo vā ete | yadāraṇyāḥ | yadāraṇyaiḥ saṃsthāpayet | kṣipre yajamānamaraṇyaṃ mṛtaṃ hareyuḥ | araṇyāyatanā hyāraṇyāḥ paśava iti | yatpaśūnnālabheta | anavaruddhā asya paśavaḥ syuḥ | yatparyagnikṛtānuthsṛjet
meaning: ऋक्षीकाः पुरुषव्याघ्राः परिमोषिण आव्याधिनीस्तस्करा अरण्येष्वाजायेरन् । तदाहुः । अपशवो वा एते । यदारण्याः । यदारण्यैः संस्थापयेत् । क्षिप्रे यजमानमरण्यं मृतं हरेयुः । अरण्यायतना ह्यारण्याः पशव इति । यत्पशून्नालभेत । अनवरुद्धा अस्य पशवः स्युः । यत्पर्यग्निकृतानुथ्सृजेत्
text_mt:
Noxious insects, man-tigers, robbers, and piercing thieves would be born in the forests.
Therefore they say:
‘These are not domestic animals,
namely the wild ones.
If he were to conclude [the sacrifice] with the wild ones,
they would soon carry the sacrificer dead to the forest,
for the wild animals have the forest as their domain.’
If he were not to seize domestic animals,
his domestic animals would be unobtained.
If he were to release them after carrying fire around them,

sanskrit_iast: yajñaveśasaṃ kuryāt | yatpaśūnālabhate | tenaiva paśūnavarundhe | yat paryagni kṛtānuthsṛjatyayajña veśasāya | avaruddhā asya paśavo bhavanti | na yajñaveśasaṃ bhavati | na yajamānamaraṇyaṃ mṛtaṃ haranti | grāmyaiḥ saṃsthāpayati | ete vai paśavaḥ kṣemo nāma | saṃ pitāputrāvavasyataḥ | samadhvānaḥ krāmanti | samantikaṃ grāmayorgrāmāntau bhavataḥ | narkṣīkāḥ puruṣavyāghrāḥ parimoṣiṇa āvyādhinīstaskarā araṇyeṣvājāyante
meaning: यज्ञवेशसं कुर्यात् । यत्पशूनालभते । तेनैव पशूनवरुन्धे । यत् पर्यग्नि कृतानुथ्सृजत्ययज्ञ वेशसाय । अवरुद्धा अस्य पशवो भवन्ति । न यज्ञवेशसं भवति । न यजमानमरण्यं मृतं हरन्ति । ग्राम्यैः संस्थापयति । एते वै पशवः क्षेमो नाम । सं पितापुत्राववस्यतः । समध्वानः क्रामन्ति । समन्तिकं ग्रामयोर्ग्रामान्तौ भवतः । नर्क्षीकाः पुरुषव्याघ्राः परिमोषिण आव्याधिनीस्तस्करा अरण्येष्वाजायन्ते
text_mt:
he would cause slaughter of the sacrifice.
When he seizes domestic animals,
by that alone he obtains domestic animals.
When he releases them after carrying fire around them to avoid slaughter of the sacrifice,
his domestic animals become obtained,
there is no slaughter of the sacrifice,
and they do not carry the sacrificer dead to the forest.
He concludes [the rite] with domestic animals.
These domestic animals, indeed, are security.
Father and son settle together;
the pathways converge;
the borders of two villages are close together;
and noxious insects, man-tigers, robbers, and piercing thieves are not born in the forests.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirakāmayatobhau lokāvavarundhīyeti | sa etānubhayānpaśūnapaśyat | grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | tānālabhata | tairvai sa ubhau lokāvavārundha | grāmyaireva paśubhirimaṃ lokamavārundha | āraṇyairamum | yadgrāmyānpaśūnālabhate | imameva tairlokamavarundhe | yadāraṇyān
meaning: प्रजापतिरकामयतोभौ लोकाववरुन्धीयेति । स एतानुभयान्पशूनपश्यत् । ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । तानालभत । तैर्वै स उभौ लोकाववारुन्ध । ग्राम्यैरेव पशुभिरिमं लोकमवारुन्ध । आरण्यैरमुम् । यद्ग्राम्यान्पशूनालभते । इममेव तैर्लोकमवरुन्धे । यदारण्यान्
text_mt:
Prajāpati desired: ‘May I obtain both worlds.’
He saw both kinds of animals,
both domestic and wild.
He seized them.
With them, indeed, he obtained both worlds.
With the domestic animals he obtained this world,
with the wild ones, yonder world.
When he seizes domestic animals,
with them he obtains this world.
When [he seizes] wild ones,

sanskrit_iast: amuṃ taiḥ | anavaruddho vā etasya saṃvathsara ityāhuḥ | ya ita itaścāturmāsyāni saṃvathsaraṃ prayuṅkta iti | etāvān vai saṃvathsaraḥ | yaccāturmāsyāni | yadete cāturmāsyāḥ paśava ālabhyante | pratyakṣameva taiḥ saṃvathsaraṃ yajamāno'varundhe | vi vā eṣa prajayā paśubhirṛddhyate | yaḥ saṃvathsaraṃ prayuṅkte | saṃvathsaraḥ suvargo lokaḥ
meaning: अमुं तैः । अनवरुद्धो वा एतस्य संवथ्सर इत्याहुः । य इत इतश्चातुर्मास्यानि संवथ्सरं प्रयुङ्क्त इति । एतावान् वै संवथ्सरः । यच्चातुर्मास्यानि । यदेते चातुर्मास्याः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । प्रत्यक्षमेव तैः संवथ्सरं यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । वि वा एष प्रजया पशुभिरृद्ध्यते । यः संवथ्सरं प्रयुङ्क्ते । संवथ्सरः सुवर्गो लोकः
text_mt:
with them [he obtains] yonder world.
They say: ‘Unobtained is the year for him
who employs the year here and there through the Cāturmāsyas.’
The year, indeed, is of such extent
as the Cāturmāsyas.
When these Cāturmāsya animals are seized,
by them the sacrificer directly obtains the year.
He is deprived of offspring and domestic animals,
who employs the year.
The year is the heavenly realm;

sanskrit_iast: suvargaṃ tu lokaṃ nāparādhnoti | prajā vai paśava ekādaśinī | yadeta aikādaśināḥ paśava ālabhyante | sākṣādeva prajāṃ paśūn yajamāno'varundhe | prajāpatirvirājamasṛjata | sā sṛṣṭā'śvamedhaṃ prāviśat | tāṃ daśibhiranu prāyuṅkta | tāmāpnot | tāmāptvā daśibhiravārundha | yaddaśina ālabhyante
meaning: सुवर्गं तु लोकं नापराध्नोति । प्रजा वै पशव एकादशिनी । यदेत ऐकादशिनाः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । साक्षादेव प्रजां पशून् यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । प्रजापतिर्विराजमसृजत । सा सृष्टाऽश्वमेधं प्राविशत् । तां दशिभिरनु प्रायुङ्क्त । तामाप्नोत् । तामाप्त्वा दशिभिरवारुन्ध । यद्दशिन आलभ्यन्ते
text_mt:
he does not fail to reach the heavenly realm.
Offspring and domestic animals are the group of eleven.
When these eleven animals are seized,
the sacrificer directly obtains offspring and domestic animals.
Prajāpati created the Virāj.
Having been created, she entered the horse sacrifice.
He pursued her with groups of ten.
He reached her.
Having reached her, he obtained her with the groups of ten.
When groups of ten are seized,

sanskrit_iast: virājameva tairāptvā yajamāno'varundhe | ekādaśa daśata ālabhyante | ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭup | traiṣṭubhāḥ paśavaḥ | paśūnevāvarundhe | vaiśvadevo vā aśvaḥ | nānādevatyāḥ paśavo bhavanti | aśvasya sarvatvāya | nānārūpā bhavanti | tasmānnānārūpāḥ paśavaḥ | bahurūpā bhavanti | tasmādbahurūpāḥ paśavaḥ samṛddhyai
meaning: विराजमेव तैराप्त्वा यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । एकादश दशत आलभ्यन्ते । एकादशाक्षरा त्रिष्टुप् । त्रैष्टुभाः पशवः । पशूनेवावरुन्धे । वैश्वदेवो वा अश्वः । नानादेवत्याः पशवो भवन्ति । अश्वस्य सर्वत्वाय । नानारूपा भवन्ति । तस्मान्नानारूपाः पशवः । बहुरूपा भवन्ति । तस्माद्बहुरूपाः पशवः समृद्ध्यै

sanskrit_iast: asmai vai lokāya grāmyāḥ paśava ālabhyante | amuṣmā āraṇyāḥ | yadgrāmyānpaśūnālabhate | imameva tairlokamavarundhe | yadāraṇyān | amuṃ taiḥ | ubhayānpaśūnālabhate | grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | ubhayorlokayoravaruddhyai | ubhayān paśūnālabhate
meaning: अस्मै वै लोकाय ग्राम्याः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । अमुष्मा आरण्याः । यद्ग्राम्यान्पशूनालभते । इममेव तैर्लोकमवरुन्धे । यदारण्यान् । अमुं तैः । उभयान्पशूनालभते । ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । उभयोर्लोकयोरवरुद्ध्यै । उभयान् पशूनालभते
text_mt:
For this world domestic animals are seized,
for yonder world, the wild ones.
When he seizes domestic animals,
he obtains this world with them.
When [he seizes] wild ones,
[he obtains] yonder world with them.
He seizes both kinds of animals,
both domestic and wild,
for the obtaining of both worlds.
He seizes both kinds of animals,

sanskrit_iast: grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | ubhayasyānnādyasyāvaruddhyai | ubhayānpaśūnālabhate | grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | ubhayeṣāṃ paśūnāmavaruddhyai | trayastrayo bhavanti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | brahmavādino vadanti | kasmāthsatyāt
meaning: ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । उभयस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै । उभयान्पशूनालभते । ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । उभयेषां पशूनामवरुद्ध्यै । त्रयस्त्रयो भवन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । कस्माथ्सत्यात्
text_mt:
both domestic and wild,
for the obtaining of both kinds of food.
He seizes both kinds of animals,
both domestic and wild,
for the obtaining of both kinds of animals.
They are in sets of three.
Three are these worlds,
for the attainment of these worlds.
The discussers of sacred lore say:
‘By what truth

sanskrit_iast: asmiṃ lloke bahavaḥ kāmā iti | yathsamānībhyo devatābhyo'nye'nye paśava ālabhyante | asminneva taṃ lloke kāmāndadhāti | tasmādasmiṃ lloke bahavaḥ kāmāḥ | trayāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ saha vapā juhoti | tryāvṛto vai devāḥ | tryāvṛta ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | eṣāṃ lokānāṃ klṛptyai | paryagnikṛtānāraṇyānuthsṛjantyahiṃsāyai
meaning: अस्मिं ल्लोके बहवः कामा इति । यथ्समानीभ्यो देवताभ्योऽन्येऽन्ये पशव आलभ्यन्ते । अस्मिन्नेव तं ल्लोके कामान्दधाति । तस्मादस्मिं ल्लोके बहवः कामाः । त्रयाणां त्रयाणां सह वपा जुहोति । त्र्यावृतो वै देवाः । त्र्यावृत इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । एषां लोकानां क्लृप्त्यै । पर्यग्निकृतानारण्यानुथ्सृजन्त्यहिंसायै

sanskrit_iast: yuñjanti bradhnamityāha | asau vā ādityo bradhnaḥ | ādityamevāsmai yunakti | aruṣamityāha | agnirvā aruṣaḥ | agnimevāsmai yunakti | carantamityāha | vāyurvai caran | vāyumevāsmai yunakti | paritasthuṣa ityāha
meaning: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमित्याह । असौ वा आदित्यो ब्रध्नः । आदित्यमेवास्मै युनक्ति । अरुषमित्याह । अग्निर्वा अरुषः । अग्निमेवास्मै युनक्ति । चरन्तमित्याह । वायुर्वै चरन् । वायुमेवास्मै युनक्ति । परितस्थुष इत्याह

sanskrit_iast: ime vai lokāḥ paritasthuṣaḥ | imānevāsmai lokān yunakti | rocante rocanā divītyāha | nakṣatrāṇi vai rocanā divi | nakṣatrāṇyevāsmai rocayati | yuñjantyasya kāmyetyāha | kāmānevāsmai yunakti | harī vipakṣasetyāha | ime vai harī vipakṣasā | ime evāsmai yunakti
meaning: इमे वै लोकाः परितस्थुषः । इमानेवास्मै लोकान् युनक्ति । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवीत्याह । नक्षत्राणि वै रोचना दिवि । नक्षत्राण्येवास्मै रोचयति । युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्येत्याह । कामानेवास्मै युनक्ति । हरी विपक्षसेत्याह । इमे वै हरी विपक्षसा । इमे एवास्मै युनक्ति

sanskrit_iast: śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasetyāha | ahorātre vai nṛvāhasā | ahorātre evāsmai yunakti | etā evāsmai devatā yunakti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketava iti dhvajaṃ pratimuñcati | yaśa evainaṃ rājñāṃ gamayati | jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkamityāha | yathā yajurevaitat | ye te panthānaḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāsa ityadhvaryuryajamānaṃ vācayatyabhijityai
meaning: शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसेत्याह । अहोरात्रे वै नृवाहसा । अहोरात्रे एवास्मै युनक्ति । एता एवास्मै देवता युनक्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतव इति ध्वजं प्रतिमुञ्चति । यश एवैनं राज्ञां गमयति । जीमूतस्येव भवति प्रतीकमित्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । ये ते पन्थानः सवितः पूर्व्यास इत्यध्वर्युर्यजमानं वाचयत्यभिजित्यै

sanskrit_iast: parā vā etasya yajña eti | yasya paśurupākṛto'nyatra vedyā eti | etaṃ stotaretena pathā punaraśvamāvartayāsi na ityāha | vāyurvai stotā | vāyumevāsya parastāddadhātyāvṛttyai | yathā vai haviṣo gṛhītasya skandati | evaṃ vā etadaśvasya skandati | yadasyopākṛtasya lomāni śīyante | yadvāleṣu kācānāvayanti | lomānyevāsya tathsaṃbharanti
meaning: परा वा एतस्य यज्ञ एति । यस्य पशुरुपाकृतोऽन्यत्र वेद्या एति । एतं स्तोतरेतेन पथा पुनरश्वमावर्तयासि न इत्याह । वायुर्वै स्तोता । वायुमेवास्य परस्ताद्दधात्यावृत्त्यै । यथा वै हविषो गृहीतस्य स्कन्दति । एवं वा एतदश्वस्य स्कन्दति । यदस्योपाकृतस्य लोमानि शीयन्ते । यद्वालेषु काचानावयन्ति । लोमान्येवास्य तथ्संभरन्ति
text_mt:
The sacrifice of him goes away,
whose animal, once brought up, goes elsewhere than the altar ground.
‘O praiser, turn this horse back to us by this path,’ he says.
Vāyu, indeed, is the praiser;
he places Vāyu beyond it, for turning back.
Just as that which is spilled of the offered oblation [is lost],
so also is that which spills of the horse,
when the hairs of him who has been brought up fall out.
When they weave beads into the tail hairs,
they thereby collect his hairs.

sanskrit_iast: bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti prājāpatyābhirāvayanti | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā samardhayanti | bhūriti mahiṣī | bhuva iti vāvātā | suvariti parivṛktī | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai | hiraṇyayāḥ kācā bhavanti | jyotirvai hiraṇyam | rāṣṭramaśvamedhaḥ
meaning: भूर्भुवः सुवरिति प्राजापत्याभिरावयन्ति । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया समर्धयन्ति । भूरिति महिषी । भुव इति वावाता । सुवरिति परिवृक्ती । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै । हिरण्ययाः काचा भवन्ति । ज्योतिर्वै हिरण्यम् । राष्ट्रमश्वमेधः

sanskrit_iast: jyotiścaivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | sahasraṃ bhavanti | sahasrasaṃmitaḥ suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasyābhijityai | apa vā etasmātteja indriyaṃ paśavaḥ śrīḥ krāmanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | vasavastvā'ñjantu gāyatreṇa chandaseti mahiṣyabhyanakti | tejo vā ājyam | tejo gāyatrī | tejasaivāsmai tejo'varundhe
meaning: ज्योतिश्चैवास्मै राष्ट्रं च समीची दधाति । सहस्रं भवन्ति । सहस्रसंमितः सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिजित्यै । अप वा एतस्मात्तेज इन्द्रियं पशवः श्रीः क्रामन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । वसवस्त्वाऽञ्जन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसेति महिष्यभ्यनक्ति । तेजो वा आज्यम् । तेजो गायत्री । तेजसैवास्मै तेजोऽवरुन्धे
text_mt:
Light and realm he thus unites for him.
There are a thousand [beads].
The heavenly realm is measured by a thousand.
[It is] for winning the heavenly realm.
From him who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice, fiery energy, power of the senses, domestic animals, and fortune indeed depart.
With "May the Vasus anoint you with the gāyatrī metre," the Chief Queen anoints [him].
Ghee is fiery energy;
the gāyatrī is fiery energy.
By means of fiery energy, she secures fiery energy for him.

sanskrit_iast: rudrāstvā'ñjantu traiṣṭubhena chandaseti vāvātā | tejo vā ājyam | indriyaṃ triṣṭup | tejasaivāsmā indriyamavarundhe | ādityāstvā'ñjantu jāgatena chandaseti parivṛktī | tejo vā ājyam | paśavo jagatī | tejasaivāsmai paśūnavarundhe | patnayo'bhyañjanti | śriyā vā etadrūpam
meaning: रुद्रास्त्वाऽञ्जन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसेति वावाता । तेजो वा आज्यम् । इन्द्रियं त्रिष्टुप् । तेजसैवास्मा इन्द्रियमवरुन्धे । आदित्यास्त्वाऽञ्जन्तु जागतेन छन्दसेति परिवृक्ती । तेजो वा आज्यम् । पशवो जगती । तेजसैवास्मै पशूनवरुन्धे । पत्नयोऽभ्यञ्जन्ति । श्रिया वा एतद्रूपम्
text_mt:
With "May the Rudras anoint you with the triṣṭubh metre," [anoints] the Favorite Wife.
Ghee is fiery energy;
the triṣṭubh is power of the senses.
By means of fiery energy, she secures power of the senses for him.
With "May the Ādityas anoint you with the jagatī metre," [anoints] the Discarded Wife.
Ghee is fiery energy;
the jagatī is domestic animals.
By means of fiery energy, she secures domestic animals for him.
The wives anoint [him].
For this is the form of fortune:

sanskrit_iast: yatpatnayaḥ | śriyamevāsmintaddadhati | nāsmātteja indriyaṃ paśavaḥ śrīrapakrāmanti | lājī ñchācīn yaśomamāṃ ityatiriktamannamaśvāyopāharanti | prajāmevānnādīṃ kurvate | etaddevā annamattaitadannamaddhi prajāpata ityāha | prajāyāmevānnādyaṃ dadhate | yadi nāvajighret | agniḥ paśurāsīdityavaghrāpayet | ava haiva jighrati | ākrān vājī kramairatyakramīdvājī dyauste pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛthivī sadhasthamityaśvamanumantrayate | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai | samiddho añjankṛdaraṃ matīnāmityaśvasyāpriyo bhavanti sarūpatvāya
meaning: यत्पत्नयः । श्रियमेवास्मिन्तद्दधति । नास्मात्तेज इन्द्रियं पशवः श्रीरपक्रामन्ति । लाजी ञ्छाचीन् यशोममां इत्यतिरिक्तमन्नमश्वायोपाहरन्ति । प्रजामेवान्नादीं कुर्वते । एतद्देवा अन्नमत्तैतदन्नमद्धि प्रजापत इत्याह । प्रजायामेवान्नाद्यं दधते । यदि नावजिघ्रेत् । अग्निः पशुरासीदित्यवघ्रापयेत् । अव हैव जिघ्रति । आक्रान् वाजी क्रमैरत्यक्रमीद्वाजी द्यौस्ते पृष्ठं पृथिवी सधस्थमित्यश्वमनुमन्त्रयते । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै । समिद्धो अञ्जन्कृदरं मतीनामित्यश्वस्याप्रियो भवन्ति सरूपत्वाय
text_mt:
that there are wives.
They thus place fortune in him.
Fiery energy, power of the senses, domestic animals, and fortune do not depart from him.
With "Fried grains, barley meal, [bring] honor to me!" they offer the surplus food to the horse.
They make offspring eaters of food.
With "O gods, eat this food; eat this food, O Prajāpati," he says.
They place food and food-eating in offspring.
If he should not smell it,
he should make him smell it with "Agni was the animal."
He indeed smells it.
With "The courser has advanced, the courser has stepped beyond with strides; the sky is your back, the earth your seat," he addresses the horse with the mantra,
for winning these worlds.
With "Kindled, anointing the seat of the prayers..." are the Āprī verses of the horse, for conformity of form.

sanskrit_iast: tejasā vā eṣa brahmavarcasena vyṛddhyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | hotā ca brahmā ca brahmodyaṃ vadataḥ | tejasā caivainaṃ brahmavarcasena ca samardhayataḥ | dakṣiṇato brahmā bhavati | dakṣiṇata āyatano vai brahmā | bārhaspatyo vai brahmā | brahmavarcasamevāsya dakṣiṇato dadhāti | tasmāddakṣiṇo'rdho brahmavarcasitaraḥ | uttarato hotā bhavati
meaning: तेजसा वा एष ब्रह्मवर्चसेन व्यृद्ध्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । होता च ब्रह्मा च ब्रह्मोद्यं वदतः । तेजसा चैवैनं ब्रह्मवर्चसेन च समर्धयतः । दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा भवति । दक्षिणत आयतनो वै ब्रह्मा । बार्हस्पत्यो वै ब्रह्मा । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवास्य दक्षिणतो दधाति । तस्माद्दक्षिणोऽर्धो ब्रह्मवर्चसितरः । उत्तरतो होता भवति
text_mt:
He who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice is deprived of fiery energy and spiritual preeminence.
The Hotṛ and the Brahmā speak the theological dialogue.
They endow him with fiery energy and spiritual preeminence.
The Brahmā is on the south.
The Brahmā has his seat on the south;
the Brahmā belongs to Bṛhaspati.
He thus places spiritual preeminence on his south;
therefore the southern half is richer in spiritual preeminence.
The Hotṛ is on the north.

sanskrit_iast: uttarata āyatano vai hotā | āgneyo vai hotā | tejo vā agniḥ | teja evāsyottarato dadhāti | tasmāduttaro'rdhastejasvitaraḥ | yūpamabhito vadataḥ | yajamānadevatyo vai yūpaḥ | yajamānameva tejasā ca brahmavarcasena ca samardhayataḥ | kiṃsvidāsītpūrvacittirityāha | dyaurvai vṛṣṭiḥ pūrvacittiḥ
meaning: उत्तरत आयतनो वै होता । आग्नेयो वै होता । तेजो वा अग्निः । तेज एवास्योत्तरतो दधाति । तस्मादुत्तरोऽर्धस्तेजस्वितरः । यूपमभितो वदतः । यजमानदेवत्यो वै यूपः । यजमानमेव तेजसा च ब्रह्मवर्चसेन च समर्धयतः । किंस्विदासीत्पूर्वचित्तिरित्याह । द्यौर्वै वृष्टिः पूर्वचित्तिः
text_mt:
The Hotṛ has his seat on the north;
the Hotṛ belongs to Agni.
Agni is fiery energy.
He thus places fiery energy on his north;
therefore the northern half is richer in fiery energy.
They speak on either side of the sacrificial post.
The sacrificial post has the sacrificer as its deity.
They endow the sacrificer with fiery energy and spiritual preeminence.
"What was the first thought?" he says.
The sky, rain, was the first thought.

sanskrit_iast: divameva vṛṣṭimavarundhe | kiṃ svidāsīdbṛhadvaya ityāha | aśvo vai bṛhadvayaḥ | aśvamevāvarundhe | kiṃsvidāsītpiśaṃgiletyāha | rātrirvai piśaṃgilā | rātrimevāvarundhe | kiṃsvidāsītpilippiletyāha | śrīrvai pilippilā | annādyamevāvarundhe
meaning: दिवमेव वृष्टिमवरुन्धे । किं स्विदासीद्बृहद्वय इत्याह । अश्वो वै बृहद्वयः । अश्वमेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विदासीत्पिशंगिलेत्याह । रात्रिर्वै पिशंगिला । रात्रिमेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विदासीत्पिलिप्पिलेत्याह । श्रीर्वै पिलिप्पिला । अन्नाद्यमेवावरुन्धे
text_mt:
He secures the sky, rain.
"What was the great bird?" he says.
The horse was the great bird.
He secures the horse.
"What was the reddish-brown one?" he says.
Night was the reddish-brown one.
He secures the night.
"What was the slippery one?" he says.
Fortune was the slippery one.
He secures food and food-eating.

sanskrit_iast: kaḥ svidekākī caratītyāha | asau vā āditya ekākī carati | teja evāvarundhe | ka u svijjāyate punarityāha | candramā vai jāyate punaḥ | āyurevāvarundhe | kiṃsviddhimasya bheṣajamityāha | agnirvai himasya bheṣajam | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe | kiṃsvidāvapanaṃ mahadityāha
meaning: कः स्विदेकाकी चरतीत्याह । असौ वा आदित्य एकाकी चरति । तेज एवावरुन्धे । क उ स्विज्जायते पुनरित्याह । चन्द्रमा वै जायते पुनः । आयुरेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विद्धिमस्य भेषजमित्याह । अग्निर्वै हिमस्य भेषजम् । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विदावपनं महदित्याह
text_mt:
"Who wanders alone?" he says.
Yonder sun wanders alone.
He secures fiery energy.
"And who is born again?" he says.
The moon is born again.
He secures lifespan.
"What is the remedy for cold?" he says.
Agni is the remedy for cold.
He secures spiritual preeminence.
"What is the great scattering-ground?" he says.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ vai loka āvapanaṃ mahat | asminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | pṛcchāmi tvā paramaṃ taṃ pṛthivyā ityāha | vedirvai paro'ntaḥ pṛthivyāḥ | vedimevāvarundhe | pṛcchāmi tvā bhuvanasya nābhimityāha | yajño vai bhuvanasya nābhiḥ | yajñamevāvarundhe | pṛcchāmi tvā vṛṣṇo aśvasya reta ityāha | somo vai vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ | somapīthamevāvarundhe | pṛcchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyometyāha | brahma vai vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe
meaning: अयं वै लोक आवपनं महत् । अस्मिन्नेव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । पृच्छामि त्वा परमं तं पृथिव्या इत्याह । वेदिर्वै परोऽन्तः पृथिव्याः । वेदिमेवावरुन्धे । पृच्छामि त्वा भुवनस्य नाभिमित्याह । यज्ञो वै भुवनस्य नाभिः । यज्ञमेवावरुन्धे । पृच्छामि त्वा वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेत इत्याह । सोमो वै वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः । सोमपीथमेवावरुन्धे । पृच्छामि वाचः परमं व्योमेत्याह । ब्रह्म वै वाचः परमं व्योम । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे
text_mt:
"This world is the great scattering-ground."
He establishes himself in this world.
"I ask you about the furthest limit of the earth," he says.
The altar is the furthest limit of the earth.
He secures the altar.
"I ask you about the navel of the world," he says.
The sacrifice is the navel of the world.
He secures the sacrifice.
"I ask you about the seed of the lusty horse," he says.
Soma is the seed of the lusty horse.
He secures the drinking of Soma.
"I ask about the highest heaven of speech," he says.
Brahman is the highest heaven of speech.
He secures spiritual preeminence.

sanskrit_iast: apa vā etasmātprāṇāḥ krāmanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāheti saṃjñapyamāna āhutīrjuhoti | prāṇānevāsmindadhāti | nāsmātprāṇā apakrāmanti | avantī sthāvantīstvā'vantu | priyaṃ tvā priyāṇām | varṣiṣṭhamāpyānām | nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe vaso mametyāha | apaivāsmai taddhnuvate
meaning: अप वा एतस्मात्प्राणाः क्रामन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहेति संज्ञप्यमान आहुतीर्जुहोति । प्राणानेवास्मिन्दधाति । नास्मात्प्राणा अपक्रामन्ति । अवन्ती स्थावन्तीस्त्वाऽवन्तु । प्रियं त्वा प्रियाणाम् । वर्षिष्ठमाप्यानाम् । निधीनां त्वा निधिपतिं हवामहे वसो ममेत्याह । अपैवास्मै तद्ध्नुवते
text_mt:
The vital breaths depart from him
who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice.
With "To exhalation, svāhā! To diffused breath, svāhā!" he offers oblations while [the horse] is being quieted.
He places the vital breaths in him;
the vital breaths do not depart from him.
With "You are helping ones; may the helping ones help you; / You who are dear among the dear ones, / Highest among friends, / You the lord of treasures among treasures do we invoke, O my treasure," he says.
They appease it for him;

sanskrit_iast: atho dhuvantyevainam | atho nyevāsmai hnuvate | triḥ pariyanti | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya evainaṃ lokebhyo dhuvate | triḥ punaḥ pariyanti | ṣaṭthsaṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtubhirevainaṃ dhuvate | apa vā etebhyaḥ prāṇāḥ krāmanti
meaning: अथो धुवन्त्येवैनम् । अथो न्येवास्मै ह्नुवते । त्रिः परियन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एभ्य एवैनं लोकेभ्यो धुवते । त्रिः पुनः परियन्ति । षट्थ्संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतुभिरेवैनं धुवते । अप वा एतेभ्यः प्राणाः क्रामन्ति

sanskrit_iast: ye yajñe dhuvanaṃ tanvate | navakṛtvaḥ pariyanti | nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ | prāṇānevātmandadhate | naibhyaḥ prāṇā apakrāmanti | ambe ambālyambika iti patnīmudānayati | ahvataivainām | subhage kāmpīlavāsinītyāha | tapa evaināmupanayati | suvarge loke saṃprorṇvāthāmityāha
meaning: ये यज्ञे धुवनं तन्वते । नवकृत्वः परियन्ति । नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः । प्राणानेवात्मन्दधते । नैभ्यः प्राणा अपक्रामन्ति । अम्बे अम्बाल्यम्बिक इति पत्नीमुदानयति । अह्वतैवैनाम् । सुभगे काम्पीलवासिनीत्याह । तप एवैनामुपनयति । सुवर्गे लोके संप्रोर्ण्वाथामित्याह

sanskrit_iast: suvargamevaināṃ lokaṃ gamayati | ā'hamajāni garbhadhamā tvamajāsi garbhadhamityāha | prajā vai paśavo garbhaḥ | prajāmeva paśūnātmandhatte | devā vā aśvamedhe pavamāne | suvargaṃ lokaṃ na prājānan | tamaśvaḥ prājānāt | yathsūcībhirasi pathānkalpayanti | suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai | gāyatrī triṣṭubjagatītyāha
meaning: सुवर्गमेवैनां लोकं गमयति । आऽहमजानि गर्भधमा त्वमजासि गर्भधमित्याह । प्रजा वै पशवो गर्भः । प्रजामेव पशूनात्मन्धत्ते । देवा वा अश्वमेधे पवमाने । सुवर्गं लोकं न प्राजानन् । तमश्वः प्राजानात् । यथ्सूचीभिरसि पथान्कल्पयन्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रज्ञात्यै । गायत्री त्रिष्टुब्जगतीत्याह
text_mt:
he makes her go to the heavenly realm.
With "I shall drive in the embryo-layer; drive in the embryo-layer," he says.
Offspring, domestic animals, are the embryo;
he places offspring and domestic animals in himself.
When the horse sacrifice was purifying itself, the gods
did not know the heavenly realm.
The horse knew it.
When they arrange the knife-paths with needles,
[it is] for the knowing of the heavenly realm.
"Gāyatrī, triṣṭubh, jagatī," he says;

sanskrit_iast: yathā yajurevaitat | trayyaḥ sūcyo bhavanti | ayasmayyo rajatā hariṇyaḥ | asya vai lokasya rūpamayasmayyaḥ | antarikṣasya rajatāḥ | divo hariṇyaḥ | diśo vā ayasmayyaḥ | avāntaradiśā rajatāḥ | ūrdhvā hariṇyaḥ | diśa evāsmai kalpayati | kastvā chyati kastvā viśāstītyāhāhiṃsāyai
meaning: यथा यजुरेवैतत् । त्रय्यः सूच्यो भवन्ति । अयस्मय्यो रजता हरिण्यः । अस्य वै लोकस्य रूपमयस्मय्यः । अन्तरिक्षस्य रजताः । दिवो हरिण्यः । दिशो वा अयस्मय्यः । अवान्तरदिशा रजताः । ऊर्ध्वा हरिण्यः । दिश एवास्मै कल्पयति । कस्त्वा छ्यति कस्त्वा विशास्तीत्याहाहिंसायै

sanskrit_iast: apa vā etasmācchrī rāṣṭraṃ krāmati | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ūrdhvāmenāmucchrayatādityāha | śrīrvai rāṣṭramaśvamedhaḥ | śriyamevāsmai rāṣṭramūrdhvamucchrayati | veṇubhāraṃ girāvivetyāha | rāṣṭraṃ vai bhāraḥ | rāṣṭramevāsmai paryūhati | athāsyā madhyamedhatāmityāha | śrīrvai rāṣṭrasya madhyam
meaning: अप वा एतस्माच्छ्री राष्ट्रं क्रामति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । ऊर्ध्वामेनामुच्छ्रयतादित्याह । श्रीर्वै राष्ट्रमश्वमेधः । श्रियमेवास्मै राष्ट्रमूर्ध्वमुच्छ्रयति । वेणुभारं गिराविवेत्याह । राष्ट्रं वै भारः । राष्ट्रमेवास्मै पर्यूहति । अथास्या मध्यमेधतामित्याह । श्रीर्वै राष्ट्रस्य मध्यम्
text_mt: Prosperity and dominion depart from him who performs the horse sacrifice. When he says, 'Raise her upwards,' the horse sacrifice is indeed prosperity and dominion; thus he raises up prosperity and dominion for him. When he says, 'like a burden of reeds upon a mountain,' dominion is indeed a burden; thus he heaps dominion upon him. When he says, 'Then let her middle swell,' the middle of dominion is indeed prosperity;

sanskrit_iast: śriyamevāvarundhe | śīte vāte punannivetyāha | kṣemo vai rāṣṭrasya śīto vātaḥ | kṣemamevāvarundhe | yaddhariṇī yavamattītyāha | viḍvai hariṇī | rāṣṭraṃ yavaḥ | viśaṃ caivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | na puṣṭaṃ paśumanyata ityāha | tasmādrājā paśūnna puṣyati
meaning: श्रियमेवावरुन्धे । शीते वाते पुनन्निवेत्याह । क्षेमो वै राष्ट्रस्य शीतो वातः । क्षेममेवावरुन्धे । यद्धरिणी यवमत्तीत्याह । विड्वै हरिणी । राष्ट्रं यवः । विशं चैवास्मै राष्ट्रं च समीची दधाति । न पुष्टं पशुमन्यत इत्याह । तस्माद्राजा पशून्न पुष्यति
text_mt: thus he secures prosperity. When he says, 'as if winnowing in a cool breeze,' a cool breeze is indeed the security of dominion; thus he secures security. When he says, 'When the doe eats the barley,' the people are the doe and dominion is the barley; thus he aligns the people and dominion with each other. When he says, 'She thinks not of the fattened animal,' therefore the king does not fatten domestic animals.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrā yadaryajārā na poṣāya dhanāyatītyāha | tasmādvaiśīputraṃ nābhiṣiñcante | iyaṃ yakā śakuntiketyāha | viḍvai śakuntikā | rāṣṭramaśvamedhaḥ | viśaṃ caivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | āhalamiti sarpatītyāha | tasmādrāṣṭrāya viśaḥ sarpanti | āhataṃ gabhe pasa ityāha | viḍvai gabhaḥ
meaning: शूद्रा यदर्यजारा न पोषाय धनायतीत्याह । तस्माद्वैशीपुत्रं नाभिषिञ्चन्ते । इयं यका शकुन्तिकेत्याह । विड्वै शकुन्तिका । राष्ट्रमश्वमेधः । विशं चैवास्मै राष्ट्रं च समीची दधाति । आहलमिति सर्पतीत्याह । तस्माद्राष्ट्राय विशः सर्पन्ति । आहतं गभे पस इत्याह । विड्वै गभः
text_mt: When he says, 'When the Śūdra woman has an Ārya paramour, she does not strive for wealth to flourish,' therefore they do not consecrate the son of a Vaiśya woman. When he says, 'This little bird here,' the people are the little bird and the horse sacrifice is dominion; thus he aligns the people and dominion with each other. When he says, 'She creeps, crying āhal,' therefore the people creep towards dominion. When he says, 'The penis is struck into the vulva,' the vulva is the people,

sanskrit_iast: rāṣṭraṃ pasaḥ | rāṣṭrameva viśyāhanti | tasmādrāṣṭraṃ viśaṃ ghātukam | mātā ca te pitā ca ta ityāha | iyaṃ vai mātā | asau pitā | ābhyāmevainaṃ paridadāti | agraṃ vṛkṣasya rohata ityāha | śrīrvai vṛkṣasyāgram | śriyamevāvarundhe
meaning: राष्ट्रं पसः । राष्ट्रमेव विश्याहन्ति । तस्माद्राष्ट्रं विशं घातुकम् । माता च ते पिता च त इत्याह । इयं वै माता । असौ पिता । आभ्यामेवैनं परिददाति । अग्रं वृक्षस्य रोहत इत्याह । श्रीर्वै वृक्षस्याग्रम् । श्रियमेवावरुन्धे
text_mt: and the penis is dominion; thus he drives dominion into the people; therefore dominion is destructive to the people. When he says, 'Both your mother and your father,' this [earth] is the mother and yonder [heaven] is the father; he entrusts him to these two. When he says, 'climb to the top of the tree,' the top of the tree is prosperity; thus he secures prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: prasulāmīti te pitā gabhe muṣṭimataṃsayadityāha | viḍvai gabhaḥ | rāṣṭraṃ muṣṭiḥ | rāṣṭrameva viśyāhanti | tasmādrāṣṭraṃ viśaṃ ghātukam | apa vā etebhyaḥ prāṇāḥ krāmanti | ye yajñe'pūtaṃ vadanti | dadhikrāvṇṇo akāriṣamiti surabhimatīmṛcaṃ vadanti | prāṇā vai surabhayaḥ | prāṇānevātmandadhate | naibhyaḥ prāṇā apakrāmanti | āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva ityadbhirmārjayante | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ | devatābhirevātmānaṃ pavayante
meaning: प्रसुलामीति ते पिता गभे मुष्टिमतंसयदित्याह । विड्वै गभः । राष्ट्रं मुष्टिः । राष्ट्रमेव विश्याहन्ति । तस्माद्राष्ट्रं विशं घातुकम् । अप वा एतेभ्यः प्राणाः क्रामन्ति । ये यज्ञेऽपूतं वदन्ति । दधिक्राव्ण्णो अकारिषमिति सुरभिमतीमृचं वदन्ति । प्राणा वै सुरभयः । प्राणानेवात्मन्दधते । नैभ्यः प्राणा अपक्रामन्ति । आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुव इत्यद्भिर्मार्जयन्ते । आपो वै सर्वा देवताः । देवताभिरेवात्मानं पवयन्ते
text_mt: When he says, 'Saying "I am thrusting," your father moved his fist in the vulva,' the vulva is the people, and the fist is dominion; he drives dominion into the people; therefore dominion is destructive to the people. Breaths depart from those who speak what is unpurified at the sacrifice. They recite the fragrant verse, 'I have celebrated Dadhikrāvan'; the breaths are indeed fragrant; thus they place the breaths in themselves; the breaths do not depart from them. They sprinkle themselves with water, saying, 'Since you waters are beneficent'; the waters are all the deities; thus they purify themselves through the deities.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā preṇā'nu prāviśat | tābhyaḥ punaḥ saṃbhavituṃ nāśaknot | so'bravīt | ṛdhnavadithsaḥ | yo metaḥ punaḥ saṃbharaditi | taṃ devā aśvamedhenaiva samabharan | tato vai ta ārdhnuvan | yo'śvamedhena yajate | prajāpatimeva saṃbharatyṛdhnoti | puruṣamālabhate
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा प्रेणाऽनु प्राविशत् । ताभ्यः पुनः संभवितुं नाशक्नोत् । सोऽब्रवीत् । ऋध्नवदिथ्सः । यो मेतः पुनः संभरदिति । तं देवा अश्वमेधेनैव समभरन् । ततो वै त आर्ध्नुवन् । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । प्रजापतिमेव संभरत्यृध्नोति । पुरुषमालभते
text_mt: Prajāpati, having created offspring, entered into them with his breath. He could not collect himself again from them. He said: 'He shall prosper who shall collect me again from here.' The gods collected him by means of the horse sacrifice; thereupon they prospered. He who performs the horse sacrifice collects Prajāpati and prospers. He offers a human being;

sanskrit_iast: vairājo vai puruṣaḥ | virājamevālabhate | atho annaṃ vai virāṭ | annamevāvarundhe | aśvamālabhate | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | prajāpatimevālabhate | atho śrīrvā ekaśapham | śriyamevāvarundhe | gāmālabhate
meaning: वैराजो वै पुरुषः । विराजमेवालभते । अथो अन्नं वै विराट् । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । अश्वमालभते । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । प्रजापतिमेवालभते । अथो श्रीर्वा एकशफम् । श्रियमेवावरुन्धे । गामालभते
text_mt: a human being belongs to the Virāj; he thus offers the Virāj; moreover, the Virāj is food; thus he secures food. He offers a horse; the horse belongs to Prajāpati; he thus offers Prajāpati; moreover, the single-hoofed animal is prosperity; thus he secures prosperity. He offers a cow;

sanskrit_iast: yajño vai gauḥ | yajñamevālabhate | atho annaṃ vai gauḥ | annamevāvarundhe | ajāvī ālabhate bhūmne | atho puṣṭirvai bhūmā | puṣṭimevāvarundhe | paryagnikṛtaṃ puruṣaṃ cāraṇyāṃścothsṛjantyahiṃsāyai | ubhau vā etau paśū ālabhyete | yaścāvamo yaśca paramaḥ | te'syobhaye yajñe baddhāḥ | abhīṣṭā abhiprītāḥ | abhijitā abhihutā bhavanti | nainaṃ daṃkṣṇavaḥ paśavo yajñe baddhāḥ | abhīṣṭā abhiprītāḥ | abhijitā abhihutā hiṃsanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
meaning: यज्ञो वै गौः । यज्ञमेवालभते । अथो अन्नं वै गौः । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । अजावी आलभते भूम्ने । अथो पुष्टिर्वै भूमा । पुष्टिमेवावरुन्धे । पर्यग्निकृतं पुरुषं चारण्यांश्चोथ्सृजन्त्यहिंसायै । उभौ वा एतौ पशू आलभ्येते । यश्चावमो यश्च परमः । तेऽस्योभये यज्ञे बद्धाः । अभीष्टा अभिप्रीताः । अभिजिता अभिहुता भवन्ति । नैनं दंक्ष्णवः पशवो यज्ञे बद्धाः । अभीष्टा अभिप्रीताः । अभिजिता अभिहुता हिंसन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
text_mt: the cow is the sacrifice; he thus offers the sacrifice; moreover, the cow is food; thus he secures food. He offers a goat and a sheep for abundance; moreover, abundance is nourishment; thus he secures nourishment. They release the human being and the wild animals after fire has been carried around them, for non-injury. Both these kinds of animals are offered: both the lowest and the highest; bound at his sacrifice, sought after, delighted in, conquered, and sacrificed to, they become his. The biting animals, bound at the sacrifice, sought after, delighted in, conquered, and sacrificed to, do not harm him who performs the horse sacrifice and who knows it thus.

sanskrit_iast: prathamena vā eṣa stomena rādhvā | catuṣṭomena kṛtenāyānāmuttare'han | ekaviṃśe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhati | ekaviṃśātpratiṣṭhāyā ṛtūnanvārohati | ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni | ṛtavaḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | ṛtuṣveva saṃvathsare pratiṣṭhāya | devatā abhyārohati | śakvarayaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavantyanyadanyacchandaḥ | anye'nye vā ete paśava ālabhyante
meaning: प्रथमेन वा एष स्तोमेन राध्वा । चतुष्टोमेन कृतेनायानामुत्तरेऽहन् । एकविंशे प्रतिष्ठायां प्रतितिष्ठति । एकविंशात्प्रतिष्ठाया ऋतूनन्वारोहति । ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि । ऋतवः संवथ्सरः । ऋतुष्वेव संवथ्सरे प्रतिष्ठाय । देवता अभ्यारोहति । शक्वरयः पृष्ठं भवन्त्यन्यदन्यच्छन्दः । अन्येऽन्ये वा एते पशव आलभ्यन्ते
text_mt: Having succeeded with the first chant, having attained the winning throws [of dice] with the fourfold chant on the following day, he is established upon the firm foundation of the twenty-one-fold. From the firm foundation of the twenty-one-fold he mounts upon the seasons. The seasons are the pṛṣṭha stotras; the seasons are the year; having established himself in the seasons, in the year, he mounts up to the deities. The Śakvarī verses become the pṛṣṭha stotra, each verse in a different meter. Various domestic animals are offered;

sanskrit_iast: uteva grāmyāḥ | utevāraṇyāḥ | ahareva rūpeṇa samardhayati | atho ahna evaiṣa balirhriyate | tadāhuḥ | apaśavo vā ete | yadajāvayaścāraṇyāśca | ete vai sarve paśavaḥ | yadgavyā iti | gavyānpaśūnuttame'hannālabhate
meaning: उतेव ग्राम्याः । उतेवारण्याः । अहरेव रूपेण समर्धयति । अथो अह्न एवैष बलिर्ह्रियते । तदाहुः । अपशवो वा एते । यदजावयश्चारण्याश्च । एते वै सर्वे पशवः । यद्गव्या इति । गव्यान्पशूनुत्तमेऽहन्नालभते
text_mt: both those of the village and those of the wild; he enriches the day with its proper form; moreover, this tribute is brought for the day. Concerning this they say: 'These are not domestic animals, namely, the goats, sheep, and the wild beasts; all these are domestic animals, namely, the bovine beasts.' He offers the bovine animals on the final day;

sanskrit_iast: tenaivobhayānpaśūnavarundhe | prājāpatyā bhavanti | anabhijitasyābhijityai | saurīrnava śvetā vaśā anūbandhyā bhavanti | antata eva brahmavarcasamavarundhe | somāya svarājñe'novāhāvanaḍvāhāviti dvandvinaḥ paśūnālabhate | ahorātrāṇāmabhijityai | paśubhirvā eṣa vyṛddhyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | chagalaṃ kalmāṣaṃ kikidīviṃ vidīgayamiti tvāṣṭrānpaśūnālabhate | paśubhirevātmānaṃ samardhayati | ṛtubhirvā eṣa vyṛddhyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | piśaṅgāstrayo vāsantā ityṛtupaśūnālabhate | ṛtubhirevātmānaṃ samardhayati | ā vā eṣa paśubhyo vṛścyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | paryagnikṛtā uthsṛjantyanāvraskāya
meaning: तेनैवोभयान्पशूनवरुन्धे । प्राजापत्या भवन्ति । अनभिजितस्याभिजित्यै । सौरीर्नव श्वेता वशा अनूबन्ध्या भवन्ति । अन्तत एव ब्रह्मवर्चसमवरुन्धे । सोमाय स्वराज्ञेऽनोवाहावनड्वाहाविति द्वन्द्विनः पशूनालभते । अहोरात्राणामभिजित्यै । पशुभिर्वा एष व्यृद्ध्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । छगलं कल्माषं किकिदीविं विदीगयमिति त्वाष्ट्रान्पशूनालभते । पशुभिरेवात्मानं समर्धयति । ऋतुभिर्वा एष व्यृद्ध्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । पिशङ्गास्त्रयो वासन्ता इत्यृतुपशूनालभते । ऋतुभिरेवात्मानं समर्धयति । आ वा एष पशुभ्यो वृश्च्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । पर्यग्निकृता उथ्सृजन्त्यनाव्रस्काय
text_mt: thereby he secures both kinds of domestic animals. They are dedicated to Prajāpati, for the conquest of what has not been conquered. Nine white barren cows dedicated to Sūrya are the concluding victims; at the end he secures spiritual preeminence. He offers domestic animals in pairs, saying: 'To Soma the self-ruler two cart-drawing oxen,' for the conquest of the days and nights. He who performs the horse sacrifice is deprived of domestic animals; he offers the domestic animals dedicated to Tvaṣṭṛ, saying: 'A he-goat, a speckled [beast], a blue jay, a vidīgaya'; thus he enriches himself with domestic animals. He who performs the horse sacrifice is deprived of the seasons; he offers the seasonal victims, saying: 'Three reddish-brown ones belonging to spring'; thus he enriches himself with the seasons. He who performs the horse sacrifice is cut off from domestic animals; they release them after fire has been carried around them, to prevent being cut off.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirakāmayata mahānannādaḥ syāmiti | sa etāvaśvamedhe mahimānāvapaśyat | tāvagṛhṇīta | tato vai sa mahānannādo'bhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta mahānannādaḥ syāmiti | sa etāvaśvamedhe mahimānau gṛhṇīta | mahānevānnādo bhavati | yajamānadevatyā vai vapā | rājā mahimā | yadvapāṃ mahimnobhayataḥ pariyajati | yajamānameva rājyenobhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | purastāthsvāhākārā vā anye devāḥ | upariṣṭāthsvāhākārā anye | te vā ete'śva eva medhya ubhaye'varudhyante | yadvapāṃ mahimnobhayataḥ pariyajati | tānevobhayānprīṇāti
meaning: प्रजापतिरकामयत महानन्नादः स्यामिति । स एतावश्वमेधे महिमानावपश्यत् । तावगृह्णीत । ततो वै स महानन्नादोऽभवत् । यः कामयेत महानन्नादः स्यामिति । स एतावश्वमेधे महिमानौ गृह्णीत । महानेवान्नादो भवति । यजमानदेवत्या वै वपा । राजा महिमा । यद्वपां महिम्नोभयतः परियजति । यजमानमेव राज्येनोभयतः परिगृह्णाति । पुरस्ताथ्स्वाहाकारा वा अन्ये देवाः । उपरिष्टाथ्स्वाहाकारा अन्ये । ते वा एतेऽश्व एव मेध्य उभयेऽवरुध्यन्ते । यद्वपां महिम्नोभयतः परियजति । तानेवोभयान्प्रीणाति
text_mt: Prajāpati desired, "May I be a great consumer of food." / He saw these two Mahiman [cups] in the horse sacrifice. / He drew them. / Thereupon, indeed, he became a great consumer of food. / Whoever should desire, "May I be a great consumer of food," / he should draw these two Mahiman [cups] in the horse sacrifice; / he becomes indeed a great consumer of food. / The omentum has the sacrificer as its deity; / the Mahiman cup is a king. / When he offers around the omentum on both sides with the Mahiman cup, / he encompasses the sacrificer on both sides with kingship. / Some gods have the Svāhā-call at the beginning; / others have the Svāhā-call at the end. / Both of them indeed are encompassed in the sacrificial horse itself. / When he offers around the omentum on both sides with the Mahiman cup, / he gratifies both of them.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevo vā aśvaḥ | taṃ yatprājāpatyaṃ kuryāt | yā devatā apibhāgāḥ | tā bhāgadheyena vyardhayet | devatābhyaḥ samadaṃ dadhyāt | stegāndaṃṣṭrābhyāṃ maṇḍūkāñjambhyebhiriti | ājyamavadānaṃ kṛtvā pratisaṃkhyāyamāhutīrjuhoti | yā eva devatā apibhāgāḥ | tā bhāgadheyena samardhayati | na devatābhyaḥ samadaṃ dadhāti
meaning: वैश्वदेवो वा अश्वः । तं यत्प्राजापत्यं कुर्यात् । या देवता अपिभागाः । ता भागधेयेन व्यर्धयेत् । देवताभ्यः समदं दध्यात् । स्तेगान्दंष्ट्राभ्यां मण्डूकाञ्जम्भ्येभिरिति । आज्यमवदानं कृत्वा प्रतिसंख्यायमाहुतीर्जुहोति । या एव देवता अपिभागाः । ता भागधेयेन समर्धयति । न देवताभ्यः समदं दधाति
text_mt: The horse belongs to the All-Gods. / If he were to make it belong to Prajāpati, / whichever deities have a share, / he would deprive them of their share; / he would cause discord among the deities. / With: "Fly-specks [I offer] to the fangs, frogs to the grinders," / having made clarified butter the portion, he offers the oblations one by one. / Whichever deities have a share, / he provides them with their share; / he does not cause discord among the deities.

sanskrit_iast: caturdaśaitānanuvākāñjuhotyanantarityai | prayāsāya svāheti pañcadaśam | pañcadaśa vā ardhamāsasya rātrayaḥ | ardhamāsaśaḥ saṃvathsara āpyate | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te'bruvannagnayaḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ | aśvasya medhyasya vayamuddhāramuddharāmahai | athaitānabhibhavāmeti | te lohitamudaharanta | tato devā abhavan
meaning: चतुर्दशैताननुवाकाञ्जुहोत्यनन्तरित्यै । प्रयासाय स्वाहेति पञ्चदशम् । पञ्चदश वा अर्धमासस्य रात्रयः । अर्धमासशः संवथ्सर आप्यते । देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । तेऽब्रुवन्नग्नयः स्विष्टकृतः । अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य वयमुद्धारमुद्धरामहै । अथैतानभिभवामेति । ते लोहितमुदहरन्त । ततो देवा अभवन्
text_mt: He offers these fourteen sections for non-omission. / "To the endeavor, hail!" is the fifteenth. / Fifteen indeed are the nights of the half-month; / by half-months the year is obtained. / The gods and the asuras were in conflict. / The Sviṣṭakṛt Agnis said, / "Let us take up a selected portion of the sacrificial horse, / and then let us overcome them." / They took up the blood. / Thereupon the gods prevailed,

sanskrit_iast: parā'surāḥ | yathsviṣṭakṛdbhyo lohitaṃ juhoti bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai | bhavatyātmanā | parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | gomṛgakaṇṭhena prathamāmāhutiṃ juhoti | paśavo vai gomṛgaḥ | rudro'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrādeva paśūnantardadhāti | atho yatraiṣā''hutirhūyate | na tatra rudraḥ paśūnabhimanyate
meaning: पराऽसुराः । यथ्स्विष्टकृद्भ्यो लोहितं जुहोति भ्रातृव्याभिभूत्यै । भवत्यात्मना । पराऽस्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति । गोमृगकण्ठेन प्रथमामाहुतिं जुहोति । पशवो वै गोमृगः । रुद्रोऽग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । रुद्रादेव पशूनन्तर्दधाति । अथो यत्रैषा'ऽहुतिर्हूयते । न तत्र रुद्रः पशूनभिमन्यते
text_mt: the asuras were defeated. / That he offers the blood to the Sviṣṭakṛts is for overcoming the rival. / He himself thrives; / his rival is defeated. / He offers the first oblation with the throat of a nilgai. / Domestic animals indeed are the nilgai; / Rudra is Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. / He screens the domestic animals from Rudra. / And where this oblation is offered, / Rudra does not harm the domestic animals there.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaśaphena dvitīyāmāhutiṃ juhoti | paśavo vā ekaśapham | rudro'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrādeva paśūnantardadhāti | atho yatraiṣā''hutir hūyate | na tatra rudraḥ paśūnabhimanyate | ayasmayena kamaṇḍalunā tṛtīyām | āhutiṃ juhotyāyāsyo vai prajāḥ | rudro'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrādeva prajā antardadhāti | atho yatraiṣā''hutirhūyate | na tatra rudraḥ prajā abhimanyate
meaning: अश्वशफेन द्वितीयामाहुतिं जुहोति । पशवो वा एकशफम् । रुद्रोऽग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । रुद्रादेव पशूनन्तर्दधाति । अथो यत्रैषा'ऽहुतिर् हूयते । न तत्र रुद्रः पशूनभिमन्यते । अयस्मयेन कमण्डलुना तृतीयाम् । आहुतिं जुहोत्यायास्यो वै प्रजाः । रुद्रोऽग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । रुद्रादेव प्रजा अन्तर्दधाति । अथो यत्रैषा'ऽहुतिर्हूयते । न तत्र रुद्रः प्रजा अभिमन्यते
text_mt: He offers the second oblation with a horse's hoof. / Domestic animals indeed are the single-hoofed. / Rudra is Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. / He screens the domestic animals from Rudra. / And where this oblation is offered, / Rudra does not harm the domestic animals there. / He offers the third oblation with an iron water-pot. Striving indeed are offspring; / Rudra is Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. He screens offspring from Rudra. / And where this oblation is offered, / Rudra does not harm offspring there.

sanskrit_iast: aśvasya vā ālabdhasya medha udakrāmat | tadaśvastomīyamabhavat | yadaśvastomīyaṃ juhoti | sa medhamevainamālabhate | ājyena juhoti | medho vā ājyam | medho'śvastomīyam | medhenaivāsminmedhaṃ dadhāti | ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ juhoti | ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī
meaning: अश्वस्य वा आलब्धस्य मेध उदक्रामत् । तदश्वस्तोमीयमभवत् । यदश्वस्तोमीयं जुहोति । स मेधमेवैनमालभते । आज्येन जुहोति । मेधो वा आज्यम् । मेधोऽश्वस्तोमीयम् । मेधेनैवास्मिन्मेधं दधाति । षट्त्रिंशतं जुहोति । षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा बृहती
text_mt: When the horse was seized, its sacrificial essence went out. / That became the horse-stoma hymn. / When he offers the horse-stoma oblations, / he seizes it endowed with sacrificial essence. / He offers with clarified butter. / Clarified butter is sacrificial essence; / the horse-stoma is sacrificial essence; / with sacrificial essence he places sacrificial essence in it. / He offers thirty-six [oblations]. / The Bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables;

sanskrit_iast: bārhatāḥ paśavaḥ | sā paśūnāṃ mātrā | paśūneva mātrayā samardhayati | tā yadbhūyasīrvā kanīyasīrvā juhuyāt | paśūnmātrayā vyardhayet | ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ juhoti | ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī | bārhatāḥ paśavaḥ | sā paśūnāṃ mātrā | paśūneva mātrayā samardhayati
meaning: बार्हताः पशवः । सा पशूनां मात्रा । पशूनेव मात्रया समर्धयति । ता यद्भूयसीर्वा कनीयसीर्वा जुहुयात् । पशून्मात्रया व्यर्धयेत् । षट्त्रिंशतं जुहोति । षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा बृहती । बार्हताः पशवः । सा पशूनां मात्रा । पशूनेव मात्रया समर्धयति
