text_mt: domestic animals belong to the Bṛhatī. / That is the measure of domestic animals; / he provides domestic animals with their measure. / If he were to offer more or fewer of them, / he would deprive the domestic animals of their measure. / He offers thirty-six. / The Bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables; / domestic animals belong to the Bṛhatī. / That is the measure of domestic animals; / he provides domestic animals with their measure.

sanskrit_iast: aśvastomīyaṃ hutvā dvipadā juhoti | dvipādvai puruṣo dvipratiṣṭhaḥ | tadenaṃ pratiṣṭhayā samardhayati | tadāhuḥ | aśvastomīyaṃ pūrvaṃ hotavyāṃ dvipadāiti | aśvo vā aśvastomīyam | puruṣo dvipadāḥ | aśvastomīyaṃ hutvā dvipadā juhoti | tasmāddvipāccatuṣpādamatti | atho dvipadyeva catuṣpadaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati | dvipadā hutvā | nānyāmuttarāmāhutiṃ juhuyāt | yadanyāmuttarāmāhutiṃ juhuyāt | pra pratiṣṭhāyāścyaveta | dvipadā antato juhoti pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: अश्वस्तोमीयं हुत्वा द्विपदा जुहोति । द्विपाद्वै पुरुषो द्विप्रतिष्ठः । तदेनं प्रतिष्ठया समर्धयति । तदाहुः । अश्वस्तोमीयं पूर्वं होतव्यां द्विपदाइति । अश्वो वा अश्वस्तोमीयम् । पुरुषो द्विपदाः । अश्वस्तोमीयं हुत्वा द्विपदा जुहोति । तस्माद्द्विपाच्चतुष्पादमत्ति । अथो द्विपद्येव चतुष्पदः प्रतिष्ठापयति । द्विपदा हुत्वा । नान्यामुत्तरामाहुतिं जुहुयात् । यदन्यामुत्तरामाहुतिं जुहुयात् । प्र प्रतिष्ठायाश्च्यवेत । द्विपदा अन्ततो जुहोति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: Having offered the horse-stoma [oblations], he offers with the two-footed [verse]. / Two-footed indeed is man, resting on two [feet]; / he provides him with a firm foundation. / On this they say: / "Should the horse-stoma be offered first, or the two-footed [verse]?" / The horse is the horse-stoma; / man is the two-footed. / Having offered the horse-stoma [oblations], he offers with the two-footed [verse]; / therefore the two-footed eats the four-footed. / Moreover, in the two-footed he establishes the four-footed. / Having offered with the two-footed [verse], / he should not offer another subsequent oblation. / If he were to offer another subsequent oblation, / he would fall from his firm foundation. / He offers with the two-footed [verse] at the end, for a firm foundation.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiraśvamedhamasṛjata | so'smāthsṛṣṭo'pākrāmat | taṃ yajñakratubhiranvaicchat | taṃ yajñakratubhirnānvavindat | tamiṣṭibhiranvaicchat | tamiṣṭibhiranvavindat | tadiṣṭīnāmiṣṭitvam | yathsaṃvathsaramiṣṭibhiryajate | aśvameva tadanvicchati | sāvitriyo bhavanti
meaning: प्रजापतिरश्वमेधमसृजत । सोऽस्माथ्सृष्टोऽपाक्रामत् । तं यज्ञक्रतुभिरन्वैच्छत् । तं यज्ञक्रतुभिर्नान्वविन्दत् । तमिष्टिभिरन्वैच्छत् । तमिष्टिभिरन्वविन्दत् । तदिष्टीनामिष्टित्वम् । यथ्संवथ्सरमिष्टिभिर्यजते । अश्वमेव तदन्विच्छति । सावित्रियो भवन्ति
text_mt: Prajāpati emitted the horse sacrifice. / Emitted, it departed from him. / He sought it with the sacrificial rites. / He did not find it with the sacrificial rites. / He sought it with the iṣṭis. / He found it with the iṣṭis. / That is the iṣṭi-nature of the iṣṭis. / When he sacrifices with iṣṭis for a year, / he thereby seeks the horse. / They are addressed to Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vai savitā | yo vā asyāṃ naśyati yo nilayate | asyāṃ vāva taṃ vindanti | na vā imāṃ kaścanetyāhuḥ | tiryaṅnordhvo'tyetumarhatīti | yathsāvitriyo bhavanti | savitṛprasūta evainamicchati | īśvaro vā aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parāṃ parāvataṃ gantoḥ | yathsāyaṃ dhṛtīrjuhoti | aśvasya yatyai dhṛtyai
meaning: इयं वै सविता । यो वा अस्यां नश्यति यो निलयते । अस्यां वाव तं विन्दन्ति । न वा इमां कश्चनेत्याहुः । तिर्यङ्नोर्ध्वोऽत्येतुमर्हतीति । यथ्सावित्रियो भवन्ति । सवितृप्रसूत एवैनमिच्छति । ईश्वरो वा अश्वः प्रमुक्तः परां परावतं गन्तोः । यथ्सायं धृतीर्जुहोति । अश्वस्य यत्यै धृत्यै
text_mt: This [earth] indeed is Savitṛ. / Whatever is lost on her, whatever hides, / on her indeed they find it. / "For no one at all," they say, / "can cross beyond her, neither sideways nor upwards." / When they are addressed to Savitṛ, / impelled by Savitṛ he seeks it. / The horse, when set free, is liable to go to the farthest distance. / When he offers the holding-oblations in the evening, / it is for the holding of the horse's gait.

sanskrit_iast: yatprātariṣṭibhiryajate | aśvameva tadanvicchati | yathsāyaṃ dhṛtīrjuhoti | aśvasyaiva yatyai dhṛtyai | tasmāthsāyaṃ prajāḥ kṣemyā bhavanti | yatprātariṣṭibhiryajate | aśvameva tadanvicchati | tasmāddivā naṣṭaiṣa eti | yatprātariṣṭibhiryajate sāyaṃ dhṛtīrjuhoti | ahorātrābhyāmevainamanvicchati | atho ahorātrābhyāmevāsmai yogakṣemaṃ kalpayati
meaning: यत्प्रातरिष्टिभिर्यजते । अश्वमेव तदन्विच्छति । यथ्सायं धृतीर्जुहोति । अश्वस्यैव यत्यै धृत्यै । तस्माथ्सायं प्रजाः क्षेम्या भवन्ति । यत्प्रातरिष्टिभिर्यजते । अश्वमेव तदन्विच्छति । तस्माद्दिवा नष्टैष एति । यत्प्रातरिष्टिभिर्यजते सायं धृतीर्जुहोति । अहोरात्राभ्यामेवैनमन्विच्छति । अथो अहोरात्राभ्यामेवास्मै योगक्षेमं कल्पयति
text_mt: When he sacrifices with iṣṭis in the morning, / he thereby seeks the horse. / When he offers the holding-oblations in the evening, / it is for the holding of the horse's gait. / Therefore in the evening offspring are secure. / When he sacrifices with iṣṭis in the morning, / he thereby seeks the horse; / therefore one goes seeking what is lost by day. / When he sacrifices with iṣṭis in the morning and offers the holding-oblations in the evening, / by means of day and night he seeks it; / and by means of day and night he secures acquisition and preservation for him.

sanskrit_iast: apa vā etasmācchrī rāṣṭraṃ krāmati | yo'śvamedhena yajate | brāhmaṇau vīṇāgāthinau gāyataḥ | śriyā vā etadrūpam | yadvīṇā | śriyamevāsmintaddhattaḥ | yadā khalu vai puruṣaḥ śriyamaśnute | vīṇā'smai vādyate | tadāhuḥ | yadubhau brāhmaṇau gāyetām
meaning: अप वा एतस्माच्छ्री राष्ट्रं क्रामति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । ब्राह्मणौ वीणागाथिनौ गायतः । श्रिया वा एतद्रूपम् । यद्वीणा । श्रियमेवास्मिन्तद्धत्तः । यदा खलु वै पुरुषः श्रियमश्नुते । वीणाऽस्मै वाद्यते । तदाहुः । यदुभौ ब्राह्मणौ गायेताम्
text_mt: Prestige and dominion depart from him / who performs the horse sacrifice. / Two Brahmin lute-singers sing. / The lute is the form of prestige. / They place prestige in him. / When a man attains prestige, / the lute is played for him. / On this they say: / "If both Brahmins were to sing..."

sanskrit_iast: prabhraṃśukā'smācchrīḥ syāt | na vai brāhmaṇe śrī ramata iti | brāhmaṇo'nyo gāyet | rājanyo'nyaḥ | brahma vai brāhmaṇaḥ | kṣattraṃ rājanyaḥ | tathā hāsya brahmaṇā ca kṣattreṇa cobhayataḥ śrīḥ parigṛhītā bhavati | tadāhuḥ | yadubhau divā gāyetām | apāsmādrāṣṭraṃ krāmet
meaning: प्रभ्रंशुकाऽस्माच्छ्रीः स्यात् । न वै ब्राह्मणे श्री रमत इति । ब्राह्मणोऽन्यो गायेत् । राजन्योऽन्यः । ब्रह्म वै ब्राह्मणः । क्षत्त्रं राजन्यः । तथा हास्य ब्रह्मणा च क्षत्त्रेण चोभयतः श्रीः परिगृहीता भवति । तदाहुः । यदुभौ दिवा गायेताम् । अपास्माद्राष्ट्रं क्रामेत्
text_mt: [they say,] "splendor would fall away from him; / splendor does not dwell with a Brahmin." / One singer should be a Brahmin, / the other a Rājanya. / The Brahmin is brahman; / the Rājanya is regal power. / Thus, through both brahman and regal power, his splendor is enclosed on both sides. / They also say: / "If both were to sing by day, / the realm would depart from him;

sanskrit_iast: na vai brāhmaṇe rāṣṭraṃ ramata iti | yadā khalu vai rājā kāmayate | atha brāhmaṇaṃ jināti | divā brāhmaṇo gāyet | naktaṃ rājanyaḥ | brahmaṇo vai rūpamahaḥ | kṣattrasya rātriḥ | tathā hāsya brahmaṇā ca kṣattreṇa cobhayato rāṣṭraṃ parigṛhītaṃ bhavati | ityadadā ityayajathā ityapaca iti brāhmaṇo gāyet | iṣṭāpūrtaṃ vai brāhmaṇasya
meaning: न वै ब्राह्मणे राष्ट्रं रमत इति । यदा खलु वै राजा कामयते । अथ ब्राह्मणं जिनाति । दिवा ब्राह्मणो गायेत् । नक्तं राजन्यः । ब्रह्मणो वै रूपमहः । क्षत्त्रस्य रात्रिः । तथा हास्य ब्रह्मणा च क्षत्त्रेण चोभयतो राष्ट्रं परिगृहीतं भवति । इत्यददा इत्ययजथा इत्यपच इति ब्राह्मणो गायेत् । इष्टापूर्तं वै ब्राह्मणस्य
text_mt: the realm does not dwell with a Brahmin. / Whenever indeed a king desires, / he oppresses the Brahmin." / The Brahmin should sing by day, / the Rājanya by night. / Day is the form of brahman; / night is the form of regal power. / Thus, through both brahman and regal power, his realm is enclosed on both sides. / "Thus you gave, thus you sacrificed, thus you cooked [the offering]"—so the Brahmin should sing; / sacrificial and charitable work belongs to the Brahmin;

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭāpūrtenaivainaṃ sa samardhayati | ityajinā ityayudhyathā ityamuṃ saṃgrāmamahanniti rājanyaḥ | yuddhaṃ vai rājanyasya | yuddhenaivainaṃ sa samardhayati | aklṛptā vā etasyartava ityāhuḥ | yo'śvamedhena yajata iti | tisro'nyo gāyati tisro'nyaḥ | ṣaṭthsaṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūnevāsmai kalpayataḥ | tābhyāṃ saṃsthāyām | anoyukte ca śate ca dadāti | śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ | āyuṣyevendriye pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: इष्टापूर्तेनैवैनं स समर्धयति । इत्यजिना इत्ययुध्यथा इत्यमुं संग्राममहन्निति राजन्यः । युद्धं वै राजन्यस्य । युद्धेनैवैनं स समर्धयति । अक्लृप्ता वा एतस्यर्तव इत्याहुः । योऽश्वमेधेन यजत इति । तिस्रोऽन्यो गायति तिस्रोऽन्यः । षट्थ्संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतूनेवास्मै कल्पयतः । ताभ्यां संस्थायाम् । अनोयुक्ते च शते च ददाति । शतायुः पुरुषः शतेन्द्रियः । आयुष्येवेन्द्रिये प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: he enriches him with sacrificial and charitable work. / "Thus you conquered, thus you fought, thus you struck that battle"—so the Rājanya [should sing]; / warfare belongs to the Rājanya; / he enriches him with warfare. / They say: "Unordered are his seasons / who offers the horse sacrifice." / One sings three [verses], the other sings three; / they amount to six; / the seasons are six; / the two order the seasons for him. / At the completion of the rite, / he gives to both of them a yoked cart and a hundred [cows]; / man has a lifespan of a hundred years and a hundred faculties; / he firmly establishes himself in lifespan and faculty.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣu vā eṣu lokeṣu mṛtyavo'nvāyattāḥ | tebhyo yadāhutīrna juhuyāt | loke loka enaṃ mṛtyurvindet | mṛtyave svāhā mṛtyave svāhetyabhi pūrvamāhutīrjuhoti | lokāllokādeva mṛtyumavayajate | nainaṃ loke loke mṛtyurvindati | yadamuṣmai svāhā'muṣmai svāheti juhvathsaṃcakṣīta | bahuṃ mṛtyumamitraṃ kurvīta | mṛtyave svāhetyekasmā evaikāṃ juhuyāt | eko vā amuṣmiṃ lloke mṛtyuḥ
meaning: सर्वेषु वा एषु लोकेषु मृत्यवोऽन्वायत्ताः । तेभ्यो यदाहुतीर्न जुहुयात् । लोके लोक एनं मृत्युर्विन्देत् । मृत्यवे स्वाहा मृत्यवे स्वाहेत्यभि पूर्वमाहुतीर्जुहोति । लोकाल्लोकादेव मृत्युमवयजते । नैनं लोके लोके मृत्युर्विन्दति । यदमुष्मै स्वाहाऽमुष्मै स्वाहेति जुह्वथ्संचक्षीत । बहुं मृत्युममित्रं कुर्वीत । मृत्यवे स्वाहेत्येकस्मा एवैकां जुहुयात् । एको वा अमुष्मिं ल्लोके मृत्युः
text_mt: Deaths attend upon all these worlds. / If he were not to offer oblations to them, / death would find him in world after world. / "To death, svāhā! To death, svāhā!"—thus he offers oblations in succession; / he wards off death from world after world; / death does not find him in world after world. / If he were to recite, offering: "To such a one svāhā! To such a one svāhā!", / he would create many a death as an enemy. / "To death, svāhā!"—so he should offer just one [oblation] to the one; / for there is only one death in yonder world:

sanskrit_iast: aśanayā mṛtyureva | tamevāmuṣmiṃ lloke'vayajate | bhrūṇahatyāyai svāhetyavabhṛtha āhutiṃ juhoti | bhrūṇahatyāmevāvayajate | tadāhuḥ | yadbhrūṇahatyā'pātryā'tha | kasmādyajñe'pi kriyata iti | amṛtyurvā anyo bhrūṇahatyāyā ityāhuḥ | bhrūṇahatyā vāva mṛtyuriti | yadbhrūṇahatyāyai svāhetyavabhṛtha āhutiṃ juhoti
meaning: अशनया मृत्युरेव । तमेवामुष्मिं ल्लोकेऽवयजते । भ्रूणहत्यायै स्वाहेत्यवभृथ आहुतिं जुहोति । भ्रूणहत्यामेवावयजते । तदाहुः । यद्भ्रूणहत्याऽपात्र्याऽथ । कस्माद्यज्ञेऽपि क्रियत इति । अमृत्युर्वा अन्यो भ्रूणहत्याया इत्याहुः । भ्रूणहत्या वाव मृत्युरिति । यद्भ्रूणहत्यायै स्वाहेत्यवभृथ आहुतिं जुहोति
text_mt: death by hunger itself; / that one he wards off in yonder world. / "To the slaying of an embryo, svāhā!"—thus he offers an oblation at the final bath; / he wards off the slaying of an embryo. / As to that, they say: / "Since the slaying of an embryo is unfit for the sacrificial cup, / why then is it performed in the sacrifice?" / "Death is nothing other than the slaying of an embryo," they say; / "the slaying of an embryo is indeed death." / When he offers an oblation at the final bath saying, "To the slaying of an embryo, svāhā!",

sanskrit_iast: mṛtyumevāhutyā tarpayitvā paripāṇaṃ kṛtvā | bhrūṇaghne bheṣajaṃ karoti | etāṃ ha vai muṇḍibha audanyavaḥ | bhrūṇahatyāyai prāyaścittiṃ vidāñcakāra | yo hāsyāpi prajāyāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hanti | sarvasmai tasmai bheṣajaṃ karoti | jumbakāya svāhetyavabhṛtha uttamāmāhutiṃ juhoti | varuṇo vai jumbakaḥ | antata eva varuṇamavayajate | khalaterviklidhasya śuklasya piṅgākṣasya mūrdhañjuhoti | etadvai varuṇasya rūpam | rūpeṇaiva varuṇamavayajate
meaning: मृत्युमेवाहुत्या तर्पयित्वा परिपाणं कृत्वा । भ्रूणघ्ने भेषजं करोति । एतां ह वै मुण्डिभ औदन्यवः । भ्रूणहत्यायै प्रायश्चित्तिं विदाञ्चकार । यो हास्यापि प्रजायां ब्राह्मणं हन्ति । सर्वस्मै तस्मै भेषजं करोति । जुम्बकाय स्वाहेत्यवभृथ उत्तमामाहुतिं जुहोति । वरुणो वै जुम्बकः । अन्तत एव वरुणमवयजते । खलतेर्विक्लिधस्य शुक्लस्य पिङ्गाक्षस्य मूर्धञ्जुहोति । एतद्वै वरुणस्य रूपम् । रूपेणैव वरुणमवयजते
text_mt: having gratified death with the oblation and made a defense, / he makes a cure for the slayer of an embryo. / Muṇḍibha Audanyava indeed / knew this expiation for the slaying of an embryo; / even if someone among his descendants kills a Brahmin, / he effects a remedy for all that. / "To Jumbaka, svāhā!"—thus he offers the final oblation at the final bath; / Jumbaka is Varuṇa; / at the very end he wards off Varuṇa. / He offers it on the head of a bald, mangy, white, yellow-eyed man; / that is the form of Varuṇa; / through his form he wards off Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇo vā aśvaḥ | taṃ devatayā vyardhayati | yatprājāpatyaṃ karoti | namo rājñe namo varuṇāyetyāha | vāruṇo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā samardhayati | namo'śvāya namaḥ prajāpataya ityāha | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā samardhayati | namo'dhipataya ityāha
meaning: वारुणो वा अश्वः । तं देवतया व्यर्धयति । यत्प्राजापत्यं करोति । नमो राज्ञे नमो वरुणायेत्याह । वारुणो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया समर्धयति । नमोऽश्वाय नमः प्रजापतय इत्याह । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया समर्धयति । नमोऽधिपतय इत्याह
text_mt: The horse belongs to Varuṇa; / he deprives it of its deity / when he makes it belong to Prajāpati. / He says: "Homage to the king, homage to Varuṇa!" / The horse belongs to Varuṇa; / he enriches it with its own deity. / He says: "Homage to the horse, homage to Prajāpati!" / The horse belongs to Prajāpati; / he enriches it with its own deity. / He says: "Homage to the sovereign!"

sanskrit_iast: dharmo vā adhipatiḥ | dharmamevāvarundhe | adhipatirasyadhipatiṃ mā kurvadhipatirahaṃ prajānāṃ bhūyāsamityāha | adhipatimevainaṃ samānānāṃ karoti | māṃ dhehi mayi dhehītyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | upākṛtāya svāhetyupākṛte juhoti | ālabdhāya svāheti niyukte juhoti | hutāya svāheti hute juhoti | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai
meaning: धर्मो वा अधिपतिः । धर्ममेवावरुन्धे । अधिपतिरस्यधिपतिं मा कुर्वधिपतिरहं प्रजानां भूयासमित्याह । अधिपतिमेवैनं समानानां करोति । मां धेहि मयि धेहीत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । उपाकृताय स्वाहेत्युपाकृते जुहोति । आलब्धाय स्वाहेति नियुक्ते जुहोति । हुताय स्वाहेति हुते जुहोति । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै
text_mt: Righteous order is the sovereign; / he wins righteous order. / "You are the sovereign; make me the sovereign; may I become the sovereign of offspring"—he says; / he makes him the sovereign among his peers. / "Establish me, establish within me"—he says; / it is this blessing that he invokes. / "To the brought up, svāhā!"—thus he offers when it is brought up; / "To the seized, svāhā!"—thus he offers when it is tied up; / "To the offered, svāhā!"—thus he offers when it is sacrificed, / for the conquest of these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: pra vā eṣa ebhyo lokebhyaścyavate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | āgneyamaindrāgnamāśvinam | tānpaśūnālabhate pratiṣṭhityai | yadāgneyo bhavati | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ | devatā evāvarundhe | brahma vā agniḥ | kṣattramindraḥ | yadaindrāgno bhavati
meaning: प्र वा एष एभ्यो लोकेभ्यश्च्यवते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । आग्नेयमैन्द्राग्नमाश्विनम् । तान्पशूनालभते प्रतिष्ठित्यै । यदाग्नेयो भवति । अग्निः सर्वा देवताः । देवता एवावरुन्धे । ब्रह्म वा अग्निः । क्षत्त्रमिन्द्रः । यदैन्द्राग्नो भवति
text_mt: He falls away from these worlds / who offers the horse sacrifice. / [A victim] for Agni, one for Indra-and-Agni, one for the Aśvins— / he seizes these sacrificial animals for firm standing. / Because there is one for Agni, / Agni being all the deities, / he secures the deities. / Agni is brahman; / Indra is regal power; / because there is one for Indra-and-Agni,

sanskrit_iast: brahmakṣattre evāvarundhe | yadāśvino bhavati | āśiṣāmavaruddhyai | trayo bhavanti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣveva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati | agnaye'ṃhomuce'ṣṭākapāla iti daśahaviṣamiṣṭiṃ nirvapati | daśākṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyamavarundhe | agnermanve prathamasya pracetasa iti yājyānuvākyā bhavanti sarvatvāya
meaning: ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रे एवावरुन्धे । यदाश्विनो भवति । आशिषामवरुद्ध्यै । त्रयो भवन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एष्वेव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति । अग्नयेऽंहोमुचेऽष्टाकपाल इति दशहविषमिष्टिं निर्वपति । दशाक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । अग्नेर्मन्वे प्रथमस्य प्रचेतस इति याज्यानुवाक्या भवन्ति सर्वत्वाय
text_mt: he secures both brahman and regal power. / Because there is one for the Aśvins, / [it is] for the securing of blessings. / They are three; / three are these worlds; / he firmly establishes himself in these worlds. / "To Agni, who delivers from distress, [a cake] on eight potsherds"—thus he performs a sacrificial rite of ten oblations. / The virāj has ten syllables; / the virāj is food; / by means of the virāj he secures proper food. / "I consider Agni the first, the wise…"—these are the offering verse and invitatory verse, for completeness.

sanskrit_iast: yadyaśvamupatapadvindet | āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | saumyaṃ carum | sāvitramaṣṭākapālam | yadāgneyo bhavati | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ | devatābhirevainaṃ bhiṣajyati | yathsaumyo bhavati | somo vā oṣadhīnāṃ rājā | yābhya evainaṃ vindati
meaning: यद्यश्वमुपतपद्विन्देत् । आग्नेयमष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् । सौम्यं चरुम् । सावित्रमष्टाकपालम् । यदाग्नेयो भवति । अग्निः सर्वा देवताः । देवताभिरेवैनं भिषज्यति । यथ्सौम्यो भवति । सोमो वा ओषधीनां राजा । याभ्य एवैनं विन्दति
text_mt:
If illness should befall the horse, / he should offer [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni, / a mess of boiled grain to Soma, / and [a cake] on eight potsherds to Savitṛ. / Because there is one for Agni, / Agni being all deities, / he heals it through the deities. / Because there is one for Soma, / Soma being the king of plants, / through those very plants from which it suffers,

he heals it with them. / Because there is one for Savitṛ, / impelled by Savitṛ he heals it. / With these deities he heals it; / it becomes free from disease. / He should offer a mess of boiled grain to Pūṣan / if it should be lame; / Pūṣan is the healer of lameness; / he heals it; / it becomes free from lameness.

sanskrit_iast: tābhirevainaṃ bhiṣajyati | yathsāvitro bhavati | savitṛprasūta evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | etābhirevainaṃ devatābhirbhiṣajyati | agado haiva bhavati | pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapet | yadi śloṇaḥ syāt | pūṣā vai ślauṇyasya bhiṣak | sa evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | aśloṇo haiva bhavati
meaning: ताभिरेवैनं भिषज्यति । यथ्सावित्रो भवति । सवितृप्रसूत एवैनं भिषज्यति । एताभिरेवैनं देवताभिर्भिषज्यति । अगदो हैव भवति । पौष्णं चरुं निर्वपेत् । यदि श्लोणः स्यात् । पूषा वै श्लौण्यस्य भिषक् । स एवैनं भिषज्यति । अश्लोणो हैव भवति

sanskrit_iast: raudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet | yadi mahatī devatā'bhimanyeta | etaddevatyo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā bhiṣajyati | agado haiva bhavati | vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapenmṛgākhare yadi nāgacchet | iyaṃ vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ | iyamevainamarcibhyāṃ parirodhamānayati | ā haiva sutyamahargacchati | yadyadhīyāt
meaning: रौद्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् । यदि महती देवताऽभिमन्येत । एतद्देवत्यो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया भिषज्यति । अगदो हैव भवति । वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेन्मृगाखरे यदि नागच्छेत् । इयं वा अग्निर्वैश्वानरः । इयमेवैनमर्चिभ्यां परिरोधमानयति । आ हैव सुत्यमहर्गच्छति । यद्यधीयात्
text_mt: He should offer a mess of boiled grain to Rudra / if the great deity should assail it; / the horse belongs to this deity; / he heals it through its own deity; / it becomes free from disease. / He should offer [a cake] on twelve potsherds to Vaiśvānara at a deer-lair if it should not return; / this [earth] is Agni Vaiśvānara; / she brings it back, confining it with her flames; / it arrives on the very day of soma-pressing. / If it should wander away,

sanskrit_iast: agnaye'ṃhomuce'ṣṭākapālaḥ | sauryaṃ payaḥ | vāyavya ājyabhāgaḥ | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | aṃhasā vā eṣa gṛhītaḥ | yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito'dhyeti | yadaṃhomuce nirvapati | aṃhasa eva tena mucyate | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | retasā vā eṣa vyṛdhyate
meaning: अग्नयेऽंहोमुचेऽष्टाकपालः । सौर्यं पयः । वायव्य आज्यभागः । यजमानो वा अश्वः । अंहसा वा एष गृहीतः । यस्याश्वो मेधाय प्रोक्षितोऽध्येति । यदंहोमुचे निर्वपति । अंहस एव तेन मुच्यते । यजमानो वा अश्वः । रेतसा वा एष व्यृध्यते
text_mt: [There is a cake] on eight potsherds for Agni, Deliverer from Distress; / milk for Sūrya; / a portion of clarified butter for Vāyu. / The horse indeed is the sacrificer. / Seized by distress indeed is he / whose horse, sprinkled for the sacrifice, mates. / In that he offers to the Deliverer from Distress, / thereby he is freed from distress. / The horse indeed is the sacrificer. / From semen indeed is he deprived,

sanskrit_iast: yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito'dhyeti | sauryaṃ retaḥ | yathsauryaṃ payo bhavati | retasaivainaṃ sa samardhayati | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | garbhairvā eṣa vyṛdhyate | yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito'dhyeti | vāyavyā garbhāḥ | yadvāyavya ājyabhāgo bhavati | garbhairevainaṃ sa samardhayati | atho yasyaiṣā'śvamedhe prāyaścitiḥ kriyate | iṣṭvā vasīyānbhavati
meaning: यस्याश्वो मेधाय प्रोक्षितोऽध्येति । सौर्यं रेतः । यथ्सौर्यं पयो भवति । रेतसैवैनं स समर्धयति । यजमानो वा अश्वः । गर्भैर्वा एष व्यृध्यते । यस्याश्वो मेधाय प्रोक्षितोऽध्येति । वायव्या गर्भाः । यद्वायव्य आज्यभागो भवति । गर्भैरेवैनं स समर्धयति । अथो यस्यैषाऽश्वमेधे प्रायश्चितिः क्रियते । इष्ट्वा वसीयान्भवति
text_mt: whose horse, sprinkled for the sacrifice, mates. / Semen belongs to Sūrya. / In that there is milk for Sūrya, / he endows him with semen. / The horse indeed is the sacrificer. / From embryos indeed is he deprived, / whose horse, sprinkled for the sacrifice, mates. / Embryos belong to Vāyu. / In that the portion of clarified butter belongs to Vāyu, / he endows him with embryos. / Moreover, he for whom this expiation is performed at the horse sacrifice, / having sacrificed, becomes more prosperous.

sanskrit_iast: tadāhuḥ | dvādaśa brahmaudanānthsaṃsthite nirvapet | dvādaśabhirveṣṭibhiryajeteti | yadiṣṭibhiryajeta | upanāmuka enaṃ yajñaḥ syāt | pāpīyāṃstu syāt | āptāni vā etasya chandāṃsi | ya ījānaḥ | tāni ka etāvadāśu punaḥ prayuṃjīteti | sarvā vai saṃsthite yajñe vāgāpyate
meaning: तदाहुः । द्वादश ब्रह्मौदनान्थ्संस्थिते निर्वपेत् । द्वादशभिर्वेष्टिभिर्यजेतेति । यदिष्टिभिर्यजेत । उपनामुक एनं यज्ञः स्यात् । पापीयांस्तु स्यात् । आप्तानि वा एतस्य छन्दांसि । य ईजानः । तानि क एतावदाशु पुनः प्रयुंजीतेति । सर्वा वै संस्थिते यज्ञे वागाप्यते
text_mt: Concerning this they say: / 'When [the sacrifice] is completed, he should offer twelve boiled rice messes for Brahmins; / or he should sacrifice with twelve oblations.' / If he should sacrifice with oblations, / the sacrifice would be inclined to yield to him, / but he would become worse off. / Reached indeed are the meters of him / who has sacrificed. / 'Who would employ them again so quickly?' [they ask]. / All speech indeed is reached when the sacrifice is completed.

sanskrit_iast: sā''ptā bhavati yātayāmnī | krūrīkṛteva hi bhavatyaruṣkṛtā | sā na punaḥ prayujyetyāhuḥ | dvādaśaiva brahmaudanānthsaṃsthite nirvapet | prajāpatirvā odanaḥ | yajñaḥ prajāpatiḥ | upanāmuka enaṃ yajño bhavati | na pāpīyānbhavati | dvādaśa bhavanti | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsara eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: सा'ऽप्ता भवति यातयाम्नी । क्रूरीकृतेव हि भवत्यरुष्कृता । सा न पुनः प्रयुज्येत्याहुः । द्वादशैव ब्रह्मौदनान्थ्संस्थिते निर्वपेत् । प्रजापतिर्वा ओदनः । यज्ञः प्रजापतिः । उपनामुक एनं यज्ञो भवति । न पापीयान्भवति । द्वादश भवन्ति । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: Having been reached, it becomes exhausted; / for it becomes, as it were, wounded, full of sores. / 'It is not to be employed again,' they say. / When [the sacrifice] is completed, he should offer just twelve boiled rice messes for Brahmins. / Boiled rice mess indeed is Prajāpati; / the sacrifice is Prajāpati. / The sacrifice becomes inclined to yield to him; / he does not become worse off. / There are twelve. / Twelve months are the year. / In the year indeed he finds a firm foundation.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vai vibhūrnāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vibhu bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai prabhūrnāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra prabhu bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vā ūrjasvānnāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatrorjasvadbhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai payasvānnāma yajñaḥ
meaning: एष वै विभूर्नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र विभु भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै प्रभूर्नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र प्रभु भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वा ऊर्जस्वान्नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्रोर्जस्वद्भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै पयस्वान्नाम यज्ञः
text_mt: This sacrifice is named Far-reaching; / everything indeed becomes far-reaching there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Abundant; / everything indeed becomes abundant there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Full of Vigor; / everything indeed becomes full of vigor there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Rich in Milk;

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ ha vai tatra payasvadbhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai vidhṛto nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vidhṛtaṃ bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai vyāvṛtto nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vyāvṛttaṃ bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai pratiṣṭhito nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ bhavati
meaning: सर्वं ह वै तत्र पयस्वद्भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै विधृतो नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र विधृतं भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै व्यावृत्तो नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र व्यावृत्तं भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै प्रतिष्ठितो नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र प्रतिष्ठितं भवति
text_mt:
everything indeed becomes rich in milk there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Sustained; / everything indeed becomes sustained there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Distinguished; / everything indeed becomes distinguished there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Established; / everything indeed becomes established there

where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Possessing Fiery Energy; / everything indeed possesses fiery energy there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Endowed with Spiritual Preeminence; / a Brahmin endowed with spiritual preeminence is born there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Piercing Far; / a Rājanya who pierces far is born there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Long; / long-lived indeed are the people there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Well-ordered; / acquisition and preservation turn out successfully for the offspring there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai tejasvī nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra tejasvi bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai brahmavarcasī nāma yajñaḥ | ā ha vai tatra brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyate | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vā ativyādhī nāma yajñaḥ | ā ha vai tatra rājanyo'tivyādhī jāyate | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai dīrgho nāma yajñaḥ | dīrghāyuṣo ha vai tatra manuṣyā bhavanti | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai klṛpto nāma yajñaḥ | kalpate ha vai tatra prajābhyo yogakṣemaḥ | yatraitena yajñena yajante
meaning: यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै तेजस्वी नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र तेजस्वि भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै ब्रह्मवर्चसी नाम यज्ञः । आ ह वै तत्र ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसी जायते । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वा अतिव्याधी नाम यज्ञः । आ ह वै तत्र राजन्योऽतिव्याधी जायते । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै दीर्घो नाम यज्ञः । दीर्घायुषो ह वै तत्र मनुष्या भवन्ति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै क्लृप्तो नाम यज्ञः । कल्पते ह वै तत्र प्रजाभ्यो योगक्षेमः । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते

sanskrit_iast: tārpyeṇāśvaṃ saṃjñapayanti | yajño vai tārpyam | yajñenaivainaṃ samardhayanti | yāmena sāmnā prastotā'nūpatiṣṭhate | yamalokamevainaṃ gamayati | tārpye ca kṛttyadhīvāse cāśvaṃ saṃjñapayanti | etadvai paśūnāṃ rūpam | rūpeṇaiva paśūnavarundhe | hiraṇyakaśipu bhavati | tejaso'varuddhyai
meaning: तार्प्येणाश्वं संज्ञपयन्ति । यज्ञो वै तार्प्यम् । यज्ञेनैवैनं समर्धयन्ति । यामेन साम्ना प्रस्तोताऽनूपतिष्ठते । यमलोकमेवैनं गमयति । तार्प्ये च कृत्त्यधीवासे चाश्वं संज्ञपयन्ति । एतद्वै पशूनां रूपम् । रूपेणैव पशूनवरुन्धे । हिरण्यकशिपु भवति । तेजसोऽवरुद्ध्यै
text_mt: With a garment of tārpya cloth they suffocate the horse. / Sacrifice indeed is the tārpya cloth; / with sacrifice indeed they endow it. / With the chant of Yama the Prastotṛ attends [it]; / to the world of Yama indeed he conducts it. / Upon the tārpya cloth and an upper garment of skins they suffocate the horse. / This indeed is the form of domestic animals; / by form indeed he secures domestic animals. / There is a gold-embroidered cushion, / for the securing of fiery energy.

sanskrit_iast: rukmo bhavati | suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai | aśvo bhavati | prajāpaterāptyai | asya vai lokasya rūpaṃ tārpyam | antarikṣasya kṛttyadhīvāsaḥ | divo hiraṇyakaśipu | ādityasya rukmaḥ | prajāpateraśvaḥ | imameva lokaṃ tārpyeṇāpnoti ||
meaning: रुक्मो भवति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै । अश्वो भवति । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । अस्य वै लोकस्य रूपं तार्प्यम् । अन्तरिक्षस्य कृत्त्यधीवासः । दिवो हिरण्यकशिपु । आदित्यस्य रुक्मः । प्रजापतेरश्वः । इममेव लोकं तार्प्येणाप्नोति ॥
text_mt: There is a gold plate, / for the illumination of the heavenly realm. / There is a horse, / for the attainment of Prajāpati. / The tārpya cloth is the form of this world; / the upper garment of skins, of the atmosphere; / the gold-embroidered cushion, of heaven; / the gold plate, of the sun; / the horse, of Prajāpati. / This world he attains with the tārpya cloth,

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣaṃ kṛtyadhīvāsena | divaṃ hiraṇyakaśipunā | ādityaṃ rukmeṇa | aśvenaiva medhyena prajāpateḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | etāsāmeva devatānāṃ sāyujyam | sārṣṭitāṃ samānalokatāmāpnoti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
meaning: अन्तरिक्षं कृत्यधीवासेन । दिवं हिरण्यकशिपुना । आदित्यं रुक्मेण । अश्वेनैव मेध्येन प्रजापतेः सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । एतासामेव देवतानां सायुज्यम् । सार्ष्टितां समानलोकतामाप्नोति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
text_mt: the atmosphere with the upper garment of skins, / heaven with the gold-embroidered cushion, / the sun with the gold plate; / by the horse fit for sacrifice he attains unison and co-residence with Prajāpati. / He attains unison, / equal power, and sharing the same realm with these deities, / who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice, / and who thus knows it.

sanskrit_iast: ādityāścāṃgirasaśca suvarge loke'spardhanta | te'ṃgirasa ādityebhyaḥ | amumādityamaśvaṃ śvetaṃ bhūtaṃ dakṣiṇāmanayan | te'bruvan | yaṃ no'neṣṭa | sa varyo'bhūditi | tasmādaśvaṃ savaryetyāhvayanti | tasmādyajñe varo dīyate | yatprajāpatirālabdho'śvo'bhavat | tasmādaśvo nāma
meaning: आदित्याश्चांगिरसश्च सुवर्गे लोकेऽस्पर्धन्त । तेऽंगिरस आदित्येभ्यः । अमुमादित्यमश्वं श्वेतं भूतं दक्षिणामनयन् । तेऽब्रुवन् । यं नोऽनेष्ट । स वर्योऽभूदिति । तस्मादश्वं सवर्येत्याह्वयन्ति । तस्माद्यज्ञे वरो दीयते । यत्प्रजापतिरालब्धोऽश्वोऽभवत् । तस्मादश्वो नाम
text_mt: The Ādityas and the Aṅgirases vied in the heavenly realm. / Those Aṅgirases brought that sun / having become a white horse as the sacrificial fee to the Ādityas. / They said: / 'The one whom you have brought to us, / he has become precious.' / Therefore they address the horse as 'precious'; / therefore the choice boon is given at the sacrifice. / In that Prajāpati, being seized, became a horse (aśva), / therefore he is named horse (áśva).

sanskrit_iast: yacchvayadarurāsīt | tasmādarvā nāma | yathsadyo vājānthsamajayat | tasmādvājī nāma | yadasurāṇāṃ lokānādatta | tasmādādityo nāma | agnirvā aśvamedhasya yonirāyatanam | sūryo'gneryonirāyatanam | yadaśvamedhe'gnau citya uttaravedimupavapati | yonimantamevainamāyatanavantaṃ karoti
meaning: यच्छ्वयदरुरासीत् । तस्मादर्वा नाम । यथ्सद्यो वाजान्थ्समजयत् । तस्माद्वाजी नाम । यदसुराणां लोकानादत्त । तस्मादादित्यो नाम । अग्निर्वा अश्वमेधस्य योनिरायतनम् । सूर्योऽग्नेर्योनिरायतनम् । यदश्वमेधेऽग्नौ चित्य उत्तरवेदिमुपवपति । योनिमन्तमेवैनमायतनवन्तं करोति
text_mt: In that, swelling, he was a courser (aru), / therefore he is named steed (árvan). / In that he immediately won the prize (vāja), / therefore he is named charger (vājín). / In that he took away (ādatta) the worlds of the asuras, / therefore he is named Āditya. / Agni indeed is the womb and resting place of the horse sacrifice; / Sūrya is the womb and resting place of Agni. / In that at the horse sacrifice, when the fire is to be piled, he strews the high altar, / he makes him possess a womb and a resting place.

sanskrit_iast: yonimānāyatanavānbhavati | ya evaṃ veda | prāṇāpānau vā etau devānām | yadarkāśvamedhau | prāṇāpānāvevāvarundhe | ojo balaṃ vā etau devānām | yadarkāśvamedhau | ojo balamevāvarundhe | agnirvā aśvamedhasya yonirāyatanam | sūryo'gneryonirāyatanam | yadaśvamedhe'gnau citya uttaravediṃ cinoti | tāvarkāśvamedhau | arkāśvamedhāvevāvarundhe | atho arkāśvamedhayoreva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: योनिमानायतनवान्भवति । य एवं वेद । प्राणापानौ वा एतौ देवानाम् । यदर्काश्वमेधौ । प्राणापानावेवावरुन्धे । ओजो बलं वा एतौ देवानाम् । यदर्काश्वमेधौ । ओजो बलमेवावरुन्धे । अग्निर्वा अश्वमेधस्य योनिरायतनम् । सूर्योऽग्नेर्योनिरायतनम् । यदश्वमेधेऽग्नौ चित्य उत्तरवेदिं चिनोति । तावर्काश्वमेधौ । अर्काश्वमेधावेवावरुन्धे । अथो अर्काश्वमेधयोरेव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: He comes to possess a womb and a resting place / who knows thus. / The exhalation and inhalation of the gods indeed are these two, / namely Arka and the horse sacrifice; / exhalation and inhalation indeed he secures. / The splendorous might and physical strength of the gods indeed are these two, / namely Arka and the horse sacrifice; / splendorous might and physical strength indeed he secures. / Agni indeed is the womb and resting place of the horse sacrifice; / Sūrya is the womb and resting place of Agni. / In that at the horse sacrifice, when the fire is to be piled, he piles the high altar, / those two are Arka and the horse sacrifice; / Arka and the horse sacrifice indeed he secures; / moreover, he finds a firm foundation in Arka and the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiṃ vai devāḥ pitaram | paśuṃ bhūtaṃ medhāyālabhanta | tamālabhyopāvasan | prātaryaṣṭāsmaha iti | ekaṃ vā etaddevānāmahaḥ | yathsaṃvathsaraḥ | tasmādaśvaḥ purastāthsaṃvathsara ālabhyate | yatprajāpatirālabdho'śvo'bhavat | tasmādaśvaḥ | yathsadyo medho'bhavat
meaning: प्रजापतिं वै देवाः पितरम् । पशुं भूतं मेधायालभन्त । तमालभ्योपावसन् । प्रातर्यष्टास्मह इति । एकं वा एतद्देवानामहः । यथ्संवथ्सरः । तस्मादश्वः पुरस्ताथ्संवथ्सर आलभ्यते । यत्प्रजापतिरालब्धोऽश्वोऽभवत् । तस्मादश्वः । यथ्सद्यो मेधोऽभवत्
text_mt: The gods seized their father Prajāpati, / who had become a domestic animal, for the sacrifice. / Having seized him, they waited by [him], saying: / 'We shall sacrifice tomorrow.' / Indeed, one day of the gods / is a year. / Therefore, the horse is seized a year beforehand. / Because Prajāpati, when seized, became a horse (áśva), / therefore it is a horse. / Because he immediately became sacrificial substance (médha),

sanskrit_iast: tasmādaśvamedhaḥ | veduko'śvamāśuṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | yadvai tatprajāpatirālabdho'śvo'bhavat | tasmādaśvaḥ prajāpateḥ paśūnāmanurūpatamaḥ | ā'sya putraḥ pratirūpo jāyate | ya evaṃ veda | sarvāṇi bhūtāni saṃbhṛtyālabhate | samenaṃ devāstejase brahmavarcasāya bharanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate
meaning: तस्मादश्वमेधः । वेदुकोऽश्वमाशुं भवति । य एवं वेद । यद्वै तत्प्रजापतिरालब्धोऽश्वोऽभवत् । तस्मादश्वः प्रजापतेः पशूनामनुरूपतमः । आऽस्य पुत्रः प्रतिरूपो जायते । य एवं वेद । सर्वाणि भूतानि संभृत्यालभते । समेनं देवास्तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय भरन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते
text_mt: therefore it is the horse sacrifice (aśvamedhá). / He becomes one who finds a swift horse, / whoever knows thus. / When Prajāpati, having been seized, became a horse, / therefore, of domestic animals, the horse is the most suitable counterpart to Prajāpati. / A son who is his exact counterpart is born to him, / whoever knows thus. / Having gathered all beings, he seizes [it]. / The gods bring him together for fiery energy and spiritual preeminence, / who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast: ya u cainamevaṃ veda | etadvai taddevā etāṃ devatām | paśuṃ bhūtaṃ medhāyālabhanta | yajñameva | yajñena yajñamayajanta devāḥ | kāmapraṃ yajñamakurvata | te'mṛtatvamakāmayanta | te'mṛtatvamagacchan | yo'śvamedhena yajate | devānāmevāyanenaiti
meaning: य उ चैनमेवं वेद । एतद्वै तद्देवा एतां देवताम् । पशुं भूतं मेधायालभन्त । यज्ञमेव । यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवाः । कामप्रं यज्ञमकुर्वत । तेऽमृतत्वमकामयन्त । तेऽमृतत्वमगच्छन् । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । देवानामेवायनेनैति
text_mt: and whoever knows it thus. / This was that deity that the gods / seized for the sacrifice when he had become a domestic animal: / namely, sacrifice itself. / With sacrifice the gods sacrificed to sacrifice; / they made the sacrifice wish-fulfilling. / They desired immortality; / they went to immortality. / Whoever sacrifices with the horse sacrifice / goes along the very path of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyenaiva yajñena yajate kāmapreṇa | apunarmārameva gacchati | etasya vai rūpeṇa purastātprājāpatyamṛṣabhaṃ tūparaṃ bahurūpamā labhate | sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ | sarvasyāptyai | sarvasya jityai | sarvameva tenāpnoti | sarvaṃ jayati | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
meaning: प्राजापत्येनैव यज्ञेन यजते कामप्रेण । अपुनर्मारमेव गच्छति । एतस्य वै रूपेण पुरस्तात्प्राजापत्यमृषभं तूपरं बहुरूपमा लभते । सर्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यः । सर्वस्याप्त्यै । सर्वस्य जित्यै । सर्वमेव तेनाप्नोति । सर्वं जयति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
text_mt: He sacrifices with the wish-fulfilling sacrifice of Prajāpati; / he attains non-dying-again. / In the form of this [Prajāpati], beforehand, he seizes a hornless, many-colored bull sacred to Prajāpati / for all desires, / for the attainment of everything, / for the conquest of everything. / By that he attains everything; / he conquers everything— / whoever sacrifices with the horse sacrifice, / and whoever knows it thus.

sanskrit_iast: yo vā aśvasya medhyasya lomanī veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya lomaṃ llomañjuhoti | ahorātre vā aśvasya medhyasya lomanī | yathsāyaṃ prātarjuhoti | aśvasyaiva medhyasya lomaṃ llomañjuhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya lomaṃ llomañjuhvati | yo vā aśvasya medhyasya pade veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya pade pade juhoti | darśapūrṇamāsau vā aśvasya medhyasya pade
meaning: यो वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य लोमनी वेद । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य लोमं ल्लोमञ्जुहोति । अहोरात्रे वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य लोमनी । यथ्सायं प्रातर्जुहोति । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य लोमं ल्लोमञ्जुहोति । एतदनुकृति ह स्म वै पुरा । अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य लोमं ल्लोमञ्जुह्वति । यो वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य पदे वेद । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य पदे पदे जुहोति । दर्शपूर्णमासौ वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य पदे
text_mt: Whoever knows the two hairs of the sacrificial horse, / he offers upon each hair of the sacrificial horse. / Day and night are the two hairs of the sacrificial horse. / When he offers evening and morning, / he offers upon each hair of the sacrificial horse. / In imitation of this, formerly, / they used to offer upon each hair of the sacrificial horse. / Whoever knows the two footprints of the sacrificial horse, / he offers in every footprint of the sacrificial horse. / The new-moon and full-moon rites are the two footprints of the sacrificial horse.

sanskrit_iast: yaddarśapūrṇamāsau yajate | aśvasyaiva medhyasya pade pade juhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya pade pade juhvati | yo vā aśvasya medhyasya vivartanaṃ veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhoti | asau vā ādityo'śvaḥ | sa āhavanīyamāgacchati | tadvivartate | yadagnihotraṃ juhoti | aśvasyaiva medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhvati

text_mt: When he performs the new-moon and full-moon rites, / he offers in every footprint of the sacrificial horse. / In imitation of this, formerly, / they used to offer in every footprint of the sacrificial horse. / Whoever knows the rolling-place of the sacrificial horse, / he offers at every roll of the sacrificial horse. / Yonder sun is the horse. / He comes to the Āhavanīya; / there he rolls. / When he offers the Agnihotra, / he offers at every roll of the sacrificial horse. / In imitation of this, formerly, / they used to offer at every roll of the sacrificial horse.

sanskrit_iast: āveśayanniveśayanthsaṃveśanaḥ saṃśāntaḥ śāntaḥ | ābhavanprabhavanthsaṃbhavanthsaṃbhūto bhūtaḥ | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ saṃstutaṃ kalyāṇaṃ viśvarūpam | śukramamṛtaṃ tejasvi tejaḥ samiddham | aruṇaṃ bhānumanmarīcimadabhitapattapasvat | savitā prasavitā dīpto dīpayandīpyamānaḥ | jvalañjvalitā tapanvitapanthsaṃtapan | rocano rocamānaḥ śumbhūḥ śumbhamāno vāmaḥ | sutā sunvatī prasutā sūyamānā'bhiṣūyamāṇā | pītī prapā saṃpā tṛptistarpayantī

sanskrit_iast: aruṇo'ruṇarajāḥ puṇḍarīko viśvajidabhijit | ārdraḥ pinvamāno'nnavānrasavānirāvān | sarvauṣadhaḥ sambharo mahasvān | ejatkā jovatkāḥ | kṣullakāḥ śipiviṣṭakāḥ | sarisrarāḥ suśeravaḥ | ajirāso gamiṣṇavaḥ | idānīṃ tadānīmetarhi kṣipramajiram | āśurnimeṣaḥ phaṇo dravannatidravan | tvaraṃstvaramāṇa āśurāśīyāñjavaḥ | agniṣṭoma ukthyo'tirātro dvirātrastrirātraścatūrātraḥ | agnirṛtuḥ sūrya ṛtuścandramā ṛtuḥ | prajāpatiḥ saṃvathsaro mahānkaḥ
meaning: अरुणोऽरुणरजाः पुण्डरीको विश्वजिदभिजित् । आर्द्रः पिन्वमानोऽन्नवान्रसवानिरावान् । सर्वौषधः सम्भरो महस्वान् । एजत्का जोवत्काः । क्षुल्लकाः शिपिविष्टकाः । सरिस्रराः सुशेरवः । अजिरासो गमिष्णवः । इदानीं तदानीमेतर्हि क्षिप्रमजिरम् । आशुर्निमेषः फणो द्रवन्नतिद्रवन् । त्वरंस्त्वरमाण आशुराशीयाञ्जवः । अग्निष्टोम उक्थ्योऽतिरात्रो द्विरात्रस्त्रिरात्रश्चतूरात्रः । अग्निरृतुः सूर्य ऋतुश्चन्द्रमा ऋतुः । प्रजापतिः संवथ्सरो महान्कः
text_mt: Red, red-dusted, lotus-like, all-conquering, victorious; / moist, overflowing, rich in food, sapful, rich in refreshment; / containing all herbs, all-gathering, mighty; / stirring, moving quickly; / small, Śipiviṣṭa; / gliding, easy to lie upon; / swift, departing; / now, then, at this moment, instantly, swiftly; / quick, twinkling, gliding, running, outrunning; / hastening, hurrying, swift, swifter, speed; / Agniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Atirātra, Dvirātra, Trirātra, Catūrātra; / Agni is the season, Sūrya is the season, Candramas is the season; / Prajāpati is the year, the great Ka.
