meaning: भूरग्निं च पृथिवीं च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद । भुवो वायुं चान्तरिक्षं च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद । स्वरादित्यं च दिवं च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद । भूर्भुवः स्वश्चन्द्रमसं च दिशश्च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
text_mt: 'Bhūḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with Agni, the earth, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!' / 'Bhuvaḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with Vāyu, the atmosphere, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!' / 'Svaḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with the sun, heaven, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!' / 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with the moon, the directions, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!'

sanskrit_iast: tvameva tvāṃ vettha yo'si so'si | tvameva tvāmacaiṣīḥ | citaścāsi saṃcitaścāsyagne | etāvāṃścāsi bhūyāṃścāsyagne | yatte agne nyūnaṃ yadu te'tiriktam | ādityāstadaṃgirasaścinvantu | viśve te devāścitimāpūrayantu | citaścāsi saṃcitaścāsyagne | etāvāṃścāsi bhūyāṃścāsyagne | mā te agne cayena mā'ti ca yenāyurāvṛkṣi | sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiryadadāvudeti | tapaso jātamanibhṛṣṭamojaḥ | tatte jyotiriṣṭake | tena me tapa | tena me jvala | tena me dīdihi | yāvaddevāḥ | yāvadasāti sūryaḥ | yāvadutāpi brahma
meaning: त्वमेव त्वां वेत्थ योऽसि सोऽसि । त्वमेव त्वामचैषीः । चितश्चासि संचितश्चास्यग्ने । एतावांश्चासि भूयांश्चास्यग्ने । यत्ते अग्ने न्यूनं यदु तेऽतिरिक्तम् । आदित्यास्तदंगिरसश्चिन्वन्तु । विश्वे ते देवाश्चितिमापूरयन्तु । चितश्चासि संचितश्चास्यग्ने । एतावांश्चासि भूयांश्चास्यग्ने । मा ते अग्ने चयेन माऽति च येनायुरावृक्षि । सर्वेषां ज्योतिषां ज्योतिर्यददावुदेति । तपसो जातमनिभृष्टमोजः । तत्ते ज्योतिरिष्टके । तेन मे तप । तेन मे ज्वल । तेन मे दीदिहि । यावद्देवाः । यावदसाति सूर्यः । यावदुतापि ब्रह्म
text_mt: You alone know yourself, who you are, what you are. / You alone have piled yourself. / You are piled, and you are gathered, O Agni; / you are so great, and you are greater still, O Agni. / What of yours is deficient, O Agni, and what of yours is redundant, / let the Ādityas and the Aṅgirases pile that; / let all the gods fill up the layer. / You are piled, and you are gathered, O Agni; / you are so great, and you are greater still, O Agni. / May I not cut off your lifespan, O Agni, by under-piling or by over-piling! / The light of all lights that rises yonder, / the unflagging splendorous might born of ascetic heat, / that is your light, O brick. / With that heat me; / with that shine for me; / with that beam for me, / as long as there are gods, / as long as the sun shall be, / and even as long as brahman!

sanskrit_iast: saṃvathsaro'si parivathsaro'si | idāvathsaro'sīdu vathsaro'si | idvathsaro'si vathsaro'si | tasya te vasantaḥ śiraḥ | grīṣmo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | varṣāḥ puccham | śaraduttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | hemanto madhyam | pūrvapakṣāścitayaḥ | aparapakṣāḥ purīṣam
meaning: संवथ्सरोऽसि परिवथ्सरोऽसि । इदावथ्सरोऽसीदु वथ्सरोऽसि । इद्वथ्सरोऽसि वथ्सरोऽसि । तस्य ते वसन्तः शिरः । ग्रीष्मो दक्षिणः पक्षः । वर्षाः पुच्छम् । शरदुत्तरः पक्षः । हेमन्तो मध्यम् । पूर्वपक्षाश्चितयः । अपरपक्षाः पुरीषम्
text_mt: You are the Saṃvatsara; you are the Parivatsara; / you are the Idāvatsara; you are the Iduvatsara; / you are the Idvatsara; you are the Vatsara. / Of you, spring is the head; / summer is the right wing; / the rains are the tail; / autumn is the left wing; / winter is the middle; / the waxing fortnights are the layers; / the waning fortnights are the loose soil;

sanskrit_iast: ahorātrāṇīṣṭakāḥ | ṛṣabho'si svargo lokaḥ | yasyāṃ diśi mahīyase | tato no maha āvaha | vāyurbhūtvā sarvā diśa āvāhi | sarvā diśo'nu vivāhi | sarvā diśo'nu saṃvāhi | cityā citimāpṛṇa | acityā citimāpṛṇa | cidasi samudrayoniḥ
meaning: अहोरात्राणीष्टकाः । ऋषभोऽसि स्वर्गो लोकः । यस्यां दिशि महीयसे । ततो नो मह आवह । वायुर्भूत्वा सर्वा दिश आवाहि । सर्वा दिशोऽनु विवाहि । सर्वा दिशोऽनु संवाहि । चित्या चितिमापृण । अचित्या चितिमापृण । चिदसि समुद्रयोनिः
text_mt: the days and nights are the bricks. / You are the bull, the heavenly realm. / In whichever quarter you are magnified, / from there bring us greatness. / Becoming the wind, blow in all directions; / blow along through all directions; / blow together through all directions. / With thought fill the layer; / with absence of thought fill the layer. / You are thought, ocean-born;

sanskrit_iast: indurdakṣaḥ śyena ṛtāvā | hiraṇyapakṣaḥ śakuno bhuraṇyuḥ | mahānthsadhasthe dhruva āniṣattaḥ | namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ | eti preti vīti samityuditi | divaṃ me yaccha | antarikṣaṃ me yaccha | pṛthivīṃ me yaccha | pṛthivīṃ me yaccha | antarikṣaṃ me yaccha | divaṃ me yaccha | ahnā prasāraya | rātryā samaca | rātryā prasāraya | ahnā samaca | kāmaṃ prasāraya | kāmaṃ samaca
meaning: इन्दुर्दक्षः श्येन ऋतावा । हिरण्यपक्षः शकुनो भुरण्युः । महान्थ्सधस्थे ध्रुव आनिषत्तः । नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः । एति प्रेति वीति समित्युदिति । दिवं मे यच्छ । अन्तरिक्षं मे यच्छ । पृथिवीं मे यच्छ । पृथिवीं मे यच्छ । अन्तरिक्षं मे यच्छ । दिवं मे यच्छ । अह्ना प्रसारय । रात्र्या समच । रात्र्या प्रसारय । अह्ना समच । कामं प्रसारय । कामं समच
text_mt: a drop, skillful, a righteous falcon, / a golden-winged, nurturing bird, / great, seated firm in the common abode. / Homage be to you; do not harm me! / Entering, issuing forth, dispersing, uniting, ascending! / Grant me heaven; / grant me the midspace; / grant me the earth. / Grant me the earth; / grant me the midspace; / grant me heaven. / Stretch forth by day; / contract by night. / Stretch forth by night; contract by day. / Stretch forth desire; / contract desire.

sanskrit_iast: bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ | ojo balam | brahma kṣattram | yaśo mahat | satyaṃ tapo nāma | rūpamamṛtam | cakṣuḥ śrotram | mana āyuḥ | viśvaṃ yaśo mahaḥ | samaṃ tapo haro bhāḥ | jātavedā yadi vā pāvako'si | vaiśvānaro yadi vā vaidyuto'si | śaṃ prajābhyo yajamānāya lokam | ūrjaṃ puṣṭiṃ dadadabhyāvavṛthsva
meaning: भूर्भुवः स्वः । ओजो बलम् । ब्रह्म क्षत्त्रम् । यशो महत् । सत्यं तपो नाम । रूपममृतम् । चक्षुः श्रोत्रम् । मन आयुः । विश्वं यशो महः । समं तपो हरो भाः । जातवेदा यदि वा पावकोऽसि । वैश्वानरो यदि वा वैद्युतोऽसि । शं प्रजाभ्यो यजमानाय लोकम् । ऊर्जं पुष्टिं दददभ्याववृथ्स्व
text_mt: Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! / Splendorous might, power; / brahman, regal power; / glory, greatness; / truth, ascetic heat, name; / form, the immortal; / eye, ear; / mind, lifespan; / all, glory, greatness; / equality, ascetic heat, heat-glow, light! / Whether you are Jātavedas or the purifying one, / whether you are Vaiśvānara or the lightning fire, / giving welfare to offspring, a realm to the sacrificer, / vigor, and nourishment, turn toward [us]!

sanskrit_iast: rājñī virājñī | samrājñī svarājñī | arciḥ śociḥ | tapo haro bhāḥ | agnirindro bṛhaspatiḥ | viśve devā bhuvanasya gopāḥ | te mā sarve yaśasā saṃsṛjantu
meaning: राज्ञी विराज्ञी । सम्राज्ञी स्वराज्ञी । अर्चिः शोचिः । तपो हरो भाः । अग्निरिन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः । विश्वे देवा भुवनस्य गोपाः । ते मा सर्वे यशसा संसृजन्तु
text_mt: Queen, ruling queen, / sovereign queen, self-ruling queen! / Flare, radiance, / ascetic heat, heat-glow, light! / Agni, Indra, Bṛhaspati, / all the gods, guardians of the world— / may they all endow me with glory!

sanskrit_iast: asave svāhā vasave svāhā | vibhuve svāhā vivasvate svāhā | abhibhuve svāhā'dhipataye svāhā | divāṃ pataye svāhā'ṃhaspatyāya svāhā | cākṣuṣmatyāya svāhā jyotiṣmatyāya svāhā | rājñe svāhā virājñe svāhā | saṃrājñe svāhā svarājñe svāhā | śūṣāya svāhā sūryāya svāhā | candramase svāhā jyotiṣe svāhā | saṃsarpāya svāhā kalyāṇāya svāhā | arjunāya svāhā
meaning: असवे स्वाहा वसवे स्वाहा । विभुवे स्वाहा विवस्वते स्वाहा । अभिभुवे स्वाहाऽधिपतये स्वाहा । दिवां पतये स्वाहाऽंहस्पत्याय स्वाहा । चाक्षुष्मत्याय स्वाहा ज्योतिष्मत्याय स्वाहा । राज्ञे स्वाहा विराज्ञे स्वाहा । संराज्ञे स्वाहा स्वराज्ञे स्वाहा । शूषाय स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहा । चन्द्रमसे स्वाहा ज्योतिषे स्वाहा । संसर्पाय स्वाहा कल्याणाय स्वाहा । अर्जुनाय स्वाहा
text_mt: To breath, svāhā! / To the Vasu, svāhā! / To the pervasive one, svāhā! / To Vivasvat, svāhā! / To the vanquisher, svāhā; to the overlord, svāhā! / To the lord of days, svāhā; to the lord of distress, svāhā! / To the visionary one, svāhā; to the luminous one, svāhā! / To the king, svāhā; to the sovereign, svāhā! / To the emperor, svāhā! / To the independent king, svāhā! / To vigor, svāhā; to the sun, svāhā! / To the moon, svāhā; to the light, svāhā! / To the creeping one, svāhā! / To the auspicious one, svāhā! / To the bright one, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: vipaścite pavamānāya gāyata | mahī na dhārā'tyandho arṣati | ahirha jīrṇāmatisarpati tvacam | atyo na krīḍannasaradvṛṣā hariḥ | upayāmagṛhīto'si mṛtyave tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | eṣa te yonirmṛtyave tvā | apa mṛtyumapa kṣudham | apetaḥ śapathaṃ jahi | adhā no agna āvaha | rāyaspoṣaṃ sahasriṇam
meaning: विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत । मही न धाराऽत्यन्धो अर्षति । अहिर्ह जीर्णामतिसर्पति त्वचम् । अत्यो न क्रीडन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः । उपयामगृहीतोऽसि मृत्यवे त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । एष ते योनिर्मृत्यवे त्वा । अप मृत्युमप क्षुधम् । अपेतः शपथं जहि । अधा नो अग्न आवह । रायस्पोषं सहस्रिणम्
text_mt: Sing to the wise purifying one; / like a mighty stream, he rushes beyond the soma plant; / the snake indeed sloughs its worn skin; / like a steed playing, the tawny bull has run. / You are taken with a support; I take you pleasing to Death. / This is your womb; for Death, you! / Death away, hunger away! / Slay the curse away from here! / Then, O Agni, bring us / nourishment of wealth a thousandfold!

sanskrit_iast: ye te sahasramayutaṃ pāśāḥ | mṛtyo martyāya hantave | tān yajñasya māyayā | sarvānavayajāmahe | bhakṣo'syamṛtabhakṣaḥ | tasya te mṛtyupītasyāmṛtavataḥ | svagākṛtasya madhumataḥ | upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi | mandrā'bhibhūtiḥ keturyajñānāṃ vāk | asāvehi
meaning: ये ते सहस्रमयुतं पाशाः । मृत्यो मर्त्याय हन्तवे । तान् यज्ञस्य मायया । सर्वानवयजामहे । भक्षोऽस्यमृतभक्षः । तस्य ते मृत्युपीतस्यामृतवतः । स्वगाकृतस्य मधुमतः । उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि । मन्द्राऽभिभूतिः केतुर्यज्ञानां वाक् । असावेहि
text_mt: The thousand, the myriad fetters that are yours, / O Death, for the mortal's slaying— / all those, by the sacrifice's mystic power, / we sacrifice away. / You are a portion, the portion of immortality. / Of you, drunk by Death, possessed of immortality, / made into svagā, full of honey, / invited, I partake as an invited one. / Pleasing, conquering, the banner of sacrifices is speech. / O So-and-so, come!

sanskrit_iast: andho jāgṛviḥ prāṇa | asāvehi | badhira ākrandayitarapāna | asāvehi | ahasto'stvā cakṣuḥ | asāvehi | apādāśo manaḥ | asāvehi | kave vipracitte śrotra | asāvehi |
meaning: अन्धो जागृविः प्राण । असावेहि । बधिर आक्रन्दयितरपान । असावेहि । अहस्तोऽस्त्वा चक्षुः । असावेहि । अपादाशो मनः । असावेहि । कवे विप्रचित्ते श्रोत्र । असावेहि ।
text_mt: Blind, watchful exhalation; / O So-and-so, come! / Deaf, shrieking inhalation; / O So-and-so, come! / Handless archer, eye; / O So-and-so, come! / Footless runner, mind; / O So-and-so, come! / O sage, wise-minded ear; / O So-and-so, come!

sanskrit_iast: suhastaḥ suvāsāḥ | śūṣo nāmāsyamṛto martyeṣu | taṃ tvā'haṃ tathā veda | asāvehi | agnirme vāci śritaḥ | vāgghṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | vāyurme prāṇe śritaḥ
meaning: सुहस्तः सुवासाः । शूषो नामास्यमृतो मर्त्येषु । तं त्वाऽहं तथा वेद । असावेहि । अग्निर्मे वाचि श्रितः । वाग्घृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । वायुर्मे प्राणे श्रितः
text_mt: Deft-handed, well-clad, / you are named strength, immortal among mortals; / as such do I know you. / O So-and-so, come! / Agni is resting in my speech; / speech in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Vāyu is resting in my exhalation;

sanskrit_iast: prāṇo hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | sūryo me cakṣuṣi śritaḥ | cakṣurhṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | candramā me manasi śritaḥ
meaning: प्राणो हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । सूर्यो मे चक्षुषि श्रितः । चक्षुर्हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । चन्द्रमा मे मनसि श्रितः
text_mt: the exhalation in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Sūrya is resting in my eye; / the eye in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The moon is resting in my mind;

sanskrit_iast: mano hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | diśo me śrotre śritāḥ | śrotraṃ hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | āpo me retasi śritāḥ
meaning: मनो हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । दिशो मे श्रोत्रे श्रिताः । श्रोत्रं हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । आपो मे रेतसि श्रिताः
text_mt: the mind in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The directions are resting in my ear; / the ear in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The waters are resting in my semen;

sanskrit_iast: reto hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | pṛthivī me śarīre śritā | śarīraṃ hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | oṣadhivanaspatayo me lomasu śritāḥ
meaning: रेतो हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । पृथिवी मे शरीरे श्रिता । शरीरं हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । ओषधिवनस्पतयो मे लोमसु श्रिताः
text_mt: the semen in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The earth is resting in my body; / the body in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Herbs and trees are resting in my bodily hairs;

sanskrit_iast: lomāni hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | indro me bale śritaḥ | balaṃ hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | parjanyo me mūrdhni śritaḥ
meaning: लोमानि हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । इन्द्रो मे बले श्रितः । बलं हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । पर्जन्यो मे मूर्ध्नि श्रितः
text_mt: the bodily hairs in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Indra is resting in my power; / power in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Parjanya is resting in my head;

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhā hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | īśāno me manyau śritaḥ | manyurhṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | ātmā ma ātmani śritaḥ
meaning: मूर्धा हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । ईशानो मे मन्यौ श्रितः । मन्युर्हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । आत्मा म आत्मनि श्रितः
text_mt: the head in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Īśāna is resting in my wrath; / wrath in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The self is resting in my self;

sanskrit_iast: ātmā hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | punarma ātmā punarāyurāgāt | punaḥ prāṇaḥ punarākūtamāgāt | vaiśvānaro raśmibhirvāvṛdhānaḥ | antastiṣṭhatvamṛtasya gopāḥ
meaning: आत्मा हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । पुनर्म आत्मा पुनरायुरागात् । पुनः प्राणः पुनराकूतमागात् । वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर्वावृधानः । अन्तस्तिष्ठत्वमृतस्य गोपाः
text_mt: the self in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Back has come my self, back my lifespan, / back exhalation, back intention has come. / May Vaiśvānara, waxing with his rays, / stand within as the guardian of immortality!

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatirdevānasṛjata | te pāpmanā saṃditā ajāyanta | tānvyadyat | yadvyadyat | tasmādvidyut | tamavṛścat | yadavṛścat | tasmādvṛṣṭiḥ | tasmādyatraite devate abhiprāpnutaḥ | vi ca haivāsya tatra pāpmānaṃ dyataḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिर्देवानसृजत । ते पाप्मना संदिता अजायन्त । तान्व्यद्यत् । यद्व्यद्यत् । तस्माद्विद्युत् । तमवृश्चत् । यदवृश्चत् । तस्माद्वृष्टिः । तस्माद्यत्रैते देवते अभिप्राप्नुतः । वि च हैवास्य तत्र पाप्मानं द्यतः
text_mt: Prajāpati created the gods. / They were born bound by evil. / He cut them free. / Because he cut them free [vyadyat], / therefore lightning [vidyut] came to be. / He sheared it away. / Because he sheared it away [avṛścat], / therefore rain [vṛṣṭiḥ] came to be. / Therefore, wherever these two deities reach, / they cut away and they shear away his evil there;

sanskrit_iast: vṛścataśca | saiṣā mīmāṃsā'gnihotra eva saṃpannā | atho āhuḥ | sarveṣu yajñakratuṣviti | hoṣyannapa upaspṛśet | vidyudasi vidya me pāpmānamiti | atha hutvopaspṛśet | vṛṣṭirasi vṛśca me pāpmānamiti | yakṣyamāṇo veṣṭvā vā | vi ca haivāsyaite devate pāpmānaṃ dyataḥ
meaning: वृश्चतश्च । सैषा मीमांसाऽग्निहोत्र एव संपन्ना । अथो आहुः । सर्वेषु यज्ञक्रतुष्विति । होष्यन्नप उपस्पृशेत् । विद्युदसि विद्य मे पाप्मानमिति । अथ हुत्वोपस्पृशेत् । वृष्टिरसि वृश्च मे पाप्मानमिति । यक्ष्यमाणो वेष्ट्वा वा । वि च हैवास्यैते देवते पाप्मानं द्यतः
text_mt: and they shear it away. / This same inquiry is accomplished in the Agnihotra alone. / Moreover, they say: / "In all sacrificial rites." / About to offer, he should touch water, [saying,] / "You are lightning; cut away my evil!" / Then having offered, he should touch [water, saying,] / "You are rain; shear away my evil!" / Whether about to sacrifice or having sacrificed, / these two deities cut away his evil

sanskrit_iast: vṛścataśca | atyaṃho hāruṇiḥ | brahmacāriṇe praśnānprocya prajighāya | parehi | plakṣaṃ daiyāmpātiṃ pṛccha | vettha sāvitrānna vetthāiti | tamāgatya papraccha | ācāryo mā prāhaiṣīt | vettha sāvitrānna vetthāiti | sa hovāca vedeti
meaning: वृश्चतश्च । अत्यंहो हारुणिः । ब्रह्मचारिणे प्रश्नान्प्रोच्य प्रजिघाय । परेहि । प्लक्षं दैयाम्पातिं पृच्छ । वेत्थ सावित्रान्न वेत्थाइति । तमागत्य पप्रच्छ । आचार्यो मा प्राहैषीत् । वेत्थ सावित्रान्न वेत्थाइति । स होवाच वेदेति
text_mt: and shear it away. / Atyaṃhas Āruṇi, / having explained the questions to a Vedic student, sent him forth: / "Go, / ask Plakṣa Dayyāmpāti: / 'Do you know the Sāvitra [fire] or do you not know it?'" / Coming to him, he asked: / "The teacher has sent me: / 'Do you know the Sāvitra [fire] or do you not know it?'" / He said: "I know it."

sanskrit_iast: sa kasminpratiṣṭhita iti | parorajasīti | kastadyatparorajā iti | eṣa vāva sa parorajā iti hovāca | ya eṣa tapati | eṣo'rvāgrajā iti | sa kasmintveṣa iti | satya iti | kiṃ tathsatyamiti | tapa iti
meaning: स कस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठित इति । परोरजसीति । कस्तद्यत्परोरजा इति । एष वाव स परोरजा इति होवाच । य एष तपति । एषोऽर्वाग्रजा इति । स कस्मिन्त्वेष इति । सत्य इति । किं तथ्सत्यमिति । तप इति
text_mt: "On what is it established?" [the student asked]. / "Beyond the realm of space [parorajas]," [Plakṣa replied]. / "What is that which is beyond the realm of space?" / "This one indeed is beyond the realm of space," he said, / "who shines here; / he is [also] on this side of the realm of space [arvāgrajas]." / "On what, however, is this one [established]?" / "On truth." / "What is that truth?" / "Austerity."

sanskrit_iast: kasminnu tapa iti | bala iti | kiṃ tadbalamiti | prāṇa iti | mā sma prāṇamati pṛccha iti mā''cāryo'bravīditi hovāca brahmacārī | sa hovāca plakṣo dayyāmpātiḥ | yadvai brahmacārinprāṇamatyaprakṣyaḥ | mūrdhā te vyapatiṣyat | ahamuta ācāryācchreyānbhaviṣyāmi | yo mā sāvitre samavādiṣṭeti
meaning: कस्मिन्नु तप इति । बल इति । किं तद्बलमिति । प्राण इति । मा स्म प्राणमति पृच्छ इति मा'ऽचार्योऽब्रवीदिति होवाच ब्रह्मचारी । स होवाच प्लक्षो दय्याम्पातिः । यद्वै ब्रह्मचारिन्प्राणमत्यप्रक्ष्यः । मूर्धा ते व्यपतिष्यत् । अहमुत आचार्याच्छ्रेयान्भविष्यामि । यो मा सावित्रे समवादिष्टेति
text_mt: "In what now is austerity [established]?" / "In strength." / "What is that strength?" / "The exhalation." / "Do not question beyond the exhalation, so my teacher told me," said the Vedic student. / Plakṣa Dayyāmpāti said: / "If, O Vedic student, you had questioned beyond the exhalation, / your head would have fallen off. / And I shall be better than your teacher, / who disputed with me about the Sāvitra [fire]."

sanskrit_iast: tasmāthsāvitre na saṃvadeta | sa yo ha vai sāvitraṃ viduṣā sāvitre saṃvadate | sahāsmiñchriyaṃ dadhāti | anu ha vā asmā asau tapañchriyaṃ manyate | anvasmai śrīstapo manyate | anvasmai tapo balaṃ manyate | anvasmai balaṃ prāṇaṃ manyate | sa yadāha | saṃjñānaṃ vijñānaṃ darśā dṛṣṭeti | eṣa eva tat
meaning: तस्माथ्सावित्रे न संवदेत । स यो ह वै सावित्रं विदुषा सावित्रे संवदते । सहास्मिञ्छ्रियं दधाति । अनु ह वा अस्मा असौ तपञ्छ्रियं मन्यते । अन्वस्मै श्रीस्तपो मन्यते । अन्वस्मै तपो बलं मन्यते । अन्वस्मै बलं प्राणं मन्यते । स यदाह । संज्ञानं विज्ञानं दर्शा दृष्टेति । एष एव तत्
text_mt: Therefore one should not dispute about the Sāvitra [fire]. / Whoever disputes about the Sāvitra [fire] with one who knows the Sāvitra [fire], / he places prosperity in him. / That one who shines over there certainly concedes prosperity to him; / prosperity concedes austerity to him; / austerity concedes strength to him; / strength concedes the exhalation to him. / When he says: / "Consciousness, discernment, sight, seen," / it is just this [sun].

sanskrit_iast: atha yadāha | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ sutā sunvatīti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva tānyahāni | eṣa rātrayaḥ | atha yadāha | citraḥ keturdātā pradātā savitā prasavitā'bhiśāstā'numanteti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te'hno muhūrtāḥ | eṣa rātreḥ
meaning: अथ यदाह । प्रस्तुतं विष्टुतं सुता सुन्वतीति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव तान्यहानि । एष रात्रयः । अथ यदाह । चित्रः केतुर्दाता प्रदाता सविता प्रसविताऽभिशास्ताऽनुमन्तेति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव तेऽह्नो मुहूर्ताः । एष रात्रेः
text_mt: Then, when he says: / "Praised, branched, pressed, pressing," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those days; / he is the nights. / Then, when he says: / "Bright, banner, giver, distributor, Savitṛ, impeller, ruler, consenter," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those muhūrtas of the day; / he is [those] of the night.

sanskrit_iast: atha yadāha | pavitraṃ pavayiṣyanthsahasvān thsahīyānaruṇo'ruṇarajā iti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te'rdhamāsāḥ | eṣa māsāḥ | atha yadāha | agniṣṭoma ukthyo'gnirṛtuḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃvathsara iti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te yajñakratavaḥ | eṣa ṛtavaḥ |
meaning: अथ यदाह । पवित्रं पवयिष्यन्थ्सहस्वान् थ्सहीयानरुणोऽरुणरजा इति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव तेऽर्धमासाः । एष मासाः । अथ यदाह । अग्निष्टोम उक्थ्योऽग्निरृतुः प्रजापतिः संवथ्सर इति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव ते यज्ञक्रतवः । एष ऋतवः ।
text_mt: Then, when he says: / "Purifier, about to purify, mighty, mightier, reddish, having red dust," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those fortnights; / he is the months. / Then, when he says: / "Agniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Agni, season, Prajāpati, year," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those sacrificial rites; / he is the seasons;

sanskrit_iast: eṣa saṃvathsaraḥ | atha yadāha | idānīṃ tadānīmiti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtāḥ | janako ha vaidehaḥ | ahorātraiḥ samājagāma | taṃ hocuḥ | yo vā asmān veda | vijahatpāpmānameti
meaning: एष संवथ्सरः । अथ यदाह । इदानीं तदानीमिति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव ते मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्ताः । जनको ह वैदेहः । अहोरात्रैः समाजगाम । तं होचुः । यो वा अस्मान् वेद । विजहत्पाप्मानमेति
text_mt: he is the year. / Then, when he says: / "Now, then," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas. / Janaka of Videha / met with the days and nights. / They said to him: / "Whoever knows us / goes leaving evil behind;

sanskrit_iast: sarvamāyureti | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | nāsyāmuṣmiṃ lloke'nnaṃ kṣīyata iti | vijahaddha vai pāpmānameti | sarvamāyureti | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | nāsyāmuṣmiṃ lloke'nnaṃ kṣīyate | ya evaṃ veda | ahīnā hāśvathyaḥ | sāvitraṃ vidāṃcakāra
meaning: सर्वमायुरेति । अभि स्वर्गं लोकं जयति । नास्यामुष्मिं ल्लोकेऽन्नं क्षीयत इति । विजहद्ध वै पाप्मानमेति । सर्वमायुरेति । अभि स्वर्गं लोकं जयति । नास्यामुष्मिं ल्लोकेऽन्नं क्षीयते । य एवं वेद । अहीना हाश्वथ्यः । सावित्रं विदांचकार
text_mt: he attains full lifespan; / he wins the heavenly realm; / his food does not diminish in yonder realm." / Leaving evil behind, indeed, he goes; / he attains full lifespan; / he wins the heavenly realm; / his food does not diminish in yonder realm, / who knows thus. / Ahīnas Āśvatthya / knew the Sāvitra [fire].

sanskrit_iast: sa ha haṃso hiraṇmayo bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokamiyāya | ādityasya sāyujyam | haṃso ha vai hiraṇmayo bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokameti | ādityasya sāyujyam | ya evaṃ veda | devabhāgo ha śrautarṣaḥ | sāvitraṃ vidāṃcakāra | taṃ ha vāgadṛśyamānā'bhyuvāca
meaning: स ह हंसो हिरण्मयो भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमियाय । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । हंसो ह वै हिरण्मयो भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमेति । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । य एवं वेद । देवभागो ह श्रौतर्षः । सावित्रं विदांचकार । तं ह वागदृश्यमानाऽभ्युवाच
text_mt: Becoming a golden goose [haṃsa], / he went to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya. / Becoming a golden goose, / he goes to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya, / who knows thus. / Devabhāga Śrautarṣa / knew the Sāvitra [fire]. / An invisible voice spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ bata gautamo veda | yaḥ sāvitraṃ vedeti | sa hovāca | kaiṣā vāgasīti | ayamahaṃ sāvitraḥ | devānāmuttamo lokaḥ | guhyaṃ maho bibhraditi | etāvati ha gautamaḥ | yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā'dho nipapāta | namo nama iti
meaning: सर्वं बत गौतमो वेद । यः सावित्रं वेदेति । स होवाच । कैषा वागसीति । अयमहं सावित्रः । देवानामुत्तमो लोकः । गुह्यं महो बिभ्रदिति । एतावति ह गौतमः । यज्ञोपवीतं कृत्वाऽधो निपपात । नमो नम इति
text_mt: "Ah, Gautama knows everything, / he who knows the Sāvitra [fire]!" / He said: / "What voice are you?" / "I am this Sāvitra [fire], / the highest world of the gods, / bearing a secret greatness." / At that, Gautama, / having arranged his sacred thread over his shoulder, bowed down low, / [saying,] "Homage! Homage!"

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca | mā bhaiṣīrgautama | jito vai te loka iti | tasmādye ke ca sāvitraṃ viduḥ | sarve te jitalokāḥ | sa yo ha vai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā'bhiṣiktaṃ veda | śriyā haivābhiṣicyate | ghṛṇiriti dve akṣare | sūrya iti trīṇi | āditya iti trīṇi
meaning: स होवाच । मा भैषीर्गौतम । जितो वै ते लोक इति । तस्माद्ये के च सावित्रं विदुः । सर्वे ते जितलोकाः । स यो ह वै सावित्रस्याष्टाक्षरं पदं श्रियाऽभिषिक्तं वेद । श्रिया हैवाभिषिच्यते । घृणिरिति द्वे अक्षरे । सूर्य इति त्रीणि । आदित्य इति त्रीणि
text_mt: It said: / "Do not fear, Gautama; / your world has indeed been won." / Therefore, whoever knows the Sāvitra [fire], / all of them have their world won. / Whoever knows the eight-syllabled line of the Sāvitra [fire] anointed with prosperity, / he is indeed anointed with prosperity. / 'Ghṛṇiḥ' are two syllables; / 'sūryaḥ' are three; / 'ādityaḥ' are three.

sanskrit_iast: etadvai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā'bhiṣiktam | ya evaṃ veda | śriyā haivābhiṣicyate | tadetadṛcā'bhyuktam | ṛco akṣare parame vyoman | yasmindevā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ | yastaṃ na veda kimṛcā kariṣyati | ya ittadvidusta ime samāsata iti | na ha vā etasyarcā na yajuṣā na sāmnā'rtho'sti | yaḥ sāvitraṃ veda
meaning: एतद्वै सावित्रस्याष्टाक्षरं पदं श्रियाऽभिषिक्तम् । य एवं वेद । श्रिया हैवाभिषिच्यते । तदेतदृचाऽभ्युक्तम् । ऋचो अक्षरे परमे व्योमन् । यस्मिन्देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुः । यस्तं न वेद किमृचा करिष्यति । य इत्तद्विदुस्त इमे समासत इति । न ह वा एतस्यर्चा न यजुषा न साम्नाऽर्थोऽस्ति । यः सावित्रं वेद
text_mt: This indeed is the eight-syllabled line of the Sāvitra [fire] anointed with prosperity. / Whoever knows thus / is indeed anointed with prosperity. / That is declared by a verse: / 'In the supreme firmament, the syllable of the ṛc, / in which all the gods are seated; / he who does not know that, what will he do with the ṛc? / Only those who know that sit here together.' / He who knows the Sāvitra [fire] / has no need for a ṛc, nor a yajus, nor a sāman.

sanskrit_iast: tadetatpari yaddevacakram | ārdraṃ pinvamānaṃ svarge loka eti | vijahadviśvā bhūtāni saṃpaśyat | ārdro ha vai pinvamānaḥ svarge loka eti | vijahanviśvā bhūtāni saṃpaśyan | ya evaṃ veda | śūṣo ha vai vārṣṇeyaḥ | ādityena samājagāma | taṃ hovāca | ehi sāvitraṃ viddhi | ayaṃ vai svargyo'gniḥ pārayiṣṇuramṛtāthsaṃbhūta iti | eṣa vāva sa sāvitraḥ | ya eṣa tapati | ehi māṃ viddhi | iti haivainaṃ taduvāca
meaning: तदेतत्परि यद्देवचक्रम् । आर्द्रं पिन्वमानं स्वर्गे लोक एति । विजहद्विश्वा भूतानि संपश्यत् । आर्द्रो ह वै पिन्वमानः स्वर्गे लोक एति । विजहन्विश्वा भूतानि संपश्यन् । य एवं वेद । शूषो ह वै वार्ष्णेयः । आदित्येन समाजगाम । तं होवाच । एहि सावित्रं विद्धि । अयं वै स्वर्ग्योऽग्निः पारयिष्णुरमृताथ्संभूत इति । एष वाव स सावित्रः । य एष तपति । एहि मां विद्धि । इति हैवैनं तदुवाच
text_mt: That wheel of the gods, moving around, / moist and swelling, goes in the heavenly realm, / leaving all beings behind, beholding [them]. / Moist and swelling, he goes in the heavenly realm, / leaving all beings behind, beholding [them], / who knows thus. / Śūṣa Vārṣṇeya / met with Āditya. / He said to him: / "Come, know the Sāvitra [fire]; / this indeed is the heavenly Agni, transporting across, born from the immortal." / This one indeed is that Sāvitra [fire] / who shines here. / "Come, know me!" / — thus indeed he said to him then.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vāva saraghā | tasyā agnireva sāraghaṃ madhu | yā etāḥ pūrvapakṣāparapakṣayo rātrayaḥ | tā madhukṛtaḥ | yānyahāni | te madhuvṛṣāḥ | sa yo ha vā etā madhukṛtaśca madhuvṛṣāṃśca veda | kurvanti hāsyaitā agnau madhu | nāsyeṣṭāpūrtaṃ dhayanti | atha yo na veda
meaning: इयं वाव सरघा । तस्या अग्निरेव सारघं मधु । या एताः पूर्वपक्षापरपक्षयो रात्रयः । ता मधुकृतः । यान्यहानि । ते मधुवृषाः । स यो ह वा एता मधुकृतश्च मधुवृषांश्च वेद । कुर्वन्ति हास्यैता अग्नौ मधु । नास्येष्टापूर्तं धयन्ति । अथ यो न वेद
text_mt: This [earth] indeed is a queen bee; / her wild honey is Agni alone. / Those nights of the waxing fortnight and waning fortnight, / they are the honey-makers; / the days, / they are the honey-drones. / He who knows these honey-makers and honey-drones, / they make honey for him in the fire; / they do not suck away his sacrificial and charitable works. / Now, he who does not know [them],

sanskrit_iast: na hāsyaitā agnau madhu kurvanti | dhayantyasyeṣṭāpūrtam | yo ha vā ahorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni veda | nāhorātreṣvārtimārcchati | saṃjñānaṃ vijñānaṃ darśā dṛṣṭeti | etāvanuvākau pūrvapakṣasyāhorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ sutā sunvatīti | etāvanuvākāvaparapakṣasyāhorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni | nāhorātreṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: न हास्यैता अग्नौ मधु कुर्वन्ति । धयन्त्यस्येष्टापूर्तम् । यो ह वा अहोरात्राणां नामधेयानि वेद । नाहोरात्रेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । संज्ञानं विज्ञानं दर्शा दृष्टेति । एतावनुवाकौ पूर्वपक्षस्याहोरात्राणां नामधेयानि । प्रस्तुतं विष्टुतं सुता सुन्वतीति । एतावनुवाकावपरपक्षस्याहोरात्राणां नामधेयानि । नाहोरात्रेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद
text_mt: they do not make honey for him in the fire; / they suck out his accrued merit. / Whoever knows the names of the days and nights / does not incur misfortune among the days and nights. / 'Consciousness, discernment, new-moon night, seen night' — / these two anuvākas are the names of the days and nights of the bright fortnight. / 'Praised, separated, pressed, pressing' — / these two anuvākas are the names of the days and nights of the dark fortnight. / He does not incur misfortune among the days and nights, / who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: yo ha vai muhūrtānāṃ nāmadheyāni veda | na muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati | citraḥ keturdātā pradātā savitā prasavitā'bhiśāstā'numanteti | ete'nuvākā muhūrtānāṃ nāmadheyāni | na muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vā ardhamāsānāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca nāmadheyāni veda | nārdhamāseṣu na māseṣvārtimārcchati | pavitraṃ paviyiṣyanthsahasvānthsahīyānaruṇo'ruṇarajā iti | ete'nuvākā ardhamāsānāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca nāmadheyāni
meaning: यो ह वै मुहूर्तानां नामधेयानि वेद । न मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । चित्रः केतुर्दाता प्रदाता सविता प्रसविताऽभिशास्ताऽनुमन्तेति । एतेऽनुवाका मुहूर्तानां नामधेयानि । न मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । यो ह वा अर्धमासानां च मासानां च नामधेयानि वेद । नार्धमासेषु न मासेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । पवित्रं पवियिष्यन्थ्सहस्वान्थ्सहीयानरुणोऽरुणरजा इति । एतेऽनुवाका अर्धमासानां च मासानां च नामधेयानि
text_mt:
Whoever knows the names of the muhūrtas / does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas. / 'Bright, beacon, giver, bestower, stimulator, instigator, commander, consenter' — / these anuvākas are the names of the muhūrtas. / He does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas, / who knows thus. / Whoever knows the names of the half-months and of the months / does not incur misfortune among the half-months nor among the months. / 'Purifier, about to purify, mighty, mightier, reddish, reddish-dust' — / these anuvākas are the names of the half-months and of the months.

He does not incur misfortune among the half-months nor among the months, / who knows thus. / Whoever knows the names of the sacrificial rites, and of the seasons, and of the year / does not incur misfortune among the sacrificial rites, nor among the seasons, nor in the year. / 'Agniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Agni is the season, Prajāpati is the year' — / these anuvākas are the names of the sacrificial rites, and of the seasons, and of the year. / He does not incur misfortune among the sacrificial rites, nor among the seasons, nor in the year, / who knows thus. / Whoever knows the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas / does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas.

sanskrit_iast: nārdhamāseṣu na māseṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vai yajñakratūnāṃ cartūnāṃ ca saṃvathsarasya ca nāmadheyāni veda | na yajñakratuṣu nartuṣu na saṃvathsara ārtimārcchati | agniṣṭoma ukthyo'gnir ṛtuḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃvathsara iti | ete'nuvākā yajñakratūnāṃ cartūnāṃ ca saṃvathsarasya ca nāmadheyāni | na yajñakratuṣu nartuṣu na saṃvathsara ārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vai muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtān veda | na muhūrtānāṃ muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati |
meaning: नार्धमासेषु न मासेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । यो ह वै यज्ञक्रतूनां चर्तूनां च संवथ्सरस्य च नामधेयानि वेद । न यज्ञक्रतुषु नर्तुषु न संवथ्सर आर्तिमार्च्छति । अग्निष्टोम उक्थ्योऽग्निर् ऋतुः प्रजापतिः संवथ्सर इति । एतेऽनुवाका यज्ञक्रतूनां चर्तूनां च संवथ्सरस्य च नामधेयानि । न यज्ञक्रतुषु नर्तुषु न संवथ्सर आर्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । यो ह वै मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्तान् वेद । न मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति ।

sanskrit_iast: idānīṃ tadānīmiti | ete vai muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtāḥ | na muhūrtānāṃ muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | atho yathā kṣetrajño bhūtvā'nu praviśyānnamatti | evamevaitān kṣetrajño bhūtvā'nu praviśyānnamatti | sa eteṣāmeva salokatāṃ sāyujyamaśnute | apa punarmṛtyuṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: इदानीं तदानीमिति । एते वै मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्ताः । न मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । अथो यथा क्षेत्रज्ञो भूत्वाऽनु प्रविश्यान्नमत्ति । एवमेवैतान् क्षेत्रज्ञो भूत्वाऽनु प्रविश्यान्नमत्ति । स एतेषामेव सलोकतां सायुज्यमश्नुते । अप पुनर्मृत्युं जयति । य एवं वेद
text_mt: 'Now, then' — / these are the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas. / He does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas, / who knows thus. / And just as one who knows the field, having entered, eats food, / even so he, knowing the field, having entered these, eats food. / He attains unison and co-residence with them. / He wards off re-death, / who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: kaściddha vā asmāllokātpretya | ātmānaṃ veda | ayamahamasmīti | kaścithsvaṃ lokaṃ na prati prajānāti | agnimugdho haiva dhūmatāntaḥ | svaṃ lokaṃ na prati prajānāti | atha yo haivaitamagniṃ sāvitraṃ veda | sa evāsmāllokātpretya | ātmānaṃ veda | ayamahamasmīti
meaning: कश्चिद्ध वा अस्माल्लोकात्प्रेत्य । आत्मानं वेद । अयमहमस्मीति । कश्चिथ्स्वं लोकं न प्रति प्रजानाति । अग्निमुग्धो हैव धूमतान्तः । स्वं लोकं न प्रति प्रजानाति । अथ यो हैवैतमग्निं सावित्रं वेद । स एवास्माल्लोकात्प्रेत्य । आत्मानं वेद । अयमहमस्मीति
text_mt: A certain one, having departed from this world, / knows himself: / 'This am I.' / Another does not recognize his own world. / Deluded by fire, overcome with smoke, / he does not recognize his own world. / But whoever knows this Sāvitra fire, / he, having departed from this world, / knows himself: / 'This am I.'

sanskrit_iast: sa svaṃ lokaṃ pratiprajānāti | eṣa u vevainaṃ tathsāvitraḥ | svargaṃ lokamabhivahati | ahorātrairvā idaṃ sayugbhiḥ kriyate | itirātrāyādīkṣiṣata | itirātrāya vratamupāguriti | tānihānevaṃ viduṣaḥ | amuṣmiṃ lloke śevadhiṃ dhayanti | dhītaṃ haiva sa śevadhimanu paraiti | atha yo haivaitamagniṃ sāvitraṃ veda
meaning: स स्वं लोकं प्रतिप्रजानाति । एष उ वेवैनं तथ्सावित्रः । स्वर्गं लोकमभिवहति । अहोरात्रैर्वा इदं सयुग्भिः क्रियते । इतिरात्रायादीक्षिषत । इतिरात्राय व्रतमुपागुरिति । तानिहानेवं विदुषः । अमुष्मिं ल्लोके शेवधिं धयन्ति । धीतं हैव स शेवधिमनु परैति । अथ यो हैवैतमग्निं सावित्रं वेद
text_mt: He recognizes his own world. / And this Sāvitra [fire] / carries him up to the heavenly realm. / By the days and nights joined together this is done: / 'They were consecrated for this night; / they have undertaken the vow for this night.' / For him who does not know thus, / they suck out his treasure in yonder world. / Sucked dry, he follows after that treasure. / But he who knows this Sāvitra fire —

sanskrit_iast: tasya haivāhorātrāṇi | amuṣmiṃ lloke śevadhiṃ na dhayanti | adhītaṃ haiva sa śevadhimanu paraiti | bharadvājo ha tribhirāyurbhirbrahmacaryamuvāsa | taṃ ha jīrṇiṃ sthaviraṃ śayānam | indra upa vrajyovāca | bharadvāja | yatte caturthamāyurdadyām | kimenena kuryā iti | brahmacaryamevainena careyamiti hovāca
meaning: तस्य हैवाहोरात्राणि । अमुष्मिं ल्लोके शेवधिं न धयन्ति । अधीतं हैव स शेवधिमनु परैति । भरद्वाजो ह त्रिभिरायुर्भिर्ब्रह्मचर्यमुवास । तं ह जीर्णिं स्थविरं शयानम् । इन्द्र उप व्रज्योवाच । भरद्वाज । यत्ते चतुर्थमायुर्दद्याम् । किमेनेन कुर्या इति । ब्रह्मचर्यमेवैनेन चरेयमिति होवाच
text_mt: the days and nights / do not suck out his treasure in yonder world. / Unsucked, he follows after that treasure. / Bharadvāja lived in studenthood for three lifespans. / When he was lying decrepit and aged, / Indra approached and said: / 'Bharadvāja, / if I were to give you a fourth lifespan, / what would you do with it?' / 'I would just practice studenthood with it,' he said.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ ha trīngirirūpānavijñātāniva darśayāṃcakāra | teṣāṃ haikaikasmānmuṣṭinā''dade | sa hovāca | bharadvājetyāmantrya | vedā vā ete | anantā vai vedāḥ | etadvā etaistribhirāyurbhiranvavocathāḥ | atha ta itaradananūktameva | ehīmaṃ viddhi | ayaṃ vai sarvavidyeti
meaning: तं ह त्रीन्गिरिरूपानविज्ञातानिव दर्शयांचकार । तेषां हैकैकस्मान्मुष्टिना'ऽददे । स होवाच । भरद्वाजेत्यामन्त्र्य । वेदा वा एते । अनन्ता वै वेदाः । एतद्वा एतैस्त्रिभिरायुर्भिरन्ववोचथाः । अथ त इतरदननूक्तमेव । एहीमं विद्धि । अयं वै सर्वविद्येति
text_mt: He showed him three unknown things, as it were, shaped like mountains. / From each one of them he took a handful. / He said, / addressing him: 'Bharadvāja, / these are the Vedas! / Boundless, indeed, are the Vedas! / This is what you have recited through those three lifespans, / and the rest of yours is just unstudied! / Come, know this: / this is all-knowledge!'

sanskrit_iast: tasmai haitamagniṃ sāvitramuvāca | taṃ sa viditvā | amṛto bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokamiyāya | ādityasya sāyujyam | amṛto haiva bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokameti | ādityasya sāyujyam | ya evaṃ veda | eṣo eva trayī vidyā
meaning: तस्मै हैतमग्निं सावित्रमुवाच । तं स विदित्वा । अमृतो भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमियाय । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । अमृतो हैव भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमेति । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । य एवं वेद । एषो एव त्रयी विद्या
text_mt: He declared this Sāvitra fire to him. / Having known it, / having become immortal, / he went to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya. / Having become immortal, / he goes to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya, / who knows thus. / This is indeed the threefold knowledge.

sanskrit_iast: yāvantaṃ ha vai trayyā vidyayā lokaṃ jayati | tāvantaṃ lokaṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda | agnervā etāni nāmadheyāni | agnereva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | vāyorvā etāni nāmadheyāni | vāyoreva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | indrasya vā etāni nāmadheyāni
meaning: यावन्तं ह वै त्रय्या विद्यया लोकं जयति । तावन्तं लोकं जयति । य एवं वेद । अग्नेर्वा एतानि नामधेयानि । अग्नेरेव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । वायोर्वा एतानि नामधेयानि । वायोरेव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । इन्द्रस्य वा एतानि नामधेयानि
text_mt:
As great a world as one wins by the threefold knowledge, / that great a world he wins, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Agni; / he attains unison and co-residence with Agni, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Vāyu; / he attains unison and co-residence with Vāyu, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Indra;

he attains unison and co-residence with Indra, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Bṛhaspati; / he attains unison and co-residence with Bṛhaspati, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Prajāpati; / he attains unison and co-residence with Prajāpati, / who knows thus. / These are the names of brahman; / he attains unison and co-residence with brahman, / who knows thus. / That fire, wingless and tailless, is Vāyu himself; / Agni is its mouth; / yonder Āditya is its head. / Because it sews together all that is between these two deities, / therefore it is Sāvitra.
